product_title: Buffalo Bills 18oz Western Cut Big Slab Beef Jerky (15 beef jerky slabs per bag) - Available in 5 Flavors
review_body:
UPDATE 4/17/14:
Not impressed. My original review was 3 stars, for the reasons below. After having this for a couple of weeks (received 3/29/14), I am rating down to 2 stars. I would give it 1, but I think it earns an extra star for novelty. Last week I noticed the jerky seemed to have a different flavor, but I couldn't quite pinpoint what it was... When I opened the bag last night, it had definitely spoiled.

I store my jerky in closed ziploc bags. This method works great and keeps the jerky from drying out. Never had a problem before, so I'm not sure what happened here... There is an unusual amount of fat on this jerky. Wild Bill's and Buffalo Bill's are just beef, but this is literally a shaved slice of meat, and there are veins of fat and gristle that run through the slabs. Maybe those deposits played a factor and caused the jerky to spoil? I would recommend eating very quickly (less than 14 days) or refrigerating...

Previous Review:
Not too shabby... It was interesting. The texture was softer, not as tough and chewy as WB's or BB's, which I prefer. To me, it was similar to the texture you would get in Jack Link's original jerky... The taste is similar too--I would rate this one higher, but it's a tight margin. For the record, I tried Buffalo Bill's Original flavor.

Overall, it was fun to eat a sheet of beef jerky, so I guess the novelty factor wins out here. I probably wouldn't buy again--Wild Bill's is just too good! :)

product_title: Premium Madagascar Vanilla Beans 1/4 lb (26-30 beans) JR Mushrooms Brand
review_headline: Great product and even greater customer service!
review_body:
I initially wrote a negative review (since deleted ... read on) after the beans started to grow mold after a few weeks despite following the instructions on the package of NOT putting them into the freezer, but keeping them in a dark, dry place - our pantry.

YES, they did smell GREAT when opening the package. YES, you get much more/much higher quality beans for less than at your local store. But the mold was a bummer.

Even though I posted the review, I figured I'll give them at least a chance to make amends by contacting their customer service team.

I didn't expect much of a reply based on other reviewers here and the fact that I placed the order well over 30 days earlier.

I was AMAZED at the response I received!

Not just did they reply in a very short time, but even offered to REPLACE MY PRODUCT! WOW!

Regarding the mold-issue I learned that
- their vanilla beans are much fresher than other products (and not dried or put in preservatives), thus they should be used up rather soon after opening the bag
- freezing them isn't recommended since it can influence they aroma of the beans (read: they loose much of their flavor if frozen!)
- the best way to keep them fresh if not used up within a month is to put them in the refrigerator (or make your own vanilla extract by putting them in alcohol)

Again: It's rare to find a company that stands behind their products like JR Mushroom does! The beans DO fill the whole kitchen with vanilla scent after opening the package, and they are VERY FRESH, not dried at all! PLUS: Their customer service makes it a no-brainer as to who I'd place my next order with! You can't go wrong with these guys!

review_headline: This has become my standard "go-to" hot sauce......
review_body:
The Bufalo brand hot sauce has become my favorite day-to-day hot sauce ever since I found it lurking on the shelf at my local supermarket. I like it better than any of the other brands that I have tried. The use of carrots and sugar in the sauce gives it a robust hot-sweet tang that is unique in a store bought sauce. review_body:

So save yourself some trouble and look into crazy about cookies product (http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00AML5UV6/ref=oh_details_o02_s00_i00?ie=UTF8&psc=1) as they are by far my favorite and you can choose to eat it as cookie dough, freshly baked, or store them for later.

product_title: Mole Poblano Paste, 1 Kg Brick
review_headline: Fine Product for New Comers to Mole
review_body: Delivered efficiently and at an economical cost, this mole paste was easy to prepare, delicious and satisfying. While probably not any better than Dona Maria (which is QUITE good, btw), it was MUCH less expensive (you save on shipping, not on per-pound cost). For the timid just starting with mole, it's not too spicy and not too "hot" - but has an authentic flavor, none-the-less. I chopped the 1 kg brick into four equal hunks (about 8 OZ each) and kept them in my fridge until I needed them. Standard "reconstitution" from paste to sauce through addition of 2 - 3 cups chicken stock (or even water) worked easily; though stirring is required throughout the "rehydration" phase - begin by gently heating and crushing the paste in your skillet, then add only one cup of fluid at a time. A quarter piece of the brick provided sufficient rehydrated sauce to amply flavor 4 -5 pounds of boneless chicken. Adelante!

product_title: Davidson's Tea Apricot
review_headline: Love it! I brew it to drink everyday!
review_body:
Hibiscus tea is so very good for your blood pressure. I brew up a batch to chill as iced tea to drink throughout the day. The flavor is similar to cranberry juice, only a little lighter. It's been called \\"Sour Tea\\". Recent studies have shown it has diuretic properties, it opens up arteries and is a natural ACE inhibitor, which means it slows the release of hormones that constrict blood vessels. My source for this info is from an article in Mother Earth News by Michael Castleman Oct/Nov 2011. However I've come across a number of encouraging articles on the benefits of Hibiscus Tea. Another source is The Health Ranger, Mike Adams on naturalnews.com.

This tea is an everyday staple for me. I have it delivered on Amazon's auto ship program.
Another bonus: The left over tea bags are fun to use in fabric and paper dyeing crafts too! Great color!

Enjoy, and be well.
Elaine Beckwith

product_title: Dr. Fuhrman's Supreme Greens Soup (case of 12)
review_headline: A wonderful demonstration of a nutritarian recipe. Just perfect.
review_body:
I love this soup! Very creamy and rich flavors. And this is an amazingly healthy food, without unnecessary ingredients which detract from its healthfulness. It's a wonderful demonstration of a delicious nutritarian recipe.

To the reviewer who disliked the taste, I would say that there really is something to the idea of an "acquired taste." (That's not just an expression). It can take about a dozen tries before new tastes become appealing. THAT's WHY this comes in cases of 12. :-) Healthy nutritious foods are delicious. And once you get off all the added salt in processed foods, you start tasting the salt in unrefined whole foods, plus all the flavors which were hiding underneath all that added salt.

product_title: Good Earth Green Tea 4 Flavor Variety Pack, 18 Count Tea Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body:
I used to love Good Earth tea, they were my favorite brand. I love the use of fruit oils to flavor tea and give it a natural sweetness. However, now they added stevia to their teas. These new flavors are over the top sweet. I like to add honey or sugar to my tea, but this tea is over the top, tastes like cheap candy, sweet before adding anything. If you iced this tea and gave it to someone to taste I really don't think they would even be able to tell it's tea. It tastes more like an energy drink.

I also don't like the number of ingredients, and seeing weird ingredients. The pomegranate flavor has corn starch in it!

If you really don't like tea, like really sweet things, and want to drink tea because it's healthy or you just don't like coffee, then maybe you would like this. Otherwise there's nothing enjoyable about any of these flavors.

review_headline: Terrific sampler with many flavors I had not tried.
review_body:
The 12 K-cup Variety CAFE ESCAPES Keurig K-cup Sample pack was encloses in my last order of coffee K-Cups from Keurig. I am a coffee drinker - 3-4 cups per day, dark with a bit of sugar and evaporated milk. I don't much care for tea, except for some herbal infusions like chamomile. I have a Keurig coffee machine, (Elite Brewing System). Actually one can make other beverages using this same machine...but I have only used it for making my daily cups of java.

I tried each beverage sample. They were all good - but when I tasted Chai Latte I was totally Wowed(!!)...not being too dramatic here...this is now my favorite morning beverage. It's good for an afternoon pick-me-up too. The flavor is truly delicious.

Chai Latte is a blend of savory, exotic spices and black tea, accompanied by milk and a blend of natural and artificial sweeteners. There are overtones of cinnamon, so if you like that spice, you will definitely enjoy this drink. A plus is that this chai is low in sugar. I know that some reviewers have complained that the taste is too sweet. This has not been my experience. I highly recommend this chai and hope you enjoy it as much as I do

The other Cafe Escapes included in the sampler: Cafe Mocha, Cafe Caramel, Cafe Vanilla, Milk Chocolate Cocoa, Dark Chocolate Cocoa, are all very good and all seem to be lattes....but my favorite, Chai Latte, is outstanding! Excellent for the discriminating palate.

If your Keurig order doesn't come with this sampler, you can always get one from Amazon.
JANA

product_title: Teisseire French Syrup Orgeat Syrup (almond) 20.3fl.oz
review_body:
I have only used this product for mai tais and other tiki-style drinks. This product has quite a few good reviews, but it appears most reflect its use in coffee and one may not be able to distinguish between quality orgeats that way. If this is all you can get your hands on, it will do. However, there are better options.
I would classify this as having a kick on the nose, as if all the flavor is introduced by using almond extract. However, their is no depth of flavor or "lusciousness" once in the mouth. Not a good choice for cocktails, in my opinion.
For comparison:
I have also tried Small Hands Foods, B.G. Reynolds and Monin. The first two are great and have a very nice mouth feel. I think Reynolds uses gomme syrup to enhance that. The first two are also listing quality ingredients (like ALMONDS), not "flavorings." That being said, I really like the Monin. It's a bit sweeter than Reynolds, but that allows me to skip the addition of a quarter ounce of simple syrup in my mai tais. And I find the difference in flavor between the three (which is quite apparent neat), to be so small as nearly indiscernible after mixing it in the drink. I can, however, recognize the use of teisseire, and do not recommend it. The real test would be to make a mai tai with each of these at the same time and blind taste test (I'm too lazy; someone else post that one please). Someone else (? professor cocktail) has taste tested and posted online descriptions of the products tasted neat (and liked the teisseire), but that's not very helpful if it doesn't correlate with your end use.
So depending on your use, you could get away with the cheaper Monin if it doesn't become too sweet for your drink. Reynolds and Small Hands are the premium products, though.

product_title: Community Coffee Cafe Special Decaffeinated Instant Coffee 7-Ounce Jars (Pack of 4)
review_headline: watery flavor; burnt smell; product of Mexico!!!
review_body:
This coffee is both a horrible product and the Amazon ad is very misleading. I purchased it despite the mixed reviews, because I wanted to support a small Louisiana company. After all, the Amazon ad says:

Community Coffee Company has sold the finest, fresh-roasted premium coffee in Louisiana since 1919
Now, you can taste the genuine flavor of New Orleans from anywhere in the world
Community Coffee Company Baton Rouge, LA

When it came in, I smelled the crystals and they smelled burnt; there was no coffee aroma. I made some coffee with it and it was like water. Then I made it stronger, and it just tasted like burned water. However, even at that point, I was not going to complain. However, then I saw that it is a PRODUCT OF MEXICO.

I admit that if you peer at the photo of the side of the container, it discloses that it is a \\"product of Mexico.\\" However, the Amazon product description does nothing to suggest this. I usually look for country of origin, but for once I didn't, because I was so certain - given the ad info - that it was a Louisiana product.

I have been misled, and want to return this horrible product. According to Amazon, this product is \\"not eligible for returns.\\" Excuse me, but on the side of the container it reads: \\"We unconditionally guarantee your satisfaction.\\" So how am I going to have this promise made good? Am I supposed to ship it BACK TO MEXICO???? Ooops, guess not; there is no Mexican address on the label - just an incomplete Baton Rouge address. Amazon carries this stuff; it is in THEIR warehouse; THEY are the ones who should be making good on the guarantee.

review_body:

I've been ordering these capsules for several months now and CBTL capsules for over a year. My latest order arrived and one of the boxes had an expiration date of 5/15/13. The other box had a label in that spot and the exp date was listed as 9/4/14. I peeled the label off and the real exp date was 5/15/13. I e-mailed amazon and they told me that CBTL decided capsules were good for 24 months instead of 18 and so both boxes were still good. Apparently they're not good at math, because this is January of 2014. Even with the additional 6 months the capsules were still expired. They said they would refund me the money for the box that wasn't re-labeled but not the box with the covered up exp date. I'm DONE ordering these from amazon.

When calculating cost, it is the same cost for me as a Prime member to have it shipped to me as to pick it up at my local Wal-Mart (who doesn't carry the DIET brand - criminal!). The SodaStream doesn't save you LOADS of money all at once...a few pennies here and there compared to canned sodas, so the cost of buying one takes a while to recoup UNLESS you drink a lot of soda. We have 4 teens in the house, so we go through so much soda that we truly DO save.

What you do save is SPACE! I no longer have boxes and cans lining my laundry area for me to trip over.

All that said - you could save about the same amount buying generic sodas (trust me, I have tried), but this tastes better AND saves you the space.

product_title: Blair's Mega Death Hot Sauce with Liquid Fury and Skull Key Chain, 5 Ounce
review_body:
So my dad bought this for me one Christmas, like 4 or 5 years ago, and I've loved this stuff ever since. If you like hot sauces, like pranking your friends, and like really awesome-looking free skull key chains, then I recommend this sauce to anyone brave enough to get it. (I still remember the first food I tried it on and ruined the whole bowl, it was my my family's red beans and rice. I put like a teaspoon full in the bowl and mixed it up and tried to eat it. The first bite was excruciating, the second bite made me sick to my stomach it was so hot. After that, I had to watch how much I put in my foods, but thus began my love affair with Mega Death.)

Where do I start with this? It tastes great. All the ingredients are natural. It's super hot. The Scoville rating on this thing is like 250,000 units. I put one drop in a bowl of anything to get a little heat, and then I don't have to worry about anyone messing with my food. lol. (In fact, it says on the bottle that it's over 500 times hotter than a jalapeno chili, and to dilute. Not with water, but what better way than in food?) I'll put 2 drops in if I really want a sweat fest. I never go over that, though. Too much of this stuff can be detrimental to your health, but that's part of what makes it awesome. It goes great in ramen, gumbo, red beans and rice, chili, stew, soups, homemade sauces, hot wings, mexican dishes, etc., etc.

And that's another great thing about this sauce, since you don't use but maybe a drop or two per dish, it will last you forever. Mine could probably last me well over a year, as long as someone doesn't steal it, or the bottle gets lost, or falls off the refrigerator like my last one did. Which sucked, because either I have to order it on Amazon or I have to drive from the Mississippi coast over to the New Orleans/Slidell area of Louisiana to get more. Now that's a fun experience in itself, but it's just easier and cheaper to order it on here. I don't have to drive, and I save money on gas. lol.

Oh, and it also comes in the really awesome coffin box, and with a free skull keychain, with the Blair's name permanently inked on its forehead. I could be called the bone collector, I have so many of these skulls hanging off my keychain. lol. But seriously, if you love hot stuff, or you love to mess with your friends, buy this. You will not be disappointed. And you WILL "Feel Alive!"save money on gas. lol.

Oh, and it also comes in the really awesome coffin box, and with a free skull keychain, with the Blair's name permanently inked on its forehead. I could be called the bone collector, I have so many of these skulls hanging off my keychain. lol. But seriously, if you love hot stuff, or you love to mess with your friends, buy this. You will not be disappointed. And you WILL "Feel Alive!"

review_body: Delicious coffee!  I was pleased with this coffee, even though it is decaffeinated, it is tasty.  I especially like it because I can use my French press to brew it and I drink it black.

product_title: Domatcha Green Tea, Organic Matcha, 1.0-ounce Tin
review_headline: This Is Matcha That's Made For Drinking Like A Boss
review_body:
I tried the cheaper matchas first. I admit it. My bad.

They tasted like hay and alfalfa left in the sun to rot after a rainstorm.

They tasted like ditch grass mowed and then picked up by chaingang workers in orange jumpsuits.

This Ceremonial Grade matcha was made to sip and enjoy.

I don't need to add anything to my cup, not even honey.

If you have no idea what Umami is, buy this and you will.

I also put just a little dab in my water bottle when I leave home in the morning and sip on it all day. Even unbrewed, it's dang fine.

This stuff is a 10. The cheap crap is a 2.5.

review_body:

product_title: Andes Crème De Menthe Thins, 120 Individually Wrapped Chocolates in a Gift Box
review_headline: Delicious but pricy - a few other notes
review_body: I love Andes mints and so does my whole family.  I bought this as a gift for my wife and it met all my expectations.  The candies are delicious and its packaged nicely.  However, there are a few things to keep in mind.  One is that these are chocolates, so they can melt.  If you order these and they end up on your porch in the summer, they may be melted before you can get them.  Secondly, they do come in a gift box, but beware that the sellers slap a product label on the end of the box, so it clearly says whats inside.  This is undesirable in a gift box, and its a sticky label too so it doesn't always come off nicely.  I can't find these in this quantity anywhere locally to me, so I order them online.  Its a bit pricy, but they are so good!  Just be aware of those few little things and you'll be fine if you are willing to spend the money.

I have to tell you that that cup was the most incredible cup of earl grey tea I had ever known (and it was the decaf, mind you). The aroma of this tea is so amazing, perfumed as it is with the most vibrant bergamot and botanicals. The base tea leaf also shines through in a way that foods that contain fig leaf, for example, maintain that figgy flavor (of course this tea does not contain fig leaves--I am just making a comparison with another leaf whose presence is always obvious). The taste is layered and beautiful, and not at all bitter, as I had found other earl grey teas to be. The decaf is amazing even on its own, and the regular I have been able to enjoy with a bit of milk and honey. I enjoy both thoroughly, and HIGHLY recommend them. "Lipid coated viruses" is a pretty big class, including herpes viruses (that would be not only cold sores and genital herpes, but chicken pox and shingles), HIV, flu, a number of cancer-causing viruses, and Epstein-Barr. I first took BHT in the 1980s, when I was getting cold sores every few weeks. I took 500 mgs per day for a year, and haven't had a cold sore since.

review_headline: Don't Care If It Has Sucralose
review_body: All I know is that this tastes good to me.  My Keurig coffee maker has a feature where I can choose what size cup I want, from 3.25 to 11.25 ounces.  I had to experiment with the sizes. product_title: MW Polar Nayural Tuna
review_body: Polar started our with the excellent Yellowfin Tuna Steak, 6 oz of solid light tuna - 48 cans for about $75 and almost no brine. Next came the 6 oz pack of Yellowfin chunk light tuna, 48 cans for about $65, another very good product but not up to the quality we'd come to expect for the Yellowfin Steak. Now we have this relatively mediocre chunk light tuna and only 5 oz, at 48 cans for $63.91, almost as much as we paid for the good stuff. So we used to get 288 oz of solid tuna, then 288 oz of chunk tuna (~20% water) and now only 240 oz (~30 water).  Do the math: 70% x 240 oz/288 = ~60%. So we now pay 85% of the price for only 60% of the tuna.

product_title: Hapi Hot Wasabi Peas, 9.9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)
review_body: As soon as I heard on Dr. Oz that wasabi makes cancer cells commit suicide, I bought four cans of these. I have given cans to my Dad, my brother, my girlfriend's Mom, her husband, etc. They are easy to eat and always fresh. BUT...this is what I've found out since. The wasabi we get here in America is NOT real wasabi (which causes cancer cells to commit suicide). Here in America, the only wasabi we can get is actually \\"artificially colored horseradish\\", and the artificial colorings used in it are known carcinogenics (they GIVE you cancer). The Green and Yellow food coloring. So, wasabi in America GIVES you cancer, and Wasabia Japonica from the orient KILLS your cancer. HUGE Difference. The REAL stuff is not WASABI (contents: horseradish or mustard), it's WASABIA JAPONICA (contents: wasabia japonica). And it's not available in America for some reason, even tho proven university studies show that it cures cancer. Dr. Oz was WAY OFF on this one.

product_title: Special K Cereal, Protein 13.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Good for high protein diets, questions about excessive soy consumption remain
review_body: This cereal along with Kashi GoLean have the highest concentrations of protein in commonly available cereals.  They also represent a good value in terms of cost per gram of soy.  That being said, there is some mixed medical research on consumption of large amounts of soy-based products in that soy mimics certain hormones like estrogen. For a strength athlete consuming 200+ grams of protein per day, this might be an issue. While I enjoy the taste of this cereal, I have decided to limit my consumption to normal levels and get more protein from rice protein powder and other products.

product_title: TruffleHunter White Truffle Oil (3.38 Oz)
review_body:
After having had (several times) a true white truffle risotto at the restaurant I used to work at, I went on a mission to duplicate the flavor without duplicating the price. I knew right off the bat that truffle shavings were not within my budget. Unfortunately, most of the oils that I tried were either weak, chemically tasting, or smelled bad. I found a couple that were just ok, but that wasn't really what I was going for. I don't remember who suggested this product, but suffice to say my search is over. I LOVE LOVE LOVE this stuff, and am never without it in my house. Even my wife who generally doesn't like truffles as much as I do is quick to remind me to order more when our bottle is getting low. Buy it. Love it. Done.

Not sure about some of the reviews on here saying that this oil isn't powerful. I have never used more than a drizzle, and the flavor and aroma come through even the most complex dish. If you a few drops and you can allow the flavor to be present, but completely meld with the other flavors of the dish, adding that little extra something that is almost unrecognizable.

review_headline: I am able to enjoy my favorite childhood snack once again!
review_body:
Arrived direct from London so the shipping took a bit longer, which is to be expected. The box it came in was sturdy and the crisps arrived undamaged. The expiration date was 3 months away, something I wouldn't typically see for overseas items purchased locally. When my supply runs low I will definately be a repeat customer.

As for the crisps ... to Americans I would describe them as having a texture similiar to Funyuns. The flavors are different than anything we have here - they're savory, salty, and full of flavor. My favorite is probably the roast beef. As I child I remember liking one with bacon but wikipedia says that one has been discontinued. Bummer!

review_body:

Update:
So the super market bonsai died :( and I use the larger pot for the plant from this kit. The tree is a little small, but it will grow.

product_title: 16 Count - Barista Prima Coffeehouse VARIETY PACK ~ ITALIAN ROAST, FRENCH ROAST, HOUSE BLEND & COLOMBIA For KEURIG BREWERS

However, I found that Barista Prima's variety definitely brews much stronger than most other brands (especially their French & Italian roasts). Yummy! I often stick to the Colombian brew for afternoon coffee breaks .. as it is 'slightly' lighter .. but still very pleasant.

I may subscribe to regular shipments of these!

product_title: Pure Himalayan Salt Rocks 2-4 inches 5 Pounds
review_body:
I use these in my salt lamps. I use ordinary night light bulbs in a deep glass dishes, and the 7-watt bulbs light the salt rocks beautifully. I also feel it warms them enough to help ionize the air in each room. I have noticed a big difference in my allergies since I set up a salt rock lamp in each room.

These salt chunks arrived in a range of color from dark amber to pale pink (almost white). Incidentally, the rocks closest to the heat source (even a night light bulb) will become whiter over time. The effect of the light shining beneath the salt chunks creates a gorgeous golden glow. The light becomes the warm visual focus of any room.

product_title: Amoretti Premium Syrup, Coconut Cream, 25.4 Ounce
review_body:
The flavor is very subtle, some might even say that it's a little on the weak side. However it does have the authentic flavor, and aroma, of Coconut. Providing an enjoyable taste treat. The subtleness of the flavor creates the effect of a tantalizing taste tease.

As with all flavors of Amoretti brand syrup. It's best to do a little trial and error type of experimentation. To determine the ideal amount of syrup to use, to suit your own taste. I start with 1 full pump into a 10 ounce glass of Ice water. Then I increase the amount of syrup by additional half pumps, until I get it as good as possible. In this case, I found that 2 full pumps works best. Increasing the amount of syrup beyond 2 full pumps did not make the flavor any stronger, or otherwise improve the taste. Adding more than 2 pumps only served to make it sweeter, but not better.

I have now tried a total of 6 different flavors of Amoretti brand syrup, with an additional flavor on its way to me. Each bottle of syrup comes in its own box, packaged together with a pump. The pump is very convenient, when it actually works. However, of the six different bottles of syrup that I have tried, so far. 2 of the 6 pumps were broken, and useless. -

Each bottle of boxed syrup also has a Coupon included inside of the box. The Coupon states that it is good for a 20% discount on a re-order. All of the Coupons have the same Coupon code number of VX85VPBH and there isn't any expiration date on the coupon. I would like to re-order a couple of the Amoretti Brand flavors that I have enjoyed. However, when I tried to re-order, and entered the coupon code number as instructed. I received the screen message that the Coupon was not valid, and the discount was denied. -

I have rated this flavor syrup with 4 stars, because that's what the syrup itself deserves. I did NOT subtract any stars because of the bogus Coupons, or non working pumps. -

review_headline: Great health find for a respectable price
review_body: I am very happy with this product.  I have used chia seeds for several years as part of my regimen to keep a check on my cholesterol.  At the present time, my HDL, good cholesterol, is 93, the range being 5 - 86.  I like to especially incorporate chia seeds in my pancakes.  I try to make a healthy breakfast using chia seeds, flax meal, oatmeal, and multigrain pancake mix.  All I need to make one good size pancake, is a heaping tablespoon of this mix.  I add almost the same amount of warm water to make a watery mix and let it stand for five to ten minutes before cooking it..  The chia seeds absorb the water and make a nice fluffy mix. product_title: Intelligentsia House Blend - 12oz - Roasted Fresh To Order, Light Roast, Direct Trade, Whole Bean Coffee
review_body:
After having coffee prepared using the pour over method at Intelligentsia Coffee in Chicago and Alterra Coffee in Milwaukee I decided it's the best method for me. I was blown away by how good it was. Luckily, I'm in Chicago often and can pop into Intelligentsia for a pour over, an espresso, and beans on a regular basis.

Other brands like SB roast their coffee very dark and sell it past the two-three week window. It's too strong and bitter, for me, for a pour over. I can't drink it that way. Even with quantity and brewing adjustments the results are not to my liking. The new \\"blond roasts\\" yield much better results but still leave me wanting.

Alterra was bought by a large corporation, are no longer roasting at their original location, and are pushing some sort of pre packed office coffee. I went to collage in Milwaukee and they were my favorite. Actually, I don't think I really liked coffee until I had Alterra. Best espresso I can remember. Very fun place to hang out at too. Now Im weary. I did have an amazing pour over there a year ago, however.

Intelligentsia has a great app with their recomemded brewing methods. Their coffee is really ideal for a pour over. Tastes amazing.

It's -15F in Chicago so I decided to order Intelligentsia through Amazon Prime. Sadly, these beans were roasted in NOVEMBER! Really a disappointment. If I had not had Intelligentsia previously I would have given it a one star.

If they could ship freshly roasted beans, even two weeks old, I'd be ordering from Amazon weekly. Unfortunately, I've read other customers reviews and they've had the same experience (I decided jot roll the dice when I ordered). As it is, I'd never order these beans from Amazon again unless they implament a corrective action.

product_title: Puripan Loose Green Tea, Jeju Island
review_headline: Hands down, my favorite green tea.
review_body:
If you think you know what good green tea tastes like, and haven't had tea from Jeju Island, you're seriously missing out.

It's a tea you do need to be careful with; scorch the leaves by pouring too hot (over 165F) water on them and it'll taste bitter, but that happens with every green tea.

Brewed correctly, it's amazing. Flowery, grassy, and very fresh smelling. It also has a 'fresh' taste to it, almost like drinking a breath mint.

Leaves tend to be good for 2-3 steepings.

The only downside is that it's a fairly pricey tea as it only comes from Jeju Island and there are very few places that import it at anything other than wholesale bulk.

It is, however, worth every last bit that it costs.

product_title: Emeril's Big Easy Bold K-Cup Packs for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body:
This is my favorite Keurig Coffee. My coworker and I wanted a good coffee that was a compromise between the flavorful mud (my opinion) he likes to drink and the coffee flavored water (his opinion) I like. Big Easy Bold is perfect.

I'm not a big fan of Keurig coffees to be honest and we both like to brew drip coffee. But at work, we have Keurigs, so we have to use Keurigs, and we decided to just buy one brand, and split the cost. We tried a bunch of different coffees, Donut Shop, Green Mountain, Dunkin Donuts, Starbucks and and a few others and could not find a Keurig Coffee that tasted like the coffee we brew at home or get from the shop.

Big Easy Bold tastes like good coffee to me: Flavorful without burning a hole in my stomach. Ordering some now.

review_body: I was looking for nuts that were not high in fat content.  This was recommended by a friend who lost a bunch of weight. I recommend these taste great and no shells.

product_title: Chebe Gluten Free Cinnamon Roll Mix -- 7.5 oz
review_headline: Great-for GF....had to make my own icing
review_body:
Maybe my expectations for pastries are low, at this point, but we really liked these. My 5 stars are not 5 stars for wonderful cinnamon rolls, but more like, "These are great....for GF!". Kind of like when someone tells you you look wonderful....for your age. It is relative.

I made icing, which surely helped. It was a butter, milk, vanilla, powdered sugar concoction, which made them seem more normal.
I'd say make icing, whatever type you like, and make them pretty, and kick it up a notch. I doubt I would have loved them without it.

They didn't look like the picture, I will say. They didn't have that warm, risen bread thing going on.
If you have just gone GF, no, probably don't bother.
But, if you've been missing decent pastries, breads, pizza dough, etc., you will be more realistic about what can be achieved without gluten and yeast.
It is funny to read the reviews, because my experience was different. I fed them to my non-GF family members, and, while they would have loved the real thing, they gave them a, "not bad" thumbs up and ate a few each.

My family's crazy about the buckwheat pancakes. Their begging me to make more buckwheat beagles, I've got an order in for buckwheat hamburger buns. I'm not kidding. If you’re stuck being gluten free save yourself a load of money. Buy this fabulous flour and Pamela’s bread mix and start baking. With half buckwheat and half Pamela’s you'll be eating food so good it'll feel like you never went gluten free.

product_title: Cafejo Single Serve Reusable Filter for Keurig Capsule Brewers
review_body: I purchased this so that I wouldn't have to constantly buy the expensive K-cups for my brewer and could use up the coffee I already had.  After using it a few times my machine clogged up (the needle that punctures the bottom of the cup for brewing).  I cleaned it out and it was fine for about 2 more brews and did it again.  It got to the point that I was having to clean it between every brew.  I thought it was the machine (I hadn't had it very long) but when I stopped using the filter and just used the K-cups the problem stopped as well.  It may work better with coffee that is not ground so fine, but I haven't tried it.  It does fit perfectly in my machine, which other filters do not since mine is a Mr. Coffee brand and the needle on the bottom is not centered.

product_title: French Gray Sea Salt - Light Grey (Coarse) - "Sel Gris De Guérande" French Sea Salt
review_body:
Out of four kinds of sea salt I purchased, this was the only one that arrived wet. If I want wet salt, I can add my own water. Give me that option instead of making me pay for 12 oz of salt and 4 oz of water when I think I'm paying for 16 oz. of salt. At the very least, this product ought to be cheaper since you're getting less salt.

And no, don't treat me like a cretin and tell me it's supposed to be like that. If it is, it ought to say so in the description and on the package. Do I believe this is actually sea water in the pouch? No, since I didn't just today fall off the turnip truck.

I won't buy again. I did like the Himalayan pink salt I bought at the same time. It was dry. The salt that came from RealSalt in Utah came from the Great Salt Lake. And yet, it was dry, too.

review_body: Harmony House's Freeze-Dried Celery helps cut prep time on soups, stews, and casseroles PLUS, for smaller households, helps avoid food waste. I keep this in my pantry and then just add a tablespoon or two to my recipes (if adding to a casserole recipe, make sure there's enough extra liquid to rehydrate this while cooking).  The flavor's excellent, just like "real" celery (because it IS real celery, just freeze-dried).  Best of all, you just use what you need & keep the rest for later. product_title: Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn All-Inclusive Popping Kits - Real Theater Popcorn - 5 Pack - 27.5oz
review_headline: If You Don't Like The Wabash Family Farms Pricing or Customer Service - Read This
review_body:
WOW!!!! We bought a Whirley-Pop from Wabash Family Farms several years ago, after reading about the additional risks associated with microwave popcorn and always being dissatisfied with the missing "movie theater" flavor in the microwave brands. We have always bought the Wabash Valley Farms Real Theater popping kits because we think that this is the closest thing to movie theater popcorn that you can get, until recently. Over the past year we have received two seperate 5-kit orders that were somehow "lame ducks".......low volume, low flavor, and low color in terms of what we were accustomed to. On the second instance we contacted WFF and they helped us check the packaging date, and then advised that the kits were well within their "Best By" date. At that point we lost their attention and were unable to regain it, even after asking for an exchange. They just didn't seem to care about the product and any potential issues with it, although they seemed to be interested at first.

After searching for other alternatives, we came across the Great Northern brand and noticed that while the pricing was MUCH lower than WFF, the reviews were still really good. We just received the order and popped up a batch, and it is at least equal to what we came to expect from WFF, at half the price. Great flavor and amazing price!!! Sorry WFF, you let me down after an amicable 4-year relationship.

product_title: Nabisco, Belvita, Soft Baked, Banana Bread, 8.8oz Box (Pack of 4)
review_headline: I am a big fan of BelVita, but not so much this particular product.
review_body:
A Facebook friend turned me on to BelVita in 2012 and I've been a fan ever since. I've written reviews of several varieties of the BelVita crispy biscuits and one review of the Soft Baked version. Banana Bread is the only other of the Soft Baked I've tried besides the Mixed Berry, which I love.

The flavor of this variety definitely does taste like banana bread when you first bite into it but, for me, that flavor does not necessarily continue throughout eating the entire biscuit. I am a huge banana bread lover and I find myself reaching for the Mixed Berry variety all the time...only when they're gone do I eat the Banana Bread ones.

Since I reviewed the Mixed Berry variety in September 2013, the dry, too crumbly texture seems to have been improved. They still on the dry side (especially this Banana Bread variety) but at least hold together a bit better now. When I bought my first box of the Soft Baked BelVita, they were so crumbly that it was next to impossible to eat the thing without it falling apart in your hand. Now, instead of taking it out of the package to eat like a cookie, I leave the open package on my desk and break off small chunks to keep it from leaving crumbs all over the place. Even though it is not quite as bad in the crumbly department as that first box, it still falls apart with slight pressure from my fingers.

It should be noted that, whereas the usual thin/crisp BelVita biscuits come 5 or so to a pack, these soft baked biscuits come only ONE in a pack and there are five packs in a box.

Nutrition information for 1 50g biscuit:

Calories 190
Total Fat 7g
Sat Fat 1g (twice that of the Mixed Berry)
Trans Fat 0
Polyunsat Fat 2g
Monounsat Fat 4g
Cholesterol 0
Sodium 150mg
Potassium 85mg (slightly higher than the Mixed berry due to the potassium in bananas, I assume)
Total Carbs 32g
Ditary Fiber 5g
Sugars 9g (slightly lower than the Mixed Berry)
Protein 3g

Contains Vitamins A, B6 and C, Calcium, Iron, Thiamin, Riboflavin and Niacin.

The first ingredient is Whole Grain Blend. Sweeteners include raisin paste and sugar. It contains banana puree. Note to those with dietary restrictions or allergies: Contains wheat and soy.

I like that these biscuits contain 20% of your daily fiber and that the majority of the fats are better fats like monounsat and polyunsat. The sugar could be reduced, but 9g is not bad compared to many products out there, and at least some of the sweetening comes from fruit.

In summary, while I love the flavor of the Mixed Berry Soft Baked variety and buy them regularly, I find the Banana Bread variety "just okay" and therefore gave them 3 stars.br />Protein 3g

review_body:

Dont' get me wrong. I like \\"queeno\\" or whatever this stuff is, but man am I glad I decided to serve this up as a \\"healthy\\" side dish to the bacon cheeseburgers I prepared, cooked in bacon grease. I wasn't expecting much; let's be honest. But the box promises dehydrated veggies. I'm thinking cup-a-soup dehydrated veggies, at least. After all, I paid like $1.67 a meal. Cup-a-soup costs like $0.49. Nope. I dumped the mixture into the salted, boiling water and thought to myself, \\"why does everything look the same?\\"

Because it is. My best guess is that Johnny ground everything up -- Quinoa, rice, corn and \\"all,\\" bleached it, added the minimum amount of seasoning possible and pooted it into white plastic bags, 2 oz at a time. This stuff has *no* flavor, no textural variety and no color, other than a faded piss yellow. If you *must* subsist on this stuff, skip to Ramen and frozen veggies (a cheaper staple) or at least sautee up some onions and garlic to add to the mix when you cook this stuff. Yawn.

review_headline: Tupelo Honey is NOT what I thought it is....
review_body: This is the real deal, the "prized" Tupelo honey BUT I didn't know what it was when I ordered it. The REASON Tupelo honey is so prized is because it is extremely high in fructose....that is concentrated sweetness (real sugar) AND it has VERY LITTLE extraneous flavor other than it's sweetness so you can literally use a smaller amount of it to sweeten coffee, tea or what have you (so diabetics like it). However so far as having those wonderful floral tones that real clover and wildflower honey have you find NONE of it. And that's the deal. What I crave in honey is all that other flavor in addition to the sweetness....So it's not the products fault that I'm not thrilled with it. This in that regard is probably the first real Tupelo I have ever had. In that regard it's perfect...but for me, and this is ALL MY FAULT, it's like I thought I was ordering a bicycle and got a motorbike instead, Not what I was looking for. I adore their honey comb honey and probably everything else they make too. I just didn't know what the f I was ordering. product_title: Erythritol - 5 Pounds - Kosher - NON GMO - USA Made - Gluten Free - 100% Natural
review_body:
I was concerned when I received this item because of the label. It states \\"Xylitol USA Erythritol A natural, low-glycemic sweetener that is extracted from natural xylan-rich sources.\\" Nowhere on the package does it state an ingredients list, nor is \\"Non-GMO\\" printed anywhere on the package. I contacted the seller with these concerns and they responded that I was probably confused because it said Xylitol USA but reassured me it was the Non-GMO erythritol that I ordered. I responded and said that they should include an ingredient list and remove the \\"...xylan-rich sources\\" phrase as xylan is associated with xylitol, not erythritol. They did not respond to this second message. I went ahead and tried cooking with it (passionfruit curd), and did a side-by-side comparison of it with \\"Emerald Forest\\" brand pure erythritol (which doesn't specify whether it's GMO or not) and it seems to be a very similar product. I will go ahead and keep it, but I would feel a lot more comfortable if the label stated non-GMO, listed the ingredient(s), and removed the the \\"extracted from...xylan\\" part.
**UPDATE** I ended up throwing almost the entire bag away and I am not a wasteful person and changed my star rating accordingly. Please see the comments below and consume erythritol at your own risk!

review_headline: Good for brownies, not so much for pancakes

I don't have much experience with gluten-free baking, so I forged ahead with my favorite brownie recipe using this as a direct substitute and it actually turned out better—meaning moister and more fudge-like and less cake-like. I never use a recipe for pancakes, so I made pancakes using this flour and they definitely turned out different in texture as well, more like crêpes than fluffy flapjacks.

review_headline: Something about this coffee is a bit different.
review_body:
I have a sensitive stomach. Some coffees and teas just make me extremely nauseous. Sometimes they taste fine and about ten minutes later everything starts spinning and I have to lay down.

I don't remember who recommended Yuban to me but I hesitantly decided to give it a try. All I can say is there's something different about it from most of the coffee I have tried before. It has never made me feel sick or nauseous and it tastes just great.

I get a great price on this coffee local. I can get it for about $3 for a 12 ounce can. It's better to buy small cans of coffee anyway. Otherwise it'll go bad on the shelf before I can drink it all. I kind of wish the cans were metal because I like to reuse metal coffee cans for screws and nails and such. These cans will fall apart of you try to wash them.

As far as I'm concerned, Yuban has me for a while. I have tried other coffees when I'm out of Yuban and I almost always regret it. I hate that kind of uncertainty.

product_title: Better Than Bouillion; Vegetable Base (8 oz)
review_body:
I am completely and totally hooked on Better than Boullion.

My mother, my grandmother and I all have a thing for soup: we eat it, we make it, we love it . . . we're not necessarily great cooks, but we have the gift of throwing crazy things into a pot together and making a truly delicious soup out of it all when it's done.

I have very occasionally selected other broths, and have always regretted it. This stuff is just GOOD. Other stuff is often . . . not.

This is great in soups, marinades, mashed potatoes, or in the absorbed cooking water for meats or veggies. It's really just tasty.

The price fluctuates wildly locally, and availability beyond the chicken, beef, and veggie broths is rare. When I find this for $3-4, I buy up everything they've got. The shelf life is outstanding, and so is the refrigerated life once you open it. I also have a gluten intolerance and have never reacted badly to Better than Bouillon, and I have reacted to some other broths.

Do check the label if you have a problem with some ingredients! I learned the hard way that the ingredients sometimes change without warning.

Happy cooking!

review_body: This is my favorite k-cup of the moment! I love this coffee! It is the strongest, but still smoothest coffee k-cup I have tried to date. It has a decent amount of body as well, which is hard to find with k-cups. Revv was one of my favorites until I found this one. Revv is still good, but it is not nearly as smooth. This k-cup is somewhat reminiscent to pressed coffee, which I also enjoy. It is a very close second to that. I highly recommend Jet Fuel to those who want a strong and smooth k-cup with a decent amount of body.

product_title: Mucinex Children's Multi-Symptom, Cold Relief Liquid, Very Berry, 6.8oz
review_body: I received a free sample from Smiley360.com. I found that is was pretty comparable to a lot of other cold medicines out there. My son is 7 and suffers from enlarged tonsils that he will be having removed in a few weeks. He is constantly catching colds, coughs, and runny noses from the swollen tonsils, so I am always looking for something to give him some relief. The little measuring cup that it comes with is very cute, but it's hard to see the measurements and at the 10ML mark it's easy to spill. He drank the medicine and hated the taste. This medicine took a little while to \\"kick in\\" but once it did, I noticed his coughing had calmed down. It worked for about an hour, and the coughing came back. I bet this stuff work for a lot of people, but my little man only got a little bit of relief.

product_title: Bob's Red Mill Cereal, 10 Grain Hot, 25 Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: Good oatmeal to lower your cholesterol. Great price and quality. Use it every am.  With organic honey and tart cherry juice

product_title: Allen's Collard Green, 14-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love these greens but its difficult to find them.  I'm not surprised they aren't available.  I couldn't find them in my local store so I thought I'd check Amazon.  As luck would have it - they aren't available.  They are the best canned greens - better than Glory.

product_title: Raisin Bran Crunch Cereal, 18.2 -Ounce Boxes
review_body: i bought this for my little daughter and she loves it. i've recommended it to my friends and colleagues. btw the price was nice too.

review_body: Love this stuff. I use it when I brown hamburger. It's so yummy. I use it in everything, salads, chicken, soups. It's perfect for seasoning a turkey.

review_body: This is such a great breakfast if you are on the go. They are small, but filling. I am always on the run and don't always have time to make breakfast so these do the job for me. Plus, total bonus that there is chocolate in them! I did receive this product for free from Influenster but all opinions are 100% my own.

product_title: Jif to Go Chocolate Silk Peanut Butter & Chocolate Flavored Spread 8-1.5 Oz. Cups (Pack of 3)
review_body: This is a new product that I have not yet found in local markets.  For someone who wants more than just peanut butter, it is peanut butter with chocolate (the combination seems to be a favorite with some people).  The flavor is good .  For a single sandwich, it might be slightly more than you want, but it provides an interesting variation - for example, if you like bananas and peanut butter, you can now have a banana-peanut butter-chocolate sandwich.  I would note that the convenience pack makes the price per ounce somewhat high when compared to a regular jar of peanut butter, but think in terms of buying candy bars.

product_title: Lance Cocoa Classics Premium Cocoa Mix Variety Pack, 42 Count
review_body: Found them not as strong in flavor as I would have liked. Disappointed especially because they are made by Land O' Lakes and these are suppose to be their premium mix.

product_title: Stash Premium Loose Leaf Tea, 16 Ounce Pouch
review_body:
I first came to enjoy Assam tea by drinking the Special Rare Doomur Dulling from Taylors of Harrogate. I liked the flavor, but not the price, and I wanted to find a less expensive whole leaf Assam. Enter Stash's Kopili Estate tea.

The aroma of the leaves is much stronger than the Taylors, and just a touch smoky. The characteristic Assam golden tips are present. Using a heaping teaspoon per 8 oz water and brewing for 3 minutes yields a rich malty red liquor, much more flavorful than the Taylors but in no way harsh or bitter. It's delicious by itself, with milk and sugar, and when made into masala chai.

It's tastier and cheaper than my previous pick, and is now my standard tea. Highly recommended if you like the style.

product_title: Jacobs Coffee Kronung Balance, Net Wt 17.6 Oz (Pack of 3)
review_body:
Cutting back on caffeine doesn't mean losing flavor. This is truly a "Balanced" blend of Kronung Coffee. The flavor is still strong enough to be considered a rich, black coffee, and the reduction of caffeine makes it a great compromise.

We still have bags of the regular Kronung in the freezer, but this is the one we reach for most often. (Makes a great cup of Sunday evening Bailey's and Coffee.)

product_title: Heavenly Rewards ~ Marshmallow Cupcakes 3.8 oz.
review_body: I got these for a nursing home patient that has no teeth on top. He ate the one but did not seem interested in wanting another one. They came packaged very well and I received it quickly.

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Whole Bean Coffee, 5 Pound
review_body:
I give it 5 stars because it is very evenly roasted, beans are of consistent size/color, and not stale. Brewing a pot brings the coffee drinkers out of the woodwork because of the aroma.

Aroma plus smooth flavor combine to make a great cup of coffee. I can drink it all day long.

product_title: Langers Pineapple Juice, 16-Ounces (Pack Of 12)
review_body: Tasty and sweet and handy for a lunch drink. Pineapple juice is a healthy drink; you can dilute this with a bit of water if you find it too sweet.

product_title: Cella's Milk Chocolate Covered Cherries 11oz.
review_headline: Leakie liquid filling makes VERY STICKY MESS
review_body: Great taste like aways. Although I recently purchased 2 boxes both boxes had several cherries with a whole in the top of the chocolate causing the liquid to spill out making a very sticky mess. Usually I buy several boxes for gifts not sure I want to take the chance that I would have the samething happen. Really wouldn't want to give or receive as a gift in that condition.

product_title: Cocotes
review_body: My husband and I have long had an obsession with coconut water. The first time we tried it, we had Zico, which was good enough to get us hooked. But then we tried fresh coconut water from a young coconut and realized what we were missing. After we had fresh coconut water, we didn't want other brands anymore. We kept trying new kinds, but none of them tasted as fresh. I was browsing Amazon and came across Cocozia. It's so hard to find organic coconut water in stores! If you're wondering what we thought of it... the case was gone in less than 5 days. AMAZING. Fresh, crisp, refreshing. It has that sweet taste like real coconut water and nothing extra has been added. And you can't beat the price. When Whole Foods is charging $3+ for a single bottle, this makes so much more sense.

product_title: Ritz Crackers Cheese Flavour 200G
review_headline: Not the Cheese Ritz of my childhood.
review_body: Fifty years ago, the cheese flavored Ritz Crackers were one of my favorite snacks.  I've tried writing the manufacturer over the years to get them reintroduced. No luck. Then I saw these were available in England so ordered a box for twelve bucks. Unfortunately my first bite told me the recipe was entirely different in color, texture, and taste. No bad, just not the same.

The picture does not reflect the pieces in the ends and pieces bag in the ad. Also the stick is difficult to chew. product_title: Dickinson's Curd, Coconut, 9.50-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: 5 stars for the product..... minus 10 stars for everything else.... Before you buy please read this, then decide.
review_body: I love this stuff. I love everything Dickinson's make. BUT...... before you buy it here check out walmart's online store. Much, Much less expensive! In fact they have lime, lemon, vanilla and coconut curd and they are all less expensive. This same coconut curd sells at $18.96 for 6 jars!  Big difference!  The wait is about 1 week, same as the vendor here on Amazon. It will ship free with a $50 order. Great deal there. 5 stars for the product...... Minus 10 stars for the price and delivery time here on Amazon. I don't normally tell shoppers to go anywhere but Amazon.... Amazon Prime is where it's at for me for most things. Especially with 2 kindles. But I won't buy  these curds here again now that I know. Your choice, but shop around first to find the best price. I wish I had but now I know. And you do Too!

review_body: I prefer fogchaser but decent, especially for the money. It's missing some robustness and not the best out there but it's better than many other coffee.

product_title: True Lemon Pack
review_body: We took these packets on a mission trip to add to our water bottles as a change of pace -- help to make sure everyone stayed fully hydrated in a very dry climate. The packets were a hit with both the adults and teens. The flavor is similar to fresh squeezed lime. Not quite as good as fresh, but close. I have sprinkled it on food when I am out of fresh lime, and added it to recipes. It is convenient to carry True Lime packs in a pocket or purse and the product tastes much better than the liquid lime concentrate currently on the market.

product_title: Kracie Popin' Cookin' kit soft donuts DIY candy
review_headline: Get the instructions off you tube
review_body: My granddaughter is crazy for these.  I don't necessarily understand why but that's no problem as long as they love them.

product_title: Truvia Natural Sweetener,0.10 oz, 80 Packets
review_body: I tried this product from my local grocery.  It seems like it costs a lot more to order it online than finding it at a local store.  I don't normally use sweeteners in hot drinks, so I don't know how this product works in those kind of items.  I tried Truvia in plain, unsweetened Greek yogurt and over fresh strawberries.  While it does taste sweet, the Truvia crystals and HUGE - much, much larger than regular sugar, and they don't dissolve with stirring.  My yogurt and strawberries had big gritty clumps of sweetener all over.  At least I didn't notice a strange aftertaste like others did.  I don't think I will try this product again.  I prefer powdery Splenda to mix with my yogurt.

product_title: Crystallized Ginger, 5 Lb Bag
review_body: Very fresh product.  I eat it by the handful.  Ginger really helps my indigestion problems.  I also use it in cooking recipes.  It is a lot easier to work with than fresh ginger.  If I do not want the sugar on it, I just rinse it off under cool water.

product_title: Stash Tea Holiday Tea Assortment
review_body: I really didn't enjoy any of these flavors. The pumpkin spice is too clove-based, the cranberry is just ok, and the cinnamon vanilla is nauseatingly sweet.  I love Stash Teas though, so I'll just stick with the flavors I know I enjoy.

product_title: Grove Square Cappuccino, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: satisfies your pumpkin cappuccino craving from the comfort of your home.
review_body: i am always stopping at gas stations in the fall to get a pumpkin cappuccino.  but, they are a couple of bucks each.  for the price, this pays for itself in just 4 of the 24 servings that are in this case.  these are tasty and you don't have to leave your house to get one or wait until the limited window to go buy one.

product_title: S.Pellegrino Sparkling Natural Mineral Water, 33.8 fl oz. (Pack of 12)
review_body: First off, like others have said, the packaging was AWFUL.  The SP boxes inside the Amazon boxes were torn apart/cut.  Bottles were loose.  One of the boxes was literally taped together (???).  I have no idea why so many of us are receiving this water in such horrible condition.  I just opened the first bottle, and maybe it's mind over matter because I read another review that said the water tasted flat, but I agree.  There are SOME bubbles, yes, but it sure doesn't seem to be up to San Pellegrino standards.  Where is this water coming from?  Is it old stuff that's been collected off of shelves that didn't sell?  I've been drinking this stuff for over 10 years...and something just isn't right here.  I thought this would be a wonderful way to get these very heavy cases of water to my house.  Considered doing a "subscribe and save" with them.  No way now.  I'll be looking for an alternative.

review_body: this for my hubby. pumpkin seed is good for low blood pressure. i hope this works for it!!! !  thanks.

product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_body: Great cups for the price. Taste is reasonably strong. The one downside to this style of K-cup is, since they are not sealed, I wouldn't recommend putting them into a K-cup storage shelf/drawer. Open one bag at a time and use them up. review_body: Campbell's used to have this almost exact same soup (Campbell's had spinach) and I was so addicted to it. I found Progresso's Chickarina soup last night and was giddy with excitement! I couldn't wait to take it home and try it. Sure enough, it filled that sad void that was missing. product_title: Popchips 11-Flavor Variety Count, 0.8-oz. Single Serve Bags (Count of 24)
review_body: Man, I love me some pop chips. This variety pack is an excellent representation of the product line. If you wait for the right time, you can get a case of 24 for about $14. Only 100 calories a bag.

product_title: South Beach Diet Gluten Free Chewy Nut Bar, 5 Count
review_body:
There are some chocolate South Beach foods that are good and some that are horrible; this bar is one of the good ones. Made with unsweetened chocolate, peanuts, almonds, and lots of different sugars and syrups it may not be the healthiest treat but it is certainly more nutritional than your average candy bar with the same amount of calories.

The chunks of chocolate are a good size though they are about 2/3 the size of the almonds. The sweetness is a bit too intense, it could be cut to let more of the chocolate, almonds, and peanut flavors through and have even less calories. While very easy to chew it also makes a good crunch with each chew. The chunks of chocolate adds little semi-sweet bursts when you hit them. Satisfying for an afternoon craving.

product_title: The Sprout House HOT and Spicy 1 Pound Certified Organic Non-gmo Sprouting Seeds Yellow Mustard and Red Radish

review_body: I've been using a lot of raw cashews in my Fuhrman's Eat for Health recipes and also love to snack on them after exercise or when going on long hikes.  I had been purchasing Navitas, but when their price when up significantly I had to look for a different option.  After lots of research and reading lots of reviews over several weeks I decided to try these.  I like them even better than Navitas and what a great value!  The cashews are large, raw, and simply amazing. They come in a large, sturdy, resealable bag, but I portioned them out in 1 lb packages and keep the extras in the refrigerator until I'm ready for them.  I'm so glad I discovered these.  I've just ordered another bag and am hoping these quality cashews will stick around at this great price.

product_title: Lawry's Garlic Seasonings

review_body: This tahini is good in my homemade hummus. It tastes as expected like any other tahini. The bottle is not as hard as I expected, it is a fairly soft plastic. I would purchase this again because it is less costly than what I can find locally.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body: I bought it for my hair and it worked great.  Haven't tried cooking with it but I'm sure it will be good for that too.

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet

product_title: Orgain Healthy Kids Organic Nutritional Shakes, 3 Flavors, 11 Ounce, 12 Count
review_body: My daughter always wants this stuff ever since we tried it once. Amazon seems to always have the best price on it so bonus.

product_title: Community Coffee Variety Sample Pack
review_body: anything free is good. not for everyone, stronger than what I am used to. but overall had a good taste

product_title: Valley Fresh Chuck Chicken in Water, White & Dark, 10-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: It is what it is: chicken bits form a can
review_body: Is there such a thing as five-star canned chicken? Me thinks not. But this is a good product at a good price. I add it to other dishes like rice or vegetable broth and it works well in that capacity

product_title: Valley Lahvosh Rounds, 3 inch, 4.5oz
review_body: I really liked this product.  It was crispy and crunching and very addictive. In fact, it only took me two days to eat them. I would recommend this product to any one who likes a type of cracker that is does not have any salt. In fact it is rather bland but the crunching texture made up for it.

product_title: Nabisco Red Oval Farms Crackers Stoned Wheat Thins - 12 Pack
review_headline: The half box left will feed ducks...not fit for human consumption
review_body:
These crackers used to be fantastic... dense, hearty, just the right amount of saltiness... now they have very little of any of those things. There were times in college that a box of these was my dinner while studying. I have had a great association with them over the years and would love to talk to the person (corporate study) which inflicted this change on these once great crackers.

yes, I realize it is a cost savings measure, probably more flour/less actual cracked wheat...but they are so horribly generic and bland now (( they even reduced the salt...seriously how expensive is salt ?!? )). Sorry Nabisco, you ruined these crackers, and this half box I have left will likely be used to feed ducks...

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Fair Trade Organic Sumatran Reserve, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: This is my all-time favorite K-cup flavor.  It's very rich, flavorful, and bold.  I look forward to making it every morning!

product_title: Aunt Jemima Instant Oatmeal Maple Syrup flavor (4 Pack)
review_body: The oatmeal is great! It's sweet and do not need to add any sugar at all. The price was too much!

product_title: Colorado Spice Cayenne Pepper, Ground, 22-Ounce Jar
review_body: This spice is quality and at a great quantity for the price.  Done paying $6-8 dollars for a small jar.

product_title: Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars Oats 'N Honey
review_body: 96 bars for 21 dollars? Holy crap. I jumped up and bought this. It is very crunchy and goes really really well with milk. product_title: Ricochet Mints with Xylitol, Cocoa Mint, 100-Count Mints (Pack of 6)
review_body: These are yummy mints, they do dissolve quickly, but the flavor is good and no aftertaste, just natural ingredients, which I like.

product_title: Bulk Herbs: Clay, Multani Mitti (Fuller's Earth)
review_body: I made paste with witch hazel,instead of water,,,added a bit of frsh lemon juice and rose water....it is so calming nd refreshing,..once you wash it off ,,skin feels so smooth and fresh...unbelievable...loved it...will get more...

product_title: Nescafe Gold Blend Decaffeinated 100g
review_body:
I have the regular Gold Blend coffee that I first bought in a local Grocery store here in Georgia. LOVED it! so, i decided to try the decaf since i enjoy having coffee after dinner sometimes, but didn't want to be kept up til the crack of dawn with all the caffeine. So when I saw the decaf here, i decided to try it, and I am SO glad I did. It tastes just as good as the regular. I am NOT a fan of the American instant coffee, since it often tastes disgusting and nowhere NEAR brewed coffee flavor. However, the Gold Blend Coffees do not disappoint.
Give it a try, you will be surprised!

product_title: Raw Brazil Nuts, Shelled ( 1 Lb) - Sincerely Nuts
review_body:
Brazil Nuts

Packaged in a resealable plastic bag, the nuts were medium sized,
fresh and tasty. A great source of magnesium, I'll purchase these again, though
nuts are a bit expensive for my budget. They were shipped quickly and well packaged.

product_title: Harmony House Foods, Dried Mushrooms, Shiitake
review_headline: I use this in my homemade backpacking spaghetti sauce
review_body: These work great for backpacking, nice and light, good taste, re-hydrate wonderfully in my homemade spaghetti sauce with mushrooms when backpacking.

product_title: Gevalia Signature Blend - 36 Count
review_body: The Columbian is very good, but the Signature Blend has a deeper taste, very satisfying in the morning. Many of the other Keurig varieties have a weak taste and a disappointing finish, but this one won't let you down. Bold, but not over the top (like Starbucks can be).

product_title: GoMacro Organic Peanut Protein, 2.3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love these vegan bars; however, the price has gone up considerably, and I can no longer justify the purchase.  There are other vegan bars with a higher protein content and non-GMO ingredients that cost less.

product_title: Just Like Sugar Sweetener
review_body: When refined and artificial sugar/sweeteners are out of your diet, you will be glad you have Just Like Sugar!  It is a learning process on how to incorporate Just like Sugar Baking into your recipes, but it doesn't take rocket science. I am very happy with the results.  It has a sweet taste.  Just make sure you use the Just Like Sugar labeled for what you need to use it for---table sugar for coffee or coconut icecream etc.  I wouldn't use the Baking for my tea.  Use it in good health!  I am thankful that it exists!

product_title: Food Science Labs Dimpro 120 Cap
review_headline: Seems like a great value...until you order!
review_body:
Awesome value--12 pack for 56.51--will be interested to see if all are in date. Item description does not say they are out of date. I've used this brand before and it is very good for hormonal issues and weight management. Will update as soon as they arrive.
****UPDATE****
Finally received ONE bottle (not 12) yesterday--10 days later. Contacted seller to see if they will send the other 11. Will update again if they make it right.
****UPDATE****
Seller sent back an email saying this was an error by Amazon in posting and offered three for the price I paid. I told them I expected my order to be fulfilled at the price paid. Supposedly they forwarded to a manager in their company, but as of 10/19, I still have not received my items.

product_title: Gourmet Wafers Three Cheese (4 pack)
review_headline: Amazing - a beautiful experience for the taste buds
review_body:
The package looks promising - then again, don't packages look inviting so often, yet the content might be disappointing?

These thin wafers are amazingly and exceptionally good. They have a certain crispness, yet they melt in my mouth. There is a distinct and beautiful taste of cheese, which tastes like real cheese. Even though the wafers are thin they are solid and I feel I could put some type of spread on them without breaking them.

The package lists that the wafers are low fat, have no artificial flavor, no artificial colors, and only natural ingredients. I believe it, because that's what they taste like.

Picked them up on a chance and will buy them again, these Gourmet Wafers are that good.

I have noticed that when a canned soup is anything even remotely Italian they add waaaay to much basil, this is the exception. It doesn't taste like you are eating canned spaghetti sauce and for me that is a good thing. I didn't find anything wrong with the tortellini other than the pasta was thin but I actually liked that. I eat soup a few nights a week, and I will definitely buy this again. review_body:
I read very varying reviews on this product after I had already purchased based mostly on the excellent star-rating. When they arrived, I wasn't quite ready to undertake the project that keeping up water kefir production is. I read some very negative reviews after my grains already arrived, so I was a bit worried...

Anyway, my grains sat in their shipping packaging in a cupboard for about a week before I got around to starting them, and they still worked GREAT. I'm currently on my 6th ferment and my grains have nearly tripled in size! The package came with very helpful instructions and tips--the "oven with the light on" tip really helped my grains take off. I don't even know what to do with all the extra grains I have already, and I've only been fermenting for about 2 weeks. I really enjoy the minimal upkeep (yet " productive project" feel) and dreaming up new ways to flavor my finished product. This is my first attempt at anything kefir or fermented, and I'm very happy. My grains are also very happy, and my finished product always tastes great. It smells weird, though, so if you aren't used to fermented food/beverage and can't deal with weird smells, maybe water kefir isn't the project for you.

product_title: Grace Jamaican Red Hot Pepper Sauce 4.8oz (Single Bottle) Product of Jamaica
review_body:
Two disclaimers: (1) I purchase this locally so I will not address price or shipping, and (2) I have a high tolerance for extremely hot sauces, so mild to me may be very hot to others.

On the heat scale I would say that this is at the lower end for Jamaican hot sauces. Part of that may be due to the complex flavor profile that masks some of the piquant qualities of the peppers. Plus, like most Jamaican sauces this one has a slow burn and spread kind of heat that is typical of Scotch bonnet peppers versus the immediate bite of habanero peppers that are used in Mexico and Trinidad/Tobago.

The flavor profile seems to be a balance of both piquant and sour (from the vinegar). There is also a hint of sweetness that I suspect comes from cane sugar, and a very little touch of saltiness. The sodium content is only 40mg per one teaspoon serving. For folks like myself who have to watch their sodium intake this sauce is a good choice. All other nutritional values are so nominal that they are listed as zero on the label.

I keep this handy for guests who like a little heat, but not the fiery sauces that I normally use. I also use this for some dishes where I want a little spiciness and maximum flavor.

review_headline: Top of the line red licorice

I am fully aware that red licorice is \\"not really licorice.\\" Having said that by way of disclaimer, I will note that for red \\"licorice\\" the Kookaburra strawberry twists are about the best you'll find on the market. Unlike the red Twizzlers-type candy with which most people in the U.S. are familiar with, these strawberry twists are nicely soft and chewy but not rubbery, and have an intense strawberry flavor, which is far richer than the red licorice manufactured in the states.

Although we sell more Kookaburra black licorice than strawberry, the latter is also extremely popular with our customers. And I can see why. The burst of strawberry flavor that fills the mouth as soon as you take a bite is an exhilarating experience. I highly recommend this product for anyone who likes red licorice. The only problem we have had is that the Kookaburra company has had some trouble over time in manufacturing and shipping enough of the product to keep its U.S. warehouse from running out.

product_title: Maine Coast Sea Vegetables Kombu, Wild Atlantic, 2-Ounce Package (Pack of 5)
review_headline: Good quality Kombu, but beware of heavy metals
review_body:
I bought this product, and was pleased with it. It is very good quality, and I've been adding it to beans and things that I cook on the stove to add iodine and minerals to my food.

However, I am now feeling cautious about continuing to use this product. I will post links in a comment on this review, since links are not allowed in the main body of the review. Please see the comment section for more info.

Maine Coast has recently put on their website the results of testing of their various sea vegetables because of the Fukushima power plant dumping radiation into the ocean, and I'm grateful to them for that. They sound like a good company that cares about the people who buy their products.

However, they admitted on their website that they don't really know the levels of arsenic in their products. They haven't been able to test for it, and there seems to be confusion about what levels of arsenic are bad, whether it is inorganic or organic arsenic, etc.

This is worrisome, as you will see in one of the links I post in the comments, because a woman taking kelp supplements in 2007 had all kinds of health problems develop because of arsenic being present in her supplements. She stopped the supplements and her problems went away.

I don't know now if I will continue with this product or not. I have 4 whole bags of it, having only used up one so far!

If Maine Coast is able to update their results and relieve fears about arsenic testing, I will revise my review and bump the rating back up to five stars. Until this, it stays at 3 stars, because of the uncertainty.

product_title: UNREAL Candy - Peanut Butter Cups
review_headline: Not worth $12 shipped, but definitely worth around $5 if you can find them locally and were going to eat a PB cup anyway.
review_body:
These peanut butter cups are outstanding. The chocolate is premium quality, and they taste every bit as good as I remember Reese's cups tasting when I was a kid, before they became all greasy and oily like they are today. (Seriously, when was the last time you opened one and didn't get your fingers all full of oil? They didn't used to be like that!)

The Unreal cups taste better to me, actually, because the chocolate is darker, thicker, and has a better \\"snap\\" (temper) to it, and it is not as sweet. It is \\"real\\" chocolate, not just a wimpy sugary placeholder like Reese's. The peanut butter was a bit sparse, but there was still plenty enough there to enjoy -- not quite as salty as the peanut butter in a Reese's, but it goes nicely with the ensemble and tastes somehow more wholesome.

After eating \\"a few\\" of these, I became curious as to what \\"unjunked\\" meant, so I went to Unreal's website and watched a few videos. I did find their direct calorie comparison with Reese's to be a tad disingenuous. The Unreal cups are 0.5 oz, and Reese's are 0.6 oz. (20% larger.) So suddenly, the company's boast that their peanut butter cup contains 210 calories as opposed to Reese's 250 cal. doesn't seem so impressive. They did it by making the cup smaller.

However, their other claims are still true (less sugar by a significant margin, conscientiously sourced ingredients, no dyes, hydrogenateds, GMOs, or other \\"junk\\" (well, unless of course you consider sugar and fat to be \\"junk\\".) I wholeheartedly support what they are trying to do here. If my kids are going to eat candy, I'd much rather they eat Unreal than the other brands.

You've got to be kidding with the online $12 price tag, though. They're less than five bucks for this same bag of 12 cups in my local grocery store. I could almost buy three bags for what I'd pay on Amazon currently. No thanks. Here's hoping the price drops online.

Do yourself a favor and find somewhere local you can buy these at the normal retail price. You'll never want to switch back.
