review_headline: A New Must Have On Hand
review_body:
I never actually pay any mind to tea labels i.e. \\"breakfast tea\\", \\"afternoon tea\\", etc. It seemed more like a marketing thing to me, as tea is tea.
But that was before I tried this stuff. It really is afternoon tea! It isn't \\"rowdy\\" like breakfast teas. It's actually soothing in a very level and \\"stabilizing\\" way.

It must be the way it's brewed. It's smooth and steady - rich and calm.

I have developed a habit of having a cup every night after dinner as it helps me to end my day. :)

product_title: Michael Season's Baked Cheddar Cheese Curls, 0.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_body: I bought these for when I need a gluten free snack at night and was surprised at how good these are.  I bought some other Michael items and have to say they have all been great.  Good gluten free products can be hard to find at times.  I highly recommend this brand.

product_title: SweetGourmet Chocolate Covered Mini Pretzels
review_body:
if you're looking for something with some taste, any taste at all, look elsewhere
the yogurt covering taste like chalk
the pretzel inside is unsalted and stale
really disappointed

product_title: Idahoan Honest Earth Creamy Mash, 5.6 Pound
review_body: This is the exact same product sold occasionally at Costco. I looked for it online because Costco was out of stock. Individually packaged serving - each serving serves 3-4 people. Just add boiling water, butter and a little salt. Tastes excellent. Highly recommended. Have been buying it for years from Costco.

product_title: O.N.E. 100% Natural Coconut Water, 33.8 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: shipment was poorly packed. USPS had to deliver it in a basket because it was leaking in their truck. One box was almost empty. Two other had bacteria growing in them (yeah you don't know that until you pour you a big glass.)

product_title: Trader Joe's Freeze Dried Blueberries Unsweetened & Unsulfured 1.2oz
review_body: I guess I was looking for something with more in the package.  It was ok  I probably won't try them again.

product_title: Entenmann's Soft'ees Plain Family Pack Donuts 17 Oz 2 Packs
review_body: when I got the donuts they were broke and they were very dry and when I ate I choke on them

product_title: Ocean Spray On the Go Cran Cherry Sugar Free Drink Mix (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Can't find in stores and they're my favorite!
review_body: Yum! I will purchase again, just wish it weren't so pricey. Twice the price as it was in the store, but now they don't carry it. Supply and demand.

product_title: Certified Organic Hard Red Wheat Sprouting Seed: Pre-Measured for 10"x20" Trays For Growing Wheatgrass to Juice, Grind for Flour & Bread, Ornamental Wheat Grass – Non-GMO
review_body: I have heard so much about how wheatgrass is good for you but it is darn near impossible to just buy it around here.  A Whole Foods market just opened near here and I thought "hey they will have it and I can try it in my omega juicer".  Well it's $3 a pack for a very small amount.  I ordered these and my wife grows them.  They have grown very well and have been a staple in our juices.  Definitely recommend this product.

product_title: Alpine Spiced Cider Apple Flavor Drink Mix - 7.4 oz - 10 ct - 12 pk
review_body: Somethimes this is hard to find at the store. So I bought this umunguss case so I don't run out. So many of the other brands are to tart, this is a little sweeter, and when you feel like something hot besides coffee or hot chocolate, this will do the trick.

product_title: Paesanol Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 1L
review_headline: Good but wished it had more solids in it
review_body: Good but wished it had more solids in it. I thought since it was unfiltered it would have more solids in it.

product_title: Krusteaz Oat Bran Muffin Mix
review_body: This boxed mix makes delicious fat-free muffins. I just put in the water, mixed and folded in the cranberries. I will probably add a tad more orange essence next time.  You do get that slight taste of orange in every other bite.  Very moist and delicious. To shake things up a bit I baked these in my [[ASIN:B00008UA3H Nordic Ware Scottish Scone & Cornbread Pan]] and got 8 nice triangle shaped muffins. Yum!  Super easy to grab and go in the morning!

product_title: Good Earth Organic Tea
review_body: I love this tea! It is sweet and fragrent. It tastes great hot adn cold adn was a big hit for all of our bed and breakfast customers durng the fall.

product_title: LorAnn Natural Flavoring Oils, Cinnamon Oil, 1 Ounce Bottle
review_headline: Great flavoring for ice cream, and smoothies!
review_body: I have used a smaller version of this in the recent past, and loved it so much that I had to have more. I make cinnamon ice cream to go with summer berry pies and cobblers.

product_title: Next Organic Walnuts Dark Chocolate Covered, 4-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body:
At my first try, I found it tasty (it was quite a taste!). But I agree with another reviewer who said it's got to have more nut meat than sweet chocolate. If there was just a thin coat of dark chocolate with more walnut content, like susi with less rice and more fish, I'd continue to buy this.

I bought this at MET grocery store at $4.49 (4 oz.); I thought it was a little pricey. I came to amazon.com hoping to get it at less than that. But to my surprise, it is sold twice expensive! A pack of three should be at no more than $20.00 ($4.49 x 3 + a shipping cost). Amazon price at $28.00 made me walk away from it. Another vendor at amazon even sells it for a whooping price of $43.00! (it's the same one pack of 3 of 4 oz. pouch).

I'll look into Stop and Shop where I get Naked's Mighty Mango juice at $4.49 whereas it is sold at $6.99 at MET! As you can tell, MET is an expensive store; but they still carry this organic sweet pouch at $4.99! Vitacost.com sells it at $9.38 for 2 packs (a little lower than MET price) and I find that's an acceptable price.

Do some comparison shopping!

product_title: Shakespearean Insult Gum by Accoutrements
review_headline: Oh it is really bad stuff and please don't buy
review_body: I was got attracted by the looking and fancy product description, but actually the gum is as hard as a stone to chew! You'd better put them into a nerf gun and shoot it like a bullet! And the fancy Shakespearean stuffs are the s***y and cheap looking paperback case outside the gum. With cheap and bad looking printing, the whole pack of these gums are just look like an abandoned rubbish!

product_title: Nestle Pure Life Bottled Water, 23.7-Ounce Sport Cap Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_body: This is a regular purchase on my prime account. We drink allot of bottled water and having it delivered is easier than hauling it into the cart, out of the cart back into the cart then into the trunk out of the trunk. Get the idea? Now I just pick it up 1 time to put away. The tops are really tight and hard to get off, but that is my only negative.

product_title: Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories
review_body: I just bought this for the first time and have so far used it for protein shakes, an Asian peanut sauce, and to mix into yogurt (delicious with Yoplait 100 calorie vanilla Greek yogurt!)  Really nice peanut flavor without all of the fat.

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Organic Green Tea Hibiscus Tea
review_body: I'm a coffee person at heart but my family are all tea drinkers and pester me to drink Green Tea due to the purported health benefits.  The Traditional Medicinals Green Tea with Lemongrass is one of the few Green Tea blends that I find appealing.  It's lighter and the floral / lemony undertones are nice.  I can't find this particular blend locally so I was pleased to find it on Amazon.

product_title: Ju Hua-J0240-EF (Chrysanthemum flower) (Cendrantbema x grandiflorum)
review_body: This tea was recommended for help prevent/help my extreme dry eye condition. I didn't really find any difference, but you might. I do support much of traditional Chinese medicine.

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips
review_body: I enjoyed most of the flavors of the chips.  I think this a great way to sample many different chips without dishing out a lot of money trying to find your favorite type.

product_title: Organic Nectars 100% Raw Premium Dark Agave Syrup, 46 Ounce Jug
review_body: This product has met my expectations. I would recommend. My husband and I have replaced sugar with this product. For us it did not change the flavor of the food.

product_title: El Rio Hot Nacho Cheese Sauce with Jalapeno, 15-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: Awesome product, I used to buy this as a late night snack food as a teenager but since they stopped selling it at my grocery store, I was more than pleased to see it on Amazon, its still delicious and I recommend this product to all who enjoy nacho cheese as much as I do.

product_title: Sensible Foods Strawberry-Banana Crunch Dried Fruit Snacks, Lunch box size, 0.42-Ounce (Pack of 16)
review_body: I have bought this item before from two other sellers (not on Amazon) and Amazon has the best deal of them all. The taste of the dried fruit is delicious and the only problem I have is that the banana gets stuck on your teeth (or between) but it is such a healthy and delicious snack it's worth the 'digging out.'  Have bought a subscription which is an even better deal.  If  you are on a diet (as I am) this is a perfect snack!! Try it!

product_title: Back to the Roots Oyster Mushroom Kit
review_body: I bought this as a present for my parents. They painstakingly followed the directions, but no results. It's sad because the product sounds like a really cool idea, and my parents would have really enjoyed the mushrooms.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Rooibos Tea, 20 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: NIce flavor, one of the best teas I have tried, extra good with vanilla soy milk added to make it have a creamy taste. I recommend this tea.

product_title: Brownie Brittle Chocolate Chip, 16 Ounce
review_body: I saw this product during a segment on The Wendy Williams Show.  She said she ate them all the time and just GUSHED over how delicious they were.  She went on to quote how low in fat and calories this product had but that you would never know it by the taste.  So I took a chance and ordered a bag.  They were so shockingly good that I went to all my neighbors in my building and had them try it for themselves.  Everyone, without exception, thought they were really delicious.  I highly recommend this product.  If you like crispy part of the brownies and chocolate chips, there is NO WAY you will be disappointed.  I just wish I could find them in a store in Chicago.  The only drawback to having them shipped is that it does cause some breakage of the pieces.  But even in smaller pieces, Sheila G's Brownie Brittle is still one incredibly tasty treat that you don't ever have to feel guilty about.

product_title: Starbucks Caffe Verona Dark K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: One of my favorite coffees. Not bitter. This is always my 'go to' coffee. I do try others but always come back.

product_title: Cafe Du Monde Coffee & Chicory Net Wt. 15 OZ.
review_body: My brother was telling me how much he loved the coffee in New Orleans but he couldn't find any here in the Houston area. I found it on Amazon and ordered a can for him. He said he likes it a lot.

product_title: Haribo Gold Bears Gummi Candy 200 g
review_headline: Not the German Ones from Goldenleaf
review_body: These should be 5 stars if they were actually the German product, as pictured and described in the listing.  I received the American (Made in Turkey) version of the bears, if I wanted these I would go to my local grocery store and buy them.  I am sure if you order from a differnt seller this won't happen, but if you select \\"Goldenleaf\\" as your seller, you will NOT receive the German variety of these bears, they will be the American ones.  Buyer beware, make sure you order direct from Amazon or fulfilled by amazon at the least.

product_title: Bilardo Brothers Meat Rub, 3.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I have used this particular rub for many years, long before I knew about Amazon. After losing my original source to purchase this product, I was delighted to have been able to order it here. Thanks Amazon!

Bilardo Brothers Meat Rub is excellent when used before cooking on brisket and roasts. I've even seasoned baked beans with this rub. Good stuff!!

product_title: Maruchan Yakisoba Beef Taco, 8 - 3.99-Ounce Packages
review_body: I have to admit, this is a very good product. I've been buying these on a regular basis from Amazon for a year. However, I think there is some price gouging taking place. My last order for these was in November of 2012 and cost me $6.64. Triple the price in 6 months...I'll do without.

product_title: Libby's Sauerkraut 14.5oz Can (Pack of 12)
review_body: My husband and I love this product.  Don't know why, but it is not easy to find in the stores.  It is worth ordering a case.

product_title: Jelly Beans Just Born bulk 4.5 lbs lbs
review_body: My husband to be loves these Jelly Beans and was so excited to get them as a gift!  Order arrived in time and in great shape.

product_title: Explore Asian Organic Soybean Pasta, Spaghetti Shape, 7.05-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: we found the pasta easy to cook and very good tasting.  we weigh out our food and found we need to weigh after the pasta is cooked as we are following a plan where we have 3-4oz. of protein per meal and about 2 oz. dry is just right for us when it is cooked.

product_title: Krusteaz Buttermilk Pancake Mix
review_body: These pancakes are so easy to make and taste great!  All you do is add water and cook.  Great for mornings hen you hungry and not yet fully awake!  I bought two boxes so I wouldn't run out.

product_title: SA Japanese Green Tea Sen Cha
review_headline: The Best Sen Cha for the Price
review_body: I get this delivered every month. You really can't find a better a deal on the web for the quality you're getting here. It's not the absolute best Sen Cha I've had, but it's really good. It has a nice balance of acidity and flavor. Be sure not to over or under heat or steep. I brew mine at 165F for 4:30, which makes it taste great to my palate. Much more than that and it's too strong and acidic or any lower and it's too weak. You'll have to experiment yourself to find the perfect balance.

product_title: Heartbar Oatmeal Square, Chocolate Chip
review_body: I really have never liked oatmeal.  I just can't get over the texture of it.  I do like to eat healthy and oatmeal is good for you.  I tried one of these bars and found them to be a nice alternative to eating oatmeal in the traditional way.  The only complaint I have about these is that even in the packaging, they will dry out and get hard.  When they are fresh however, the squares are nice and moist.

product_title: Dr. John's® Sugar Free Simply Xylitol® Natural Mixed Fruit Lollipops (1 Lb.)
review_body: A friend recommended them and I've bought a couple bags after she liked them. My baby girl can have her treats and my healthnut wife wont try to take away her joy. I see win/win on this purchase, however it is still kinda pricey. Cant see a physical difference between these and the cheap bags of lollipops at the store but its all in the ingredients I guess.

product_title: Sprecher ROOT BEER PINT AMBER BOTTLES -  "Sprechen Sie Deutsch?" Wisconsin, 16-Ounce Glass Bottle (Pack of 12)
review_body: We were on a trip with my parents in Ashville, NC and the restaurant we ate at served this root beer.  So glad I found it at Amazon so I could buy her some since it is not offered in our area.

product_title: Rao's Homemade All Natural Marinara Sauce - 24 oz
review_body: This is the best marinara in a jar we've ever tasted. We like to keep some on hand for quick meals and when our local grocery stopped carrying it we had to go online for it. Twice as expensive as the common brands but tastes ten times better.

product_title: Barilla Plus Pasta, 14.5 Ounce
review_body:
I loathe all things Whole Wheat, Whole Grain, Multi-Grain...Grain, schmain. Hate it. I can taste the stuff as soon as it hits my mouth, and it's a taste I cannot stand.

That said, this is pretty good stuff. It tasted enough like regular Pasta to fool my taste buds, it had a nice texture and consistency, and my Wife and kids liked it, too. It took a bit longer to cook than regular Pasta, but you'll be fine if you follow the instructions.

product_title: Keurig Green Mountain Coffee K-Cup Packs
review_body: I usually mix this coffee with a caramel vanilla creamer and it is fantastic!  I would definitely recommend at least trying it.

product_title: Brownie Brittle Chocolate Chip, 16 Ounce
review_headline: Needed something different for a picnic
review_body: Arrived safely and on time. Tasted great but there were lots of tiny broken pieces (at least a third of the bag) that were too small to eat.

product_title: Plantation Molasses Blck Unslf
review_body: Surprisingly good taste, and I'm not even a fan of molasses. Good for anemia, and any other kind of related health issues, due to the iron, calcium, and potassium in this product. Quite pleased.

product_title: Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories
review_body: This stuff is incredible. I'll admit that I've yet to mix it with water to use it as plain peanut butter in the conventional sense, but it is SO VERSATILE. I've put it in oatmeal, protein shakes, ice cream, peanut noodle sauce, baked goods, cottage cheese... the possibilities are endless. It adds the awesome peanut taste and the fact that it's a powder allows for it to mix super easily and without mess. I'M IN LOVE.

product_title: Sea Salt Caramels
review_body: OKAY but have had better. The best I've had were temporarily sold at COSTCO - too bad I have not seen them since.

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 with Premium Chocolate
review_body:
The powder consistency was OK.
the taste was a bit different for me. After a few bites to make sure I didn't like it I started to feel sick to my stomach.
In the end I gave it away.

product_title: Dr. Scholl's Corn Removers, Maximum Strength, 9 ct
review_body: I'VE ALREADY USED A PACK AND THE CORN IS STILL HERE, EXCEPT ITS WORSE THAN BEFORE. AM I DOING SOMETHING WRONG? OR IS THIS JUST A BAD PRODUCT? I'M NOT SURE IF I SHOULD PEEL OFF THE WHITE SKIN OR NOT I JUST WISH I HAD BETTER DIRECTIONS ON HOW TO USE THIS BECAUSE I REALLY WANT THE CORNS GONE :(

product_title: Annie's Macaroni and Cheese, Shells & Aged Cheddar Mac and Cheese, 6 oz Box (Pack of 12)
review_body: 5 and 3 year old can't get enough of this organic mac and cheese...and the cheese doesn't look toxic like some other brands!

product_title: Brown Gold 100% Coffee, 12 Ounce bag
review_body: I have had 3 cups of this coffee, and my husband has had a few here and there.  It's okay, but there's nothing really distinct or pronounced about it.  It makes a good cup of coffee, but it's not particularly flavorful or completely free from the slight bite of coffee, or anything else.  We've been making it in our Keurig, so perhaps that is part of it.  Overall, it's perfect for people like me who aren't picky about coffee (as long as it hasn't been sitting on a burner for 12 hours, and is free of floaties, I'll try it!), but not-so-great for people like my husband who drink coffee throughout the day and are looking for something above average.

product_title: Brach's Heartlines Tiny Conversation Hearts, 8 oz Bags in a BlackTie Box (Pack of 4)
review_body: Once Valentine's day was over and all the candy vanished, my crippling addiction to Brach's conversation hearts reared its ugly head and demanded attention.  This served the purpose!

product_title: Lindt Excellence Dark Chocolate, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: Good stuff.  We have a square (or two) every night.  Well worth the dollars to enjoy and not have to go to the store every week just to buy chocolate.

product_title: Tully's Coffee French Dark Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I have had to cut down on this product because it was too bitter.  I like French roast usually, but now I only drink it if I need an extra boost..

product_title: Senseo Coffee Espresso - (Pack of 2)
review_body:
It is a little different, in a great way. The taste is smooth and a bit stronger than Medium. When I bought it, it cost more than the Medium that I usually buy. It is essential I drink 10-12 oz of coffee at bedtime to avoid midnight migrains. This works as well as the Medium for that issue.
I found using just one Senseo pod, no matter which strength, taste as good as using two, and saves money.

product_title: Wedderspoon Manuka Honey KFactor 16, 11.5 Ounces
review_body: I was looking for an organic brand of manuka honey anywhere on the internet and this is the only one I could find. The taste is definitely different from regular honey but I like the taste of this one. It's mild and light. You only need a little bit of it or the taste can become too strong. I have read so many good things about manuka honey. Finding one that is organic and 16+ is very difficult. I will purchase more when I run out.

product_title: Hershey's Chocolate Kisses, 56 Ounce
review_body: I Bought these to use as party favors for our wedding, everyone loved them. I only wish I would have bought two of them, they did not stretch as far as I thought, but I think some of them never made it to the reception :) No issues with shipping, came quickly and in great condition.

product_title: Werther's Original Caramel Hard Candy, 34.0-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: I am not a candy person usually but recently started taking medication that left me with dry mouth/sore throat. I got tired of drinking water all the time, especially at night. So I thought getting some hard candy would help. Werthers' Original is not too sickly sweet and doesn't leave my mouth a strange color. To me Werthers' taste like a combination of caramel and butterscotch. I think of it as an adult's hard candy. It was very helpful in soothing my throat and dry mouth. And Amazon, like usual, offered a good selection of size bags and fair prices. If ever I need them again, Amazon is where I'll go.

product_title: Wolfgang Puck Coffee, Oktober Spice Pods
review_body:
So smooth.
First had in a hotel and was glad it was available for purchase to the public.
Will re order

product_title: Caza Trail Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 50 Count
review_headline: Best deal on Kona blend in over a year!
review_body:
Fantastic quality blend. Nice rich taste - bold enough but not at all bitter. We haven't bought Kona Blend since the shortage last year drove the prices through the roof. In fact ALL k-cup prices got jacked up for some reason and we stopped buying through Amazon since they couldn't even compete with Sam's Club prices on Colombian.

This was a very welcome addition to the suppliers here and I will keep buying from them as long as they keep the prices down to about .40 a cup.

Highly recommend this. No problems with faulty k-cups like earlier reviewers noted. Maybe they improved the QC.
At any rate - this coffee is (like the reason I started using Keurig when they first came out) a perfect cup every time.

product_title: Annie's Homegrown Gluten Free Cookies
review_body: I have been purchasing these cookies for several years now. They are delicious and are gluten free. I save tons of money buying on amazon. They are shipped promptly & I've never had any complains.

product_title: Similac Go and Grow Toddler Formula - Soy - Powder - 1.38 lb.
review_body:
Got my similac today, the expiration date says Nov 2013, it's June 2013 right now.

Usually the expiration date is at least 1 year later, not happy this formula is not as fresh as other places.

product_title: Better Oats Organic Raw Pure & Simple Chai Spiced Multigrain Hot Cereal with Flax Pack of 3 Boxes (5 Pouches Per Box)
review_body: This has become a morning staple in my home.  The only thing I do is add an bit more additional flax seed.  I have a very rough work schedule and eat around 4:30 am and do not eat my lunch until 11:00 am.  I eat this in the morning with an egg and a small glass of tomatoe juice.  If I don't include the oats I am ravenous by lunch.  Definitely, makes a difference in how I feel.

product_title: Ortega Original Fire Roasted Diced Green Chiles, Hot, 4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Astonishingly bad stuff. This is just a tasteless semi-puree of something that looks like green pepper. The HOT is patently false advertising and they should at least remove that.

product_title: Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cinnamon Almond, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 4)
review_body:
This granola has a strange taste. I would describe it as flat. The cocoa flavor, the main ingredient, is overwelming. It tastes and feels pasty. The cinnamon is a second taste, seperate from the cocoa. It tastes very much like plain cinnamon, not blended or enhanced by other flavors. There is very little sweet flavor in the mix.

I tried mixing it with plain yogurt, but that didn't fix the unpleasant taste.

The granola upsets my stomach. After eating a few pieces, it sits like a rock in my gut. The entire product is very strange. How on earth do you make bad granola?

product_title: Anderson's Pure Maple Syrup, Grade B, 32-Ounce
review_body: We've tried a couple of the Grade B syrups on Amazon and this is our favorite. The taste is very, welll, maple-y, which is what a dark, grade B should be.  Don't hesitate to try this one out if your looking for a great syrup.

product_title: Wonka Nerds Jelly Beans Easter, 13.0-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: this is candy, it taste good. there is not much more i can say about it but i have a minimun word count.

product_title: Original Gourmet Lollipops, Watermelon, (Pack of 30)
review_body: I love these lollipops! They are great for satisfying a sweet tooth! I would get them again! 30 is alot but they don't go bad

product_title: Kinder Schoko-Bons 125g
review_body: I've missed these since moving back to the States and this price wasn't bad so I picked em up.  Now half my friends are hooked on em too!

product_title: Zote Pink Laundry Bar Soap With Soap Grater
review_body: If you are looking for a good laundry soap, stain remover, softener; then this is it!  My towels come out of the dryer so fluffy & soft, no more fabric softener a to gunk up my washer!

product_title: 9GreenBox - 5 Money Tree Plants Braided into 1 Tree – Ceramic Pot
review_body: This arrived healthy with no damage or withering. It is a beautiful Pachira plant. Im amazed at how it looked straight out the box! It is doing extremely well. Most def will purchase another for my room since this was a gift for my sons room.

product_title: Crazy Cups Premium Sampler
review_body: Good variety featuring different roasts, blends and flavored coffees.  We are still working our way through it but have only found a couple that we didn't care for.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: This is a very smooth blend of coffee.  My wife and I really love the Donut Shop, and it is unlikely we would change anytime soon.  Every once in a while we get a cup that "bursts" while brewing, but it is not a big enough deal to make me change brands.  The subscribe and save (5% standard, 20% with 4 other items) helps with the price.  For the price-per-cup I think this is one of the best deals around.

product_title: Musselman's Cherry Pie Filling, 21 -Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is the worst excuse for cherry pie filling that I have ever seen. Three cans from different packing dates were opened to make my pies.  The cans were approximately 75% goop and only a few cherries.  I have been using various brands of cherry pie filling over the years and never have seen anything like this before.

product_title: Sprout Master Mini Triple
review_body: The smaller units are perfect for a single family & these units allow me to grow and keep fresh just enough sprouts to meet that criteria. However, for alfalfa sprouts, it takes so many seeds to make up the bulk that I would recommend using their larger units

product_title: Belvita Breakfast Biscuit, Blueberry, 8.8 Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: It was like it said in the ad. I love them as they are a quick nutricitional breakfast. Very good flavor.

product_title: Certified Organic Hard Red Wheat Sprouting Seed: Pre-Measured for 10"x20" Trays For Growing Wheatgrass to Juice, Grind for Flour & Bread, Ornamental Wheat Grass – Non-GMO
review_body: I thought I'd try growing this for my 2 cats who love the "cat grass" very easy to grow.  I was spending $5 a pop at the pet store for cat grass and that can really add up.

product_title: LorAnn Hard Candy Flavoring Oils 10 Pack YOU PICK THE FLAVORS
review_body: I'm on a "hard candy making" binge this month (next month it might be scones) and these flavors are great.  Such a large selection to choose from and I found a REALLY easy recipe to follow (6 minutes total in microwave).  Happy husband, happy shopping wife!

product_title: Oberto All Natural BBQ Seasoned Pork Jerky, 3.25 Ounce Bag (Pack Of 4)
review_body: I received a bag of BBQ Pork, which I'd never had before. I'm hooked! They are so moist and flavorful I can't put them down. I may never buy beef jerky again. I order these by the dozens.

product_title: Amazing Grass Kidz Formulas
review_body: Since my daughters been drinking this product their inmune system has boost so much. Before they'll use to get sick all the time and now No more colds or runny noses on weekends after school. This product is amazing, and have a great flavor too!

product_title: Kernel Season's Popcorn Seasoning White Cheddar, 2.85 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great for Popcorn and Other Foods
review_body:
It is branded as popcorn salt, but can be used on pretty much anything you want. It is a good price for the amount you get. Almost $3 each at the grocery store.

Good taste by a good brand.

product_title: Hollywood Safflower Oil, 32 Ounce Bottle
review_headline: Healthy oil at a great price and convenient
review_body:
I make sure to stock up on these oils every few months for my parents. They both have high cholesterol and as I've learned in my medical school biochemistry teachings, safflower oil is one of the best oils in reducing cholesterol as well as unhealthy saturated fats. It is far superior to the health benefits of olive oil, which is "fattier". Also this oil has a higher burning temperature for reduced accidental fire risk and it is also very light and does not give off a noticeable taste. Excellent for frying, grilling, sautéing or any use where oil is needed and especially if you don't want the strong flavors of other oils to overpower your food.

At this price and the 3 pack packaging makes it a no brainer when it comes to purchasing oil. And I must add we go through a lot so the added benefit of not carrying a heavy container to and from home (we live in a NYC apartment) and at a cheaper price what more can you ask for?

Before moving on, remember to 'shake well before use' because oil does separate over time and when kept in my 55 degree basement. Maybe it was aged to perfection? I dont know, but my experience was out of this world. I used Kettle One and a dry Martini n Rossi vermouth, along with some garlic stuffed olives. Well upon mixing it up, 80% vodka, 10% vermouth, 10% 1888 (I'm no pro) what resulted was a cloudy beverage that tasted smooth (probably thanks to the oils), not overly salty, mellow (probably thanks to the 1888) and delightful. Even though Kettle One is a very smooth vodka, its still vodka and has a bite to it. When using the 1888 vs any other brine olive juice, I think its the real oil in there that takes away from the bite. Maybe it coats the tongue, maybe it neutralizes something, I dont know, but its just so smooth and mellow I cannot get over it. I have been drinking dirty martinis for years and this tastes nothing like those, but in a good way. That in itself though may be something to consider for someone buying this.

So as of writing this review, I have a martini night scheduled with friends where I will gain some second opinions and post them here in the future.

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 with Premium Chocolate
review_body:
I first heard about PB2 at a Weight Watchers meeting in fall 2012. It was the leader who mentioned it, and informed those of us who hadn't yet been enlightened. Powdered peanut butter? Just add water? 45 calories per 2-tablespoon serving? Regular and chocolate-flavored? Sign me up!
I use PB2 as most people probably use peanut butter: spread on a bread product. Oh, but wait - there's more. I add a tablespoon to my oatmeal, to smoothies, to homemade spicy peanut sauce, to banana soft-serve, and to sweet baked goods that could benefit from another level of flavor. I know! Like I said, versatile.
Whether you want to decrease the amount of fat you're consuming, or you want to decrease the amount of calories you're consuming, or you just want convenience and versatility, PB2 is for you.

I have already made a batch of sourdough pancakes with the leftover dough that you're supposed to discard before feeding and they turned out extra yummy. Will bake my first bread with the sourdough starter tomorrow. I also like the breadtopia website with all its helpful information and recipes. The website helped me understand how to correctly feed the dough so it develops its full potential, which helped me getting my "homemade" wheat starter dough to bubble up just as the starter that I bought from breadtopia. Great product!

product_title: Hapi Hot Wasabi Peas, 4.9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 8)
review_body:
These are hard to describe for those who have never had them, but I'll give it a try...

If you've had wasabi before, then this is simply dried wasabi baked onto a dehydrated sweet pea. You don't really taste the pea. It almost tastes like a hollow roasted soybean with wasabi.

If you've never had wasabi before, it is a very spicy flavor that comes from a type of horseradish. It is a green sort of powdery paste, which has been baked onto the dehydrated peas.

These are not super spicy, but the spice does gradually build while you eat them. On a spice scale of 1 to 5, I would rate these a 2 at the start and after eating a handful, the spiciness goes up to about a 3 or 3.5-ish.

One day I actually read the label carefully and realized there are milk ingredients and immediately threw the bag away.....such a dissappointment. Now I am experiementing with gluten free flowers to make my own all purpose flower.

Here are some alternatives to find recipes for:

~ Quinoa flour
~ Amaranth Flour
~ Brown Rice Flour
~ Sorghum Flour
~ Teff Flour
~ Coconut Flour
~ Almond Flour

I think I found a flour combo that I like (Amaranth/Almon) but I need to find a good starch binder. Here are some examples:

~ Tapioca Starch
~ Potato Starch
~ Arrowroot

Bottom line, there is more to the gluten free world than what is in this bag.

product_title: Quaker Instant Oatmeal Variety Pack
review_headline: Great taste, good for on-the-go - maybe not quite as healthy as other choices
review_body:
Quaker knows how to make tasty oatmeal, no doubt.

This is a sweet - but not too sweet - breakfast meal, which is also easy to take on-the-go. Unlike the Kashi oatmeal brand, you could make Quaker with just hot water (Kashi needs a microwave).

Nutrionally (and I'm only going off the packet info), Quaker matches up well with Kashi. Quaker is a slightly larger packet (43 to 40 grams), so that subtly affected differences in nutrition as well.

Quaker has more sugar - 12 grams to 7 grams. More sodium - 200 grams to 100. And less dietary fiber - 4 grams to 5 grams.

Quaker is enriched - it has Vitamin A, Calcium, Niacin, and other vitamins that Kashi does not have at all.

Calories are about the same - 160 for Quaker to 150 for Kashi.

I'm no nutrition expert, so I make no claims what all this really means. But I know that more sodium = not always good, and dietary fiber = good.

Quaker tastes better - maybe slightly too sweet. But I really like it. On the other hand, Kashi does seem slightly healthier. I think either choice would work, but I would go with Quaker if I wanted that sweeter get-started taste in the morning.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Raw Chia Seeds
review_headline: The seeds of the infamous "chia pets" have made a revolutionary comeback! Here are the specific health benefits.
review_body:
Who would have thought the source of the once popular chia pets would make a comeback decades later as a revolutionary health food... Chia seeds have only fairly recently come into the light in the health community and are now even referred to as a \\"superfood,\\" primarily for their unusually high natural soluble fiber and omega-3 fatty acid content, and a vegan source to boot. These omega-3 fatty acids have powerful anti-inflammatory effects that help heal and prevent a range of chronic diseases. Chia seeds are also rich in zinc, which also has beneficial anti-inflammatory effects. Another great effect of chia seeds is blood sugar stabilization, which can benefit those with hypoglycemia.

Chia seeds have been around for a while, of course, but have recently become popular as word has spread about their health benefits and ease of consumption. You can eat a spoonful of them alone, or sprinkle them on yogurt, oatmeal, and salads. You can also make pudding with the \\"gel\\" that results from soaking the seeds. This gel can be used as a substitute for eggs in baked goods recipes.

Chia seeds are exceptionally popular among those trying to lose weight; they expand in the stomach and take longer to digest, making you feel full faster. It has been said that the Aztecs used to carry a small pouch of chia seeds on long trips to maintain energy levels. Chia seeds have also become favorable to flax seeds because chia seeds are easier to digest, don't have to be ground up, and contain more antioxidants. Like flax seeds, chia seeds have a mild, nutty flavor.

As mentioned, chia seeds are an extremely concentrated source of vital omega-3 fatty acids, which is great news if you happen to be allergic to fish. They are also loaded with natural soluble fiber, which causes the gel expansion. Because of this, it is not recommended to consume more than a couple tablespoons of chia seeds per day, because the high concentration of fiber can upset your stomach. Iremember the first day I tried chia seeds; I had a little too much, and had severe stomach pain for about an hour.

These chia seeds from NOW Foods are very good; they are certified organic, kosher, vegan, gluten-free, and raw.

review_headline: Tasty popcorn, but not hull free
review_body:
I've enjoyed making numerous batches of kettle corn with these kernels. My husband hates popcorn because it gets stuck in his teeth, but he will eat this. Although not hull-less I usually only get one or two per batch. I've successfully converted my hubbie to a popcorn connoisseur with this recipe.

Prepare a cup with:
1/2 corn kernels,
1 tsp salt,
1/4 cup brown sugar and set aside.

In a whirley pop over medium-high heat. Warm two kernels of corn with 1/8 cup coconut oil.

When the two test kernels pop, the oil is ready. Dump the cup with the kernels, salt and brown sugar into the whirley pop and start turning the handle. It's very important not to over pop as the carmelized sugar can easily burn. As soon as it starts to slow down to less than one pop per second remove from heat and shake vigorously until it is finished popping. Then empty into a bowl asap.

Let cool slightly then brake up any clumps and serve.

review_body:
Only in America can a man become a cable technician, then a funny comedian, then a famous chef of boxed food! Larry \\"got-r-done\\" again with this cheeseburger dinner, a sequel to his hamburger dinner. Just like Larry's role in \\"Tooth Fairy 2\\", this box proves that sequels CAN be as amazing as the first!

This is the perfect dinner to eat alone or with a person. If you feel intimate, you can even cook it for a date. I tried this a couple weeks ago when Carla agreed to meet with me. She would not come to my apartment because of the pest problem. But this meal is so easy to make, I managed to cook it using a skillet and utility hook-up at the public park! Just add some water, heat it up, spray on some WD-40 for texture, then BAM! You got yourself dinner for two. The meat cooked well and mixed right in. It felt like I was eating a cheeseburger, in bowl form. Carla dug in too, and I heard no complaints from that one! Not even with regards to the raccoon meat.

After we finished I turned on my tape deck and fast-forwarded to the guitar solo from \\"Take it on the Run\\" by REO Speedwagon. And I took off my shirt. Unfortunately Carla was not ready to \\"take it\\" to the next level and \\"Git-R-Done\\"! Don't blame it on the cheeseburger dinner though. My only complaint, guys, is that the picture of Larry on the box will make you look less attractive by comparison. This can cause ladies to lose interest quickly after catching Larry and those biceps! I suggest cutting off your sleeves before eating.

Another warning is that the box does NOT come with meat included. If you don't have a BB gun, twine, and access to varmints, you will need to buy meat from the store at an extra cost. But trust me, fellas, it's worth it! This box is a must-have for your kitchen, trailer, or trunk. \\"Eat Up\\", as Larry might say after a long day of wranglin' fiberoptic cable.

I give the meal 5 STARS and I'll be eating this for a good while. At least until Larry finally comes out with that beef jerky pasta meal I've been hearing about.comes out with that beef jerky pasta meal I've been hearing about.

review_body:

I really, really wish Walkers would start selling these crisps here in the US. They are just so good, it nearly kills me to pay this price for them, but they are worth it.

As a side note : Make sure you are NOT ordering from British Groceries Wholesale! It is nearly impossible to speak with their cust. service, and items get lost in the mail with tragic regularity. Most of the other sellers of this item are great, but always always ALWAYS check the sellers feedback when ordering from overseas. Some are far more reliable than others!

product_title: Balance Bar, 1.76 Ounce - Regular Honey Peanut
review_headline: The best of the chocolate balance bars! Delicious and nutritious....
review_body:
After trying half a dozen brands of nutritional bars, and at least a dozen balance bars, I decided that the honey peanut balance bar is the best. It tastes like the real chocolate it is, with the chewiness of caramel/honey/peanut, plus it's very nutritious. I've been buying these in bulk for over three years, and always carry at least one around in my purse. Since I teach and often don't have time for a meal during breaks, I find that one of these bars tastes good, fills me up, and provides me with many hours of energy. It's almost an instant pick-me-up.

One bar has only 200 calories. It has 23 vitamins and minerals, including 50% or more of the daily requirements for vitamin A, vitamin C and vitamin E (anti-oxidants), and 25% for vitamin D. It supplies 30% of the daily requirement for protein. It also has 15% of the requirements for such vitamins and minerals as thiamine, riboflavin, B12, selenium, zinc, niacin, B6 and many more. In regard to the potentially \\"bad stuff\\" - its saturated fat DV% is only 15% (compared to 50% or more in many chocolate bars), and sodium is only 8%.

For those with food allergies: Be aware that it does quite obviously contain peanuts and peanut butter - as well as lactose, fructose, soy, soybean oil, and glucose syrup so anyone with allergies to any of these foods should not eat this bar. But for the rest of us and chocolate lovers in particular, I doubt that you could find a nutritional bar that tastes as good as this, and is as healthy.

(Note: I have no investment in balance bars, so gain nothing by recommending about this product except the satisfaction of sharing my enthusiasm.)

product_title: Barista Prima Coffeehouse Coffee, Keurig K-Cups, 24 Count
review_headline: Just What I was Looking For!
review_body:
I purchased a Keurig last month and have been experimenting with different types of coffee, looking for a dark roast with a robust flavor that will stand up to coffee creamer, including flavored ones. The Barista Prima Coffeehouse Italian Dark Roast is just what I was looking for!

I drink 3-5 cups of coffee a day, starting with a cup the first thing in the morning. I don't want some wimpy blond roast for my first cup of the day and the Dark Italian Roast is just perfect for that morning jolt. I was unable to detect any suggestion of a burnt flavor which sometimes occurs with other brands. Sometimes Arabica beans can produce a slightly harsh brew, but that is not the case here. It is smooth and it does stand up to any type of flavored coffee creamer. I make the largest cup available with my Keurig, which is a little over 10 ounces. With some other dark roast brands I had to go to a medium size cup to get the flavor I wanted, but that is not true with Barista Prima -- I could have a large cup and get the flavor. I highly recommend this brand.

review_headline: This is semi-sweet chocolate, not 72% or higher
review_body: It took time and effort for me to explore the label, but explore I did, and discovered that the label itself calls this product semi-sweet chocolate.  That being said, in defense of the product, it is absolutely delightful.  My experience with this product rates up there with excellent red table wine along with a perfectly grilled steak!  Lindt, Ghirardelli, and other brands sell dark chocolate products designed to protect the body from the surge of blood sugar and then insulin that follows the consumption of candy bars with less than about 70-80% cacao (cocoa), depending upon which authority you consult.  Ask Paleo dieters and diabetics.  I think the Lindt brand accomplishes more creaminess in the very high % cocoa bars, but I also like to buy American and I know that Ghirardelli is American. IN SUMMARY: You can't go wrong with this product if you are looking for a fine sweet treat, but if you need a low sugar chocolate bar, go for the midnight reverie at 72% or a bar with even higher % of cocoa.  P.S. this review was by Joy Irvin, William's wife

This tea is very tasty and smells delightful.

product_title: Jell-O Instant Chocolate Mousse, 3.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Texture far too light for mousse
review_body:
I am a huge fan of chocolate mousse, but this is not quite mousse. I'd call it "fluff," because the texture is extremely airy. Mousse is airy with some weight behind it--richer, and more like thick and fluffy at the same time. This product is more along the lines of Cool Whip. It might have its place, but you probably wouldn't eat it straight from the carton by itself.

The flavor is not all bad, but you must serve it very cold. As soon as it starts to warm even slightly (even below room temperature), it begins to taste...odd. It reminds me of freezer-burned chocolate ice cream. The echo of the flavor is there, but it's not quite right. My four-year-old enjoyed his first taste from the bowl, but a few more bites in it had warmed up just a tad (not much, considering how fast my kids will down chocolate), and suddenly he wouldn't eat anymore. A four-year-old does not turn down chocolate lightly--especially not one who was so excited to sample the dessert he helped mommy make! We had some leftover, and it was somewhat better when layered with strawberry pudding. As a garnish/accent layer in a parfait, it is perhaps a reasonable choice.

On the plus side, it is very easy to make. The mixer does all the work, and it is an excellent choice for making with your little ones. It is fun to see the texture go from milk/powder to "fluff." But next time I use a boxed mix, I'll just stick to pudding.

product_title: Mario Camacho Green Pitted Olives Seasoned with Thyme and Chili, 1.75-Ounce Packages (Pack of 10)
review_body:
The small pkg is deceiving ~ it contains more olives than I expected, which not only makes for a good 'tide-me-over' snack between meals, I find that it's also a handy portion to include on a sampler tray for 2-4 people.

I like the versatility of the the individual packaging for the simple reason that (1) it's a snack-to-go & (2) it's also handy for using in recipes w/out having to dig olives out of a jar & then drain them too, but that's just a personal preference & YMMV.

While not exactly mushy, these are *not* firm olives, to be sure ~ they're also not bitter like some green olives can be, & I imagine that the texture is the result of duration spent soaking in the flavorful brine. The flavor holds up well when included in a pasta dish or on a pizza.

Because olives have so many health-boosting benefits, & because there are so many intricate varieties of flavor due to processing (of which tasting is half the fun) these are definitely worth a try.

review_headline: Not that impressed.  Premium price for a pedestrian blend.

It did have a nice smell as I opened the bag, but there wasnt much oil on the beans which sent up a red flag. It brewed up and smelled really nice in the kitchen, the taste was creamy and buttery with a mild aftertaste. It tasted very familiar. In fact, it tasted exactly like Jose's Columbian Supremo Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee you can buy in a 3 pound bag at Target for about half the price. Like, exactly the same. The irony here is I was trying to REPLACE Jose's coffee with a better bean.

I was expecting a qualitatively better cup of coffee at $.89 an ounce. I paid a premium for it too. Needless to say, I was pretty disappointed that the price paid did not reflect a better cup of coffee. Looks like I will have to find another blend.

review_headline: overall  good but might be too spicy for some
review_body: I bought 2 of  these to try out for hunting and fishing trip.  Shipping was very fast and they are well packaged.  I tried one today.  The penna w sausage and vegetables.  The heater worked very fast, very hot - be careful with these. The crackers, peanut butter and orange creamcicle cookies are pretty good.  The penna was good, heated hot but way too spicy for me. I AM pretty sensitive but this stuff had my head and neck sweating heavily. Needed a towel - no kidding. If you like that kind of thing fine but I won't choose that one for future purchases.  I haven't tried the other one - don't recall what flavor it is. For those who recall "tasteless" military rations - for that one flavor, they went overboard the other way. Also, for a serious cold day hunt I'd probably have to eat 2 of these meals - I tend to eat big meals.  For a lunch, warm weather (above 30 F)  or back-up emergency rations these will do nicely - the flameless heater could be very very nice in some situations. I want to try other flavors - hopefully a bit more mildly seasoned. I hope to revisit this review when I try the other trial meal pack.

product_title: Brooklyn Beans Single-cup Coffee for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 40-Count
review_body:
This review is not for the coffee, but for the cup itself. The bottom won't pierce. This is the only brand I have experienced this with and I use a lot of kcups. After thinking that a friend's Keurig may not have been working properly when she told me she had this same problem with this brand, I now see that she was right. The plastic must be too hard.

UPDATE: Since writing my original review, which I rated 1 star, I decided to try to continue to use these kcups anyway. I am more than half way through the box and have had only one more incident. You can tell when you don't hear that familiar \\"pop\\" sound upon lowering the lever to close down on the kcup, that it didn't pierce bottom. So I merely lifted the Keurig lever and pushed down gently on the kcup with my fingers until I felt it pierce, then proceeded as usual.

COFFEE: Very good! I think it is delicious and smooth. I purchased the variety pack and I truly enjoy all of the flavors. I find the coffee is not bitter at all and even the extra bold dark roasts don't have what I call an \\"ash-y\\" taste that I have experienced with other brands.

I would buy again because I see that the company is earnestly trying to fix the problems with the cups themselves. I can't wait to update this to 5 stars.

review_headline: Apart from the price, this is almost perfect
review_body:
As my title imply, I'm pretty satisfied with this chip.

I've been frequenting the Lay's Stack tubing type previously until I found amazon dropped the price for this, so I decided to give it a try. I ordered the classic, wavy original, cheddar, as well as the sour cream, all tasted as good as the tubing(the blue plastic tube packaging) type. Fresh and tasty. One of the biggest thing I noticed is the salt in this lay's branded is all applied smoothly. So far I've consumed 10+ bags already, none of them tasted different, while in some other brands, you'd get two bags with different amount of salt, especially the chips in the bottom portion of the bag - -..

Only one thing I don't really like, slightly a bit too much salt...maybe they are designed to be served with drink?? Anyway, 4 stars.

PS: amazon priced these $15+ per bag in the past..unbelievable!!! Did they think they can really sell a single bag for that price? Anyway, they then dropped the prices to around $3.5 per bag which is just hitting the acceptable line. Recently, they dropped the prices again down to around $2.75(buying some other small bands locally are less than 2 bucks, around $1.5~2 for this kind of 10 ounce family pack), so this becomes one of my daily snack lol~

Very nice packaging BTW (also 2 photos uploaded for this). Amazon has really put a lot of effort in this, they put two supporting cardboard as the frame with one flat cardboard in between to divide the box into two layers, and so chips can be put into each little box to better protect them from crashing. I'd love them if they can keep the shipping low for long as they finally established the business physically in CA, the same state where I reside. Maybe start paying the tax in compensation for the shipping? hum....

review_headline: Pretty good rice cracker. Light and crispy. A little sticky though.

The most important thing to understand about these crackers: they are RICE crackers. While technically multigrain, they are mostly rice. So they have a light, extremely crispy texture and none of the wheat taste one expects from crackers. They are strong and brittle, with a salty light taste.

They are coated with a very thin layer of glaze, which makes them get slightly sticky in the hand.

Good, air-tight inner packaging ensures they arrive fresh and not broken.

product_title: Simply Shari's Gluten-free Lemon Shortbread Cookies, 6.5-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body:
I picked these cookies up in a Marshall's, of all places.

We are really getting into different teas that my wife buys at Teavana and it's becoming sort of an evening tradition to have a cup of tea with some \\"special\\" cookies. And what I mean by special is something I'm learning from attending WeightWatchers.

Instead of eating a few not-all-that-good cookies, we'd rather have a really good cookie in a smaller quantity and enjoy each bite more thoroughly. So when I saw these in Marshall's, they seemed to fit the bill. They are bite-sized shortbread cookies. They are fantastic. Not only is the shorbread texture great, the lemon is pronounced and just how I like it. The fact that these are gluten-free didn't faze me in the least. I'm not gluten intolerant but it doesn't even matter... these taste good whether they are gluten-free or not.

We're definitely buying these again and probably from Amazon next time since they're sold in packs of 4 from Amazon. Yum!

By the way, if you like Shari's Lemon Shortbreak cookies, you may also enjoy [[ASIN:B006H33U7O WOW BAKING COMPANY Cookies, Lemon Burst, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6)]]. They are also very lemony. Not shortbread, but a really good soft, moist & gluten-free lemon cookie.

product_title: Ragu Pasta Sauce, Old World Style, Traditional, 45-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body:
I know, I know, one should make one's own spaghetti sauce from scratch. But we often run short of thyme (get it, thyme? Oh well...).

This reviewer received four bottles of the Ragu sauce. Well, that means four chances to try it in recipes!

First was basic spaghetti. I usually add ground beef or turkey and this sauce added the right zest. It was enjoyed by all!

I like to use spaghetti sauce when I make my chili, so bottle #2 went into chili. Again, we all liked the zest.

My sister decided to use a jar in making lasagna. I'm glad she had that idea!

Finally, we decided to make home-made pizzas and bread sticks. Jar #4 went to the pizza crust with some left out for bread stick marinade. Well, the football game might have been boring, but the pizza and bread sticks were a hit!

Overall, I found Ragu to be a great accompaniment to many of my favorite recipes!

product_title: Open Pit Thick and Tangy Barbeque Sauce, 18 Ounce
review_headline: Old friend getting hard to find.
review_body:
As of late this particular flavor of Open pit BBQ sauce has been missing from all of our grocers shelves. Fearing the demise of this our favorite. We found it on Amazon and stocked up. But like all good things. No sooner than we get our order from Amazon, than the grocers all have it back on their shelves. Figures right. Who knows why there was this period of not being in stock except for Amazon. But we are glad to know that we won't have to go back to making this flavor from scratch. That is how we came to start using it. We found by accident that the sauce that I had made up was very close in flavor to this sauce, but was a lot of bother to make. So finding this just freed up a bunch of time. While still providing that flavor that we had come to love. Of course I still have to add one special ingredient to make it perfect. But let's just say that my BBQ Chicken and Ribs always get rave reviews. It is a very tasty sauce with out any doctoring as well. So feel free just to lather it on your favorite BBQ. It will still taste great. This in my opinion is their best tasting sauce, bar none.

So we are feeling very secure knowing that if we again cannot find it in our local grocers, we will still be able to find it on Amazon. Makes one feel all warm and fuzzy inside to know that your favorite item will still be available on Amazon.

review_body:

review_headline: Great bulk product -saves money & easy to make ahead for quick breakfasts
review_body: The 4 pack is great, economical compared to buying singly at the grocery store.  We get up quite early during the week so here is what I do:  Use a smaller sized crockpot, grease it with a little coconut oil, put in one cup of steel cut oats, 1 cup milk, and 2.5 cups water, add a little liquid stevia to sweeten, cook on low for 2.5 hours.  Keep covered as it cools, mix in plenty of cinnamon (also a cholesterol skimmer:) and sometimes some ground flax seed if I have it around.  Put in a covered bowl in the fridge.  We get a little out each morning into our bowls and microwave it.  Healthy, yummy, and easy.

review_body: These pods are OK, but I still prefer the Senseo brand. When I open a bag of Melitta pods I get....coffee. A bag of Senseo pods brings people from the hall into my office with a smile on their face hoping to get a cup of that wonderful smell. With Melitta I couldn't smell the coffee if I strapped the bag to my face. Heck, an open can of Chock Full O' Nuts smells better. Granted, the taste of the coffee itself is pretty good. Perhaps a little less flavor than the Senseo brand. But I will pay the small incremental price for the more robust flavor and that wonderful aroma. product_title: Spicy World Ground Coriander Powder Bulk, 5-Pounds
review_headline: SAVE MONEY-BUY A LARGE BULK BAG. GREAT CORIANDER. ARRIVES FRESH AND FLAVORFUL!
review_body:
Coriander is a wonderful, versatile spice. We use it a lot in enchiladas, sauces, curries. some stews, etc.

You may be familiar with the leaves-Fresh coriander leaves, also known as Chinese parsley or cilantro.

The seeds have a lemony citrus flavor when you crush them due to release of the terpenes linalool and pinene contained within. The taste of the ground spice ( a very ancient spice) is warm, nutty, spicy, and citrus-y, orange-flavored. This spice acts as a thickener and imparts a richness to your sauces and stews.

Coriander roots have a deeper, more intense flavor than the leaves. They are used in a variety of Asian cuisines. They are commonly used in Thai dishes, including soups and curry pastes. So, if you use the ground spice, you'll need to use more.

Honestly, a penurious little jar of coriander is around $5 for 1.5 oz at the store (OK, $4.89). So use it, the rationale that it won't be flavorful is just not true. Keep it well sealed, dry, and cool. We also got a bunch of little jars to store the spice in a better airtight container & also to give away to friends who like to cook. Good spice is always appreciated!

Coriander contains antioxidants and has been investigated and found to have many health benefits. (Might even increase your HDL!) Interesting to do some searches on that subject. Coriander seeds are boiled with water and drunk as indigenous medicine for colds. Most of these significant health benefits probably require the actual seed.

If you want really fresh coriander, get the seeds and grind them. It's just a great spice & this is a fantastic savings!

product_title: Pilon Gourmet Espresso Coffee
review_body:
Although I prefer the lower-priced sibling - [[ASIN:B004SVMAOG Cafe Pilon]] - this is truly a five star coffee, and especially so if your tastes run towards smooth brews.

In order to understand why this is not my personal preference compared to Pilon's other roast, I grew up drinking Italian and European espresso. Those are characterized by a slight bitterness that is prized by folks who enjoy those coffees. Of course the first time I tried Cuban coffee I became hooked.Those coffees lacked the bitter notes of the European roasts, but have a richness and aroma that appealed to my palate. Naturally I had to try this one since I love the Cafe Pilon regular roast. Unfortunately it was too smooth. Of course personal tastes are as individual as snowflakes, but the smoothness of this particular roast and the beans seemed to also diminish the thick richness.

I make my espressos in a [[ASIN:B000CNY6UK Bialetti 6800 Moka Express 6-Cup Stovetop Espresso Maker]]. That pot works best with a grind that is not too fine, and I found the grind of this coffee to be ideal for that maker.

Overall, if you love Cuban coffees, but want something a little smoother than the normal fare - but still rich - this is worth a try. If you like your coffee super strong with a hint of bitterness you may not enjoy this premium roast as much as Pilon's regular one.

product_title: Grove Square Cappuccino, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Surprisingly good! Lots of Caffeine too!
review_body:
I received my K-Cup machine for Chrimstas and have basically been tired since then. I've tried most of the K-Cups and just just gave up on having caffeine in my system unless I buy a cup of coffee elsewhere. Relegated to a novelty, I used the K-Cup brewer for tea, hot chocolate, and other fun drinks. I came across this pack in the store and gave it a whirl- wow!

It tastes GREAT! And I'm actually awake after I drink it! It has just enough caffeine to pick me up but not so much that I'm shaking. It basically tastes like their hot chocolate k-cups (which are also good). I know these use instant coffee rather than normal coffee, but that might be why all of the caffeine makes it into the drink. These k-cups work by emptying all of the contents of the k-cup into your coffee cup, no filters. Most k-cups leave the coffee in the k-cup, with much of it unused and the caffeine gets tossed in the garbage. These are great because all of the coffee winds up in your body!

product_title: Hodgson Mill Gluten Free Multi Purpose Baking Mix, 12-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Odd results, not enough recipes from the company
review_body:
I don't hate this, and that's why it's getting three stars. I knew when I bought it that it was made from heavier flours, and I chose it for that reason over baking mixes that are basically made from light, white flours.

But I didn't expect the dearth of information the company provides about this mix. Like how to use it. I've bought gluten-free baking mixes before and easily used them for breads, cobblers, etc. just with common sense additions (I've been cooking a long time). Not so with this one. Things barely rise despite the additions of leavening, sugar, eggs, whatever I thought would help. Everything's heavy and too crusty. Nothing in the bread family worked at all. And so I went looking on the website for sample recipes beyond the few on the box.

There are a lot of recipes on the site, but nothing using this mix. So I called them to ask if they had any, and unbelievably they don't, not one. I wonder how they developed this mix, without producing recipes in their test kitchen. So I'm left with the boxes of this I bought in optimism, but will now require a lot of experimentation (and more failures) to use.

This could go up to five stars if there was more kitchen support from the company.

If anyone who likes and has success with this mix would post recipes or advice here, I'd be really grateful.

product_title: Farm-fresh: 100% Kona Coffee, Medium Roast, Whole Beans, 1 Lb
review_headline: It Is Hard To Describe The Love
review_body:
I made my first pot of this Kona this morning. The hardware: 6-month-old standard Mr. Coffee high-quality drip coffee maker, and a high-quality burr grinder. The grind: medium with small chunks and almost no powder. Water: Texas tap water through Pur filter/pitcher. The brew: 5 slightly heaping teaspoons of freshly-ground Blue Horse Kona.(I like it strong but not THICK)

Nose: smooth coffee aroma with cinnamon-vanilla hints
Taste: Pure pleasure. No bitter, no green. Warm, rich smokiness, perhaps a little dark chocolate in there. It is so smooth I almost couldn't feel it in my mouth. Amazing!

A decade or so ago, I visited my parents in California. A friend of theirs had just gotten back from Hawaii the afternoon before. As he was headed to the airport in Hawaii that morning, he stopped and bought some Kona that had literally just been roasted, to bring back with him. When he got back and found out I love Kona coffee, he invited us over for coffee from that batch. It was the best cup of Kona I have ever had.

My cup of Blue Horse coffee this morning was the second best cup of Kona I have ever had. Period.

Thank you Blue Horse for an absolutely AWESOME experience!

review_body:

I steeped mine in one of those refillable steel-mesh balls. The flavor was excellent. It was so good, in fact, that i was tempted to eat some of the steeped tea- so I did, and it was pretty good!

The instructions call for 1 Tbsp per 8 oz of water, steeped at 170F.

My only disappointment was that 1.76 oz is not very much tea. I paid $12.69 (Amazon Prime Jan 2013). I estimate that if I drink one 8-oz cup per day, this will last a couple of weeks or so.

Pros: It taste awesome. I like it with Spenda.
Cons: Expensive per oz.

Also, don't add milk. I just read a study that suggests the protein in milk destroys the antioxidants in green tea. Google this to see if they still think it's true.

Peace.

product_title: Melitta Java Jig, Reusable K-Cups for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Uses Melitta Paper Coffee Filters,2 cups and 30 filters
review_headline: Works well, but difficult to get right
review_body:
I've used my Keurig happily for two years. I would gladly use my own coffee and use these refillable cups IF i could get a good cup of coffee out of these.

This particular cup is very easy to use, and very easy to lose. It has four separate parts. A lid, a piece that holds the filter in place, the filter and then the cup. My previous reusable cup fell victim to the garbage disposal, so I'm extra careful now. It comes with two sets of the three main pieces, and a bunch of filters.

The concept is easy, cleanup is simple (simply throw out the filter, rinse/wash the rest) but the execution is still flawed. The coffee tends to come out SO weak. I use a dark bold roast so I know it isn't my coffee. I think that it just doesn't stay in the cup long enough and just brews so fast that it comes out as barely flavored water verses K-cups that kind of force the water to linger for a minute.

I'll keep using this and trying to get a good cup, but as of now - 20+ cups in - I still cannot say I've gotten it down enough to trust it with my crucial first cup of coffee in the morning.

review_headline: Krusteaz Cinnamon Crumb Cake Mix  - Very good tasting and easy to make
review_body:
Visitors, including our parents, our college-senior daughter and her friends, and all the kids on our teen son's volleyball team, get 'upset' if we do not have these readily available when they visit. This crumb cake smells wonderful when baking, and both the taste and texture exceed the expectation that the wonderful baking fragrance sets you up for. Crispy on the top yet soft and full of cinnamon on the inside.

Making this crumb cake is easy -- preheat the oven to 350, mix the batter, spread half the batter into a 9 x 9 pan, scatter 1/3 of the cinnamon mix over the batter, spread the remaining half of the batter over the mixture, scatter 1/3 of the cinnamon mix over it all, swirl the mixture with a flat edge to meld the cinnamon and batter together, then scatter the last of the cinnamon over the top. Cook about 45 minutes.

Delicious! Crispy on the outside, but soft & moist on the inside. We recommend Krusteaz Crumb Cake mix and think you will enjoy it as much as we do. Enjoy!

product_title: Reserve Du Chateau 4 Week Wine Kit
review_body:
In a general way I think all wine kit manufacturers fudge the imaginary speed with which their products can be ready to serve to guests. And the universal fault of new wine makers is impatience.

I've been making wine for 3 years now & begin to have a decent reputation among friends. I offer the following advice in hopes that more experienced wine makers will add to or correct it. And hope beginners will find it helpful.

Wine making is insanely easy! You just buy the best juice you can afford and ferment it without contaminating it. But the cardinal sin is to drink it too soon. According to my brief experience the following are apropriate:

Apple wine - bottle between 1-3 months after start of fermentation & age 6 months more before drinking.
Cherry blueberry elderberry etc. - bottle @ 6-9 months and begin to consume after 1 year.
\\"4week\\" white wine kits - purchase at a discount & pour directly into sink as they're unfit for decent people.
\\"6 & 8 week\\" white wine kits - bottle at 3-4 months and begin to consume after 1 year. These can be good.
\\"4 week\\" red wine kits - bottle at 6 months and begin to consume after 1 year.
\\"6 & 8 week\\" red wine kits - The Best! Bottle at 1 year. Set aside in a cool place for another year. Tell your lazy son to stay out of it. Then slowly begin to enjoy.

Someone with 10 years or more experience please chime in!

UPDATE NOV 29: Further experience with premium white wines demands bottling around 9 months. The reason is gas. A soda would go flat overnight. But wine has miraculous gas retention capability. Even if sparklingly clear it might be gassy - which effects taste and visual impressions. I cannot stir it all out with the drill mounted agitator & really don't think it's right to agitate too vigorously. So I got more carboys and wait...

product_title: Trader Joe's Cocoa Powder Unsweetened
review_body:
I purchased organic TJ cocoa in Tucson and liked it, but when I tried to buy it in Houston, TX at TJ on Voss, I was lied to, yelled at, and insulted because \\"everything is natural at TJ and doesn't need to be organic.\\" Natural means nothing. I wanted organic, unsweetened, non-alkali cocoa, not a mix filled with sugar. The old man working in customer service kept yelling at me all the TJ products are natural, there are no chemicals. I said to him sugar is a chemical, it is made in a chemical plant, I don't eat sugar. He carried on like a crazy person. He insisted sugar is not a chemical. I guess TJ taught him to lie to customers. His rude, aggressive, loud behavior has assured that I will won't return to TJ. There are plenty of nice stores in Houston to shop, I won't go back to TJ. They don't have the organic, fair trade, non alkali unsweetened cocoa any more anyway. If you find a TJ product you like, you probably won't ever see it there again, so why go there?

It is difficult to find cocoa that is not processed with alkali. And now reports indicate much cocoa contains dangerous levels of metals such as cadmium. It's a good idea not to drink much cocoa.

product_title: Neuro Nutritional Supplement Drink, 14.5 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have been taking this drink before bedtime for a couple of months now. First several times I slept really well. After about several days of drinking this at night, I started having really strange dreams that would wake me up in the middle of the night. I reduced the amount that I was drinking from half the bottle to a few sips, but dreams continued and started becoming more and more strange and sometimes even very disturbing. As soon as I  stopped taking the drink and the crazy dreams would stop too. To test it, I did this on and off for a few weeks. On those nights I took the drink, I had crazy and extremely vivid dreams. On nights without taking this drink, I had no dreams. The drink will put you to sleep, that's not the problem. In that sense, it works really well. The problem for me was staying asleep. Basically, it became almost impossible to go back to sleep after waking up in the middle of the night with my heart racing because of very vivid and disturbing dreams. There were nights when the dreams would be so disturbing and violent that I would spend all night awake, from about 3:00 AM until 6:30 AM when my alarm usually goes off.  I had to stop taking this.... it's was just too weird. I can definitely link the occurrences of crazy dreams to the drink.

product_title: Key Ingredient Recipe Reader, WiFi Refurbished
review_body:
I love to cook so my mom bought me a Recipe Reader for my birthday (after I suggested it of course). I had random recipes everywhere from website print outs to hand written in a notebook to favorites from recipe books. I wanted a way to bring them all together and organize them. Through Google, I found out about the older Demy. Yes I could have used my ipad but I'm a very messy cook and I tend to spill things everywhere so one of the major selling points for me was that the Recipe Reader is splash proof and you can easily clean it by wiping the screen. I don't have to worry about ruining my ipad. The new version hadn't come out yet so I patiently waited until it was released and I pestered the people at Key Ingredient for updates.

I've had it for about 6+ months and I love my Recipe Reader and its ease of use. With Cookmark you an easily clip recipes from various websites or you can just copy and paste the recipe to your Key Ingredient account. I also like that you can add favorite recipes from other users on Key Ingredient using your phone or computer and they automatically sync to your Recipe Reader. I love the conversion function for measurements and I like being able to organize my recipes how I want. I love everything about the Recipe Reader except one thing: the battery. I took off one star because the battery life is not very long and it takes forever to charge. If you're cooking a complex meal that takes time and you forgot to charge your Recipe Reader in full then you're out of luck. This is just a minor inconvenience though and I'm willing to deal with it because of all the other positives. I can't imagine being without my Recipe Reader now.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Coconut Manna
review_headline: Check the expiration date on yours
review_body:
I'm a big fan of their [[ASIN:B001EO5Q64 Nutiva Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil, 15-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 2)]] product. It is the only oil I use. Knowing this, a friend suggested their Manna product. It took me some time before I actually looked the product up here on Amazon and read the reviews and the one particular one which explains how the product might arrive separated and the procedure you must go through to remix the product for consumption. Having my expectations in order, I placed an order on July 18, 2012 (per Amazon's records). The product arrived and the first thing I noticed was the stamped expiration date on both containers: September 2012! Seriously? I am to consume two of these in less than two months?

Next I opened one of the jars up and noticed that it was in fact separated. I followed the procedure outlined in the aforementioned review but never managed to get the consistency of it to a desirable state. review_body:
For the most part, you won't find Noh's at your neighborhood store. It is the Asian specialty grocery that normally carries it. When you first use this, you say, eureka!, finally I found what that great flavor is on BBQ spare ribs or roast pork. This little packet has that great Chinese (really Polynesian or Hawaiian) red sweet seasoning.

A few tips: 1-Don't let it drip anywhere. Don't laugh. I have a tough counter and I let a droplet sit for an hour. It was tough to remove it; this is not only seasoning but food coloring.
2-The best use of this is to take left over chicken, pork or beef. Sizzle them up with the mix and a cup of water, covering and turning all pieces. When all of the water in the mix is gone, you have a dish any Chinese restaurant in New York will charge plenty for.
3-It's also good on ribs but you have to experiment to get the exact results you want.
4-After tidbits and ribs, the best use is on chicken; again, you have to experiment with the blend of oven, grill to get the exact balance of baking, char, and Noh's.

Overall, a great little secret that brings the restaurant into your home. Just clean up every drop...

review_body: As a diabetic, I'm always looking for great tasting sugar free candy. I tried these candies, and while not a chocolate fanatic, I found these are tasty and that's not just my opinion.
