review_body: We love this corn, and have an amazon subscription to deliver a case every 6 months.  So we average about an 8oz pack a week throughout the year.  It is a little salty, but so is amazing popcorn.

product_title: Fantasicakes Gourmet Apricot Tart (8"/ 28 Oz.)
review_body: I ordered two of these and two of raspberry latice tarts directly from FantasiCakes website for a dinner party I was hosting. It arrived fresh and intact. Very good size. I froze half for later use. I am a pastry lover and these were the best I've ever tasted. The pastry was soft, the jam was really good and the taste was great. They were gone in no time. My guests were really impressed.

product_title: Himalayan Pink Salt 4 oz. Resealable Bag
review_body: ordered cinnamomum verum to repel gnats from seedlings (part of a multistage campaign). it appears to be quite capable in this regard. the spice also tasted very fresh, rich and \\"sweet\\" (as spices go).

product_title: Marshalls Creek Spices Lemon Pepper Seasoning, No Salt, 8 Ounce
review_headline: This is garlic powder, not lemon pepper.
review_body: Good thing I like garlic powder because it will get used.  However, I paid what I consider to be a high price for this product because it claimed to have lemon/pepper in it.  I thought the garlic base was a good idea and a good substitute for all the salt in other lemon/pepper seasonings.  But I expected, from the label, that there would be the taste of lemon and pepper.  If you like garlic, this is okay although not really that garlicky either.  If you like lemon pepper, this won't do it for you.  There is zero lemon or pepper taste in this product, and I have verified this with several family members.  I only rated it even 1 star because you have to click on at least 1 star to put in a review.

product_title: Buendia by Juan Valdez 100% Colombian Freeze Dried Decaf Coffee, 3.52 oz. Jars (Pack of 3)
review_body: I love this coffee better than all others. It's pricy but you can't find it anywhere else so for me it's worth the price.

product_title: Eat. Think. Smile. Baked Nutrition Bar, Orange Cranberry, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Tastes like health food, but not actually health food.
review_body: These bars are packaged fairly nicely; the individual sleeves have a cool, smooth exterior and a very Trader Joe's friendly design that's gender-neutral and age-appropriate for any adult, though I do not like that the box lays flat and takes up far more space in my pantry than it would if it stood up. But that's unfortunately the nicest thing I can say about them. The texture is on the dry side, and the flavor combination of the special cocoa blend with orange and cranberry ended up tasting very chalky -- it would have been improved by being either sweetened more or sweetened less. And the bar, which is quite small, is a whopping 200 calories, 6 grams of fat, and 34 grams of carbohydrates -- and with not large quantity of protein or vitamins/minerals to justify it. It may have the antioxidant power of a cup of green tea, but I'd find drinking that cup of tea quite a bit more pleasant (and easier on my waistline).

product_title: Revolution Tea 3D Multi Dimensional Beverage, Mango White Tea, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: Hands down, best cold tea I've tasted...  It's light, refreshing, and quenches my thirst after a good workout!  Haven't been able to find it in a loooong time... what's up with that?!  My only complaint is that the 1 can isn't enough!

product_title: Green Mountain Limited Edition Golden French Toast K Cups
review_body:
If you like coffee thick as tar, this coffee is not for you. But if you like coffee with a mild flavor, then this is perfect. This is my absolute favorite coffee. Most of the coffees for my Keurig are way too strong for my taste. Not this one...I have people that come to my house just to drink my Golden French Toast coffee. They know it's the one flavor that I will have for sure.

Again...if you expect coffee to be strong enough to pick you up and carry you around the room, this coffee is not for you. You should try a coffee with a heavy ROAST...this one is Golden French TOAST...as in light and golden. :-)

product_title: Annie Chun's Noodle Bowl
review_body: This is the absolute WORST noodle bowl I've  ever had the displeasure of tasting!!  ANNIE CHUN PRODUCTS ARE HORRID!!  I wish I could get my money back.  There are no vegetables to speak of, the noodles are sticky and the sauce is way too salty!  I learned from this dreadful experience to always read the reviews first!  Yuck!

product_title: Cereal Marshmallows, 21 oz.
review_body: These are really tasty.  I used to always eat the normal cereal before all the marshmallows so I could have just the marshmallows alone in the end...now I don't have to go through the trouble.

product_title: Udi's Gluten Free Blueberry Muffins (1 Case)
review_body: These blueberry muffins are Delicious. A friend bought them for me as I've recently tested positive for Celiac. They are soooo good I ate all 4 in 24 hours! I will pace myself the next time. lol. I sprinkle a bit of lemon juice on them, a pat of dairy free butter, and heat in the microwave for 20 seconds. Heaven.   Perfect for breakfast or late night snack. So glad they are available. They are kind of expensive but muffins at our local health food store are over $2 a piece so in that comparison I guess they win.   Also, if I were to buy all of the alternative flour mixes and blueberries, it would have cost much more to make them myself.   These are definitely going on the regular grocery list.

product_title: Coconut Popping Oil Butter Flavored
review_body: I have no idea why this product is packaged this way.  The first thing I did, was to cut the packages open and pour the contents into a small jar to keep and use from.  This butterred flavored coconut oil makes great popcorn.  I use it with pop secret popcorn in a presto microwave popcorn popper and it makes large puffy popcorn that looks and tastes great.  You only need 1 table spoon per batch so this will last a long time.

product_title: Lizi's Granola Lizi's Molasses and Pecans, 10.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I was delighted to find Lizi's Molasses and Pecan Granola here on Amazon.  I had tasted a sample of it and wanted to purchase it, but haven't found it for sale anywhere else.  I don't normally care much for granola, but this brand is the best I have ever had.  Besides tasting really good, it is also good for you.

product_title: Wonderful Pistachios, No-Shell, Roasted & Salted 24 Ounce
review_body:
Oh, boy! I could tell these were going to be good when I cracked open the bag. What a nice aroma! I was right. They're excellent! Well, I usually buy pistachios in the shell, but I passed by these bags in the nut section of my local Costco store, and I just couldn't resist trying them. They're great. Nice and fresh. Salted to perfection with the potassium content still almost double the sodium content. Lots of fiber and unsaturated fat. What more could you ask? Did I mention that they're delicious? Wonderful, indeed!

Gary Peterson

product_title: Herb-Ox Vegetable Bouillon Cubes, 25-Cubes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: excellent alternative to the Chicken bouillon.
review_body: excellent alternative to the Herb-ox Chicken bouillon cubes, for those who want avoid beef or chicken. We use this one a little less often than the Chicken, but still regularly,and it never lets us down.

product_title: Pillsbury Lemon Poppy Seed Muffin Mix, 7.6-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: These mixes use only water and are very convenient.  They have a strange lingering chemical flavor though.  I probably wouldn't buy these again.

product_title: No Fear Super Energy Supplement, 16 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: For a few years now No Fear has been the best energy drink available. It has had the best results for me. The flavor is much better than any other energy drink i've tried. Some other products leave you looking to wash your mouth out after drinking, but not No Fear. It has been discontinued in my area and Amazon.com is the only place i can get it these days.

product_title: Moonstruck Chocolate Classic Hot Cocoa Mix
review_body: This was the first hot chocolate brand I was able to find that didn't have soy or wheat (or coconut products) in it. My 20month old has quite a few allergies so I have to be very careful what prepacked items I allow her to eat. We tried the powder first, which my daughter really liked, and then I mixed some warm water and milk together with a few scoops and she seemed to really enjoy it it, but she preferred the powder chocolate more than the drink ;) I recommend it!

product_title: Tastykake Sugar Free Chocolate Cream Filled Cupcakes 12 Cupcakes Per Box
review_body: I have a friend from up north. I live in S.C. He loves tasty kakes, so when I saw they had a sugar free version. I wanted to try it. Shipment came quickly.While the product did have a real chocolate flavor, the cakes were very dry. There was a sticker over expiratin date. I won't buy anymore tastykakes from this seller.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee Cinnamon Pastry K-Cup (24 count)
review_body:
Obviously, coffee reviews are highly subjective. The best way to get an idea of the quality of this product is for me to provide a little background as to what my own tastes are, so that the reader may better determine whether he or she might agree with my interpretation.

My absolute favorite coffee is a hazelnut flavored brew, though I'm not particularly fond of \\"light\\" roasts. I prefer a more full-bodied coffee, though I find St--bu--s to be pure swill (I swear, they have one blend of coffee, and just change the amount of water at brew time, along with the grind). If I could have coffee heaven, it would probably be hazelnut Kona, but I've yet to find it (my quest is not yet over!).

Getting back to this delight...

I stumbled on this one after reading a review of Donut House Collection: Cinnamon Roll, which absolutely had me in hysterics, and which clearly recommended Timothy's instead. Intrigued, though not a real lover of cinnamon coffee (in my younger day, I used to enjoy a cinnamon breakfast blend, and have always - at least, until now - considered cinnamon coffee to be a breakfast coffee), I decided to give this a try (we have a K-Cup brewer in the office, which for me, is a bit less than economical, as I measure my daily coffee intake by the pot and not by the cup).

Wow.

Let me re-state that: WOW!!!!!

The coffee itself is full bodied, but without edge (no bitterness). It brews a large cup (max setting on our brewer, suitable for a travel mug) without becoming watery. The aroma is absolutely divine, filling the office waiting room with a light scent, truly reminiscent of a real pastry shop (no kidding), and the cinnamon isn't just in the air. The overtone is distinct without being overdone, meaning the amount of cinnamon to the brew is just right. Have one cup, and you'll want a second one.

In that same order, I picked up more hazelnut (Gloria Jean's, this time, vs Green Mountain, though I prefer the latter, in general) and a great deal on a large quantity of Tully's Kona Blend. That was April 10, and I am now coming back to re-order this Timothy's Cinnamon, while I have plenty of hazelnut and Kona left. I would have never thought it possible that another flavor could woo me from my two favorites, but this has truly won me over.

Enjoy!gh I prefer the latter, in general) and a great deal on a large quantity of Tully's Kona Blend. That was April 10, and I am now coming back to re-order this Timothy's Cinnamon, while I have plenty of hazelnut and Kona left. I would have never thought it possible that another flavor could woo me from my two favorites, but this has truly won me over.

Enjoy!

product_title: Caribou Coffee Mahogany, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I could get very used to this!  This is a nice, strong, robust coffee without bitterness.  The K-Cups are so convenient and make no mess.

product_title: Post Fruity Pebbles Cereal, 11-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: each box was less than 1.00 and one of my kids favorite cereals.....keep the deals coming and I will keep coming back...Thank you!

product_title: Earth's Best Organic 2nd Gourmet Meals, Variety Pack, 4-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_body: Our primary reason for buying this product is that it came in a variety pack.  We make most of our own baby food, but we were going on vacation and that was going to be difficult.  Since packing space was limited, we had this shipped to our destination.  It was the only brand we could find to order in a variety pack.  The kids liked all the flavors and the consistency seemed good.

product_title: Jelly Belly Bean Boozled Jelly Beans with Spinner Wheel Game, 3rd Edition 3.5oz
review_body: I bought a few boxes of these as gifts for my Daughter and her family at Easter time. They were the hit of her household, when family and friends came by, they all enjoyed spinning and trying out the flavor beans they won. Awesome fun!!!

product_title: Dabur Vatika (Hair Mask) Egg Protein Deep Conditioning (Damaged & Split Hair)
review_headline: My New Favorite Conditioner For DC'ing!
review_body: This stuff is wonderful! The first time I used it in my natural, 4A/4B AA hair, it worked wonders. Even left my 2yr old daughters 4c hair soft and manageable. I will buy this product again in the future

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: I was pleasently surprised about how soft this cookie was.  It had great flavor, I couldnt even tell there were raisins in the cookie, which is great because I dont normally like raisins.  I like that they come individually wrapped so that all the cookies don't dry out when you want to eat one.  Great snack to take on the go!

product_title: Ferrero Kinder Bueno Wafer Cookies, 1.5 Ounce (43 g) (Pack of 30)
review_body: Except the fact that there are a few packs of Bueno get crack, the overall quality is pretty good. However, the shipment is relatively slow. Hope it could be improved in the future.

product_title: House Of Tsang Korean Teriyaki Stir-Fry Sauce One 11.5 oz Bottle
review_body: You can imagine my shock when I saw the price of this item! Why would I order this when I can buy it at any grocery store for $3.79? Just curious.....

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Deluxe Holiday Tower
review_headline: Some good stuff, and some not great
review_body: I bought that for Xmas and 80% was eaten, but we were stuck with the \\"weird\\" chocolates with spices and fruit (not our favorite). I was a little bit disappointed by what was in some boxes: just large rectangular chocolate plate... I guess I'll go back to my old habits and get some Leonidas instead (more $$$ but soooo good)

product_title: Libby's Unpeeled Apricot Halves in Pear Juice From Concentrate, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
These apricots are just great. They are full of flavor but not too sweet. There are about 8 to 9 halves to a can.

There was a problem with some severely dented cans but as usual, Amazon made it right.

product_title: Famous Dave's BBQ Sauce Devil's Spit, 19-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I bought a case of this sauce for my husband.  He loves it!  I like it but it's a little warm for my taste.  He bought his first bottle at a major retail store then went back for more and they didn't have it so I found it on Amazon.  I got just what I was supposed to in 2 days (prime membership). Now hubby is a happy camper.

product_title: Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee, Brooklyn Bridge Blend, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 36-Count
review_body:
I am really enjoying this coffee. It tastes excellent, was nicely priced and the company has gone out of their way to provide excellent customer service after some initial problems.

I am going to get this monthly on subscribe and save and I do recommend it now. the brooklyn bridge and breakfast blend are very nice!

product_title: Flossugar (1/2 gallon)
review_body: This stuff is great and works very well in my cheap cotton candy machine.  The most important thing is that the grand kids are happy

product_title: Villa Manodori Organic Balsamic Vinegar - 8.8 oz
review_headline: Love this vinegar - Wish it came in a bigger bottle!
review_body: We use this vinegar in salads & soup, on sandwhiches, with fish (replace the splash of wine with this), sauteed vegetables.  Its a perfect complement, not like regular vinegar which is tart and sour, this has a mild pleasant flavor, not sour, but not sweet either.  But it also makes a great condiment to sliced strawberries - a couple of tablespoons over a bowl of sliced strawberries, let sit for 15 min and serve.  Delicious!

product_title: Late July Organic Snacks How Sweet Potato it is Multigrain Tortilla Chips, 5.5-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I just had these while visiting a friend yesterday, and have to put these in my cupboard.  :-)  I have eating restrictions and chips were a loved snack that has not been enjoyed for some time.  There are healthful chips I've tried, but most are missing the taste so I don't bother.  I will bother with these as they ARE yummy!!!!

product_title: Essentia 9.5 pH Drinking Water
review_body: I have been drinking Essentia for about a month now and really feel it makes a difference in my hydration.  I can tell that more now that I ran out and had to supplement my Amazon purchase with running to the store.  I know a couple of reviewers have said it doesn't seem to taste different but I would beg to differ.  I use a Brita filter on both my faucet and through a pitcher and can tell the Essentia water has a smoother texture \\"feel\\" than the filtered water.  I am a big fan and while I won't always shell out for bottled water, it certainly is the brand I will choose.

product_title: Crazy Cups Flavored Coffee Sampler
review_body: This Pack does not come with Kahla Coffee nor the cinnamin roll coffee which is one of the reasons i purchased it. You should have listed every flavor this included and how many. VERY DISAPPOINTED

product_title: San Francisco Bay Coffee, OneCup Single Serve Cups
review_headline: San Francisco Decaf OneCp for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: I ordered this coffee and since it was tagged as for K-Cup brewers, I assumed it would be designed like a regular K-Cup packet, but it is not. It will fit in and work in a Keurig, but because of its design, it lets a small amount of sediment through while brewing, which is not pleasing when you get to the last few sips of coffee. Also, this coffee has a bitter taste, so I definitely will not buy this product again.

product_title: Emeril's Big Easy Bold Coffee, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: Got this for Christmas, I'm addicted.  Just ordered another two boxes. Coffee tastes great, gives out an aroma that fills the whole house. I've gotten great  reviews on my coffee since I started using my new coffee machine.

product_title: San Francisco Bay Coffee, OneCup Single Serve Cups
review_body: We wanted to try something different and this coffee didn't disappoint!  We prefer bold flavored coffee which this is.  I was concerned that the pods might not fit my basic model Keurig but they fit perfect.  Less waste with these K-Cups because they have a filter type bottom instead of the plastic cup.  We will definatately order these again!

product_title: Sticky Fingers Wild Blueberry Scone Mix, 15-Ounces (Pack of 3)
review_body: I've been a fan of Sticky Fingers Scone Mix for years. They turn out moist and taste great. You can't go wrong with this mix.

product_title: Diet Snapple Ice Tea - Peach 16 Oz All Natural Flavor Real Brewed (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Diet Peach  Snapple Delivered Safely & Quickly
review_body: I ordered this product to send to my friend's husband. They had just moved to Alabama in the end of March, she could not find ANY Diet Peach Snapple that tasted the same as what they had bought up here in New Jersey. He said that the water that was used down South made the Diet Peach Snapple taste different ! So, now she is happy because she has found  a source that they can buy his Snapple from ! Thank you.

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips
review_body: Got these at a fraction of the price that they charge at the grocery store. This was a great buy. Thanks, Amazon!

product_title: Dole Mandarin in Orange Gel, 4.3-Ounce Cups (Pack of 36)
review_body: I ordered these for my 80 year old mother. She has been unable to find them locally and I searched for them and found them through Amazon.  I ordered them and within 2 days they had arrived at my mother's. She was so amazed at the speed with which they came and they are exactly what she has been getting and loving for a while now.  Again, I was impressed with the speed of the delivery of these and will be ordering them from Dole through Amazon again, as soon as my mother gets near to the bottom of the case.

product_title: Duncan Hines Frosting White Chocolate Almond, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 8)
review_body: This frosting is delicious! It goes great with Betty Crocker Butter Pecan cake. I've taken it to work functions and everyone loves it. Hope it comes available soon.

product_title: Betty Crocker Bac-Os Bacon Flavor Chips, 6-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Bacos -excellent flavor; lower salt than McCormick's
review_body:
Bacos, by Betty Crocker; have enjoyed for many years. Excellent, tasty; adds bacon flavor without the bacon on salads, casseroles...put in scrambled eggs - if want less crunchy, let cook in casserole or scrambled eggs, etc a bit.
Bacos have more flavor; I prefer the flavor, and less sodium than McCormick's. (3% vs 8 or 9%).
Recently, most stores I shop in have dropped Betty Crocker Bacos in exchange for McCormick's, probably due to pressure/ cost deals from McCormick's who supply most spices to the store. Shaw's used to carry until recently, but dropped in favor of McCormick's.
So now for me and my aunt, and my brother, sister in law who also love them, I am looking for a new online source. Hope Amazon carries the 6pk soon! -The 37 pack listed as available is way too much for just a consumer. Like another reviewer says, they do last with excellent, unchanged flavor, considerably past the listed expiration date. After opening, like it recommends, do put in refrigerator. Otherwise, when unopened, stores fine for many months, half a year or more in pantry/ food storage tote reserve storage.

product_title: Niko Rice Calrose, 10-pounds
review_body: When I found this rice on Amazon.com, I gave up thinking of driving an hour to a Korean grocery store.  This is by far my favorite type of rice. It's grown in California but is very similar to the rice grown in Korea.  The grain is larger and has wonderful flavor.  I'm not Asian, but I'm a huge rice fan.  This price was cheaper than the Korean grocery store and had free shipping.  I always buy $25 worth of items from Amazon.  I buy a book if I need to spend more. I never even thought about buying groceries.  However, my husband said,  \\"You get the most boring packages.\\"  This rice is so delicious that it's not boring to me!

product_title: Gefen Whole Organic Chestnuts, Roasted & Peeled , 5.2-Ounces (Pack of 4)
review_body: These are roasted and peeled chestnuts packaged so they can be easily used in recipes.  Priced fairly, and available all year round.

product_title: Quaker Instant Oatmeal Variety Pack
review_body: The product, Quaker Instant Oatmeal, High Fiber, Maple and Brown Sugar, was extremely sweet.  Way too much sugar taste.  I could even taste salt?  I could not taste the oats due to the high sugar content.  The product was mixed with 1/2 cup boiling water per the instructions.  UPC 30000 26190.

product_title: Fever-Tree Drinks, Glass Bottles
review_body: Sorry to say that although I have bought this product in the past and was very satisfied with it, this batch was awful. With previous orders this soda had a crisp champagne like carbonation. The latest order was flat. I don't know if there has been a change in the formulation or lack of quality control. I contacted the company with this complaint and have received no reply.

product_title: Amy & Brian Coconut Water Original, 17.5 Ounce Can (Pack of 12)
review_body: product was as promised.organic and low calorie. tasted great in my opinion.however large cans (although better priced) were too big for me as i need about 1/2 the amount aftr a walk or to mix in a smoothie. also 2 cans were dented in shipping.autoship was nice option.. but i will b looking for smaller cans to autoship.

product_title: Columela  Extra Virgin Olive Oil From Spain , 17-Ounce Glass Bottles (Pack of 2)
review_body: After reading the excellent Tom Mueller book Extra Virginity [[ASIN:0393070212 Extra Virginity: The Sublime and Scandalous World of Olive Oil]] - I decided to explore some...real olive oil. Far from the supermarket brands I've had for $8 a liter, this Columela costs 4x as much, so I was a bit nervous. Silly me. It's so superior to generic olive oils that I fear I've been ruined for life. No longer will I be able to dip my bread in the schlock from the local Italian restaurant. Nay, I may need to carry my own.  Words of warning - this is delicious, and you will find yourself using a lot more than you used that garbage before. You will also be tempted to pair it with good bread, good vegetables, and good pasta. It may entice you to cook more at home. Do not taunt Columela olive oil. It's delicious. Try some.

product_title: Numi Organic Black Tea, Loose Leaf Tea
review_headline: A Great Spiced Tea and I've Tried Many...
review_body: Great flavor from bold Assam tea coupled with flavorful spices. No powdery stuff here. Excellent for traditional chai (with milk) or brewed dairy-free. I've tried many spiced teas and this is the best for both flavor and price.

product_title: Bare Granny Smith Apple Chips - 2.2 oz - 12 pk
review_headline: Sour as heck, not dried completely
review_body: Well, green apples are sour, I should have known better.  The chips themselves are not nearly dried enough, some are mush, some dried, some mush in the center.  Very bizarre shapes and size chips.  As if they used the peels from a pie factory to make these (feels like a bag of scraps, to be honest).  Simply, avoid!

product_title: Blue Diamond Almonds, 8 Ounce Container
review_body: I ordered these nuts off a whim because of the flavor. I just got into eating more nuts because I don't get enough Omega 3's. Everybody that I shared these with loved them! I went through 2 containers in a week (because of sharing). This will be a staple in my house from now on!!!

product_title: Gold Pomegranates Challah Cover - CAS3
review_body: This is a gorgeous challah cover- too pretty to use actually!  The colors are vibrant and the fabrics are simply gorgeous.  We are going to have it mounted and framed and hung in our dinning room.

product_title: CedarHouse Ultra-Premium Liquid Smoke: All Natural Hickory Liquid Smoke - 4 FL OZ
review_body: Okay-Liquid Smoke is THE BEST! I've tried other brands like Stubb's...& Liquid Smoke is much-much-much better! I'm from Texas and though we like to smoke meats on the BBQ pit- sometimes because the rain or the Texas heat, you just don't get the chance! Liquid smoke really did the trick with my cajun chicken! Delicious!!! Full bodied hickory smoke flavor-Thanks CedarHouse! I marinaded the chicken for about 2 hours with Lawry's marinade plus the CedarHouse natural hickory liquid smoke & then cooked the chicken on a gas grill. It was perfect with the right amount of hickory smoke flavor! I highly recommend purchasing a bottle!!!

product_title: Gymnema Green Tea For Diabetics, No Caffeine
review_body: I am always looking for a product to help with my diabetes.  I have been drinking this tea for 4 months and it has help lower my blood sugar.  It does not get me off of insulin, but it does make a big difference.  Excellent product.

product_title: Sugar-Free All Natural Ginger Candies
review_body: The ginger flavoring comes through well, some of the other products are a little blander.  Remember that excess consumption may have a laxative effect!  I wish there was a way around that.

product_title: Russell Stover Whitman's Patty Peg Bag, Mint, 3.25-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: These mints are delicious which is why I ordered them. But they arrived on one of hottest days in summer and even though they weren't outside long--and had cooled off for several hours before I opened, they were completely melted to the wrapper. Probably in truck for too long. Lesson learned: don't order these in warm weather.

product_title: San Pellegrino Sparkling Beverage, Limonata (Lemon), 11.15-Ounce Cans
review_body: I absolutely love this drink.  It is a must try for anyone who likes sour drinks.  It is very fizzy and tart with a great lemon taste and scent.  It tastes very light too and even though it has as much sugar as a soft drink, it is not overly sweet.  I love the little covers on top because it keeps the lip clean.

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup For Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Ulitmate Gift Pack
review_headline: So much better than Keurig's option
review_body: When I purchased my Keurig machine, it came packaged with Keurig's My K-Cup refillable filter. I tried using that for a while, but it is tough to fill, tough to clean (I don't have a dishwasher) and tough to get in and out of the machine.  The ekobrew eliminates all of those problems.  I can grind my own coffee and it spoons very easily into the ekobrew (and I can even fill it with a little more coffee than a standard K-Cup and run the water through twice, which actually fills up my large travel mug).

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: No regrets for this purchase!  Functions exactly as it should.  I love my coffee, but hated having to change out the keurig insert when not using a K cup.  This product solves the inconvenience.  I have had the product for over a month and use them multiple times each day.  I highly recommend these for serious coffee drinkers!!

product_title: Terry's Orange Ball
review_body:
I love these things. I used to get these at Christmas years ago when I dated someone whose parents were from England and I have carried on that tradition ever since! I'm not a huge fan of orange flavored things, but I love these. There's something about the mixture of chocolate and orange that is just amazing.

I happened to catch this pack of 6 on sale directly from Amazon, not one of their third party suppliers, and it was only $20! I don't know if it was a pricing mistake or what, but it was an amazing deal.

product_title: Blue Sky Organic Soda (New Century Cola, 12-Ounce Cans, Pack of 24)
review_body:
I have been addicted to Coke-a-Cola since I was in High school (2000-2004). Eventually I got to the point where I preferred drinking then eating. I gained a lot of weight and went through horrible caffeine withdrawals (if I went more then 12 hours without my coke -a- Cola caffeine fix). I tried to quit soda with caffeine/hfcs many times but eventually always giving in because Coke always helps with my migraines. This soda became not only a substitute but by favorite, It has a lot of sugar and that is why I only gave it a 4/5. I prefer this one verse the other COla. This one is less expensive and organic compared to the Blue Sky Cola (vs this one which is Organic Blue Sky New Century Cola). I usually water it down with over a cup of ice to dilute the sugar.

Score: 4/5 It is literally the best Soda out there with or without HFCs. It didn't get 5/5 because of how much sugar in each can. I end up having to dilute it with lots of ice.

I had always been super picky of how my Cola was. It needed to COke Cola it needed to be fresh, crisp, and super cold. I am one of those people that can tell the different between coke and cola... I now perfer this one. FHC's are horrible for your body and I do see great improvement and alleviation from some of my lupus symptoms since I stopped taking in HFCs (through Coke-a-Cola) .

product_title: Lipton Tea Bags
review_body:
I've been making and having rave reviews for my Ice Tea for 35+ years and here it is:
To a One Gallon Container place 3 family sized tea bags
Gently add the hottest tap water into the container 3/4 full, so as not to break the bags
Let steep on countertop for at least 20 minutes or until desired strength
Remove tea bags and add enough ice cubes to fill container to top
Refrigerate
When serving, add sweetener to tall glass (sweet'n'low', splenda, etc...), cubes, tea, lemon or lime
Deelish
It's a staple in our fridge all year long
Enjoy!

P.S. I would make this exact recipe called Sweet Tea when my kids went to school in South Carolina and were living at home
To this same recipe, first add 1 cup of sugar to the container, then hot water, stir to dissolve and then add tea bags. Proceed as above.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Apricot
review_body:
If you know what rooibos tastes like, this is an excellent version. But if not, beware, this is not black tea. Or a \\"substitute.\\" If you are expecting that flavor; well this is not it. If you are trying to cut back on your caffeine, this is a smart choice. It has a pleasant flavor, once you get accustomed to it. But yikes folks, this is not black tea. As a vegetarian I eat various burger-shaped things that are not real meat. The caustic cynic says, \\"Well, not as good as a real burger.\\" OK maybe not, but they aren't as bad as a real burger either. They are two different things, and if you think one IS the other, as opposed to being something that serves a similar purpose, then you will be dissatisfied.

But if you say, \\"I enjoy a hot beverage with some punch, but can't do the caffeine,\\" then these are a good value. Trust me. I've been using rooibos for over 30 years; this is a great price on a good tea.

And--the bags are not wrapped individually. I hate throwing away all that foil lined paper that will last forever; these teabags come in a ziploc bag that can be re-used.

The linguine is best since it holds more sauce.  The angel hair version is a little too delicate for my cooking experiences.  No one can tell it's not the regular pasta when I cook it for guests. Another reviewer noted the honey crystallizes, but the company tells you how to avoid and solve the problem directly on the package. I almost hoped the honey would crystallize a bit, I love eating a little spoonful of honey with bits of crystals in it...

I live in Colorado but I will continue to order this honey from Amazon, as the local honeys available from my grocers aren't quite as good as Ambrosia's. I recommend this product.

I don't care for a couple of the ingredients: Life's DHA (uses Martek's Hexane method) and corn syrup

***Just so you are aware (I was not), the Obama administration banned the use of DHA and ARA in certified organic baby formula and cereal back in 2010. References:

[...]

product_title: Harvest Favorites Fruit and Gourmet Gift Box
review_body: I bought this as a gift and heard back that it was a beautiful arrangement of fresh food. The fruit was firm and unblemished. It is a great gift item as there is a little bit of something for everyone to enjoy. I've purchased other fruit gift baskets and this is by far the best value. Great quality.

product_title: Eat. Think. Smile. Baked Nutrition Bar, Orange Cranberry, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body:
this bar is delicious and filling.

the best thing about it is the subtle mix of chocolate with the tang of orange and cranberry. it is also moist and very chewy to boot. there is also the presence of some oat and nut pieces just to remind you that you are chewing on something good for you.

since receiving them, i have been snacking on them between meals or right before a four-hour rehearsal. after eating one, i feel full and my energy is well-sustained for the entire rehearsal.

this will be on my list of purchases for my summer trip to teach at arts camp!

product_title: Mountain Sun Antioxidant Power, Pure Cranberry, Unsweetened,  32-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3)
review_body: I thought I was getting a bargain because this is less expensive then R.W. knudsen brand - but isnt near as strong I add 4 oz of RW to 32 oz water and it still has a bite to it- this takes 2 times as much and still doesnt have the same effect- I had signed up for auto deliver  after trying it had to cancel.

product_title: HealthWise 100% Colombian Supremo, Decaffeinated, Swiss Water Process Low Acid Ground Coffee, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3)
review_headline: I can finally drink coffee again!
review_body: HealthWise coffee was such a great find.  Until I found HealthWise coffee I could no longer drink regular coffee because of the acid, now I can enjoy 2 cups of HealthWise coffee every morning and no heartburn!

product_title: Heinz Spotted Dick Sponge Pudding, 9.4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Quite Good. Much Too High In Calories.
review_body:
I was in a local grocery store that has a lot of items imported from England when I saw cans of Heinz Spotted Dick Pudding. Well, I'd heard of it. Hasn't everyone? The name sounds more like a medical condition than a type of foodstuff and it must lend itself to a certain middle-school-level humor, not necessarily limited to those of that particular age. In any case, I had about a half can (too much) after lunch. I heated it up in the microwave and, after heating, coated it with a veneer of Devon custard. The combination was quite good. It's much too high in calories (from fats and sugars), of course, so I'll have to watch my consumption. However, it was an interesting treat and now when I hear the snickers, I'll understand a bit better.

Gary Peterson

product_title: Lindt Lindor Truffles 60% Extra Dark Chocolate, 60-Count Box
review_body: The vendor, Penguin Mints, shipped these to me in a weird white box with tape wrapped around it.  These should have been in a sealed/unopened original Lindt box as depicted in the picture.  I can't give these away, I don't know if they have been tampered with or what.

product_title: Austin Zoo Animal Crackers, 2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 36)
review_headline: Awesome, But Available for Around Eight Dollars at Sams
review_body: This price is over double the price available elsewhere. Really bothers me when venders do this.  Buy elsewhere and force venders to price more competitively.

product_title: Health Valley Low-Fat Cracker, Cracked Pepper, 6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I was kind of worried about buying these crackers, that my family would not like them, (little kids age 8, 4) But my kids loved them! My husband who doesntlike pepper loves them.
They don't even taste like pepper, they taste like a really yummy Ritz cracker. They don't even taste healthy or organic-They 're awesome and always a hit at any party I bring them to:)

product_title: PINK "GRAFFITI" Edible Cupcake Wrappers! 24 Pieces - edible markers NOT included
review_body: I've made these and at them. They are wonderful and yummy. Great for parents to make for kids or any age! Highly recommend them. Very easy and mess free

product_title: Kraft American Cheese 2 lb - 2 Unit Pack
review_headline: Been using this cheese for 40 plus years
review_body: I seem to be preaching to the choir, but I NEED this cheese! It is the best American cheese out there (and that is saying a lot from me because I do not like Kraft). I also have several recipes I cannot make without this cheese. I've tried other American cheeses but they taste off and always make me sick. Velveeta makes me sick. The crappy sliced cheese makes me ill. I live in Texas and cannot find it anywhere. HEB has a store brand that is close and has not made me sick, yet, but it is still not the same. This is just not right! Bring it back Kraft! I already don't like you, why take away the one redeeming factor, decent cheese you had?

product_title: Gluten Free Hearty Whole Grain Bread Mix
review_body: If you like rye bread, you will like this bread.  This would make a great reuben sandwich.  (I'm eating the bread with sauerkraut right now!)  It is very dense and hearty and healthy.

product_title: Crystal Light Skin Essentials, White Peach Tea, 7 ct
review_headline: BEST TASTING TEA DRINK--WATCH SHIPPING CHARGE
review_body:
I LOVE THIS FLAVOR OF CRYSTAL LIGHT. PEVENTION MAGAZINE RATED IT AS HAVING THE BEST HEALTH BENEFIT OF THE INDIVIDUAL TEA PACKETS. IT IS HIGH IN ANTI-OXIDENTS. I TRY TO DRINK IT ALL WHILE IT IS COOL BUT IT TASTES AS GOOD AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.

THE ONLY DRAWBACK IS THAT WE ARE CHARGED $4.99 FOR EACH 3\\" X 4\\" X 1\\" BOX. I OREDERED 10 BOXES WHICH ALL CAME TOGETHER IN A US POST OFFICE BOX THAT COST LESS THAN $10.00 TO SHIP. I PAID $54.90 FOR SHIPPING. THE PRODUCT IS GREAT...WATCH THE SHIPPING COSTS.

product_title: Endangered Species Butterfly
review_body: First let me say I am a huge fan of endangered species chocolate.  This is my first time however trying this particular mixture.  I love orange and chocolate as a combination but this one definitely falls short.  Unfortunately from what I can gather and the type of bitterness it is I am guessing they add too much of the pith while creating the orange oil.  It has a smooth delightful start but the more you eat the more pronounced the bitter taste becomes.  I am disappointed by the purchase and will not order this type again.

product_title: Premium Tea Bags
review_body: This is one of the best standard black teas I've had, especially at this price. This definitely isn't your standard, bitter, grocery store fare here.  Smooth, flavorful, fragrant. You won't regret it, try it now.

product_title: Vogue Cuisine Beef (Vegetarian Beef) Soup & Seasoning Base 12oz - Low/reduced Sodium & Gluten Free
review_body: I purchased several varieties of this base. I find using the recommended amount creates a base with little to no flavor. I had to triple the amount - and it still was lacking...

product_title: Bare Fruit Organic, Gluten Free Baked Apple Chips
review_body: This item is not as pictured, i didn't get the cherries as stated & pictured in the delivery box as described in the items.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: I bought this thinking it was the same as the Donut House coffee we got from my mother-in-law. To me it is a little bit strong, much stronger than the Donut House coffee. It is bold. It has a French Roast taste to me. If you like a little bolder coffee, you will like this.

product_title: Sparkling Ice Coconut Pineapple, 17 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: I picked a bottle of this up randomly at the local supermarket after tiring of diet coke ALL the time.  Made with Splenda it doesn't have any nasty aftertaste and the added B vitamins are a definate bonus.  Chill it and its nice and refreshing in this hot weather.  Tastes more of more pineapple than coconut to me.  Love it so much I've subscribed to a regular delivery from Amazon ... can't beat that :)

product_title: Box of Famous Idaho Spud Chocolate Candy Bars - Full Size Bar, Bulk, Specialty Candy Boxes, Soft Marshmallo Center Drenched with a Dark Chocolate Coating Sprinkled with Coconut
review_body: I first discovered this candy 40 years ago when my mother bought one for me in  a 7-11 when  I was a little girl. I fell in love with them.  Over the years they became increasingly hard to find.  The Idaho candy company sells the cases and a website called hometown favorites sells them individually.  But since finding the cases here on Amazon with free shipping thru Prime,  I have ordered them 3 times.  My dentist is going to make money off my mouth the next time he sees me and I don't care!  This candy is so good and it is fresh when you get it too.  Look it is certainly not fat free and yes it is loaded with sugar.  But eat one every once in a while.... just eat them so the company will keep making them!  It has coconut on the outside and this creamy marshmellow type filling . It is in the shape of a potato.  It is sooo good, it's like potato chips... there is no way you can eat just one.  So buy the case instead.

product_title: Organic Walnut Butter - 16oz
review_body: Walnut butter has a great taste. it is good  to use in place of peanut butter. Great  choice for dieters, very healthy for you.

product_title: Grassfed Organic Ghee - Pure Indian Foods Brand
review_body: We have been following Primal Blueprint for almost two months, and it was recommended by Mark to get grass-fed butter and ghee.  My husband and I had never had ghee, and are extremely pleased with this product!  Smells and tastes delicious, like move theater butter, and is so good for us too.  Only problem is we ran out  too fast...great product.

product_title: Orgain Organic Nutritional Shakes, 4 Flavors, 11 Ounce, 12 Count
review_body: I recently tried this shake in vanilla which I purchased at my local health food store and it tastes really good chilled. The best part about it is the minimal bad ingredients and additives that make it hard for me to consume any prepackaged drinks on the market right now. I used this as a meal replacement and was very impressed on how well it sat on my very sensitive stomach. I don't care for the soy protein factor or even the whey, since it would appeal more without these ingredients. I am wondering why the doctor who formulated this would add soy into something when cancer was an issue behind the product. Maybe a reformulation is in order, at least for me to continue consuming this. Very satisfied with this product and most of the ingredients but 4 stars for the noted exceptions.

product_title: Gloria Jean's Keurig K-Cups
review_body: I expected it little bit different than it tasted. Stronger than I like my coffee to be. I would not recommend this to people who does not like strong coffee

product_title: Premium Madagascar Vanilla Beans 1/4 lb (26-30 beans) JR Mushrooms Brand
review_body: You will not believe how much more flavor you can get out of while vanilla beans compared to vanilla extract. I used these in homemade ice-cream and it was amazing. The only problem is you might get too much vanilla flavor from one whole bean.

product_title: Billington's Natural Dark Brown Molasses Sugar, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 10)
review_body: Wish we had not ordered so much, but we were basing on what others said.  It is not very sweet at all, disappointed in the baking quality.  Also, very clumped and does not blend well AT ALL.  However, it is good in coffee.

product_title: House Foods Kokumaro Curry, Medium Hot, 7.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 10)
review_body: If you like Curry, Go for it!! I´d used it to make some Japanese Curry dishes and is everything was as I suspected to be. I can strongly recommended for all curry fans.

product_title: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf Swedish Berries, Hibiscus Raisins and Berries, Naturally Caffeine-Free, 5.7-Ounce Loose Tea
review_body: It's tea and its tart. I guess you can add suger but the flavor just does't quite work hot or cold. Not my favorite.

product_title: Ambrosia Pure Honey From Colorado's Western Slope, 23-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: This is the best honey I've ever bought. It tastes just like the one my grandma used to have when I was a kid. It's not cheap but worth every penny. The taste is great plus it's not imported.

product_title: St. Dalfour, Gourmet on the Go, Ready to Eat, Wild Alaskan Salmon, 6 Pack, 6.2 oz (175 g) Each
review_body:
I bought these little meals (or snacks, if you have a bigger appetite) on Amazon and just had to buy more. They are really seasoned just perfectly. I don't add the honey, which comes in a packet - that honey must be a 'French' thing.

If you normally get the tuna salad with crackers that is sold in the supermarket and handy for lunch or snacks, you'll love this. It is flavorful, a good alternative when you just get tired of tuna.

I wish I could buy larger quantities of this stuff on Amazon.

product_title: Candy Tree Organic Strawberry Laces, 2.6-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: I can't believe these things have such great reviews! I was hoping these would be good because I had organic jelly beans and they are delicious. However, these tasted like wax/plastic. There was barely any flavor. No thank you.

product_title: J&D's Cheddar Bacon Salt, 2.5 Ounce Bottle
review_headline: DESERVES 10 STARS, IF IT WAS AVAILABLE!
review_body:
YES, YES, YES !!!

Recommend this, even if you are someone NOT watching your sodium intake. I even make sure I keep this in my car for whenever I eat out at some restaurant--much, much better than any other kind of salt combinations or spices. Wish the BACON SALT people would see about getting their product into places like: LONGHORN STEAK HOUSE, CHILI's, APPLEBEES, BOB EVANS, OLIVE GARDEN, FUDDRUCKERS, etc. People would be placing orders for it like crazy!

Thanks, BACON SALT dudes!

product_title: Let's Do Organic Reduced Fat Shredded Coconut, 8.8 ounce pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love this stuff. It smells and tastes great. Yes, it is dry, it's reduced fat shredded coconut... why wouldn't it be dry?! No nasty chemical smell, sweeteners or crap in it like other shredded coconut in generic supermarkets. I use it to make myself raw vegan \\"bread\\" and protein balls and such. It works well when mixed with wet ingredients.

product_title: Water Kefir Grains
review_body: What arrived is not a true cultures for health product. I would not feel safe using as I don't know the home where these are produced.

product_title: Seeds of Change Organic Quinoa & Brown Rice, 8.5 Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised how very good this product was.  You just tear a corner and pop it in the microwave.  Besides being easy, it is extremely tasty!

product_title: Seeking Health PurE Organic Coffee Beans, Air Roasted 5 lbs.
review_headline: Doesn't look genuine organic coffee to me
review_body: First of all the picture doesn't show the actual product. I received a plain  black 5 pound coffee bag and I am very disappointed because it does not look genuine. The bag does not have any product information printed on it. It has some stickers that were printed and than glued on the package. There is no organic certification on the box.The coffee is full beans it is not grinned at all. I was expecting for the coffee to be enema ready(drip grind coffee) since it is advertised as enema coffee.Very disappointed for spending 60$ on this.

product_title: Annie's Homegrown Organic P'sghetti Loops With Soy Meatballs, 15.0 Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Try this one before you buy
review_body:
I know to each their own taste, but this product fails my family's taste test badly. I love other Annie's products. Their homegrown mac and cheese is a personal favorite.

But this stuff is pretty vile. It is bitter, kind of slimy and doesn't taste anything like the guilty pleasure from your youth.

Please at least do yourself a favor and grab a can from the local grocer before committing to a case just to make sure.

product_title: Barney Butter Almond Butter
review_headline: one star for NONEXISTENT customer service
review_body:
edit: it has been 6+ months and still not a single reply from their 'customer service'. good to know their guarantee of a reply 'within 24-48 hours' is legit.

so my family was looking for something similar to peanut butter but w/o the peanuts. we were also looking for something that did not use roasted nuts b/c roasting is not as healthy compared to raw nuts. after looking on amazon i came across this brand. i wanted to find out more about how it was prepared so i wrote to their customer service on their website. after you submit you question a friendly message pops up basically saying \\"we'll reply within 24-48 hours\\" etc.

days passed. no reply. so i try another time. more days pass. again no reply.

since we wanted to order some soon i go ahead and buy some based on the picture they posted on amazon. i trusted that their picture listed an accurate portrayal of their item they were selling. the picture did not show anything about roasted nuts. well we get the item in and open it up. what do i see? their packaging changed. on the front of the label lists roasted and blanched nuts.

as far as taste? nothing exceptional. tastes just like all the other stuff we've bought before. needless to say we wont be buying this product again.

ps. we bought this item on july 3rd and have yet to get a reply from this company. i would have to say that their \\"customer support\\" is truly pathetic.

product_title: Fisher Almonds, Slivered Blanched, 5-Pound Packages
review_headline: Not in Fisher Packaging as show on Web site
review_body:
The ad is deceiving as it show the almonds in Fisher packaging.
When you receive it it is in a clear unmarked bag.
You do not know if it is a Fisher product or who makes it.
They were almonds

product_title: Crazy Cups Premium Sampler
review_headline: I good place to start for a K-cup beginner
review_body: I got a Keurig cofee maker for Christmas this year and bought this to try out some of different taste options. I already have a few favorites. Green Mountain and the Bigelow teas are solid performers. Wolfgang Puck is okay but there are just too many \\"extra bold\\" in here for me to give this 5 stars. Still haven't tried the really exotic ones yet like Kenya blend or \\"jet fuel\\". Overall, one nice mix for the price even if its not too well rounded.

product_title: Spice Islands Gourmet Spices Dill Weed Seasoning 4.25
review_body: I love dill and use it on most anything. I found it to have good flavor at an unbeatable price.

product_title: Amy's Organic Chili Medium -- 14.7 oz
review_headline: Excellent Flavor. The Right Mix of Ingredients.
review_body:
I shared a can of Amy's Organic Chili (Medium) with my boy (3.5 yrs old) for lunch. We had some corn bread crackers with it and a drink (him chocolate milk, me iced tea). The chili was very good, much better than I'm used to coming from a can (14.5 ounces). It cost a bit more but I think it was well worth it. The flavor was excellent. The meat-substitute (tofu) was finely ground and was somewhast granular within the sauce. The fat content was fairly low and there was little oil evident when the can was opened, quite unlike other available canned chili with the greasy oil floating on top. The sodium content was alittle higher than I like, but not bad. The chili had lots of good fiber. It was ever-so slightly spicy, but not nearly as much as the hotter variety. The chili formed a good quality meal and I'll be back for more.

Gary Peterson

product_title: Betty Crocker Chocolate Mousse No Bake Parfait Mix with Chocolatey Cookie Crumbles 25.6 Ounce Value Box
review_headline: easy to make and not expensive
review_body: To whip up a batch of this Chocolate Mousse mix you need only milk, a beater and a little time to let it set. The mousse itself is creamy and chocolatey, not too light and not too heavy, though the \\"Chocolatey Cookie Crumbles\\" add more texture than flavor. You might try serving it with added whipped cream or whipped topping, too. As classic a dessert as this is, it doesn't quite meet criteria for a fancy party, but is an excellent choice to keep on hand when family or friends want something quick and yummy.

product_title: Swiss Miss Hot Cocoa Mix, Sensible Sweets, Light, 8 count,0.29 ounce, (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Too good to be true (but it is)
review_body: I couldn't find it locally, but based on all the good reviews, I went for the 48-serving deal. It's surprisingly good for 25 calories. It even has some worthwhile nutrition. It's not \\"rich\\" or \\"creamy\\" but it is chocolatey and sweet. I prefer the sugary, milky dark chocolate but can't afford the calories or sugar. I add sub-boiling water gradually as per the instructions and have no trouble getting the powder to disolve.

product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_body: Great coffee and a great price; much less 'offensive' packaging than a normal K-cup; works just like a normal K-cup; no problems.

product_title: Amonia (Castella) 28g
review_body: Gosh I have been looking for this stuff forever.  Got here fast and worked great to make my husbands great granny's ammonia cookies that he has been craving for 60 years.

product_title: Deglet Nour Dates on Branches
review_body: This is a really good value. The dates were very tasty and arrived in very good condition. Natural Candy, they taste like caramel! I will buy again when they become available.

product_title: Duncan Hines Decadent Cake Mix, Classic Carrot, 21.4 oz
review_body: I love carrot cake and if I have the time, I would make it from scratch. But, I'm busy and usually don't have time to grate carrots and sift flour. This mix will let me put a cake together in under 10 minutes and get great results. The flavor isn't exactly what I would make if I could choose my own spices, but its still good. What I like is it is full of flavor, moist and takes only 1 bowl to stir everything together. No mixer needed.  I might try adding a few walnuts next time around. I will keep several boxes on my pantry shelf. The only reason I am giving it 4 stars instead of 5 stars is I would prefer more carrot flavor and less spice flavor.

product_title: S&B Seasoned Pepper, 3.8-Ounce
review_body: I like this, but be sure to know the first ingredient is salt. The remaining ingredients are pepper, msg, and sugar. You really only taste the salt and msg. There is really not much pepper flavor.

product_title: David Rio Chai Mix, 14 Ounce
review_body: I was disappointed with this product because I have had David Rio's Chai Tea Mix before with sugar and expected the same great taste. This was a little flat and did not have the strong spice flavor I expected. I love the Spicy Chai tea and was looking forward to one that was sugar free and this did not come up to my standard. I had to put more mix into the glass than was recommended to get any real taste out of it, thus making it more expensive. If you want a spicy Chai tea like they serve in coffee and tea shops this one is not one you would want to buy.

product_title: Community Coffee Whole Bean Coffee, Cafe Special Decaffeinated, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_headline: 3.33/bag is just about what its worth..
review_body: why pay retail ?  you need about 1/4 bag to get any flavor out of this coffee..  so when it hits 3.33/bag, that is about what its worth...

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: DO NOT ORDER.  I recently received this order and the K-Cups have a defective seal that blows liquid out of the side all over my counter.  I do not have this issue with more expensive store bought K-Cups, so Amazon has obviously changed to a cheaper manufacturer to make it's prices.  Buyer be ware!

product_title: Hain Pure Foods Vegetarian Brown Gravy Mix, 0.7 Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: Bought this because the nutrition facts indicated that it had no sodium content.  WRONG!  All kinds of sodium.  What a waste of money.

product_title: Kagayaki Rice 4.4 Lb.
review_body: I am not Japanese or Chinese but I am trying to become more vegan.  I saw this at the oriental grocery and thought Ohhh birdseed, but I was willing to try.  It is absolutely marvelous.I am ready to experiment with different ways to fix it. Everyone should know how good this is and they would give up potatoes

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body:
I received a Keurig coffee maker for Christmas, which I thought was amazing until I found out the price of the K-cups. Wow! I'm not interested in spending a dollar for each cup, or sometimes more. That's why I brew my coffee at home instead of buying it elsewhere! Naturally, I started to look around to see if there was some sort of reusable device that could help save money and create less waste than the K-cups. Keurig offers their own reusable filter, but the ekobrew was considerably cheaper, even for two. I have coffee drinking friends over a lot, so the ability to make two cups in a row was the reason I made my purchase.

I am so glad that I did! The ekobrew cups are awesome. I can brew not only loose coffee but also loose leaf tea, if it is fine enough. I love tea as well, and I still steep many cups of loose tea, but the ekobrew lets me use a fine loose tea like Lipton black tea to brew using the Keurig! Awesome. The ekobrew cups can be a bit leaky, but they never spill tea leaves or coffee grounds into my cup, and if I have to dab up a few dribbles every now and then in exchange for saving a ton of money and being able to brew practically any kind of coffee or tea that I want, I think I can handle that.

Try out ekobrew if you want to save money and be able to brew coffee and tea your way!

product_title: YumEarth Organic Fruit Lollipops
review_headline: Tastes like they took a piece of fruit and stuck a stick in it!
review_body: I've been looking for something I could snack on other than sugar free hard candy since most of the time I end up chewing them and not savoring them. I figured with a lollipop I would go through less candy and thus less calories that way. These are delicious, they don't taste artificial, they taste like they've come right off the tree, or from the ground, or whatever the case may be. Tastes like they took a strawberry or a pomegranate or a cherry and put a stick in it! Fabulous! I am wondering if they would be able to come out with a sugar free version of their lollipops that would taste just as great. If they can make organic taste this great, I'm sure they could do it!

product_title: Taylors of Harrogate Assorted Tea
review_body: This is high quality lapsang souchong with a smooth, smoky scent and flavor.  It makes a delicious cup of tea, and is a very good value for the price.

product_title: Frontier Deluxe Vegetables Soup Blend, 16 Ounce Bag
review_body:
[[ASIN:B001VNKZQY Frontier Deluxe Vegetables Soup Blend, 16 Ounce Bag]]
I use my slow cooker for this Vegetables soup mix. Once the water turns hot, drop in soup mix as directed= 1 cup soup mix to 2 cups water. let simmer 1-2 minutes. I prefer to let this mix simmer for at least 2 - 3 hours. To me , it is more flavorful. These vegetables are fresh before being flash frozen and the excess moisture extracted from them, there they taste like just fresh out of the field foods.No additional flavors or preservatives added, simply real healthy food because being flash frozen keeps in all the vitamins, Minerals and whatever else there is in this food. Amazingly delicious..., you may wish to add your favorite flavoring without the sinthetics that are used to flavor canned foods, Another plus.

product_title: 100% RAW UMF 16+ ACTIVE MANUKA HONEY 1.1lb by Haddrell's of Cambridge
review_body: I had a sore throat forming, took a massive teaspoon of this stuff and it killed it. I could literally feel the soreness dissolve almost instantly.

product_title: J&D's Baconnaise Lite Bacon-Flavored Spread
review_headline: Should be called Beggin' Strips Spread.
review_body: I found this product at my local grocery store, and immediately wanted to try it, it sounded too good to be true. Unfortunately the saying stands, when I opened the jar it smelt like dog food, and tasted just as terrible. It reminded me of those bacon dog treats, Beggin' Strips. People seem to like the original spread, but Baconnaise Lite is mussy dog food in a jar.

product_title: Crystal Light Drink Mix, Variety Pack, On The Go Packets
review_body:
I love the product, a plastic box of individual
Crystal Light drink mix packets in 4 flavors.
Each packet is good for one 500ml water bottle.
The only problem is I wish I could order a box of
single flavors instead of the mandatory mix ratio.
(I dont personally like the strawberry,-too sweet).
This purchase is especially appreciated in areas
where sugar-free products are not easily available.
Im also very happy that they ship to APO addresses.

product_title: Frontier Bay Leaf Whole, Sele Grade, 16 Ounce Bag
review_body: I needed some bay leaf for my beans. I priced it at the grocery and a big box store and refused to pay that much for a few leaves. Amazon came through for me in a big way again. It is hard to visualize a 16 ounce bag of leaves but you get enough to share with friends and family and give away like your a nut or something. I have used these in so many things that I would never have tried before. Some food is really not good with bay leaf. I didn't grow up in kindergarten but I share the bay leaf.

product_title: Tiptree Little Scarlet Strawberry Preserve 12oz
review_body:
In short, Little Scarlet is the one of the most delicious jam I've ever eaten. I used to disregard strawberry jam in favour of raspberry as I usually found strawberry to be cloyingly sweet and short on flavour. LS is certainly the exception. It's intensly flavoured and, for me, only rivaled by the homemade jam my friend's Mother in Law makes from wild strawberries picked by hand in Prince Edward Island.

I first tried Little Scarlet @ 10 yrs ago on my first trip to London at a *very* fancy hotel's, outrageously expensive, High Tea. Everything at that tea was exceptional (as one would hope after taking out a mortgage to attend) and, even then, this fabulous jam stood out. I inquired, expecting to be told that it was hand-made, in single pot quantities, by magical fairies ;-) I was shocked to learn that it's a commercial jam and could be purchased retail at the gourmet shops in Fortnum & Mason, Harrods, Selfridges and other such fancy-ass shops.

My next stop after tea was Fortnum & Mason thinking Little Scarlet would be an ideal souvenir for friends & family. I should have braced myself for the sticker shock. Even back in 2003, with the British Pound at almost $2.25 Canadian, LS commanded a price of over 7 Pounds. I'd never seen such an expensive little jar of jam but it was my first time in England and I was feeling high-falootin (how does one spell 'fallootin'?) so I scooped up several jars to wow the folks back home with. Thank goodness the airlines hadn't yet cut back so severely on luggage weight!

No big surprise, everyone LOVED it and the search began to find LS in Canada & the States. It turned out that it is produced in small batches (although, disappointingly, not by magical fairies)and its' availability varies drastically depending on the size of the year's crop at Tiptree. Entire years have since gone by where I couldn't source a drop of it by any means :-(

I ended up bribing coworkers from our London office to be buy it up for me whenever they could find it at UK shops (yes, at any price). They'd then send it over to me with the next business traveler heading back 'across the pond' to Corp Head Office in Canada (where I was located). I'd send the traveler home with a king's ransom in Canada Grade A Light Maple Syrup (a big hit \\"over'ome\\" where corn syrup is the standard)or a fistful of cash, whichever they preferred.

I was delighted (and truly shocked) recently to find this gem of a jam at a new gourmet shop in, of all places, Niagara Falls NY! At only US $14 a jar it was an relative steal and I stocked up :-) :-) :-)

I just enjoyed my breakfast toast & jam (on yesterday's Ace Bakery baguette, yummo!) and felt the need to extol the virtues of the Little Scarlet. If you're on the fence about spending big bucks for a little jar of jam I recommend treating yourself to the LS - it's very much a treat indeed.

review_headline: Healthy Ingredient in Baked Goods Recipes
review_body:
I recently discovered ordering Bob's Red Mill products through Amazon for baking ingredients that may be difficult to find in local stores. I grind the whole flaxseeds to a meal using a coffee grinder and primarily use the flaxseed meal to replace all or some of the butter and oil in baked goods recipes. Sounds sketchy but it really does work - in my experience, even in yeast bread recipes! It has a very subtle, almost undetectable flavor and you'll see little flecks of the meal in your baked product, particularly if all white flour is used. Store ground flaxseed in fridge or freezer. Flaxseed meal has multiple health benefits including Omega-3's, lignans, fiber. Here's how to add the meal to your baked goods (copied from Livestrong.com):

-Add flaxseed meal to breads, muffins, pastries, cookies and other baked goods for extra nutrition and to produce a nutty flavor. According to the Barleans website, flaxseed meal should compose a minimum of 6 to 8 percent of the dry ingredients in any recipe.

-Replace the oil, shortening, butter or margarine with flaxseed meal in any baked goods recipe at a ratio of 3:1. If a recipe calls for 1/3 cup of oil, for example, replace with 1 cup flaxseed meal. Flaxseed meal has a high oil content, but contains less fat than most oils, shortening, butter and margarine.

-Reduce the flour in any baked goods recipe by 25 percent and replace with flaxseed meal. If a recipe requires 1 cup flour, for example, use 3/4 cup flour and 1/4 cup flaxseed meal instead. Using flaxseed meal this way adds a slight nutty flavor and a golden brown color to your baked goods.

-Use flaxseed meal as replacement for eggs in baked goods. Combine 1 tbsp. flaxseed meal with 3 tbsp. water for each egg and let the mixture stand for about five minutes before using in batters and doughs.

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_headline: If you like your coffee STRONG, and fair trade, read on
review_body:
I've noticed that the fair trade and decaf options in K-cups are quite limited, so was extra motivated to get the ekobrew to work for me. I experimented a lot to get a nice, strong 10-ounce cup of coffee. In the process, I'm estimating that while the K-cups are 50 cents to 75 cents apiece when on frequently available sale at $9 to $13 a box, with the ecobrew and my food co-op's broad offering of fair trade coffees at $9.99 a pound, my coffees come to about 25 cents a cup.

I read the other reviews about the fineness of the grind, tamping the ground coffee or not, and so on. While I evolved this recipe, I got a dozen cups of nasty thin coffee that tasted like ashtrays smell. (I am so offended by weak coffee.) The process I'm satisfied with now is:

1) I choose darker roast coffees, at least 3 beans out of 4 on the darkness scale (where 4 is French Roast).

2) Using the grinders at the stores, which seem to be about the same machine everywhere, I use the coarser of the two Drip grinds. At our stores the setting is at about 1:30 if it were a clock face, or the third click back from the strongest/finest Turkish setting at 3:00. I am going to see if my little home grinder can do this, but I get it that the home grinder re-grinds some of the coffee very finely and it might choke the ekobrew. Note that if you are buying ground instead of whole bean, you'll have fresher coffee if you buy it weekly in smaller fractions of a pound than you might have before.

3) I fill the ekobrew loosely to the top fill line, which is a couple millimeters below the top lip.

4) I tap the side of the cup, to settle the grinds a bit, maybe about a quarter inch. I do ensure that no grinds are on the top lip when closing the cup.

5) I use the 10 ounce water setting.

6) I accept that the coffee will not come out in a single stream at the bottom like it does with a pinpricked K-cup. This filter, appropriately, lets brewed coffee out the sides of the cup, and I accept that there will be several streams/drips into my mug. Now and again I'll even see a small jet shoot sideways outside the mug. This is a price I'll pay for having coffee with actual COFFEE in it.

My husband doesn't like it as strong, so we skip the tapping/tamping step, to his satisfaction. He'd probably also be happy with a lighter roast bean.

Enjoy!

review_body:

product_title: Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix
review_headline: Great bread if you tweak the recipe a little - then you get Challah!!
review_body:
A kind friend bought a six pack of these for us to try out. My pre teen has Celiac and our kitchen is GF and we are always willing to try out different GF items. Our current bread standby is from Glutino and, while it is not perfect, my kids enjoy it - especially when used to make french toast!
[[ASIN:B000EVG8H4 The Gluten-Free Pantry Favorite Sandwich Bread Mix, 22-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)]]

The first four packs I made I followed to the letter. I was a little disappointed that the instructions on the back for using the bread mix for oven baked bread, bagels, pizza dough, cinnamon bread and egg free bread all stated in large bold lettering that it required the use of a heavy duty stand mixer. I don't have one and so those options were out for me. But still, using the recipe for breadmakers turned out decent (if fairly flat) loaves. I made the basic recipe and the sweet bread. The instructions state that you should make this on a Basic White bread setting instead of the Gluten free setting on your breadmaker and that is what I did.

(Note that if you are buying this mix to bake in your oven, the package states that you need to use a stand mixer!)

My child said that the bread was okay but that it had a wierd texture and taste to it. I think the texture was due to the grainy nature of the 3 rice flours in the mix. The flavor, I think, is the Millet flour which tends to have a bitter aftertaste. Millet does have good nutritional value but if the flavor turns off the child from eating it what is the point??

Anyway, I still had two packs to go so I decided to tweak things a little. I made the sweet bread recipe again but this time I used butter instead of oil and baked it in my Zojirushi breadmaker on a programmed gluten free program and Voila! The bread rose beautifully! It had a light airy feel to it; a bit spongy - almost like a cake. The 1/4 cup sugar covered up the bitterness of the millet, home made butter (could use unsalted) instead of the melted oil made it rich - and it tastes almost exactly like Challah bread!

So if you are just GF and not CF as well, this is a sure fire way to make some excellent sweet egg bread. And if, like us, you miss your Shabbat Challah, this bread mix will be a wonderful addition to your kitchen!nsalted) instead of the melted oil made it rich - and it tastes almost exactly like Challah bread!

So if you are just GF and not CF as well, this is a sure fire way to make some excellent sweet egg bread. And if, like us, you miss your Shabbat Challah, this bread mix will be a wonderful addition to your kitchen!

product_title: French Toast Crunch Cereal, 12.8-Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Not the French Toast Crunch we all know and love...
review_body: I remember loving French Toast Crunch when I was just a youngster. With it's miniature slice of bread shapes and rich, buttery French Toast flavor, it made all the other cereals look like a joke! I never ate anything else. Unfortunately, one day my parents came back from the grocery store empty-handed and told me there was no more French Toast Crunch. It had been taken off the market. At first I refused to believe them. Then I demanded that they put an end to their tom-foolery and hand the stuff over! It hit me like a freight train when I noticed a small tear in my mother's eye and I positively had a mental breakdown. I cried for weeks, saw guidance counselors at my school, but it seemed like only time would heal the wound.    It did - sort of. I attempted to move on to various other cereals in the hopes of finding a new love, but eventually drifted away from cereal as I matured. I moved on to oatmeal, cream of wheat, bagels, SQUAGELS of all things. I left home for college and thought that I had forgotten about French Toast Crunch for good...    Until my mother called me from home in hysterics. She was blubbering like a fool and I could hardly understand a word she was saying. Eventually I caught the only three I needed to hear: French, Toast, Crunch. It was back.    I burst out of my dormitory like a Kenyan in the Olympics. I ran the nearly four miles to my local grocery store without the slightest pause, grabbed a box from the shelf without giving it a second glace, payed the grimacing teenager at the register, and booked right on home again salivating all the way!    The first thing I noticed when I poured my first bowl was the difference in shape. I blew it off in my frantic state of mind, but came to a complete halt when I put the garbage in my mouth. Gone was the burst of French Toast flavor I had loved so much. The texture was no longer solid and hearty, but brittle, weak, and no different than Cinnamon Toast Crunch. I spat the foreign cereal back into the bowl, called my mom back to say thanks for nothing, and went on with my daily routine.    I guess I always knew that French Toast Crunch would never really come back. It was a sign of its time and the world will never be ready for its return. This cereal is an abomination; a cheap knock-off that plays a sick prank on everyone who ever truly gave their heart to that beautiful, bountiful French Toast Crunch of yore. Don't be fooled like me!

product_title: Amy & Brian Coconut Water Original, 17.5 Ounce Can (Pack of 12)
review_body:
Way back when I was a little kid (perhaps 65 years ago) my Dad used to bring home a coconut on occasion. It was a family affair. He'd punch a hole in it and drain the juice and all five of us would have a little sip. Then he's break the shell with a hammer and we'd all have a bit of coconut meat. I remember it as a fun childhood experience. Well, I can't recall having coconut ever since, except as an ingredient in candy or cookies.

Recently, I was visiting a local grocery store and I noticed Amy & Brian Coconut Juice In the beverage section. It was billed as a natural isotonic unsweetened beverage and was 100& coconut water. Hmmm. Just like the old days, but now it comes in a pop-top 17.5-ounce can. Well, I had to try it, of course. Well, nostalgia isn't what it used to be. It was an okay beverage, but I wouldn't put it among my favorites. The flavor is mild and non-sweet. It goes down easily. The calories are limited (120 per can). It states that it's an isotonic beverage good before or after exercise and it states that it has potassium and magnesium, but doesn't list the amount. Be sure to drink it chilled. I'd drink it again, but I'm not rushing out to get more.

Gary Peterson
