product_title: Metabo Fat Burner - 60 Capsules Extreme Fat Burner Formula Lipotropics L-Carnitine Weight Loss Diet Pills
review_body:
I don't know if its just me and maybe I have a few screws loose in my head, but after the first day of use, I feel like its working.
I have been working out for about 5 months, and I have rev'd up my metabolism pretty good, I dropped 35 lb (without using this product) but the last month or so I have had trouble getting rid of the last few LB's.
I figured that I probably had this fat for so long that it might be a little compacted up and rough to break up, so I looked into fat emulsifiers and such and decided to give this product a try (hey 9$ bucks right? what the hell! lol I spend more on vitamins....)

Im at the point where you can squeeze the skin around my naval and you can feel the individual lumps of fat in there, after the first day I noticed that the small clusters of squeezable fat nodes are shrinking/becoming a little softer (they almost feel like sacks of oil now instead of chunky rubber).

I think the longer you hold a piece of fat on you, the more calcified / harder to break up and burn it gets.

This product seems to be working, although I am a little concerned about the 100mg of Guarana, which is pretty much very concentrated Caffeine.... I would go crazy and pop 3 ~ 4 of these... 2 max per serving because the guarana can be strong for some.

For the price the risk/reward ratio seemed acceptable to try it.... if it works long term ill buy more...

PS: I like that it has chromium in it! chromium is good for weight loss... it helps mitigate insulin spikes (when insulin is present in the blood it makes fat burning nearly impossible).

This is IMO a good product to use if you have been working out/doing all the right things and need that little extra push to get you over the next milestone in your weight loss goals.

I went from 200, to 185 *quickly, then 185 to 179 rather quick but slightly slower , then 179 to 175 pretty slow, then 175 to 170 again slowly, and 170 to 165 pretty quick and then 165 to 159~160 slowly (all without this product).

I still didn't achieve the full look I was going for, and I kinda got stuck at 159~161 (bouncing around).

If this works long term ill re-review it in a month.

Obviously if you are 300 lb and don't work out eat right etc... NOTHING will help you lose weight.... there is no such thing as a magic pill and even the most reputable fat burners are questionable.

I would suggest loading up on vitamins and working out first and losing 20 lb on your own before trying any fat burners.

UPDATE: DAY 3, So far I have lost 2.5~3 LB (my scale sucks so its hard to tell).
This product seems to be working because I intentionally cut back on working out to see if this product has any effect.

I am now going to start working out a little harder to add to the effect.

Im probably going to order more/stock up on these for the summer.

product_title: Spectrum Naturals Oil Peanut Hi Heat
review_headline: Beautiful product, but it is NOT COLD PRESSED peanut oil.
review_body:
Please note that the Product Description of this product does NOT match the actual description on the bottle itself.

I ordered this peanut oil after much research on expeller pressed versus cold pressed, and searching many
sites for peanut oil to buy. What I found is that not all expeller pressed oil is
cold pressed. Cold pressed, as the name implies, means they use cooler temperatures in creating
the product. So I was looking, specifically, for COLD pressed peanut oil & \\"cold pressed\\" on the label/description, as my chiropractor prescribed.

The description of this product on amazon is: \\"Spectrum Naturals Organic High Heat Peanut Oil -
Open A Bottle And Unleash The Scent Of Fresh Roasted Peanuts. Adds Depth And Intensity To Any Saute Or Stir-Fry. Ingredients 100% Cold Pressed Unrefined Peanut Oil.\\"
BUT... the actual label on the product (which arrived today) says: \\"INGREDIENTS: 100% mechanically (expeller) pressed naturally refined high oleic peanut oil.\\"

So, not only is the actual peanut oil NOT cold pressed (the words \\"cold pressed\\" are nowhere on the bottle), it's also refined rather than unrefined as the amazon description describes.

Now, with all that said... if cold pressed, unrefined peanut oil is NOT what you are looking for, then this product looks great. It is meant to be used with high heat. It came in just two days (thanks amazon!) and is in a beautiful glass jar with a nice label with a rainbow.

And, as always, I appreciate amazon's phenomenal return policy!

product_title: Taste Specialty Foods Minced Roasted Garlic, 5-Pound
review_headline: Roasted... but still sharper than some
review_body:
Roasted garlic, whether stored moist as roasted or then dehydrated, has a much mellower taste than raw garlic. Amazon used to sell dehydrated roast cloves that were so mild you could eat one as a snack... they were great for chopping coarsely and throwing into stews and sauces. They still sell McCormick powdered roasted garlic, which is mild enough to stir into raw dips.

Taste Specialty's minced isn't quite that mild. Definitely roasted, but you still get a bit of the sulfur sharpness. You can use it for cooking... just don't expect the almost-sweet flavor of freshly and properly roasted garlic.

For what it's worth, the 5-pound container has slightly more than 1100 cloves' worth of garlic (at 1/3 tsp per). So there'll be plenty to experiment with and share with friends.

review_body: Often times I try these pre-made mixes only to be sorely disappointed and come to the realization that I must go to an Indian restaurant in order to dine properly. Not this time. To be sure there were some changes that I had to make. I used about a 1 1/2lbs -2lbs cubed chicken breast which I seasoned with sea salt, fresh black pepper, ground coriander and cumin. I let it sit out for probably an 1-2 hours. I followed the directions for cooking but I also added 1 personal serving size plain yogurt, 2 tblsp. butter, 3-4 minced garlic cloves, 1 inch of ginger quartered, and 2 tblsp. canola oil to the sauce. I let all of this simmer (low) for about 1 1/2 hours while stirring occasionally. I also added more coriander, cumin, and sea salt to the sauce while cooking for taste. I promise you this tastes just like it came from an Indian restaurant but you must be willing to tweak it in an order to get it there.

review_body:
Love this product! If I am completely honest, the first couple times I used them I wasn't sure if they worked the way I expected. Then I noticed such a big difference when I didn't use them that I became a believer and now use them every time I drink coffee.

Depending on the type of cup you use, you get different results. The one thing that stays consistent is that the coffee becomes drinkable (hot, but not scalding) within a couple of minutes. I use cream in my coffee, so in a coffee cup I will usually use 2 joulies and with my travel mug I use 3 joulies. The general rule I have come up with is it increases drinking time to about 2 or 2 1/2 times the original time. For example, in my open, no cover coffee cup, my coffee stays hot about 20-30 minutes and in my poorly insulated travel mug with cover, my coffee stays hot about an hour and a half rather than 30-45 minutes. I just recently bought an insulated mug and am very excited to use the joulies with it, because I know I am going to have perfect temperature coffee for hours (much longer than my coffee usually lasts).

This is a product I would recommend to any coffee drinker, as long as they know the type of cup you use does make a difference in the results you are going to get! If you follow the guidelines provided with the product (pre-heating, using an insulated mug with cover, and experimenting with the number of joulies) you will find the combination that works for you.

Old ketchup used to have enough sugar in it to balance the acidity and saltiness, but since the advent of corn syrup, it just seemed to me like you could dip your fries in Karo syrup. (Sorry for the rant, :) Anyway, while low carb dieting, I discovered that there were lots of meats to eat, but sometimes it is a drag to eat a plain burger or steak. What really motivated me was when I made a pork roast into pulled pork and realized you can't make it into really barbeque because that would totally blow your carbs when you add sauce. So, I found this ketchup and created my own barbecue and steak sauce which basically involves using this product mixed with other ingredients including Liquid Smoke. Viola! An ultra-low carb BBQ/steak sauce.

Granted the price fluctuates wildly here on Amazon, depending on the seller and the shipping costs. As other reviewers have mentioned, it is widely available at the big bad box store we all love to hate, and thank goodness for it. I had just had to give a shout out this product, and the Heinz folks, because this fills a need, however you get it to your house!

product_title: Fresh Italian White Truffles 1 oz By Alma Gourmet
review_headline: ORDER FROM NOWHERE ELSE!!! Beautiful quality from a Conscientious Seller.
review_body:
I had ordered both fresh white truffles[[ASIN:B004BIOE40 Fresh White Truffles 1 ounce ( White Alba Truffle)]] and some caviar close to a holiday weekend (on the Thursday before Christmas on Sunday) and I had done so without anticipation of getting them except in time for New Years. Shipping was noted as $6 for each of the 2 items I'd ordered.

Not only did the seller notice the 2 orders shipping to the same location and consolidated the shipping cost to $8 for both. But they obtained my phone number from Amazon, called me to tell me that normally they overnight these types of items in any event, but while they would happily upgrade for Saturday Delivery at no charge to me so I would have the order for Christmas, they had worries that there was possibly no Saturday delivery in rural area (I live in Bridgehampton NY and they were correct, there is no Saturday deliver here even from Fed-X) and so, to avoid the order sitting around unrefrigerated from Friday till Tuesday, they were calling to ask if they should hold the order and instead ship Tuesday for Wednesday.

Since I did not pick up my calls Thursday eve or Friday AM rather than just leave a voice-mail a call their job done, when I finally answered a call at 5:20 Friday, it was from a seller employee's cell phone, who had my order with him, in order to be able keep it freshest, pending an instruction from me, and so as to make absolutely sure they were following my wishes.

As you can imagine the items received were commensurate with that service, and when they arrived Wednesday morning they were perfect IN EVERY WAY.

And no matter how expensive the items (and they were the cheapest of their kind I found this season), this kind of service, while certainly also rare as the items themselves, is in my estimation, priceless.

review_headline: Can't get enough of this amazing sauce!
review_body:
I've used Mr. Mobley's Tahini sauce for years! It truly is amazing on just about anything. Mr. Mobley's is unlike any sauce you've tasted; it's tangy, sweet, tasty, and adds that 'special something' to whatever you're fixing. I've enjoyed it as a salad dressing, a marinade for chicken, beef, pork, and seafood, topped rice dishes with it, added it to pan-fried potatoes, dressed fresh vegetables with it, and even drizzled it on watermelon for an out of this world dessert. There's nothing I've found that can't be improved on by adding a little Mobley's to it!

The Original is fun, but Mr. Mobley's Tahini Sauce \\"With Heat\\" is even more fun! The warmth comes from cayenne, so it warms up slowly on your tongue. It's not a hot-pepper kind of heat. Of the two, \\"With Heat\\" is my favorite!

product_title: Amazing Grass Green Superfood
review_body: I bought this last night at a health food store for around $27'ish...wow it's so much cheaper on Amazon. I think I'm going to start a subscribe and save. Anyway I'm a vegetarian, and have been one for 13 years, I eat almost all USDA organic food, have a freezer full of vitamins (not like I take them regularly/I know I need to) and I try to eat healthy. Yet I'm busy and I'm sure I'm not getting all the vitamins I need in my day. I was listening to Ben Fuchs who promotes Tangy Tangerine on a radio show, but I wanted something organic as a  vitamin supplement. I had tried the EnerFood Green Drink, and couldn't keep it down, I kid you not because of the Dulse seaweed, I dry heaved every time it was like drinking from the Gulf Coast Water. (I bought and now take Modifilan pills to get around the seaweed taste). Anyway I bought this one last night at a health food store for the vitamins. I got home from work at 5:30, cleaned the house, then washed my car, then went grocery shopping and got back at 8:40 pm, finished and had a litany of things to do before I could eat dinner, unload the grocery bags, water the blasted yards because of the drought, and tackle some of the nightmare kitchen job. I mixed up a scoop of this in some cold water and downed it while I worked. The taste was decent, not yummy by any standards but the orange definitely almost masks all the unpleasant 'green' taste, not like I would care anyway, I'd force myself to drink it for health's sake. Anyway 30 minutes in, on a empty stomach I had a really big jolt of energy for the rest of the 2 hours until I finally ate dinner. I did munch on a few red grapes and strawberries, but I could definitely notice a big energy boost. I also used it this morning at work. I was in a daze today, dragging! Need more sleep! Anyway, an hour or so after I drank this....once again feeling actually operational and clear headed. I can tell a difference. Pretty good stuff.

product_title: Teeccino Caffeine Free Herbal Coffee, Espresso Grind, 16 Ounce
review_body: I quit coffee a few weeks ago and really wanted to like this drink.  For people in the same boat, consider yourself warned that this beverage is NOTHING like coffee.  As to its merits as a distinct drink, I'd have to say I'm still not a fan.  It's bitter like the previous reviewer has pointed out, but this bitterness is not (in my experience) alleviated by stevia.  While I'm usually a great fan of mint, this drink has a spoiled aftertaste which lingers on the tongue and is interlaced with nutty undertones.  There's not the slightest hint of chocolate, which is a shame because raw cocoa powder would be less bitter than this concoction.  If the taste were slightly more obnoxious, I'd say it was medicinal, but as it stands, it might be possible to disguise the poor flavors using cream or sugar.  However, I think I'll just save my money and continue on my search for a coffee alternative which I actually enjoy drinking.  This isn't to write Teeccino as a brand off; I'd suggest ordering the sampler pack from their website in order to make an informed decision rather than pin all your hopes and dreams to one large tub of a single flavor.

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Breathe Easy Tea, 16 Tea Bags
review_headline: Great tasting and excellent for relieving cough/chest congestion
review_body:
We have been using this tea for years for chest congestion and nagging coughs. The ingredients are gentle and very pleasant tasting and work great to temporarily relieve a cough.

As licorice root and fennel are two of its main ingredients, it definitely has a very slight (but not at all overpowering) licorice flavor. You can also taste slight blends of eucalyptus, peppermint and ginger (which help to settle your stomach as well as relieve other cold symptoms you might be experiencing).

Obviously, if any symptoms are very long term, nothing replaces a doctor's care, but this can definitely help with some short term, common cold or flu cough symptoms.

Also great for a vocal boost for singers/actors before a performance!

product_title: Tutto Calabria Hot Pepper Sauce 6.7 oz
review_body:
Definitely unlike other pepper pastes, like GIA and Amore that come in tubes. It's thick like a tomato paste. The flavor is tangy and hints a little Asian flavors, though it is distinctly Italian pepper flavors. I wasn't expecting a specific taste or texture when I bought it so I'm pretty happy with getting something that I haven't experience before. I will find a lot of uses for this.

I could see it being an excellent addition to a spicy pasta sauce, or pizza sauce. It may also work well mixed with olive oil and used as a base or spread for breads and pizza and such.

Also, it's fairly hot, but not too hot. It's fine for most people who like a little heat, but anyone who likes only very mild spiciness will want to pass on this.

product_title: Vino Italiano 4 Week Wine Kit, 15.5 Pound Box
review_body:
I added sugar to get the SG up to 1.085 and used a cotes de blanc yeast from Red Star. Whipped the gas off a couple times durring secondary and at SG 0.990 I degassed and cleared it per the instructions. It seamed a little thin so I added two 12 oz cans of Welches frozen white grape. This was my sweetener and 'body' filler as it were.

A month after bottling this was pretty good. I don't love Guweruztraminer but was looking for a base to make a semi sweet green chili wine after the 'Hatch Green Chili' spirit. The Green Chili is good too but the base has become a decent white table wine.

For $40 for 6 gallons you cant complain even a little on this one, though I'd rate it at $7-$9/bottle. That's $170 bucks to the good on 30 bottles at the least. So add a little juice to get the body up and a little sugar to get the alcohol up and you have a pretty decent table wine to serve. I bet the guys making 5 gallon batches are right on as the kit by itself would make a thin wine.

Very tasty and easy to drink. It may 4 vs 5 stars based on my indifference to Gewurztraminer.

product_title: Ass Basket, Ass Kickin' Hot Sauce Gift Basket
review_body: I purchased this high quality Ass Basket recently and you can bet your bottom dollar that it lives up to all the expectations you would hope for in an ass basket. There was some confusion on my end prior to receiving this in the mail. I thought I had purchased a basket of donkey figurines. Knick knacks, if you will. One of my hobbies is collecting donkey statues, pictures and paraphenalia. I just can't get enough of these magnificent creatures. They have such personality, and their work ethic is something to admire. It's just amazing what can happen when a horse a pony come together in mutual affection. The title \\"work horse\\" really belongs to these proud creatures, and I have worked tirelessly to get recognition and state funding for these jackasses. When my package arrived at my rear door, I was originally furious, but threw some of this on a beef brisket and I tell ya, I got a swift ass kickin indeed! Even offered some to my neice Fanny. She went ahead and ordered her own Ass Basket and her whole family loves it! I have found this product to be a great gift to buy in lieu of flowers and hand lotion. I've started giving it to folks for all occasions, even weddings, as well as a friend's funeral. You'd think people would be offended, but the thing is, people like hot sauce whether they're happy, sad, married or dead. Think about it, who doesn't like a hot meal? That's what I'm sayin. Just be careful though. My dog ate half a bottle of this and it came outta both ends on my kitchen rug, which is wool. Can't get the stains out! Looks like it's a total loss but I'm gonna try Magic Eraser one more time.

I ordered other items that came in a larger box which I suppose made shipping easier. I had to find alternate storage.  /  Update 2/28/13    I reordered this item. I generally purchase my kcups through [...] because not only do they offer discounts but you earn points towards other items. I reordered because I liked it the previous time, and I wanted some variety. Keurig doesnt really offer these kinds of samplers. My order arrived within the 2 days (I have a prime membership) with the box torn up. The items arrived again in the bag inside a box. I opened to find 34, not 35 kcups and 6 were damaged and unusable. I contacted their web chat customer service, who was of absolutely no help. I called their customer service line and spoke to someone who was fantastic. They are sending me a replacement over night. I am a HUGE amazon shopper, and their customer service has always been great to me. I probably wont purchase this sampler anymore. Keurig offers better deals, and each item comes in a nice storage box that you would find in a store. Amazon however, has great customer service. Just beware of these samplers.

product_title: Nissin Chow Mein Premium Teriyaki Beef, 4.0 Ounce, (Pack of 12)
review_headline: One of the Best Microwavable Meals, but Beware of Trans Fat
review_body:
This was one of my college staples. I had at least 5 of these a week for years.
After a while my parents said that it contained trans fat.
I initially ignored their claim after reading the package and seeing \\"0g Trans Fat.\\"

However, I later read that food manufacturers may put 0g if it contains up to .5g. There are two servings in this package, which is why they can say that it is \\"trans fat free.\\" If it only listed one serving, this product would have to say 1g trans fat.

This is still my favorite microwavable noodle product, but I no longer purchase it. Unnaturally occurring trans fat is simply not good for you, no matter how delicious. Should this product ever remove the trans fat, I would rate it 5 stars and go back to eating it every day.

Look for partially hydrogenated oils in the ingredients. It's not worth it.

review_body: The saltiness depends on how you prepare it.  When you pour the salt in with the oil and kernels and then pop the corn you can use the whole salt thing and it won't be salty at all. I really like this popcorn, I make it in a whirly-pop.  It always comes out perfect every time.  I like to add even more buttery-oil-goodness after popping (I like Kernel Seasons popcorn oil) to make it just like movie theater style. product_title: Morton Salt Kosher Salt, 3 lbs
review_headline: now, how does anyone write a reviewfor salt?
review_body:
Here my findings. It tastes very salty, so be careful how much you use. Also be aware that it looks like sugar. So if you plan in not storing it in its original package, mark it carefully.

Fun aside, Kosher salt is dried sea salt, it can be a bit deceitful, If you have a recipe that calls for spoon measured salts, look up how much ounces fit on a spoon and weigh it. Kosher salt comes in bigger crystals then normal salt, means bigger volume with less actual salt. SO be sure you measure accordingly.

There is nothing else I can tell you...

product_title: Sugar In The Raw/Unrefined, 32-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Sugar In The Raw has been around for over twenty years and is still a great product.  Refining sugar has never made sense to me, as food is best when minimally processed.  Unlike brown sugar, which is made of white sugar and molasses recombined, raw sugars are not separated and recombined.  Sugar In The Raw, unlike brown sugar is not sticky and easy to measure.  Less processing of foods preserves more of a foods vitamins and minerals in their original form.  Sugar In The Raw makes fine tapioca and pumpkin pudding and requires no additional time.  tapioca made with raw sugar is slightly darker looking and richer tasting.  Makes good hot chocolate when mixed with powered baker's chocolate and milk.

review_body: The vanilla beans I received were high quality - nice and moist. Also, they were delivered exactly when they were supposed to be, which was important to me. :)

product_title: Mrs. Mays Naturals Snack (12 Pack)
review_body: You know how limited your food choices can be when your plane is delayed and the airport is pretty much closing down for the night? Well, that's how I found Mrs. Mays Cran-Blueberry Crunch.  The candy and gum kiosk at LaGuardia carries them, and I was not going to make it tbrough a 2 hour delay on a Snickers. They're delicious without being overly sweet and the fruit is real fruit, not dried fruit with yucky preservatives.  When I got hom, I couldn't find it locally, so I ordered a case from Amazon, and I keep a bag in my desk drawer (for that late afternoon snack attack).  I've shared with my friends, and everyone loves it.  Enjoy!!

product_title: Blue Diamond Almonds BOLD  Habanero BBQ, 6-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is a great snack.  Has a good flaver and is spicy.  I will add a little habanro powder to give it a little more heat.  Amazon price is much better than the grocery store.  As long as Amazon continues to carry this flavor, I will continue to buy them through Amazon.

review_body: We did not like these at all.  The water was so thick, and it was too hard to get the noodles to cook properly.  They wanted to stick together.  If you have already purchased these, plan to eat right after cooking and try to use a much larger pot than you would expect. I've used the brown rice pasta before, and would recommend those instead.

product_title: Healthworks Chia Seeds 3lb 6lb Parent
review_body: I'm only giving 3 stars because of the packaging.  The product \\"was* cushioned inside the outer box but it still slid around in there.  The packaging for the chia seeds themselves wasn't sealed very well so there are some seeds scattered around in the outer box.  I'd read comments that said you didn't get the full 6 pounds and they are correct. I set them on a scale in the bag they came in and it registered 5.8 pounds. product_title: Vegemite Jar
review_body: I love Vegemite and Marmite!  It is definitely an acquired taste for most Americans, and I learned to love it a long time ago.  My taste for it was reinvigorated by a wonderful trip to New Zealand where it is commonplace.  Not so much here - hard to find and expensive for a small jar.  It is a yeasty, salty, umami taste treat - perfect spread lightly on toast, sandwiches, rice cakes.  It's not for everyone, but I was delighted to find it through Amazon.com.

product_title: Ancient Harvest Organic Quinoa, 12 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_headline: So good and good for you!
review_body: For those of us watching our diet, Quinoa is a great staple to have on hand.  We have it for breakfast along with fruit..... find it crunchy and satisfying.  It's a good substitute for rice and very high in good protein.  Being gluten free is a big plus.

product_title: Ye Olde McCormick Tea House, 100-Count Individually Wrapped Tea Bags (Pack of 5)

review_body: I had been using the Torani chocolate mocha sauce for a long time, but when it wasn't available in the smaller bottles for a while at Amazon, I started freaking out as my supply ran low. I'm a convert now.  The taste is great even though the label is different, but I think it is pretty much the same ingredients, although the proportions of the basic ingredients are a bit different.  I'm a convert now, and I'm just about ready to order a couple more bottles.

product_title: Bellavitano Raspberry Wisconsin cheese by Wisconsin Cheese Mart
review_body: love it and will come back for more. A pleasant surprise. Not sweet and a nice pairing with bread and wine

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Mints
review_body:
I LOVE Newman's Ginger Mints. I like them much better than Altoid's ginger mints because: better and stronger ginger flavor; and consistency of the mint (Altoid's are hard as rocks, though I guess that's not a big deal since they're supposed to be dissolved slowly in your mouth).

This 6-pack is also the best price I could find and I use the \\"subscribe and save\\" delivery option, so save a few more $$ that way. I have had trouble finding them in my local health food stores, so I just keep coming back to Amazon to purchase them. I have a tin in my purse, one in my car, another on my desk. Like I said, I love these things.

Plus, I carry an extra tin in my purse to give away, which I do about every other week. When I offer a mint to acquaintances or friends when I'm helping myself to one, almost all say \\"yum ... these are good - where'd you get them?\\" Then I whip out the extra tin and give them a little gift. So, I get to spread some love and we all get to enjoy these :)

product_title: Crazy Cups Wolfgang Puck Sampler,  K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 35)
review_body: Crazy Cups Wolfgang Puck Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 35) is a great deal. The sampler pack gave me an opportunity to test many flavors and decide what I really liked and would re-order.

product_title: Hodgson Mill Gluten Free Multi Purpose Baking Mix, 12-Ounce Units (Pack of 6)
review_body: I received this baking mix as a gift, and I tried it with a soft and chewy molasses cookie recipe.  I shared the cookies with a mixed group of friends: some that have to eat gluten-free some that do not.  They all loved the cookies and no one mentioned any bitter after taste that another reviewer mentioned.  I would recommend these for dark breads, cookies, and cakes, of the spice variety, such as banana bread, zucchini bread, molasses cookies, gingerbread cookies, carrot cake etc.  This works well for dark colored doughs and should work well to bake a gluten-free alternative to whole wheat bread.  I would NOT recommend this for light and fluffy buttermilk pancakes, white cakes, or other baked goods where a few simple flavoring ingredients like chocolate chips or peanut butter need to shine through.  For the right application, this is a whole grain, healthy, easy-to-use gluten-free alternative to traditional flour mixes.

product_title: Quaker Oatmeal Squares Cinnamon Cereal, 14.5-Ounce Box
review_body: I'm usually a cereal man when it comes to breakfast. That is, unless of course, there's donuts or pancakes. But most of the time I try to stick with a healthy type of cereal rather than Lucky Charms or something of that nature. My two favorites are usually raisin bran or frosted mini wheats but this has worked its way into my regular rotation. They are nice and cruncy with just enough cinnamon and sweetness to be tasty without overpowering your taste buds. Also, it's nice and hearty so it doesn't leave me hungry after only 30 minutes. Definitely recommended.

product_title: Duke's Mayonnaise, 32-Ounce Jars (Pack of 4)
review_body:
Everyone raves about this mayo, saying it's the \\"best\\". Some have said it's like the way Hellmann's used to be before they watered it down. Well I bought the 4 pack of 32 ounce jars and had high expectations. When I received the order, I opened the first jar and dipped the tip of my butter knife in to give it a taste sample. I did not like it at all. It tasted almost sour. It sort of had a mustard like after taste. I tried it on my favorite deli roast beef, and in my opinion, it ruined it. The after taste is unpleasant. I even tried to use it for tuna salad. It was awful! I don't get it? My jars are not out of date. I guess I just don't appreciate this brand like many others do.

I have recently rediscovered Kraft mayo and I am happy that they reverted back to their older recipe. It is creamy and delicious. I will stick with that.

I have three jars of Duke's left, that I will donate to our local food bank so that it doesn't go to waste. I know I will probably get a lot of heat from Duke loyalists, but what can I say? I just don't like it!

product_title: Essentia 9.5 pH Drinking Water
review_body:
My wife has recurring extreme muscle spasms, usually late at night or early morning. We started to use this water for her about 6 months ago. It has been the best purchase we have ever made [I am not kidding]. I haven't noticed anyone mentioning this benefit, but I can assure you it works!! We ran out a couple of days ago and had to wait and do without for about 3 days. She had awful muscle spasms in both legs last night. Back to where she was before we starting using this water. We were really thankful that we received 3 cases this morning. I have vowed \\"as god is my witness I will never run out of Essentia water again\\" {from the movie Gone with the wind, ha ha]. But for real, we are now ordering 4 case per month so that we will never run out again.
Update; this water is still working for my wife. We love it and continue using it.

product_title: Sapporo Ichiban
review_body:
I love these noodles. They are my favorite \\"ramen\\" style packet food - but *NOT* ramen. I've been calling them \\"chow mein\\" for some time, but other reviewers are right, they are Japanese Yakisoba style noodles.

They are cheaper here on Amazon than I can find them in stores, but more importantly, consistently available. Some local stores have them for $0.99-$1.25, but I have noticed they are incredibly difficult to find. They seem to be carried randomly. I'll find a store that carries them, buy a dozen, and next time I go back they no longer carry them.

The noodles are a wonderfully sweet, rich, salty, tangy-ish flavor. Personally, I love them, but I know the flavor is NOT for everyone. Every time I cook them, my husband always says, \\"ooh, that smells good, can I have a bite?\\" and immediately makes his \\"gross face\\" when he tastes it. EVERY TIME. So its a love-or-hate kind of food. But me? I LOVE them. As a side note, they come with a small packet of green seaweed type stuff, but I hate the way it tastes (and even smells - ick!), so I always omit it.

(And I'm a vegetarian, so these noodles are perfect for me.)

Pros:

- Quick to prepare
- Flavorful
- Cheap
- Unique
- Vegetarian

Cons:

- Sometimes inconsistent availability (outside Amazon)
- Packet of green \\"stuff\\" (personal preference)
- I wish they had a \\"1.5 packet\\" size. One packet is sometimes not enough, two is too much.

product_title: Seitenbacher Gluten Free Banana Cranberry Bar, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I was not sure what to expect from this bar. The wrapper looks quite unassuming and banana/cranberry seems to be an unlikely combination, but I decided to give this bar a try. It essentially only has 3 ingredients - dried banana, dried cranberries and chocolate (which of course contains multiple ingredients, but is German made, so good stuff and no GMOs). The center of the bar is banana/cranberry and then the bar is dipped in chocolate. The banana and cranberries are ground up/mushed together, so there are no large pieces, and the bar is very moist and soft inside (when I think of dried banana, I think crunchy, but that is not the case). The banana/cranberry part is also flavorful, and tastes of fresh banana with a hint of tartness. The chocolate is also good and not too \\"crisp\\"/hard and not too melty and is just the right coating thickness.

One thing I love about this bar and other Seitenbacher bars is that the package contains 2 individual pieces (not one big bar). I often just want to eat 1/2 of an energy bar (or even 1/4), so having it already portioned is a huge benefit for me. I also found it to be fairly filling and satisfying, even for the 80cal 1/2 portion.

Nutrition facts: 160cal (15 from fat), 5mg sodium, 37g carbs, 3g fiber, 32g sugar, 2g protein. Not the healthiest product (depending on what you are comparing to), but it is a decent source of fiber, all natural (no preservatives) and minimally processed (cold processed). It does not contain any \\"fake fiber\\" that is becoming common in so many bars. The label says that is is a raw food and is gluten-free (but the viewpoint for my review is in comparison to all products, not just those gluten free).

I recommend this bar as a smart alternative to candy and as a nice treat (it is chocolate-covered, after all).

product_title: 3 MUSKETEERS Chocolate Candy Bars
review_headline: Never fix something that isn't broken...including candy!
review_body: I've been eating 3 Musketeer bars for over 55 years and though they have never been my favorite, they were certainly delectable.  No more!  The new \\"formula\\" has eradicated the malt nougat and replaced it with \\"more chocolate.\\"  Quite honestly, it tastes more like a bad Tootsie roll than a Musketeers.  Too bad Mars has lousy corporate judgement...I mean, do we REALLY need more chocolate?!  Frankly, I think everyone's taste-buds are selectively jaded.  I loved the creamy nougat center, and to replace it with \\"whipped chocolate\\" is selling out to marketing oversell.  I won't buy them again....ever!

review_body: These lentils are great and at a great price.  They are great to have on hand and make great leftovers.   I sauté some onion, whole black peppers, carrots, and bay leaves. Then I rinse the lentils and add in a lot of water, bring to boil, then lower temp to low- medium. Let them cook about 45 to 60 minutes total until desired doneness. Sometimes I add pepperoni or ham. Ham is especially good.  Anyways, these lentils are extremely good for you and make a filling meal.

product_title: The Peelu Co. Chewing Gum, Cinnamon Sass, 300-Count
review_headline: skip this gum, try something else
review_body: This gum is crumbly and the lackluster flavor fades faster than any gum I've ever chewed. It's gone in around 10 seconds.

product_title: Torani Sugar-Free Classic Caramel, 25.4-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Amazon is selling the regular Caramel flavor
review_body:
I usually stock up on my Torani syrups on the Torani website when they run a promotion, but I had run out of my sugar-free Caramel and was pleased to see that Amazon was carrying it. Although some of the older reviews for this product state that Amazon is carrying a different flavor of Caramel, I decided to order anyways, and Amazon is definitely back to carrying the standard SF Caramel flavor.

This is one of my favorites of the Torani syrups. I use it not only in coffee, but also in baked oatmeal with apple -- it tastes like a healthier version of a caramel apple!

Amazon also carries it in the plastic bottles, which I like so much more than the glass bottles since they're lighter and won't break if dropped.

product_title: Richardson Pastel Mints 4lbs Bag
review_body: I bought these mints and found them small and tasty, very easy to share.  Everyone came visit us likes them, young and old.

product_title: Smoked Pepper - 16 oz
review_body:
I was introduced to the Chefs Warehouse Smoked Pepper about 5 years ago, and it has brought a gourmet level of seasoning and pleasure to so many dishes I make.

How?

First: The complex aroma of the smoked pepper creates the image of smokey BBQ ribs, bacon, and chicken in my mind, strong enough to make my mouth water, each and every time I open the plastic cap. It's pure yummo!

Second: the grated pepper colors themselves - so pretty and potent.

Third: The rich, smoky, mouth watering flavor it gives to beef, pork, chicken, vegetables, potatoes, eggs, rice, and fish, that I have used it on....... so far.

Whats next? Perhaps - Chocolate covered Strawberries and Smoked Pepper, Ice Creme and Smoked Pepper, Ice Pops and Smoked pepper.

Wait a minute! Time to make dinner - Curried Chicken salad with .... you guessed it - Smoked pepper.

In short, the Chefs Warehouse Smoked Pepper is a must buy, use, and share with others too.

product_title: WuFuYuan - Tapioca Pearl (Black) - Net Wt. 8.8 Oz.
review_body: These boba pearls are great! They taste amazing and are great to put in tea's, smoothies, coffee's, or just about anything else. I bought them because I moved away from some of my favorite Thai restaurants (who sold Thai tea with boba) and I can brew my own thai tea, pop these in it and it is delicious. The only slight problem is that they take a bit longer to cook than is advertised on the packaging (which says 5-7 minutes). Just leave them boiling a few minutes longer and you'll get the right consistency. All-in-all a great purchase!

product_title: Vita Coco Coconut Water
review_body:
I only recently jumped on the coconut water bandwagon, so this is a new convert review. The [[ASIN:B000LL0R8I Vita Coco 100% Pure Coconut Water, 11.1-Ounce Containers (Pack of 12)]] is an affordable way to get my coconut water fix, thanks to the additional discount of the Subscribe & Save program. It comes out to about half the price when buying it individually in stores (at least the ones I checked).

Taste wise, I don't really have a preference between this and the Zico coconut water. This size is a better for me because once I open a bottle, I usually finish it off. So this size serves as portion control. One tetra pak is 60 calories.

But my pet peeve still remains, if it has calories and other ingredients, can we please call it something other than water? While this is coming out of a coconut so it's not as bad, I find it rather annoying that different companies make sugary drinks or drinks with sugar-substitutes and call them water. Okay, rant is over!

Overall, I like this. I usually drink it over a few ice cubes. I try to limit it to one per day, since 60 calories are 60 calories. My next experiment is to make ice cubes out of it, but I need a bigger ice cube tray!

PS: the 12pk arrives in a sturdy colorful cardboard box that can be reused/repurposed.

product_title: Celestial Perfect Iced Tea Southern Sweet Keurig K-Cups
review_body: I'm addicted to this tea. It is not to sweet I must have 2 to 4 a day. I use a 32oz cup make the tea add ice.  Cant get any easier. Great taste

product_title: Frontier Soups Hearty Meals Michigan Ski Country Chili, 15-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_headline: This is a GREAT chili mix
review_body: The instructions call for some pork but I made it without.  I made nachos with this chili and 20 partygoers raved about it.

product_title: White House Roasted Coffee, Tip of The Andes (Whole Bean), 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: This coffee is great - a full-bodied flavor and is never bitter. Don't hesitate to order. I got on the saver plan and receive it every month.

product_title: Tazo Passion Filter Bag Tea, 24-Count Packages (Pack of 6)
review_headline: A coffee substitute, and a perfect tea.
review_body: This tea is a tea that will wake you up with its bold flavor, put you to sleep with its soothing smell, and make you happy just by drinking it.  5 stars for Tazo and the great job it has done in filling the gap that has long been void.

product_title: Starbucks VIA Ready Brew Coffee
review_body: I truly love this product and always carry it with me when I travel.  My only complaint is the packaging used on the product which is sold at Costco, which contains 24 packets.  Short of a hacksaw, there's no easy way to get it open.  The product inside makes it worthwhile, but come on, guys.  You advertise it as being a 'green' product, but this package had to have used up at least one tree and some mighty tough plastic.

product_title: Green Mountain Black Tea Unsweetened Perfect Iced Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: The K cup coffees are very good, but this unsweetened tea is delicious.  It tastes like the iced tea you can only get from a fine restaurant.  I make it in a 32 ounce cup full of ice and then water it down with another 32 ounces of water.  I highly recommend this tea.

product_title: Naturally Better Spearmint Xylichew, Sugar Free Chewing Gum, 100 Piece Canister
review_headline: Good gum but you need 2 pieces
review_body: I first found this gum at Whole Foods. I wanted to find a sugarless gum that did not have Aspartame. Whole Foods carries several brands. Most of the were horrible, with the exception of Xylichew. This gum holds its flavor for several mins. Even after the flavor is gone the gum does not get hard. So, I will chew for hrs. without replacing. While my mouth enjoyed Xylichew, my pocket did not. This was the most expensive of all of the non-aspartame gums offered at Whole Foods. So, I decided to search for it on Amazon. The prices on Amazon were much better. I found a gum that I like (but you will need 2 pieces at one time given the size of 1 piece) at a price that I can tolerate.

product_title: Log Cabin All Natural Syrup, 22-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Good tasting and affordable alternative to maple syrup
review_body:
The ingredients are brown rice syrup, water , sugar, brown sugar, natural flavor, xanthan gum, citric acid. It's called \\"table syrup\\". It's not maple syrup and does not pretend to be.
At a ticket price of under 5 bucks, it's a more affordable and MOST natural product of its kind. Not everyone can afford 15 bucks for maple syrup.
My family has been using this table syrup for as long as it's been available. It tastes GREAT...almost the flavor of pure maple syrup.
What is maple syrup anyway? Sugar!

product_title: Honey Stinger Protein Bar, Peanut Butta, 1.5 Ounce (Pack of 15)
review_body:
I love Honey Stinger, the company, in principle. I love that they're Colorado based, that they use a natural product as a sweetener, and that they work hard at having good, interesting flavors. What I haven't liked so much is that so many of their products and nearly entirely carbs, which is great mid-race but doesn't work so well for the rest of my life. These half-size bars are the right profile for a snack to get me to the gym after work -- enough protein to satiate my hunger until dinner, and enough carbs to let me work out before I go home for dinner.

I also really like the flavor of the dark chocolate cherry almond. I had a couple whole cherries and whole almonds in mine, which were a fun surprise, but most of the bar is crumbly powder -- easily consumed. Not as sticky/chewy as a Power bar, not as cloying as a Pure Protein bar.

product_title: All-Bran Cereal, Original, 18.3-Ounce Boxes
review_body:
It actually does taste really good. Moreover, after exercizing, I ate about a handfull (dry) without water. Filled me up immediately, which is the important thing for me is that the fiber functions as it is supposed to. Kashi's cereals didn't cut it for me in that respect, as much as I love the idea of the protein / fiber combo that they've got out at the moment.

One person posted a lot about HCFC in this product, which is a concern for me too, but here's my perspective as someone who stays away from HCFC 99% of the time when I have a choice.

Just to point out, there's 10 grams of fiber per serving and 6 grams of sugar. That means there's only 4 grams net carbs per serving. A single serving can (12oz) of regular Coca-Cola has 39 grams of sugar. (And even that overload is 'only' 13% of one's daily carb intake, technically.) A serving of this cereal has 80 calories and only 4 grams of net carbs, plus when I just bought a box in my local store I didn't see HCFC on the label. (I looked for that specifically.)

So it is possible that Kellog's has changed the formulation on this food. I laud your principled eating, OGO et al, but for those who can't afford (or are ignorant of) alternatives to this product, it is a favorable choice above Raisin Bran, for example, or another favorite among people I know, Fiber Plus \\"Antioxidants\\" which has twice as much sugar and the same amount of fiber. All nutrition choices are individual, and peoples' needs and desires vary.

At the same time, I wholly agree that HCFC is a horrible, horrible substance. When choosing things to eat, I want to know if it's included, just the same as I want to know if Aspartame is in my drink. However, my choice to consume this product is that of an informed consumer. I opt to purchase this product (5 boxes for less than $20 is the dealbreaker for me, a huge savings compared to other similar cereals such as Kashi or my personal favorite, F-Factor Skinnys (not available on Amazon at the moment, about which I am sad!)

review_body: On the back it says \\"...added pure cane sugar for just the right amount of sweetness.\\" Uhm yeah, who is Starbucks to tell me what the perfect sweetness is? When I poured the contents, I could barely even see any coffee, it was sugar in practically a 4-to-1 ratio! I check the back, 11 grams of sugar for HALF the packet. Gross. product_title: Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup Grade B, 32-Ounce Jug
review_body:
Whoa! When reviewing this syrup, two things immediately come to mind: #1. Damn this is good syrup! #2. Damn this is expensive syrup! With about 10 servings per 32 oz. jug (on pancakes) and at $23.00 per jug, you're averaging a little better than $2.00 per breakfast -- just for the syrup! Well, I can't afford that ..... Yet here I am buying ANOTHER jug. It really is that good. Last week in an attempt to save money I purchased a 64 oz. jug of Hidden Springs Vermont Maple Syrup. It was $36.25 for a 64 oz. jug, which is vastly cheaper than Coombs Family Farms Organic Maple Syrup which is about $23.00 per 32 oz. jug; so you're looking at $46.00 per 64 oz. jug of Coombs compared to the $36.00 per 64 oz. jug of Hidden Springs Vermont. Unfortunately for us thrifty shoppers, the Hidden Springs Vermont is not in the same league as Coombs Organic, and even if I saved $25.00 per jug, I'd probably still go with Coombs -- that is an indication of just how much I love this syrup.

Quite simply, I've never had syrup as delicious as Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup Grade B. I was raised on Ms. Buttersworth and other corn syrup w/ maple flavoring brands; in fact, I didn't try real maple syrup until about 6 months ago, and now I could never go back. I've tried a few brands including Highlands Sugarworks which was good and Hidden Springs Vermont Maple Syrup which was not, yet none of them hold a candle to Coombs Family Farms 100% Pure Organic Maple Syrup.

product_title: Lavazza Crema e Gusto Ground Coffee, Italian , 8.8-Ounce Bricks
review_headline: fancy coffee shop taste and smell
review_body:
one day recently, i purchased this crema e gusto lavazza when it was on sale, because i know my friend uses lavazza in his espresso-maker, and i thought i'd break out the moka maker again. well. holy cow. i had forgotten what good coffee tasted like, based on my steady kcup habit. i can barely taste my keurig kcups now, which seem fairly bland, or too sharp, or too...something else wrong in comparison. i'll still use my keurig due to the convenience, and perhaps i'll try using lavazza in my keurig as another review mentioned. But, i think you cannot go wrong with a stove top moka of this stuff. it is not bitter, it is not sour, it has no off notes-- just extremely rich and heady, a good hefty body and smoothness that can't be beat. the outrageously excellent aroma permeates the house like a great coffee shop you might step into.

i read some of the bad reviews, and i can't understand the negative comments, just as they can't understand the good reviews--taste is individual i guess! But, i LOVE this coffee! it's extremely good, and i will even drink it late in the evening despite the caffeine, due to the wonderful flavor. crazily, i find myself looking forward to a quiet weekend morning to indulge, just like you might see on some goofy ad where a woman with closed eyes is smiling in dreamy wonder while sniffing a cup. try this coffee- maybe you'll be lucky to be in the majority for whom this rings all the bells.

update: i tried the Lavazza in the Keurig, and it just does not do it justice in comparison to the stove-top moka method. but, it still tastes better than regular k-cups.

update 2: i tried this in the Aeropress (french drip type) machine that had over 1000 great reviews here on Amazon, and i have to say, this combo will be my only go-to coffee from now on. the Aeropress, in addition to being easier to use than stove top, seems to make a less burnt flavored and more creamy brew. this, combined with condensed sweetened milk (like the Vietnam-french drip type)is heavenly. i'm buying a second Aeropress to have this combo at home in addition to the office.milk (like the Vietnam-french drip type)is heavenly. i'm buying a second Aeropress to have this combo at home in addition to the office.

Not sure what exactly causes it because I'm fine with pure almonds, sea salt (at least with the one I have at home), honey, cranberries, no known food allergies. It might be salt/nuts/cranberries combination that causes it, not sure.

product_title: Eden Organic Great Northern Beans, No Salt Added, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I cook dried beans in large batches and put them in freezer containers, but like to have cans on hand for super fast meals or for when I want smaller amounts at one time. The canned beans are a bit softer than the home cooked ones, but still retain their shape and are particularly handy for salads of all kinds.

Great Northern beans combine beautifully with pinto beans for a great soup, either as a mixed bean soup or as the protein in a rich and hearty vegetable soup....or just for a big bowl of beans for a \\"beans and greens\\" meal. We also sometimes open and drain a can and use it to top a big main course salad, along with dried cranberries and feta cheese.

The fact that they are salt free in the can means you don't have to drain and rinse them several times like you do brands of canned beans that contain salt. The little bit of kombu (seaweed) that is in the cooked beans adds a bit of iodine to your diet which can be helpful if you use pure sea salt like we do - and even more so if you don't use any salt at all.

We use several Eden organic products because of their consistent quality and BPA free can linings and have been looking for the Great Northern beans at a decent price for many months. I was delighted to find them now on Amazon. I hope they continue to be available here.

product_title: Bulk Save Wholesome Sweeteners Stevia 35 Ct 6 to 24 packs each 1.23OZ
review_body: Sure, nothing tastes quite as good as sugar, but this product is just as tasty as the other Stevia based sweeteners on the market. And unlike so many of the other sweeteners on the shelves, it won't have a negative glycemic impact. Thumbs up.

product_title: South Beach Diet Meal Bar, Chocolate Flavored, 5-Count (Pack of 8)
review_body: I purchased the South Beach Diet Meal Bar, Chocolate flavored to try out different protein bards. It only has 12g of protein which is high for regular bars, but low compared to protein bars which have around 20g of protein. I like that it has 9g of fiber which should help me feel full. The calories are only 180. I'm not sure if this bar is suppose to replace a meal. The calories are extremely low as a meal replacement, but could work if it doesn't make me feel hungry afterward. I'll have to try that. I eat the meal bars as a snack. The flavor is crunchy, and decently good tasting for a protein bar. But it could taste better. The price for these bars are quite expensive so I probably won't buy these again.

product_title: Better Oats Lavish Old Fashioned Instant Oatmeal - Dark Chocolate - 5 Pouches Per 7.75-oz. Box (Pack of 3 Boxes)
review_body:
A coworker introduced me to Better Oats by giving me a packet of their Bare oatmeal. I liked it (even plain!) and tried to find this brand in my local grocery store. Didn't find it there, but found the Lavish Chocolate here on amazon. It was the least expensive of the flavors so I thought I'd give it a try.
I love the way each oatmeal packet becomes a measuring cup for your water. Very easy to prepare. Take note: you must use a microwave. You cannot prepare by just adding boiling water.
The chocolate flavor was very pleasant. Not overly sweet and not too bitter of a dark chocolate for my children to enjoy it. The oats looked and tasted better than other instant oatmeal brands. Plus the added bonus of flax seeds. I will be keeping a box of these in my drawer at work for easy breakfasts or healthy snacks.

I finally did find these in another store locally and the price is much better than here. I hope Amazon will find a way to sell a case of 9 of these for $10. That would be a perfect subscribe and save item!

product_title: Heinz Tomato Ketchup, Reduced Sugar, Bottle, 13 oz
review_body: I bought this ketchup because I was on atkins and wanted no carbs for a couple weeks. This ketchup has less carbs than the original and taste, in my opinion, the same. I would recommend it.

product_title: Gloria Jean's Coffees, Hazelnut Coffee, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: If you like hazelnut then you will love this flavor.  Does not taste artificial to me at all.  I use the 7-8 ounce setting and I add vanilla creamer which turns it into vanilla nut.  Yummy!  It is a light roast but full of hazelnut flavor.

product_title: Simply Organic Basil Leaf, Sweet Cut & Sifted Certified Organic, 0.18-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6)
review_body: I may not be a culinary expert, but I know taste.  This basil has a more intense and better flavor than I had experienced with any other dried basil.  I highly recommend it.

product_title: Gluten Free Mama Mamas Almond Blend Flour, All Purpose Flour
review_body: Gluten Free Mama, Mamas Almond Blend flour is a great product that has made our transition to a gluten-free lifestyle much smoother. Great product, great price, would highly recommend.

product_title: SweetGourmet Nik-L-Nip Wax Bottles Candy, 16 Oz.
review_body: the candy itself was a hit. although the quality after being shipped was not. the wax bottles had melted into on another causing one big clump of wax candy....not so great

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter
review_body: I love this product, PB2 is great! I love being able to have peanut butter for a lot less calories and fat. I add it to my protein shakes and it is delicious!

product_title: PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 6.5Oz - Free Bonus PB2 Recipe Cards Included (17 Cards in Total)
review_body: PB2 has a good flavor for being powdered.I like it because it has less fat and calories and yet it has a good flavor. It is easy to use and is quite versatile.

product_title: Harmony Valley Classic Hummus, 4.2-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have tried several vegetarian sausage mixes and this one is by far the best. It is easy to use and cooks up just like real sausage would. The flavor is awesome, not too strong and not salty.  I have prepared meals with it for those who are not vegetarians and they didn't even know that it wasn't real sausage until I told them. Go ahead...try it! :)

product_title: El Yucateco Extra Hot Habanero Sauce, 4 oz.
review_body: I have tasted several types of hot sauces and regularly use peppers in my cooking, even Habaneros.  It started out with Daves Insanity.  I do not use it much any longer because even though it many be HOT, it does not have the flavor and the slow burn that this sauce has.  I ordered 8 bottles and I am giving some to my relatives that love hot and flavor.  I know they will love it and use the amount that they are use to, but may gradually become addicted.  I will order more very soon because I, and my husband are really addicted to this very flavorful product, which by the way was difficult to find in specialty \\"hot sauce\\" stores.  I discovered it in a Mexican restaurant in Sausalito, CA.; I immediately copied down every word on the label until I found it on Amazon about 3-4 months later.  Thank you, \\"restaurant\\",  for making the food even better!

product_title: Popchips 11-Flavor Variety Pack, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: *Some* flavors are great, others not so much and it's spendy
review_body: These are similar to pringles, in that they are made of reconstituted potato flakes that are then flavored.  Buttttttt they are way more expensive.  I really like about half the flavors, I sort of liked a few and a few were really bad.  All in all it was nice to get a variety, but not worth the price.

product_title: Planters Deluxe Mixed Nuts - 40 oz. container - Value pack
review_headline: Don't buy unless you want mostly almonds
review_body: I have been buying Planters Deluxe mixed nuts for years. They were always more expensive but better quality. I am going to quit buying all planters nuts. The past many times they were mostly almonds. It is going that way with all the brands now but Planters are the worst and I quit buying all their products. Why pay more when you can buy something better cheaper. I say avoid all planters products you cannot see from the outside before you buy them and do not buy any you cannot see like on this site.

product_title: Bays, English Muffins, 6 ct, 12 oz
review_body: Absolutely the best english muffin out there.  They come in 3 different flavors...I especially like the sourdough version.  Can't find them in most supermarkets in NY  but Walgeern's usually carries them in their refrigerated food section....we buy them in Florids at Publix.  Love them...every day

product_title: Alpine Spiced Cider Original Apple Flavor Drink Mix , 60 Packets of 0.74-Ounce
review_body:
I've been buying this cider for awhile now and I have to say, it's really good. I went out looking for a better cider, so I ordered the Mott's Cider variety pack here on Amazon. After having the Mott's, I have to say, it wasn't a hard decision to come back to Alpine.

If you're interested, Alpine makes this cider in a non-sugar formula, but I haven't tried it since I'd rather have a natural sweetener. These packets are 80 calories per serving.

If you're interested in the Mott's, I wrote a review so you can check that out, but basically all I said was this. Alpine is stronger per packet and has better flavor. Mott's has an interesting variety of flavors, but truly, all I want is a good cider, so the Alpine is a much better fit for me. Oh yeah, Mott's also uses corn syrup solids in their cider.

If you want to flavor your cider, you can look in the coffee isle at your grocery store for the syrups used to flavor coffee. You can pick up a bottle of caramel flavoring for a couple dollars and it mixes really well in the cider. The ones I've seen are cane sugar based so they'll also sweeten up your drink a bit more too.

product_title: New Grains Gluten Free Sugar Cookie with Frosting & Sprinkles
review_body: I was pretty amazed by the taste and quality of this cookie.  It stayed fresh for a long period, which only happened because it had fallen behind something.  My kids loved them and they are known for being very forthright with their opinions.  Thx for making a great product.

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Green, 1-Count
review_headline: Perfect! Exactly what I was looking for!
review_body: We have a Keurig in my office and, though I made coffee on it regularly, always felt guilty about the excessive waste. The Ekobrew works just as well as a K-Cup (with a little more labor, of course) without the waste. Fairly easy to clean and I can use my preferred coffee, not whatever K-Cups we happen to have in the office. The only thing -- be sure to follow instructions! In particular, use professionally ground coffee. The first time I tried it I ground my coffee at home. It was too fine so the water didn't go through. Using professionally ground coffee for a drip brewer works great (just as the instructions say). If you have a Keurig, care about the environment and/or want to save money, buy this product!

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 3-Count
review_body: This ekobrew is the best one out there. I find that it is alittle larger than the rest and it has many outs for the coffee to come through evenly. Thank you .

product_title: Roland Sun-Dried Tomatoes
review_body: I had been unhappy with the expensive sundried tomatoes in the market. I took a chance with this product.  They are delicious!!!  So easy to store. And a great source of the antioxidant lycopene!!  I will order them again. VERY happy w/ quality and price.

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Dark Whole Bean Coffee, 5 Pound
review_body: This is definitely a great coffee for a great price.  The roast is still a bit on the dark side for me.  Can anyone suggest a nice light roast coffee?

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: When I saw this item on Amazon I knew that I had to get me some.  You see, I am lactose intolerant and am always looking to try rare milk brands to see if they make my intolerance tolerable.  I took one sip of this Tuscan Whole Mile, 1 Gallon, 128 fl oz and felt the silkiness slide down my throat, WOW. product_title: Mason Dots Tropical Flavor, 2.25-Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: My husband is addicted to gummy-type candies but is extremely particular. product_title: Lindt Swiss Premium Milk Chocolate
review_body:
This is my daughter's favorite. Lindt chocolate is one of the best I know on the market. But: this time I want to review also this shipper. This shipper deserves 10 stars!
The chocolate was shipped on days with extremely high temperatures and I was worried in what shape it's going arrive to. When I opened the cooler, the contain was still very cold! I could not be impressed more. And all that effort for value of $30 merchandise with the free shipping!!!! WOW!!!

product_title: See's Candies 1 lb. Truffles
review_body: My daughter moved to a new home in Washington state from San Diego, California. The grandkids loved the housewarming gift.

product_title: Barefoot Contessa Chocolate Chunk Blondie Mix, 19-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_body: Chunky and chewy- great texture!  This is surely not your everyday brownie mix. The Contessa did not disappoint! Ina Garten, this is one household that will always love you!

product_title: Bigelow Raspberry Royale Black Tea, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I drink this tea alot in cooler weather, which doesn't happen that often in Central Texas!  I was down to my last tea bag and couldn't find the product anywhere...except at Amazon of course!  Great buy.

product_title: Annie Chun's Roasted Seaweed Snacks
review_body: It is tasty but takes getting used to. I like the flavor and the spice but I cannot eat more than about 5 at a time so it will last a while. There are a lot of chips in a package.

product_title: Funky Monkey Snacks MangOJ, Mango with Orange Juice, Freeze-Dried Fruit, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

product_title: JIF Peanut Butter Creamy 40 oz Jar
review_body:
I love JIF Peanut Butter, especially since it's one of my favorite peanut butters that I grew up with during my childhood years since I used to use it a lot for peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.

As a matter of fact, JIF is my 2nd favorite peanut butter in the whole wide world, but PETER PAN is my favorite in the whole wide world, but when I can't find PETER PAN in a 28 OZ or 40 OZ size jar, I end up buying JIF in that size as a 2nd alternative, especially since I can never find PETER PAN in a 28 Ounce or 40 Ounce size at the stores anymore and only carry PETER PAN in the 16 OZ size for some reason which is perhaps due to PETER PAN being outsold by JIF and SKIPPY since I can always find SKIPPY and JIF in a 28 OZ or 40 OZ size at most grocery stores.

Additionally, I find it hard to understand why Amazon sells JIF and SKIPPY in a 40 OZ sized jar individually and wont sell PETER PAN in a 40 OZ size individually, plus it baffles me why Amazon charges you $12 bucks to buy this size product online to buy one 40 Ounce jar of JIF when you can buy it at the grocery store or a retail store in this exact same size for under $8 or $9 bucks too.

product_title: Grove Square Cappuccino, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: I was really disappointed with this instant coffee. YES. Instant coffee. They should have added stronger coffee and less creamer/sugar. Too mild and sweet for me.

product_title: Kefir Grains - Living Probiotic Enriched "As seen on TV"
review_body: I love kefir - and these grains (which arrived within a few days of my order) produce delicious kefir. The initial batch took a couple of days to culture, but after a few weeks, they grew to produce one to two glasses per day (depending on desired strength). Yummy!

product_title: Yogi Teas St. John's Wort Blues Away, 16 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: The ingredients are fresh and wholesome.  However, the taste is in my opinion, bland.  It is effective but you must be consistent in its use.  Use it daily and be patient.  After several weeks,  you will notice that you are feeling much better.  I have to brew it with another flavor of the Yogi tea because I do not like the taste.  It does not taste nasty, just very bland.  The results are worth it.

product_title: OKONATUR 100% Extra Virgin Red Palm Oil - 16 Fl Oz
review_body: red palm oil is healthy. it's loaded with vitamin E, along with other nutrients. other healthy oils are: coconut oil, sesame oil, flaxseed oil, hemp oil, nuts, seeds, and some others.

product_title: Eat. Think. Smile. Baked Nutrition Bar, Oatmeal Raisin, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: 25% of Your Daily Fiber in a Healthy Snack
review_body: Containing about 25% of the recommended daily intake of fiber, these bars are a fairly tasty way of obtaining it. However, don't expect an oatmeal raisin cookie type snack or a Larabar type snack either. It's dryer (meaning less fat/oil) than many snacks. It's also baked so it doesn't come across as a raw product either. The taste is pleasant and a bit more complex especially with the cocoa powder than many snacks. Finally, it's not an addictive snack which is good in that you won't be tempted to finish a box of these in three days. More health food than candy.

product_title: Peter Rabbit Organics Pouches (Pack of 10)
review_body: We've tried all of the Peter Rabbit food pouches, and the Pea, Spinach, and Apple Puree was very runny.  Almost the consistency of soup.  Will continue to buy other favors, but not this one.

product_title: Jacob's Cream Crackers, 7.05 Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: Jacobs is the best cracker in the world,but the way they were packed by Amazon totally messed up my enjoyment of them.All 6 packs were crushed,some more than others,but even the least damaged had about a third broken crackers.Will not be buying these again from Amazon.Will have to find another source.

product_title: Maxi/Tuna Fish Crackers, 8.7 Ounce
review_body: I needed a way to get my pictures on my iPad from my camera efficiently and this tool did the trick.However,  I have not used it in any other way, just with the sd card.

review_body: Perfect assortment of flavored coffee. I was able to try a variety of new flavors without having to commit to an entire box. Shipping was super fast and I will likely buy again.

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Organic Herbal Power, 17.6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This tea is good for the liver and cleanses your system. I love and support this brand because their teas are USDA organic and the packaging explains all you need to know about the tea and its healing properties. This tea, in particular, is one of my favorite. You may find the nutty, smokey taste off-putting at first but you will get used to it after a few days. I can honestly say I now enjoy the flavor.

product_title: Sahale Snacks Variety Pack, 3 Flavors, 2 each, 4 to 5-Ounce Pouch (Pack of 6)
review_body: So far we have mainly enjoyed the pecan version of the snacks but there are also delicious varieties with cashews, almonds, and pistachios.  All have high quality nuts combined with fruit bits such as dried cranberries plus black pepper and/or other spices to add a touch of zing.  All in all these snacks are both delicious and healthy and a new favorite.

product_title: Barr's Irn-Bru
review_body: People argue about what Irn-Bru tastes like...I am just thankful that it has caffiene in it and when I am sipping it I can at least imagine that my dreams to fly to Glasgow have come true.

product_title: Hodgson Mill Organic Naturally White Flour, Unbleached All-Purpose, 2-Pounds (Pack of 6)
review_body: Not only does this flour have the advantage of being organic (which is of questionable significance) but it has made my pizza dough and waffle batter much better than with previous flours. I am not sure if it justifies the high cost and I am not sure I will continue to use this flour due to the cost, but for now I am enjoying the benefits.

product_title: Breezy Morning Tea, Sassafrass, 20-Count
review_body: I did not care for this product at all, I thought it was the same tea my sisters and I use to drink when we were in elementary school. I found out the tea we use to drink actually came from the root of a particular type of tree.

product_title: Ito En Tea Beverage
review_body: I was skeptical about trying this product as I usually don't like bottled tea products. I was pleasantly surprised at how well this product tasted. I am an avid jasmine green tea drinker and found this product a refreshing alternative to freshly brewed tea. I love the aroma and taste of this item and that no sugar or artificial sweeteners have been added to it. Best of all this product is great refrigerated to enjoy on hot days!

product_title: Romantic Gift Basket, Valentine Gift Basket For Him by Gift Basket Village
review_body: I ordered this for my husband for Valentine's Day.  The picture and description on Amazon's website made it appear to be a large, loaded gift basket.  This is so not the case!  One basket was used just to make it appear larger, there wasn't anything in it!  The other items were stacked around the edge of it and on the smaller basket on top.  The roses are small and cheap looking.  The candy, what there is of it, is not all that great and brands that I have never heard of!  The coffee packet made terrible coffee that I dumped out.  I would not recommend this gift basket and will never order from them again.  The basket was probably worth about  $19.95 at most.  Definitely a rip off!!

product_title: Quaker Chewy Oatmeal To Go
review_headline: Great on the go breakfast option
review_body: I have ordered these for a while now. They are continue to be a favorite in our house when we don't have time to make breakfast (or out of bread again!).

product_title: Glutino Cookies & Wafers

product_title: Santa, Snowman or Penguin Christmas Holiday Gift Towers
review_body: The tower was what I wanted for family gifts.  Didn't get to view the contents but I am sure they were OK

product_title: Country Harvest Bulk Yellow Popcorn Bag
review_body: Only popped a couple pounds but seemed ok with some unpopped that is normal to me. We have a 6 oz paramount machine that i love to use for popping.

product_title: Lawry's Perfect Blend Chicken Rub And Seasoning, 24.5 oz
review_headline: looking for pork seasoning by lawry
review_body: I was looking for a pork seasoning by Lawry that I bought a while back and my family loved it. Since you didn't seem to have it, I tried the chicken. Not the same.

product_title: iCafe Iced French Vanilla Coffee (30 Pack)
review_body: I had been looking for canned iced coffee and came across this product so I decided to give it a try.  Glad I did.  It's affordable and tastes great. My wife uses it in her meal replacement shakes.  I will definitely be ordering again.

product_title: Kirkland Signature Dried Natural Cherries 20 Ounce
review_body:
Dried cherries were always a luxury for me. They were expensive at my local food store. Then I found the Kirkland Signature Dried Cherries at Amazon and they became reasonable. 20 oz in. Resealable bag, closed the deal for me.

I found a delicious recipe for a salad. Fresh greens from the garden, pistachio nuts, dried cherries and ble cheese. Highly Recommended. prisrob 07-08-12
