product_title: KIND Fruit & Nut, Macadamia & Apricot, All Natural, Gluten Free Bars, 12 Count
review_body: This was the first time I had tried Kind Bars and thought the Macadamia and Apricot would be a good one from the reviews. I liked them ok but I didn't find them amazing. I also didn't like that they have soy lecithin in them. I will stick with Larabar.

product_title: Duerrs 1881 Marmalade - 16oz
review_body: Proper marmalade the way it used to be - this it the type of preserves you'd make yourself if you had access to bitter oranges and about 6 hours' time. Not too cloyingly sweet like most American marmalade, and not bitter, just right, with interesting shreds of orange in it. Bliss spread on thick handmade Italian bread with fresh sweet butter, but also a good glaze for a pork roast, dabbed on wholegrain crackers with goat cheese, and a superb addition to cranberries in a cranberry-orange relish. (And a secret ingredient in Cosmos- use 1/4 teaspoon!)

product_title: Stash Powdered Green Iced Teas, 12-Count Packets (Pack of 6)
review_headline: lightly sweetened green iced tea powder
review_body: i have never liked green tea but i knew it was good for me so i have been drinking it for a lot of yrs. i grew up living in the western usa and our neighbors were japanese. they were sweet and gave us tea from japan. my father enjoyed it every morning and added a tablespoon of honey and a little cream to it. he smoked all his life and died at 92. anyway, i found when at times i would quit drinking it i wouldn't feel as good as i did when drinking it. i got tired of boiling the water with the teabags and then getting everything in a container to put into the frig. i really drank a lot of it.  well, i stumbled onto a warehouse to pick up some things i had ordered and noticed this tea. i was immediately interested as you get to drink the whole tea leaf which gives you 10 times more antioxidants. wow, that was good for me so i got a couple cases and when i ran out searched the internet for stash brand. i really love it. i love that it is LIGHTLY SWEETENED, i love that i can just open a packet and throw it into my tumbler, add ice and water and be on my way. it's just right. but more then anything else i love the way it makes me feel. so much more energy and i truly believe it is helping my well being. no getting around about it i don't get sick often for sure. now i haven't tried the other brands and i feel i don't have to because i am so satisfied with this one. the price is also cheaper. i don't think you can go wrong with this choice.  perky

product_title: Champion Raisels Sour Orange Raisins (1.25-Ounces), 6-Count Mini Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a really good product- less sugar than some dried fruit, less sugar than and fake flavors than most candy, and my kids love them. However, I was sent only ONE package of 6 little boxes, not twelve packages as the description reads, for $20! That price is shocking. I was refunded, but now have no source for this item.

product_title: Nescafé Taster's Choice Instant Coffee
review_headline: Got more expensive with each subsequent order
review_body: My favorite coffee but VERY expensive since company decided to package it in little inconvenient sticks (need at least 3 sticks/8 oz cup of relatively weak coffee) vs. the discontinued 8 oz jars. Amazon was cheapest way to buy in the past but price kept going up with each reorder. Cheaper now to just get at a local chain store.

product_title: Monkey Brains Granola Bar, Peanut-butter Banana, 6.2-Ounce
review_body: These are tastey. I purchased at a grocery store on sale. I disagree with some other reviewers about the strong peanut butter flavor. There are other bars out there that have a stronger peanut butter flavor. These are good. They are good for digestion, decent for breakfast, and not a bad treat. I would ask that they increase the amount of protein to make them a better product for me.

product_title: Traverse Bay Fruit Co. Dried Cranberries, 4-Pound Box
review_body: Just got my box and ate a handful of berries.  They are good, but definitely have a \\"left in plastic bag for long periods of time\\" taste.

product_title: Cheez-It Baked Snack Crackers, Parmesan & Garlic, 13.7-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: Parmesan & Garlic are the best Cheez It's! My local Wal-Mart has not been carrying Parmesan & Garlic Cheez-It's lately... boo them.

product_title: Metromint Water, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Sweet, heatlhy drink. Not at all artificial. Can't get enough!
review_body: I found this water for the first time at the Philadelphia Airport and bought a bottle for a long flight across the country. As soon as I tried it I wished I had bought a few! product_title: Golden Valley Natural Organic Beef Jerky
review_headline: be aware: they downgraded when they changed packaging :(
review_body:
Sadly, this is no longer the super-premium jerky that it used to be. Granted, if you're used to grocery-store jerky, then this is still a much better product. But if you've acclimated to chemical-free jerky, then the \\"smoke flavoring\\" that they've recently started adding tastes like, well, smoke flavoring, and not the real thing.

You may not notice a difference. Apparently jerky is one of those things where you notice a down-shift in flavor, even when you wouldn't notice an up-shift in flavor. (Like margarine eaters think butter tastes fine, and powdered milk drinkers think cartoned milk tastes fine, but when people do the opposite, they find the tastes terrible. Jerky is the same--if you upgrade from convenience store jerky to premium you might not notice it, but when you downgrade from \\"the real thing\\" to anything else, it tastes distinctly artificial.)

I used to buy this in bulk every few months (with a discount per Amazon Subscribe & Save), but the change in flavor made me double-check the ingredients list, and I found that the new \\"smoke flavoring\\" was added when they changed packaging. So this jerky is good, but not worth the premium any more. If anyone has a suggestion for an all-natural replacement without ingredients like \\"smoke flavoring\\" I'd appreciate it, since I'm now searching for something new.

But I had a chance to try this at my office today as someone had bought this and kept it in the break room to try. I was pleasantly surprised by the rich Cardamom chai taste. If you ask me it tastes like \\"Masala Chai\\" you get in Indian Restaurants. I thought I would share this with fellow Amazon shoppers.

Generally my wife makes this at home sometimes, But it requires her to heat regular [[ASIN:B002YJ6K2M Lipton Tea Bags]] in Microwave with little bit of Milk, crushed cardamom with little bit of clove and some other secret ingredients that she does not disclose :-). After that she needs to drain the tea using a filter so that Cardamom pieces and other ingredients are not present in the cup and by the time all this fiasco ends the time taken would generally be 10-15 mins. Yep! I must admit that it does taste good when she makes as she uses very \\"fresh ingredients\\" to make it. But it happens rarely at home due to the time it takes to prepare it.

Overall, what I am trying to say is it takes considerable amount of effort to make good tasting Cardamom Chai at home. But this product was \\"pleasantly refreshing\\" and took less than 30 secs to make.

All I did was opened the packet, poured the contents of one bag into my tea cup, poured hot water and stirred it with the plastic stirrer! that's it! No need to add sugar or milk and the blend is just perfect tasting Cardamom Masala Chai. Not too spicy not too sweet. Just right.

Looking at the ingredients it says \\" All Natural \\" and I am still alive.. and typing this review... so it is all good :-)

Hope this proves useful to others.

review_headline: As good as you will find anywhere
review_body: The Roland oil cured olives are quite good. They are as good as any oil cured olives that I have made. It is actually pretty easy if you live in a place where olives grow. The term 'oil cured olives' is a bit of a misnomer. This type of olive is actually salt cured not oil cured. First very ripe black olives are picked from the tree, washed and towel dried. They are then packed in a crock in thin layers with kosher salt between each layer. After a few weeks the salt draws all the water out of the olives leaving then looking like small prunes. The next step is to wash the olives very thoroughly to remove most of the salt. Then they are dried with a towel to remove any water. Next place the olives in a bowl and mix with enough good olive oil to coat the olives. They are now ready to eat. They can be kept in the refigerator for many month. So as you can see oil cured olives are actually salt cured. The olive oil is absolutely not a curing agent. It is added to make the olives more palatable. This may explain why, so called 'oil cured olives' are a bit salty for some tastes. As many reviewers have mentinoned the Roland olives can be rinsed, dried with a towel then re-oiled with olive oil. This will produce an olive with much less salt. I frankly think that the Roland oilves aren't too salty and they are a good value when compared to grocery store oil cured olives.

product_title: Petite French Green Lentils
review_body:
If you love the taste of lentils, then you'll probably love these lentils, which are more similar to the French Puy lentils than what you'd find in the supermarket. The great thing about these lentils is that they don't take hours to cook, and you pretty much can't over cook them into a gooey paste, even served as a leftover a day later these tough little lentils hold up their shape. If you like mushy lentils you might be turned off by these lentils which sort of have the consistency of al dente pasta.

I am still trying to perfect a recipe as not everything goes well with these lentils like the brown ones. I would recommend sauteing a yellow onion in four table spoons of olive oil for about 8 minutes, adding a couple minced cloves of garlic and simmering the lentils and water for about 30 to 45 minutes. It is important to add the recommend amount of water as if it is too runny then your lentils aren't covered in the delicious sauce and taste slightly bland. Add too many ingredients and you lose the essence of these lentils. They do go well with fish.

I believe they would be a much better application for this mix as the bread seems cakey all by itself. The dough is very messy to work worth but par for the course in the GF world. For bread and pizza crusts, I think I will use some of the more expensive and less sweet mixes that are available. I am going with 4 stars as this product does make good but very sweet products.

Now that I've had a few desserts made with this mix I thought I would add an update. So far, I think sugar cookies are the best application for this mix. They have been well enjoyed by all the celiacs and glutenatious people I know. They are slightly cakier than a normal sugar cookie but I don't really find that to be an issue. So for products that are normally sweet any way, this is a good mix. For regular breads and pizza crusts, I still don't love it.

product_title: Emerald Nuts Dry Roasted Almonds
review_body:
BOTTOM LINE:
These things are gross and taste like dirty hot dogs, smokey salt, or dry roasted chemical cleaner - or maybe a combination of those three flavors.

USES:
These are so gross that I think the only thing they are good for is giving to people you don't like.

TRY INSTEAD:
I bought these because I love Emeralds other flavors: [[ASIN:B006J7GJQW EMERALD CINNAMON ROAST ALMONDS 11oz 3pack]] and [[ASIN:B001EQ55RW Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4)]]. After a few bites of these, I threw out the nearly whole canister (also after giving a few to my girlfriend for laughs).

product_title: TABASCO Pepper Sauce - 64 Oz. - 1/2 Gallon
review_body: I got this, this delicious amazing sauce, within three days, which is incredibly fast, considering it's not available for Amazon Prime. Not only that, but included in the order was a complimentary jar of spicy mayonnaise, to try and see if I liked it, and a nice little booklet showing all the different Tabasco products.  It's definitely worth the money to buy, as it's impossible to find anything other than the little jar in grocery stores, and I can blaze through that sauce in a little over a week, depending.

product_title: Beneprotein 8-Ounce Canisters (Case of 6)
review_body:
I tasted literally dozens of protein powders before and after weight loss surgery. This is the only one I can tolerate. It has virtually no flavor. It contains no artificial sweeteners or flavorings.

I use it to make an iced coffee every day. I mix with room temperature plain brewed black coffee and add a splash of cream and ice. It mixes easily with cool liquid. On trips I use a shaker with cold water and instant coffee.

product_title: Krusteaz No Knead Honey Wheat Artisan Bread Mix, 14-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Quick develery time the bread mix is good. This my second order from this company. Like I said good del. time like the next day.

product_title: WHOPPERS Easter ROBIN EGGS Candy (Malted Milk Candy in a Crunchy Shell), 10 Ounce Bag (Pack of 8)
review_body: These were of course delicious.  There were so many though that it was a little more than I expected to recieve.  So I filled my apothecary jars with them and they have been a delightful treat while being pretty to look at as well.  Fast delivery and the candy wasn't near its pull date.  Completely satisfied.

product_title: MIO Liquid Peach Tea, 1.62-Ounce, (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Not the Best Mio Flavor, but Not Bad Either
review_body:
I adore Mio. I have tried ALL the flavors that they have out. This flavor was the last one that I tried since I am not a huge peach fan. I decided to give it a shot anyhow because I do like tea and they had it in Vine.

I can no longer have sugar due to health issues and Mio makes it a lot easier for me to drink water (I actually love plain water, but sometimes you just need/want some flavor). I love that it is so portable and you can mix it in ANY amount of liquid (whether you have a 20oz bottle of water or a gallon) and in any container (bottles, cups, gallon jugs, pitchers, etc.). You can also decide how much to add. If you like it strong and sweet, just add more Mio. If you want your flavor faint, then add only a tiny bit. It is easy, delicious and it doesn't have carbs or sugar. The only bad thing I can say about Mio is that there is a lot of coloring and it can stain your clothes or desk. I do wish it had less coloring.

On to the flavor, I was pleasantly surprised that the peach flavor was not overpowering. I am still not quite sure if this tastes like flavored tea, but it is nice and refreshing. While this is not my favorite flavor, it is pretty good. If you are a huge peach fan then you will probably love it. I personally will not buy this flavor again, but that is just because I like other flavors better. I am going to stick with my favorite flavors ([[ASIN:B005VOOQGO MIO Orange Tangerine, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)]] and [[ASIN:B004E4FUGW MIO Berry Pomegranate, 1.6-Ounce (Pack of 4)]] and [[ASIN:B005VOOQKA MIO Black Cherry, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)]]).

product_title: Frontier Chamomile Flowers, German Whole (double Cleaned), 16 Ounce Bag
review_body: I love this tea, I drink it all the time.  I often throw it in with other teas as well, like green tea or davidsons spring fruit and flowers.  My only reason for 4 stars is that there are a lot of smaller shavings of some sort, i guess leaves or petals, don't know what it actually is.  There is a good amount of it mixed in with the tea. But you get a ton of tea so not a big deal.  Still would recommend it.

product_title: Landjager by Bavaria
review_body:
I love these. That is the easiest way to put it. I purchased these because they have always looked so delicious. The only complaint I might have, is that these couldn't last. Everyone in the house ate them right out from under me.

I would purchase more, but the one thing that has stopped me from doing so is that the shipping price is quite simply put, outrageous. Maybe the next time I have a bunch of extra cash I'll pick up another batch, and hide them very well.

product_title: Taragui Yerba Mate Loose Leaf with Stems, Red Pack, 500-Gram Packages (Pack of 10)
review_body:
The mate is delicious and the price is great for the amount of product you get. First time I've tried this brand. I was not sure what to expect. I was not disappointed!

The other brand of mate I have tried is Rosamonte. This mate might actually be a little better than Rosamonte so I am quite pleased. I was afraid the cheaper price might mean inferior mate.

The shipping, however, left something to be desired. I chose the super saver shipping and regretted it. I placed my order on May 5 and just now got it on May 14. It was within the time specified by Amazon at the time of the order but usually items arrive well before the latest shipping date specified (Usually within a few days of ordering).

If you order this item, do not take the free shipping unless you don't mind waiting at least a week. I know the shipping has nothing to do with the quality of the product so I'm not taking anything away from my star rating for the shipping. I just want customers to be aware. I would have just paid for the faster shipping had I known it really would be towards the end of the estimated time period before I received my stuff.

product_title: Wisdom of the Ancients Pau d' Arco ancient rainforest treasure Herbal Tea,1.77 oz - 25-Count Teabags (Pack of 4)
review_body: I purchased 4 of these boxes at a time as this is one of the best brands for this tonification herb and it is light and theraputic to drink both hot or cold.  I ordered 4 boxes at a time, but was disappointed that the tea dust was everywhere.  The tea bags are not sealed very well and the tea falls out before and while in the water leaving very dusty counters and dirty water.  Other than that price and shipping were great.

product_title: Wonderful Pistachios, No-Shell, Roasted & Salted 24 Ounce
review_body: I thought this product would be good as I am tired of shelling the nut, but I threw away half of this bag.  Maybe it was just the bag I got but it was over roasted and bitter.

product_title: Nuvia Healthy Gourmet Instant Coffee, Dairy Free, Lactose Free, No GMOs, No Salt, Soy Free, Vegan, with Organic Ganoderma, Pomegranate and African Mango Extracts, Premium Appetite Suppressant
review_body:

product_title: Bellino Panettone, 2-Pound (Pack of 2)
review_body: Similar to what someone else said, I only received one Panettone.  It is advertised as a \\"Pack of 2\\" but I only received one box with one bread.  It was tasty and I made awesome french toast with it on Christmas day, but the price paid was not worth it.

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: I received 1 to try out and wasn't to sure what to expect. they are delicious i have to say, will definatly be buying more

product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_headline: San Francisco Bay Coffee ( Eco Friendly)
review_body: This is a very innovative idea no cup just the exposed pod.  This product fits perfectly in the Krieg, it did arrive in a plane Box with Three individual bags with vents, and after opening I placed the remaining pods in a zipper bag to preserve the freshness.  I do go through them very quickly, I don't really have to worry about them going stale.  For the price of this it is totally acceptable.  Its a Dark smooth roast, I'd call this a Medium roast very good even at the largest setting, not watered down.  I will recommend this to my friends.  Great product & good Price.  A new Favorite of mine I will defiantly reorder.

product_title: Equal Zero Calorie Sweetener
review_body: This is a great product. I buy this on a regular basis. I would definitely buy this from Amazon again. It was a great value for the money.

product_title: Oskri Sesame Bars with Date Syrup, Gluten Free, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 18)
review_headline: Bye Bye, OSKRI. You have issues.
review_body: I've ordered probably 15-20 cases of this product in the past year. I just cancelled my susbscription. What started out as an awesome product has turned into stale, sticky bars that taste like mold. The mold I am sure is a by-product of the inferior packaging which does not seal properly and is causing moisture to get in and start the sprouting process on the sesame seeds. A fantastic way to get really sick. The reason I know it's the packaging is because they briefly tried out a foil wrapper instead of their typical cellophane wrapper. The foil delivered crisp, magical, sweet, yummy bars. The cellophane wrappers which they stupidly went back to, delivered to my doorstep today and they're back to tasting like moldy dirt bars. Really gross. I've sent two emails directly to Oskri and have not received a response from either one. Poor customer service and inconsistent product quality has me running for the hills. I'm on the search for a new allergen-free bar that I can fall in love with.

product_title: Bakery on Main Fiber Power Gluten Free Granola, 12-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: I was thankful when Bakery on Main came out with this product, as it is so difficult to find tasty, high fiber GF cereals/granolas.  I like the cinnamon taste and enjoy eating it on top of yogurt. It's nice and crunchy, too.

product_title: Shake N Bake Pork Pouch, 2.25-Ounce (Pack of12)
review_body: I have been using Shake `n Bake with my chicken for year but never thought to use it with pork chops until they released the Original Pork flavor.  This product is as easy to use as their other products: pour the Shake `n Bake into a sealable bag: put the pork chops individual, shake and then put them in the oven.  The package says it can be used from four to six pork chops and after using it with four I would not be surprised if I could have been able to coat four more pork chops with one package.  The taste is so similar to the chicken version there were some bites when I forgot I was eating pork chops and was eating chicken with Shake `n Bake on it.  Much like the chicken version, the breading can fall off while cutting, but that is really the only negative I can say about the product.

product_title: Hot-Kid Toddler Mum-Mum Rice Biscuits
review_body: I was greatly disappointed when my grocery store quit carrying mum-mums! So I was happy to find them on Amazon cheaper than I was paying in the grocery store. My daughter loved the regular mum-mums when she was younger and now loves the toddler ones. She is 16 months now and still loves these. They are great to bring into a store to keep her occupied because they do NOT make a mess like a cracker does! I've had to explain to a TON of people that I am NOT feeding my child styrofoam (b/c that's what they look like!!!).

product_title: P.A.N Harina Blanca - Pre-cooked White Corn Meal 2lbs 3.3oz
review_body: Easy to use and cook with.  This is my second sack and I will be buying more as the need arises since I can't get it locally.

product_title: Circa Desserts Creme Brule' Dessert Mix, 9-Ounce
review_body: This dessert was delicious and luckily I have a torch so I could control the caramelizing.  I did not use a sieve and didn't think it needed it.  The custard was very smooth and tasted like restaurant creme brulees.  We couldn't wait to eat them so only waited 3 hours.  I would definitely wait 4 for firmer custard.  I think this dessert should be marketed to food-ies or in cooking catalogs since the torch is pretty essential.  I liked it a lot.

product_title: Consul Crab Meat, 6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body:
When I read the reviews for this product, I originally thought people were just being too picky, but I see now that I should have stayed away from this \\"crab meat\\" When it arrived, it was more like grated up crab mush with the taste having no resemblance to crab. It improved a bit when cooked, but it has SO MUCH shell grit in it that I can't enjoy my meal. I bought this product to save money because the price compared to local supermarkets was great, but I now see I really REALLY got what I paid for. Cheap!

product_title: Marmite Yeast Extract (1 x 4.4 OZ)
review_body: As an American, I don't ever see this kind of product at home. I received a small jar of Marmite and was apprehensive about the flavor. product_title: Stretch Island Original Fruit Leather, Grape, 0.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 30)

product_title: PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter and PB2 Powdered Cocoa Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 16 Oz Each - 2 Pack - Free Bonus PB2 Recipe Cards Included (17 Cards in Total)

product_title: Upper Crust Enterprises, Panko (Japanese Style Bread Crumb), 24-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I've gone through many different brands of Panko (we use bread crumbs often in my household) and I am happy to have finally found the perfect one. The results I have had with this particular brand have been nothing short of satisfying in regards to flavor, texture, presentation, and aside from those things...their customer service is GREAT and the panko comes in a sturdy resealable bag. You can mix the panko with italian herbs when making things like chicken parmesan, coconut flakes to make coconut shrimp, paprika to add kick on onion rings, sprinkle on top of mac & cheese, use your imagination. They also have batters available at their site which are just as great. I am well on my way to being a loyal and repeat customer. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

product_title: Ostrim Flavor Snack Sticks, 1.05 Pound
review_body: Delivery was on time but when I opened the product it was like the shelf life expired.  They were hard and chewy. I contacted the manufactur and they sent out a new box. I will be ordering direct from now on.

product_title: Lipton Tea and Honey Iced Tea Mix
review_headline: Best Iced Tea I've Ever Tasted
review_body: We love this delicious tea.  The addition of the mango and pineapple flavors adds to the terrific taste.  And just 5 calories...WOW! Iced is refreshing, and my husband likes to drink it hot.  I have shared this with friends, and recently we had some workmen at the house. It was a hot day and I gave them tall glasses of this tea with ice.  It was enjoyed by all!  Would recommend this product to everyone who likes iced tea.

product_title: Simply Orange® Twin Pack - 2/59oz Bottles
review_body:
I happened to pick this up in the grocery store several years ago on a whim since I was trying to add more fruits and vegetables to my family's diet. I had not been a big fan of orange juice due to the pulp, but this was pulp free and I thought it worth a try. That was a long time ago and I now regularly purchase this and it's WONDERFUL!

The acidity of any orange juice means that I don't drink it when I first get up in the morning, but I do drink it mid-morning after working out or in the middle of the afternoon for a pick-me-up. All natural, and full of vitamins, it has been a great addition to my diet.

Due to price, last week I decided to try another brand (larger amount of juice for the same price) and it turned out in the end to be very expensive. I drank half of a small glass of the other brand before pouring the entire container down the drain. I couldn't even force myself to drink it after getting spoiled with Simply Orange.

If you typically don't like orange juice and have avoided it in the past, you might want to give this a try -- it converted me into a regular o.j. drinker.

product_title: Eden Organic Green Lentils, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
All the labeling says - green Lentils... but lentils inside the box are brown in color --- and I am not colorblind.

I was after the green lentils because green lentils contain is more nutritious (more than 3-to-1) than brown and red lentils.

product_title: Ethical Coffee Company Espresso, Cremoso for Nespresso Capsule Brewers, 10-Count (Pack of 5)
review_headline: Too expensive for second-rate nespresso capsules
review_body:
You know, I was the person who recommended these capsules on the deal sites when they were half the price they are now. At $25, this is a COMPLETE rip-off. Basically you get like a 10% savings for a far inferior product to Nespresso's own capsules. Yes, these are biodegradable but you can bring Nespresso capsules in to have them recycled too. And ANY flavor of Nespresso tastes better than these; Cremoso is a very weak. I would only really use it for lattes, and of course you would need at least two shots to taste anything resembling espresso.

I do not work for Nespresso. I wanted to get this out of the way because I myself was suspicious about the poor reviews of this product at first. As mentioned I recommended this product on sites like Fatwallet when it was half the price because some of us are broke and can't afford the far superior Nespresso capsules.

I am really pissed off because I wasted my time, directing thousands of consumers to the Ethical capsules, assuming that the capsules were going to continue to be sold at a price that would save people money. Why in the world would a company launch an inferior product at no savings to the consumer? Nespresso capsules produce great tasting coffee, and Nespresso's capsules are sealed until they are used, unlike Ethical's capsules; once you break open Ethical's bag of ten, you pretty much have to use the capsules right away. BTW, these take a long time to decompose in a composter so be sure you cover them for months if you do decide to waste your money on these. Finally, while the capsules do work in my Essenza, it's a very tight fit and lately the Essenza lever kind of pops up at the end of the extraction. My Essenza was two weeks old when I started using these. I will amend this review if the company decides to do what is right, that is not gouge consumers.

product_title: Slim-Fast Optima Ready To Drink Shake, 11-Ounce Cans
review_headline: Great product, WAY too expensive now!
review_body: I would rate SlimFast a 5 star... or at least I would have until they jacked the prices up so high.  The product actually does work!  I went from a size 6/7 in pants to a size 2/3 in 3 months.  I felt fine and healthy, no issues to report.  I was paying $23 and change for a 24 pack (cans), which was very reasonable with the free shipping.  (They arrived quickly, too.)  Now they're charging $65-$70 for the same product, and the 20 pack bottles aren't much cheaper.  Boo, Amazon!  Bring the good prices back!

product_title: Krusteaz Oat Bran Muffin Mix
review_body:
The 2 main ingredients in this delicious muffin mix is white flour and sugar, there is more sugar in one Muffin then a bowl of Capt. crunch peanut butter cereal. Honey powder is typically corn syrup and trace amount of honey. Hydrogenated oil prolongs the shelf life of the product but shortens ours.

NGREDIENTS: Enriched bleached flour (wheat flour, niacin, reduced iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid, may contain malted barley flour), sugar, raisins, wheat bran, partially hydrogenated soybean and cottonseed oils, food starch-modified. Contains 2% or less of the following: honey powder, molasses powder, nonfat milk, soy flour, sodium bicarbonate, sodium aluminum phosphate, salt, propylene glycol monoester, mono-diglycerides, sodium stearoyl lactylate, soy lecithin, caramel color, artificial flavor, high fructose corn syrup, guar gum, corn syrup, xanthan gum.

product_title: Healthworks Chia Seeds 3lb 6lb Parent
review_headline: Enough energy for me to give up coffee
review_body: The first time I used the recommended serving size, I knew right away that these seeds were what I've been looking for.  I've been looking for natural energy instead of supplements, and theses did not disappoint.  I have a lot of problems with supplements raising my heart rate to the point that I can't get the most out of my runs, but these didn't give me that effect, intact they gave me a really good boost.  They also helped curve my appetite and that is just an added bonus.

product_title: Frontier Co-op Organic Parsley Leaf Flakes, 1 Pound Bulk Bag
review_body: Product arrived in perfect condition.  Have used it many times already and have yet to see any brown crumpled leaves.  Boy is there a lot of it!  Would recommend!

product_title: Starbucks VIA® Ready Brew Iced Coffee
review_body: I am always in the search for a yummy iced coffee to make at home and am so excited I finally tried this. The price was a little more than I wanted to spend, but compared to the real thing, it's a deal. This is how I make my wonderful glass of iced coffee: First of all, I am one of those people who enjoy a little coffee with their cream and sugar, so I only use a half packet at a time in a tall glass of cold water. I only fill the glass a little over half way full with water and mix in the half packet of coffee. Then, I pour in my milk, almost to the top of the glass, and add 2 HEAPING spoon fulls of condensed sweetened milk that I keep in a container in the fridge where it'll last for a long time. That stuff is a bit sticky, (as is anything wonderfully sweet) so stir stir stir! With a few ice cubes thrown in to keep it cold, it's perfection! No need to add any more sugar since I cut the coffee down and add sweetened condensed milk, either. The only complaint I have is what everyone else has noticed as well, that there is a slightly bitter coffee taste.

product_title: Kopiko Coffee Candies
review_body: These are great if you like coffee all the time. Can't get enough of them have them in my pocket all the time!!

product_title: Dr. Flynn's Organic Granola (Case of 3, 10-ounce Bags)
review_body: Never considered myself a granola person until I tried Dr. Flynn's granola. I was given a bowl one morning while visiting a friend in Tampa....and presto...I was hooked. Now I don't want to start my day without it. Plus I don't usually write in the Amazon comments section, but this granola deserves a 5 star review !

product_title: Stride Gum
review_body: the gum is too sweet,and doesnt last like it used too.. i tested it and in 2 hrs,the gum starts to get really hard to chew,plus the taste is gone.. had to spit it.. i bought another flavor ahead of this,and that one was longer lasting.. i grew tired of chewing it.. just to see how long it will last,but i didnt last! so i guess that's a good review

product_title: Tully's Coffee, K-Cup packs
review_body: Tullys is the best of the Kcups brands that we've tried, which is most, other than Starbucks.  We do prefer bolder coffees that are not bitter.  Kona blend is our top choice, but it is hard to find, so house blend is our go-to.  Subscribe and save for this item is a good value too.

product_title: Premium Saltines Fresh Stacks, 13.6-Ounce (Pack of6)
review_body: The Fresh Stacks packaging is a Nabisco's solution to a decidedly first-world problem: my crackers go stale because I don't eat them fast enough. This way, you only have to eat about 20 before finishing off package and anyone (even us first-worlders) can do that before they go stale. The ubiquitous problem of trans fats rears its ugly head again, however, in this product. Saltines are a carryover from the age when everything was partially hydrogenated, and these simple crackers are no exception. You'd think that since they've discovered the optimum package size for these salty treats, they could get rid of the unnatural ingredient meant to promote shelf-life, but alas, that is not the case. Besides that flaw, this product is recommended.

product_title: Yogi Tea, Stomach Ease, 16 Count (Pack of 6), Packaging May Vary
review_headline: It works in a gentle way....I'm switching
review_body:
I have been using different supplements and medications to keep myself regular throughout my life. Some over the counter medications are very harsh, they sometimes make you want to go at the time you are not supposed to. Some would give me terrible cramping and keep me in the restroom for a long time.
I was using some natural supplement capsules before I discovered Yogi. The capsules worked fine but are more expensive than Yogi taa. Yogi gives me the predictable results the next morning. I usually bring a few my favorite tea bags for a trip. Now I bring a couple of this Yogi tea bags in case I get irregular during the trip.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: Sorry.... I don't know what all the shouting is about......this is pretty mediocre coffee, in my view. I made the small (6 oz.) cup as I tend to prefer pretty potent coffee, but this was just not very flavorful. I will say it was not acidic nor bitter....but just not much coffee flavor either. Tried adding a little sugar.....but I still wasn't impressed.

product_title: Bendicks Bittermints (200g)
review_body: One of the strongest mint flavours in a candy out there, contrasts nicely with the chocolate not too much sugar. All together- delish!!!

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: I received one from Influenster and love these cookies because it's soft and chewy without being too sweet. I just wish these were more readily available.

product_title: Yume Super Premium Rice, 15-Pounds Bag
review_headline: No more $2 cheap rice from grocery store
review_body: I thought $30 for a bag of rice is expensive, but upon researching at local Asian markets, this product sells at an average of $27 for 15 lbs, so $30 including shipping was awesome.  When I received the rice, I had to try it with a bottle of salmon cavier I purchased from Costco for $10, the rice was soooooooo good. I ate rice everyday, but the other day I had to go back to the $2 rice to see the difference, big difference, nothing compares!  I bought Koshihikari this time around, I wonder if there is any difference with the sasanishiki.  If you love rice, you'll love this!

product_title: Green Mountain Limited Edition Golden French Toast K Cups
review_body: I found I need to add a flavored sweetner or 2 Splendas because the French Toast flavor has a plain taste.

product_title: Saucy Mama Chipotle Mustard
review_body: I haven't tasted this mustard, but I feel obligated to point out that the ingredient label lists disodium edta, which can combine with vitamin c or baking soda in the body to form benzenes, a family of very strong carcinogens. I guess my quest for garlic mustard must continue.

product_title: Lipton Tea Bags
review_body: I wanted tea, I got tea.  The only complaint I have is the sometimes the tag breaks of and the string falls into the tea.

product_title: Fizzies Candy Drink Tablets ASSORTED Six Pack
review_body: Wasn't a fan of three flavors. The lemonade and orange flavors are pretty good, though. Just wish they had the cherry cola and grape flavors as an assorted box

product_title: Lavazza Gran Filtro - Ground Coffee, 8-Ounce (Pack of 5)
review_body: Definitely my favorite coffee. I like most Lavazza, but this gran filtro is my favorite. I brew in drip coffee pot, a stovetop moka pot, and also in a kuerig -- great all ways, probably best from the moka pot. Good price at amazon.

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips, Snack Size
review_body:
BBQ = very tasty.

Original = Not that tasty.

product_title: KERPLUNK WTR BTL,27OZ,SS,SAKURA,ER, CT
review_body: I originally bought this bottle with the red background and loved it and used it heavily, the paint started chipping off and it is quite ugly now but still perfectly functional, however I wanted a new pretty one so I got this one - the pictures don't do them justice, the cherry blossom print is really gorgeous and in this case the brown is rich and shiny (the red was more matte). product_title: Hansen's Lo-Cal Acai Blueberry Juice, 64 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 8)
review_body: I really enjoy this flavor! Its great over ice, refreshing and much less sugar and carbs than regular juice. If you need to cut down on carbs, sugar, calories this is a unique alternative to orange juice. I bought it on sale because it is very expensive otherwise.  You can tell its a good quality product.

product_title: Vermont Morning Wheat-free Blend Oatmeal Plus, 24-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is hands-down the best oatmeal ever - wonderful texture and flavor, quick and easy to cook (10 minutes max). We make a large batch year-round which can then be reheated (or eaten cool with yogurt in the summer) on subsequent mornings for even quicker serving. review_body: These almonds are the best. I ordered them from Amazon because the store that I bought them from stopped carrying them. Amazon had them cheeper so I am happy.

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: Great taste and packaging. Perfect for lunch boxes and take along snacks. We have enjoyed these cookies and look forward to more flavors.

product_title: Magnum Sumatra Mandheling Coffee, Whole Bean, 1 lb
review_body: I'm not sure if the other reviewers know that you are able to adjust the amount of grounds you use and the grind your beans have.  I have been using this brand for years and love it.  I like the fact that it is not over roasted and you can taste the bean and not just the bitterness from the roast.  Balance of ALL THE FLAVORS is key to a good cup of coffee.  Novices drink Starbucks (the over roasting kings).  I especially like the low acidity and complexity this kind of coffee offers over the central and south American coffees.  At the end of the cup I am satisfied with what I have just consumed.  If you like your coffee so strong it can lift a car then add more beans and/or grind them finer.  That way you will taste the complexities of the bean and the place on earth it came from.  To me when you judge the coffee based on the techniques of the roaster then you can put any bean in there and have a similar tasting product.  BTW, you can usually find this coffee cheaper at your local Marshalls.  But it is hard to argue with free 2 day prime shipping convenience.

product_title: ANASTASIA
review_body:
If you are already a fan of Earl Grey, you will be delighted by the exquisite bergamot in this amazingly bold black China and Ceylon tea blend presented in a beautiful, highly giftable tin box.

This tea is available in 35 oz, 8.8oz, 4.4oz and tea bags; I usually get the 4.4oz tin to keep it the freshest. One tin of 4.4 oz is enough for ~100 cups (I use a 1.5' mesh infuser).
As usual with Kusmi, the tin is beautiful, with raised flower details and old-fashioned design and colors. Anastasia comes in the dark blue tin.

The leaves are whole, a deep black with no other visible ingredients.
The nose is extremely bold: lots of bergamot, lime and orange blossom with a very sweet appetizing varietal black tea undertone.
The mouth is rich and full and the citrus notes are not acidic.
I brew this tea a little lighter than my other Kusmi teas (3-4 min- dark amber, vs my usual ~7min) as the intensity of the oils is strong. However, the tannins are low and the finish very smooth so it is hard to infuse too much. Itdoes not get bitter.
I do not add anything but my Mom likes a cloud of milk in hers. Sweeteners are not needed as it is so round in mouth.

To my knowledge, Anastasia is the most popular of Kusmi teas. You can also pick it up from Dean and Deluca to avoid shipping or directly from the Kusmi website (where shipping is unfortunately expensive but the choices are ).

Try this beautiful tea blend; it is a real luxurious treat!
Cheers!
