product_title: Caramel Apple Orchard Pops 15 oz
review_body: Great tasting pops, just like a caramel apple without the mess! It was great being able to find them on Amazon.  My daughter loved them.

product_title: Yogi Himalayan Apple Spice Tea, 16-Count Tea Bags  1.12 Ounce  (Pack of 6)
review_body: I keep this flavor of tea on the shelf at all times.  My husband, who in the past was not a tea drinker, has this for breakfast most mornings.  The flavor is excellent with a slight sweetness due to the stevia that is included.  I recommend this for anyone who enjoys drinking tea.  I appreciate the fact that Amazon carries this tea because it is difficult to find in the Tucson stores.

product_title: Wolfgang Puck Coffee K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body: This coffee says Dark Roast & Extra Bold and.... IT ISN'T! It's weak and barely beats out a cup of Folgers.

product_title: Sliced City Ham Shanks
review_body: This is a top notch product and has met or exceededed my expectations in every way.  No more grocery store 'pork hocks' with zero meat for me!

product_title: Nescafé Taster's Choice Instant Coffee
review_body: Love the Hazelnut flavored instant coffee. I'm not a coffee drinker but when I do drink/need coffee I go to this. I do wish it came in the canisters though as these packets are sometimes difficult to open especially when I'm still half-asleep in the morning.

product_title: Roland Escargot Snails
review_body: These fine, little, crawling the earth delicacies fit nicely into my 6 cavity baking dishes.  Prepared them with a shallot-butter-garlic mixture and they were awesome.  It has been awhile since I've had Escargot, maybe because in a restaurant they are too pricey.  So purchasing them online I was able to stock up on a case and have them as a snack every now and again at a reasonable price.

product_title: Herring Fillets in Hot Tomato Sauce 18pack/6oz.
review_body: Really? My can of this product (6oz) says 400mg salt (16%). They tasted fine,fresh, and will buy them again. Considering it also states 1.4g of Omega-3 as well as healthy amounts of Vit A, Calcium, and Iron, makes this relatively healthy for canned fish. It also tastes better than sardines, I think.  My favorite recipe: 1 can of 6oz Herring fillets per 2 cans Campbell's Tomato Soup. I substitute this for a days ration of Fish oil supplements. My kids like it too, which is pretty amazing. Try a can at Walmart and then decide if this bulk item is worth it to you.

product_title: KL Design & Import - Contemporary Design Ceramic Vase with Wooden Rack and 3 Stalks Lucky Bamboo (6", 8" and 10") Perfect For Feng Shui and Gifts
review_body: The order was here in 3 days.   The bamboo was packaged well and all were very healthy and in great condition. If you add in the price of the shipping which was $9 dollars for mine then each stalk will average out to around 0.55 cents each. Try to buy stalks from your local garden nursery and I bet you wont find them even close to that price! I liked this order because they offer a variety of sizes instead of just buying all 4 inch or 6 inch etc.      Why buy lucky bamboo from anywhere else?! I am buying this same order again soon!   Thanks

product_title: Lucini Italia Pinot Grigio Italian Wine Vinegar
review_body: I have tested and used many White wine vinegars before and most have been to acidic for my liking, this one is very mellow and has a lovey after taste. It's great for making salad dressings, marinades on Fish or chicken, or Ive just discovered making my own pickling brine, I've used this and it's worked out great. Highly recommend this as a pantry staple to any cook.

product_title: Bertolli Alfredo Sauce
review_body:
This is a creamy sauce, with a mild but pleasant flavor. It has just enough garlic to enhance the flavor, but not so much that it overpowers it. I had it with spinach and cheese ravioli, which it complemented very well. The pasta it would suit best would be fettuccine, which should be coated with the sauce by thoroughly mixing it.

In addition to going well with vegetable pasta dishes, it would be good with shrimp, chicken or chopped ham. With any of those, adding onion and mushrooms would help it along, and black pepper would top it off nicely.

There is a slight but distinct garlic aftertaste, so you might want to be careful about socializing afterwards with anyone who has not shared the meal with you!

product_title: Tone's Minced Garlic, 23 oz. shaker
review_body: A reliable brand. When I was shopping at a major warehouse store (gee who could that be lol) I discovered they sold this and loaded up my cart with Tone's. I buy gourmet brands too but I like having my shelf full of Tone's products for everyday use or backup. Flavorful, long lasting, and considering its a dried item as close to fresh as you can get.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body:
This K-Cup using Kona Blend is the best of both worlds!

The Kona is mild and tasteful. The Keurig K-Cup machine is the best brewer we've ever owned.

I am disabled and eat a special diet. I use the Keurig to produce hot water very quickly, without installing a K-Cup and let the hot water fall through the Cup holder directly into my mixing bowl. How convenient is that? I also have a favorite hot chocolate (Stephen's Gourmet) that I put directly into my cup and, again, leave out the K-Cup to let the hot water go directly into my cup. I'm sure there are a hundred uses for a good source of instant hot water.

CAUTION: DON'T USE ANYTHING BUT DISTILLED WATER! NOT DRINKING WATER OR SINK FILTERED WATER... JUST PURE DISTILLED WATER OR YOU'LL END UP WITH COOLER WATER AT A SLOWER RATE AND EVENTUAL UNIT FAILURE!

Taos Guy
Taos, New Mexico
4/4/2011

product_title: Organic Camano Island Coffee Roasters Sumatra, Medium Roast, Whole Bean, 5-Pound Bag
review_body:
It's good whole bean coffee, which is more/less what description says.
For $68 thought,it feels a bit ovepriced.Otherwise,I'd expect a little bit more from
this medium roast type.But,it's pretty much balanced and satisfying Sumatra coffee.
A great choice under $60.

product_title: Gevalia Dark Chocolate Truffle Ground Coffee, Decaffeinated, 8 Ounce Package
review_body:
I am a regular customer of Gevalia and have been for over 10 yrs. or more. I receive shipments from this company on a regular basis, mostly their flavored coffees. My preference is to mix decaf with caffeinated, half caf/half decaf. I made this purchase from Amazon when the price of coffee started to rise. I hadn't tried this flavor yet so I decided to give it a try and I'm glad I did.

It has the bold flavor that one would expect from dark chocolate and the truffle gives it an earthy aroma that I'm still getting used to. All in all it is a very interesting blend for a chocolate flavored coffee.

product_title: Funkyfoodshop's Groovy 60s Candy Sampler
review_body: FOR THE VERY FIRST TIME SINCE STARTING WITH AMAZON YEARS AGO, I AM VASTLY UNSATISFIED WITH A PRODUCT OFFERING. FOR THE $$ SPENT IT IS A RIP OFF.  GOING BACK FOR SURE.

product_title: Rishi Tea Organic Wuyi Oolong Loose Tea
review_body: This Oolong is pretty good. I get two pretty good steepings out of this tea. Price should be lower, but it is not low quality. It is not the best Oolong, but is something that is worth trying and ordering more than once. The taste is similar to Bigelow Oolong tea in bags. This Oolong is a lighter amber color,obviously depending on how much tea you use and how long it is steeped.

product_title: blk Premium  Alkaline Water Infused with Fulvic Trace, 16.9 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_body: I just got my first case and let it get cold in the fridge for a couple days.  Drank my first bottle tonight and let me tell you, it tastes like.....WATER!  I didn't detect any dirty taste or even an aftertaste.  I don't understand what people are saying it tastes funky because all I drink is water and milk.  This tastes like my bottled regular water.  I'm going to switch to 2-3 bottles of BLK Water a day and see if it really makes me feel any better and energized.

product_title: Trivedi Water - 24 / 16.9 oz Bottles
review_body: I Love this water. I bought a case at the Retreat in Los Angeles and drank half before the retreat was over. It tastes awesome and is not that much more expensive. The type of material the bottles are made of do not leach into the water. I feel it is a wonderful way to support my system between energy transmissions. I have given to my pets and used on my house plants and the results are incredible. The water makes a great gift too.

product_title: Lavazza Caffe Espresso Ground Coffee
review_body: This authentic Italian espresso coffee has a strong flavor that is completely smooth.  I absolutely love using it to make lattes or drinking shots alone.  Amazon has it for a GREAT price, by the way.  Highly recommended.  Illy is another great Italian coffee, but this Lavazza is waaaayyy cheaper and practically just as delicious.

product_title: Hot Pickled Polish Sausage - 32oz.Long Lake Brand
review_body: These are just wonderful -- real, actual, crunchy, chewy, tasty Polish sausages pickled in hot vinegar. They're on the mild side of spicy, but still hot enough that you won't like them if you have a low tolerance for heat. (If, like me, you have a _high_ tolerance for heat, you may even wish they were a little hotter.)    They require no refrigeration, either before or after opening -- although they're said to best if eaten within 3-4 months. I don't think that's going to be a problem.    These are at the opposite end of the sausage spectrum from such more or less meatlike substances as [[ASIN:B0017JFLYS Penrose Tijuana Mama Pickled Sausage 12 Pack]] and [[ASIN:B001IZJT94 Jack Links Pickled Sausage, Screamin' Demon, 2.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)]] (which I also like, but they're sausage the way pasteurized processed cheese food is cheese). If you like any sort of hot pickled sausage, give these a try; they may turn out to be your favorites.    By the way, there's another similar brand (also from Wisconsin) with which these shouldn't be confused: Lakeside also produces a red hot Polish sausage (also sold, if I'm not mistaken, under the Bay View brand). They look excellent too, but I haven't tried them yet and I'm not reviewing them here.

product_title: Tony Packo Hot Dog Sauce, 7.5-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I'm so used to the \\"Greek-style\\" celery salt, cinnamon type hot dog sauce that really doesn't taste like chili that I forgot what a good beanless chili meat sauce can do for a hot dog. Locally, Don Narde's Nineteenth Hole served the chili style-Excellent!-but closed long ago. Haven't had anything like it till I tried Tony Packo's. Has a little bit of heat, nice finely ground beef-deep beefy chili flavor like Tony Packo's chili. My preferred construction is hot dog in roll with a slice of cheese cut so as to span the dog alongside it. Cover the dog with mustard, next a couple of tablespoons of Tony Packo's, top with minced Panoche sweet onion. Wrap sub style in waxpaper and microwave long enough to melt the cheese. Let it marinate wrapped for 5 to 10 minutes then go to it. REALLY GOOD!

product_title: Prince Of Peace Organic Oolong Tea
review_body: I received expedient service for this product, in addition to finding a tea th  at is good and beneficial to me health.

product_title: Amy's Organic Soup (Pack of 12)
review_body: Can't believe it came from a can.  Made me a lover of tomato soup, of this brand anyway.  Much lower in sodium than Campbells.

product_title: Pamela's Products Chunky Chocolate Chip Cookies
review_body: My fiance was already hooked on Pamela's dark chocolate cookies...so it helps to buy them by the six pack on Amazon to save $1 per box (including shipping costs) versus Kroger's. She's addicted.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 18-Count (Instant Coffee) (Pack of 2)
review_body: Did you ever stop into a Truck-stop late at night dying for a cup-a-Joe? And when you poured it out you noticed the smell of burnt coffee 'cause it was the bottom of the pot? Then you took a swig, grimaced and spit it right out again because it was the most vile tasting \\"coffee\\" you ever had?    Well, that is exactly the experience you get when you drink this swill. Perhaps it is instant coffee in a K-cup. But even at that, it is BAD instant coffee.    As they say, you get what you pay for and this coffee is not worth a cent.

product_title: John Copes Toasted Dried Sweet Corn, 7.5-Ounce Bags (Box of 12)
review_body: We've been feasting on Cope's Dried Corn for several decades now after we first tasted it in Pennsylvania Dutch country.  It is unbelievably good, especially in the creamed version (the last recipe on the back of the box).  Try it -- I guarantee you'll love it.

product_title: Emeril's Italian Essence, 0.77-Ounces (Pack of 6)
review_body: LOVE IT!  I make marinara sauce with it and it's the perfect blend of spices.  Even when using canned tomatoes as my base, it tastes so much more fresher than jarred sauces.  I only wish it were sold in local stores.  I shared a jar with a friend and now have her and my daughter hooked on using Emeril's Italian!!

product_title: Senseo Origins Coffee Variety Pack II, 16-Count Packages (Pack of 4)
review_body: I love my Senseo coffee.  I'm the only one up in the wee morning hours and this makes the perfect amount of coffee with a fabulous taste!  The price is good in comparison to the local stores and this product is getting harder to find.  Thanks Amazon!

product_title: Organic Valley Organic Nonfat Dry Milk Powder, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: Not that I'm particularly enthusiastic about powdered milk. But, this is my favorite of the brands I've tried. It doesn't smell too bad, or look too bad (if you've tried many other brands of powdered milk, as I have, you know what I'm saying).   I don't drink milk, so I rarely buy it fresh, but I use powdered milk for baking and cooking.   I don't understand the comments about this powder being difficult to mix. Measure your water, add the powdered milk, and immediately start whisking. It's quick and easy. I haven't had any problems with it myself. Now, the Bob's Red Mill that I have previously purchased, although it too is a quality product, that one is a hassle to mix.

product_title: Cafe Britt Single Origin Costa Rica Tres Rios, Whole Bean coffee, 100% Arabica, 12 oz Kosher certified
review_body: I'm a Dunn Bros Dark Colombian Roast drinker and I have to say this stuff is as good.  I brew with a Bunn coffee maker at home and this comes out as good if not better than the Dunn Bros coffee I buy locally.  I've tried Jamaican Blue Mountain also and this is a little better.

product_title: Swad Tamarind Chutney(Pack of 2)
review_body: A very delicious relish that compliments samoosas. Everyone loves it. I better not run out or I will be in trouble.

product_title: Galaxy Granola Raspberry, 12-Ounce Pouch (Pack of 6)
review_body: It tastes great in milk or dry. The fat to flavor ratio is unbeatable. Galaxy has a couple of different flavors, but this is by far my favorite. Almond Vanilla Munch is second, though it is my wife's favorite. When I run low on the Raspberry sometimes I'll cut it with her Vanilla Almond until I can get to the store.

product_title: All Bran Cereal, Strawberry Medley, 13.2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Kellogg's told me Strawberry Medley was discontinued
review_body: When it became harder and harder to find this excellent breakfast cereal on the grocers' shelves, I called the company. Kellogg's told me they had discontinued making it in January 2011.    This news was disturbing, but Kellogg's held out the hope that a different cereal might take its place in my morning diet. That cereal, with a new name, would soon be available and would also have 40% of the daily fiber needed. I see now that the new cereal is available through Amazon.com.     If it turns out that Kellogg's resumes production of All-Bran Strawberry Medley, I am glad to be on Amazon's notification list, because I have never used a breakfast cereal that has had a better effect on my health.

product_title: Canada's Dare Whippet Original Peanut-Free Cookies 8.8 oz. Box
review_body: Cookies are great but who would pay this outrageous shipping charge. Sorry, no one's product is so good that you would pay more to get it than what it cost. I bet you have lots of stock.

product_title: Lipton Iced Tea Mix
review_body: Love this product, discovered it in the market, and loved the fresh true peach flavor..but when I tried to buy it again, I found it was very hard to find in the store..then I found it here on Amazon, I keep it in my cupboard, It is hard to find a good true peach flavor and I have tried many other brands, but Liptons hit the nail on the head...very good flavor and very refreshing, like the fact it is sweetened, because it is just right...

product_title: Panda All Natural Licorice Chews, 7 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: This all natural licorice is very good -- I highly recommend it.  I bought this as I a read natural licorice is good for an upset stomach.

product_title: California Farm Sweetened Condensed Milk, 14-Ounce Can (Pack of 8)
review_body:
I like Santini Sweetened Condensed Milk, when I see it at my local Grocer I buy a couple of cans because they don't always have it on hand, and it goes fast. Santini Condensed Milk has the same Ingredients and taste much the same if not better as the Top Brand and for a lot less money. I use it for Pies, Flan, Cake Frostings and a variety of Desserts, my Family loves it in their Coffee, it is very Thick, Creamy, Sweet and Smooth, ...I love it!

Santini is the only Brand of Sweetened Condensed Milk that uses Organic Milk, Made with No Pesticides, Chemical Fertilizers, Preservatives or Synthetic Hormones and Antibiotics. I even make Eggnog during the Holidays and so many other things, however, my favorite way to eat it, is right out of the can with a Spoon, but I know better so I control myself. Santini Sweetened Condensed Milk is really the ultimate in Comfort food, especially if you have a Sweet Tooth! ...Thank You D.D.

product_title: Wheat Thins Cinnamon Kick Crunch Stix, 8-Ounce (Pack of6)
review_body: They're called Cinnamon KICK for a reason. They're not going to taste like cinnamon buns. They have a hint of sweet, a hint a salt, and a hint of spice. Great stuff and would order again and again!

product_title: True Lime Crystallized Lime, 100% Natural Ingredients, 0.03-Ounce Packets (Pack of 500)
review_body: Of course, nothing can be a good as freshly squeezed lime juice, however...sometimes my fresh limes have...uh oh!..gotten old in the bowl or fridge; sometimes I just don't have any on hand. Whatever the reason, these True Lime and True Lemon packets are just the thing. They are not sweetened [the dextrose in the ingredients seems to cut the sour taste only slightly]. I have used these packets whenever I wanted lime juice...soups, bottled water, Bloody Mary, guacamole, etc. Even in Metro Atlanta, this product is difficult to find in the grocery. Hooray for Amazon!

product_title: Robert Rothschild Anna Mae's Smoky Mustard, 9.2 Ounce
review_body: My daughters and I discovered this mustard while wandering around the fancy deli section at Harrods in London, and we were so excited when we realized it was made in Ohio! This mustard has a lovely smooth but smoky (obviously) quality that is a terrific complement to almost any sandwich. But we also put it in homemade mayonnaise for a bit of flair, in potato salad, egg salad, or even stirred into tomato soup. I buy it by the case now and share it with friends.

product_title: Nanak Pure Desi Ghee, Clarified Butter, 28-Ounce Jar
review_headline: Nanak Pure Desi Ghee, 28 oz Autoship
review_body: Desi Ghee is the BEST and easiest to use so far!  I love how it stays firm when it's cool, and softens at room temp.  Great to saute veggies in, and makes the best mac n cheese ever! LOVE the convenience of the autoship, thanks! Since this is from Canada, there are no hormones, or other gunk included!  Nanak Pure Desi Ghee, Clarified Butter, 28-Ounce Jar

product_title: RiceSelect Arborio Rice Jars
review_body: After using the rice twice over several months, I was cleaning out my pantry and saw bugs crawling around in the rice.  The jar was tightly sealed and nothing else in my pantry had bugs.  My only conclusion is that the eggs were in the rice to begin with.  Gross!

product_title: Jansal Valley Lavender Honey, 8 Ounce
review_body: I bought this item because I was led to believe that the bees had collected lavender nectar for the honey, only to discover the following on the product label:  Ingridients: USDA Grade A honey, Lavender Essential oil.  Meaning this honey could have been collected anywhere, while the lavender taste was generated by mixing lavendar essential oil into the it. Not quite what I had in mind.

product_title: Riso Scotti Rice, Arborio Gluten Free, 32-Ounce
review_headline: The rice has expired a year ago!
review_body: Scotti rice is great, but this that I received has expired over a year ago, date on the bottom of the box April 2010...

product_title: Colombino Extra Virgin Olive Oil - 500 ml
review_body: I ordered this olive oil after having it at the Gramercy Park Hotel.  It is delicious!  It's light and has no  linseed-oilish aftertaste that I find so common in so many other oils I've tried.  The price is good for  a virgin olive oil...I highly recommend it.

product_title: Cento Light Tuna in Olive Oil, Pack of 3 cans 5 oz
review_headline: Cento Light Tuna In Olive Oil, Pack of 3 cans 5 oz.
review_body: This tuna is not Italian tuna. Also it does not state that it is wild caught as I somehow presumed due to the price per can.  I called the company direct and they stated that it was wild caught. Hmmm? They also said it was caught in the oceans off of Somalia or somewhere, & to be honest I forgot that part.    The tuna IS definitely better than the other common store brands. I will try to get the Italian wild caught brand in the future if possible.  If not, I'll opt for this brand.

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Whole Bean Coffee, 5 Pound
review_body: I am a little disappointed that I have to drink 5 pounds of this stuff. It's not completely undrinkable, but it is very bland. I will not be ordering this again.

product_title: GoPicnic Tasty Treats Gluten-Free Care Package, 1.76-Pound Package
review_body: I like the little picnic pack to take and go and it is well packaged and well thought out.. I enjoyed most of what was offered, Some things better then others but I like the idea of being able to order it monthly for snacks that are not always easy to find

product_title: Create-a-treat Gingerbread House Kit, Deluxe Model net wt.2.66 lbs
review_body: Broken into 50 pieces when it arrived.  Ruined.  Had to try to glue it together, and then ultimately get another one.

product_title: Lars' Own Belgian Pearl Sugar, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: I lived in Belgium for several years and loved the waffles from Liege with their crunchy sugar crystals in the center.  I've tried to make my own and have had little success.  The sugar really makes it what it is.  You can try and break up sugar cubes, but they usually dissolve (undesired) when I do that.  I recently had some at a restaurant in Salt Lake called Bruges Waffles.  This was a legit, Belgian run waffle shop (go there!).  I talked to one of the workers about my failed attempt to recreate these wonders.  He asked, in a French accent, where found the pearled sugar.  I hadn't found any I replied.  You can only get it in Belgium, he answered.  I hopped on Amazon, and there it was.  I admit it is expensive, but I love 'em so I bought the larger quantity, which brings down the price.  The box comes with a recipe that works really well.  They recommend you use a whole 8oz box for one batch, but I use 1/2 box and it seems perfect.  These are delicious.  All I need to do now if find the right amount of cinnamon to add so they taste like those found at the Gare de Liege.

product_title: Spice Appeal Poppyseed (Black), 104-Ounce Jar
review_body: smelled weird when i opened the container. a little earthy but kinda like they have been sprayed with something. after preparing it the water tasted strange too, not like the usual Pee eS Tee flavor. it kept me from wd's so that was good, but as far as catching a good buzz...eh 1-10 it was about a 3.5

product_title: WOW Oatmeal Cranberry Apricot mini Cookies 12oz (Glueten Free)
review_body: I got these for my sister, who is Gluten Free. She really liked the cookies, said she had eaten them all before she made it on the drive home. I personally liked the Ginger Cookies better from WOW Baking but these were good too

product_title: SEN SEN 12ct
review_body: I don't know what made me even think about Sen-Sen, but glad I did.  Found this merchant, ordered, and voila!  They arrived in a timely fashion, tasting just the way I remembered.  Flashbacks to asking my grandmother for some; she'd open her \\"pocketbook\\" and pull them out, shaking her head and wondering aloud why a child would be interested in a smoker's breath mint...

product_title: Folgers Brazilian Blend Ground Coffee, 27.8 Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Best Folgers Coffee, Too Bad They Discontinued...and price is now crazy!!
review_body: Best folgers coffee!! They discontinued it in my area, so i was happy to find it on here. 2 packs for 15.99$ definately beats the 9.99$ i was paying per tub....I normally dont like folgers but would definately recommend this to anyone who loves coffee, not soo dark, not so light...

product_title: Campbell's Condensed Soup, 10.75 Ounce Cans
review_headline: Low Sodium Never Tasted So Good
review_body: 73 year old hubby was put on very low sodium diet due to heart condition & altho' he previously salted everything (when I wasn't looking), he says this soup tastes great, has good flavor & needs NO salt. Wow. So I tried it. Yep, he's right - this one is a winner in the taste department.    The only negative is that there are always dented cans in my subscribe & save shipment.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Whole Bean Coffee, Colombian Peaks, 40 Ounce
review_headline: Best Coffee- Disappointed in the new price
review_body: My husband and I really enjoy this coffee, but I am disappointed to see the price jump on amazon. Its now cheaper to buy at the grocery store!

product_title: Manner Vanilla Wafer, 2.54-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Many exceedingly thin layers with a smooth filling. Shipment arrived quickly and wafers tasted fresh. Amazon's price for the vanilla flavor is very good. Other flavors are priced much higher.

product_title: Waggin Train Cowboy Steak Dog Treats - 32oz. Bag
review_body: We have been feeding various Waggin Treats to our 4 legged friends for almost a year now - with no issues.  They love them!!  We just woke up and realized they are all made in China.   So, we too must discontinue buying.   Our friends are just too dear to take a chance on feeding them food made in China.

product_title: Kellogg's Stuffing Mix, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I am totally shocked that Kellogg has discontinued this delicious stuffing.  It is the best stuffing ever.  I have tried other brands and none can compare.  Kellogg needs to reconsider this decision.  I will call them and air my views. Hopefully they will bring it back.

product_title: Goetze's ORIGINAL "Bullseyes" Caramel Creams 100ct
review_body: I was really disappointed in the quality of these bullseyes.  They were very hard not soft like the others I have gotten.  The ones I got a long time ago were nice and soft.  These were too hard to do anything with. I had to throw them away.

product_title: Back To Nature Chocolate Chunk Cookies, 9.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: LOVE these cookies. They taste great!!!     I was looking for a natural and organic snack and these Back To Nature chocolate chip cookies are just what i needed. The only issue i have is the amount of calories (130 calories for 2 cookies), but the cookies are a good size. If you eat 4 cookies like i do somtimes its still not that bad calorie wise (260 cals.)    Buying them in bulk from Amazon really helps. Somtimes there is a little breakage but for the most part the cookies arrive intact and ready to eat! Dollar for Dollar its the best deal you are going to find. I say buy them and stop eating all those artificial chocolate chip cookies loaded with Junk!..... Lets eat healthy AMERICA!!!

product_title: Maynard&Child Premium Gift Pack of Stuffed Bleu Cheese Olives
review_body: The olives tasted good, and go well with my Dirty Vodka Martinis. The one aspect I wasn't completely happy with was the blue cheese that was in the olives. I have had Blue cheese stuffed olives at bars with my martini where the cheese was in chunk form like you would find in blue cheese dressing. The cheese in these olives look like a machine condensed a rope and stuck it in.

product_title: Steaz Organic Iced Green Tea
review_body: It's so hard to find unsweetened Iced Tea.  This tea was tasty and arrived in one piece - something you can't count on from glass bottles. I would purchase it again.

product_title: Donut House Collection Green Mountain Coffee Light Roast Coffee, K-Cup Portion Count for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count
review_body: This coffee is a great morning breakfast blend.  Beats out our local coffee houses any day of the week.

product_title: Swiss Knight Cheese Fondue, 14 oz - 6pk
review_body: Swiss Knight Fondue is something I remember fondly from when I was a kid--fondue was popular in the 70s and 80s, and we had this from time to time.  I was pleasantly surprised when I found it's still available--it even still comes in the same packaging!  But best of all, Swiss Knight turns out to be one of those few things you remember from your childhood that turn out to be just as good as they seemed at the time.  It's not cheap, especially when ordered online with shipping charges--but you'd be hard-pressed to find a substitute of equal quality.  The fondue pack is also easy to use.  Cut up some bread, maybe steam some vegetables for better variety--and nutrition--in dipping.  (I find broccoli works very well for this, as it absorbs the cheese and goes well with the flavor; the kids have to finish the broccoli before they can start dipping the bread--helps insure they get their veggies.)  Then empty the packet into your chafing dish if you have one (or use a small saucepan), and melt the cheese at low heat directly on the stovetop.  That may sound wrong, but I've found if I use my fondue set's built-in burner to melt the cheese, some of it burns to the bottom, whereas the stovetop gives better control and allows a lower heat.  Then transfer to your fondue set (or a hot plate), and dip away.

product_title: Traverse Bay Fruit Co. Dried Cherries, 4-Pound Bag
review_body: Nice and soft but the first taste is of plastic from the bag they are shipped in.  I don't believe I would purchase this product again.

product_title: Donut House Collection Coffee Chocolate Glazed Donut Keurig Single-Serve K-Cup Pods, Light Roast Coffee, 24 Count
review_headline: Best flavored coffee for a keurig!
review_body: This coffee is fantastic for anyone who loves flavored coffee, esp chocolate.  It's the best one I've had and I think I've tried them all!

product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy, Techno Bears, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: These gummy bears are a bit more dense and chewy than most other bears but that's why they are so good. My family and friends always ask for some when they come by. You got to pick up a bag for yourself!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Blueberry Iced Green Tea, 40 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love this stuff! It takes the edge off green tea for me (which I find bitter).  Its also very convenient, I keep these bags in my purse for a quick iced tea with has so many great health benefits.  The blueberry gives a nice sweetness to it & its also very thirst quenching to me!

product_title: Finn Crisp Caraway Thin Crispbread with Sourdough Rye
review_body: It's hard to find Rye bread without sugar content (only German style),  we enjoy this crispy, lightly salty, zero fat bread.

product_title: MISHPACHA Mayonnaise - Plastic Jar, 32-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 4)
review_body: I bought this basically because we needed mayo and this was a super deal when I got it. I was surprised on how good it is. Clean tasting with a tang and not as heavy as other mayo out there.  We enjoy it but I do like Dukes a little better.  I would purchase again though.

product_title: Vitalicious VitaMuffin Mix, Deep Chocolate, 12.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 3)
review_body: After my store stopped selling these I hunted for a new option. The dry mix is great! Love the 100 calories serving size

product_title: Tupperware Hotdog/Sausage/Bacon Keeper in Red
review_body: Years ago, when I discovered that ordinary hot dogs were made with nitrates and nitrites and lots of things I didn't want my kids to eat, I got rid of my original Tupperware hot dog keeper. Now grandsons love the oganic uncured hot dogs I discovered at my local co-op, so I started buying hot dogs again. I was so glad to find Tupperware still making these available.  Keeps hot dogs fresh for a couple of visits from the grandsons so I don't end up throwing out half the package.

product_title: Brach's Sundaes Neapolitan Coconuts
review_body:
I bought these for a candy basket at work. I ordered these candies specifically because I do not like them. So, I cannot comment on the taste. However, the package that was delivered was very poor quality. Most of the candies were stuck together, many partially melted, as though they had been left in a hot car and then cooled again. They looked very unappetizing. I don't think it happened during shipping, as I have Prime and they arrived in 2 days (though it is possible). Additionally, the bag had no nutritional label so we couldn't make an informed choice about possible allergens, or calories.

Overall, I would not recommend buying these (except in a brick and mortar store where you see what you're getting). I will stick to hard candy in the future.

product_title: Douwe Egberts Douwe Egberts Filter Blend Ground Coffee, Medium Roast, 8.8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)
review_body: This coffee was boring to bland, which was very disappointing since I had had what I believed to be some delicious Douwe Egberts coffee at a local diner. Clearly, this was not the same stuff. Just tasted like week coffee.

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Intense Dark Bar, Midnight Reverie, 3.17 oz.
review_headline: Way too dark for my taste
review_body:
I typically enjoy Ghiradelli dark chocolate, so when I found a deal on this, I jumped on it. My favorite variety is their 60% cacao Espresso Escape.

This, at 86% cacao, was way too dark for my taste. It tasted like solidified cocoa powder. But hey, I guess some people like that.

product_title: Tastykake SUGAR FREE Chocolate Cream Filled Cupcakes 2 boxes 12 per box
review_body: ok its supposed to be sugar free . I understand that.    But honestly they taste TERRIBLE . Very bland taste and the cream is like a teaspoon . Definitely not woth the calories.    PS if you want to try them go to WALMART i got them there cheap.

product_title: Living Harvest Organic Hemp Protein Powder, Original Flavor, 16-Ounce Plastic Container
review_body: If you're looking for a protein supplement thats easy to use, keep looking.  Hemp protein has a decent amount of protein in it and is very good for you, but its not something you want to just mix into a glass of water like you can with whey or soy protein.  This stuff tastes terrible and needs to be mixed into a smoothie where the flavor can be masked a little.  I usually mix it in a smoothie with soy milk, bananas, yogurt, and plenty of blueberries.

product_title: mix 1 Protein & Antioxidant Drink, Blueberry Vanilla, 11-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: Excellent product.  I dont have the strongest stomach.  This is one of the few protien drinks I have found that I can happily drink.

product_title: Green Cracked Olives (ziyad) 4lb (64oz)
review_body: Parthenon sent me these Turkish olives by mistake; I had ordered the Greek ones by Angel that are in a glass jar.  I can seen why Ziyad CANS these instead of using glass.  Nobody would buy these brown-spotted, small olives floating in an unappetizing 'stew' of what looks like lemon wedges and a few green finger peppers.  The flavor is reminiscent of tin, with sour lemon. UGH !  Too much of a hassle to pay to mail them back, I just accepted a refund because these olives cost less than the brand I ordered, and much deservedly so.  If I could give them a zero rating, I would.

product_title: Shiitake Mama Log Kit
review_body: This was purchased as a gift in zone 9.  The recipient followed the instructions and \\"spring shocked\\" the log for 24 hours, then placed it on the counter top with a white paper bag on it for 5 days.  Viola! He now has some shiitake starters!  This is a fun home science experiment and I hope the shiitakes are tasty!

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Rainforest Espresso K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: Okay so I bought this based on its name.  Espresso.  Extra Bold.  Rainforest!!  Sounded good. Though there is very little extra bold and espresso about it (and i have no idea what rainforest would taste like).  My Kuerig brewer has 5 size settings. My default is the fourth which fills an average mug (the fifth is their travel mug size).  When I use this K-cup I must use the third size otherwise it is just too weak.  Folgers Lively Columbian is a much better cup of coffee and much better value than this otherwise I stock Jet Fuel for a bolder mug and one kcup can actually handle the travel mug size.  ( Also like Tully's Kona and GM Sumatran Reserve)  But beside the lack of brew strength I find it to have a weird finish to the taste.  I just didn't enjoy the taste but we all have different buds so you may like it.  My gripe lately with these K-cups is that some of them are sooo weak you literally need two to make a good mug of coffee and that is way too expensive for coffee at home.  So far I find \\"Timothy's\\" coffees on the weak side- I also bought their Decaf Columbian- what a rip off, brews like weak tea from the start! So weak!

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips
review_body: I don't know why everyone loves these chips. They are healthy but taste disgusting. Only the original flavor tasted good, so getting the variety pack was a very bad idea. I would not buy this again and would rather go with baked chips than these. Pirate's Booty makes popped chips that are way better.

product_title: Indomie Instant Noodles, Special Chicken Flavor, 2.64-Ounce (Pack of 30)
review_body: Indomie Instant Noodles is the best Noodles ever, good tasty one. I was looking for it everywhere but thanks to Amazon for selling it..Highly recommended!!!!

product_title: Yakami Orchard Japanese Yuzu Marmalade 300 gram jar
review_body: I had one jar that had an overly strong pine aroma a few years ago.  Since then, I've tried it as a tea and really loved it.U recommend it highly now.

product_title: Genisoy Soy Protein Shake, Chocolate Protein Shake, 22.2-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 2)
review_body: These are really good protein shakes.  The ones with 24 vitamins were a little chalky, but the new ones aren't chalky at all.  I recommend mixing it with soy milk.

product_title: Almond French Toast Coffee, Ground, 1 lb
review_body: Oh wow! I can't say enough about this coffee.  It's the kind that sits on your tongue and makes your whole mouth happy! I will order this over and over again.  The flavor is smoothe and delicious! 5 Stars for me, and if you knew me, i don't give 5 stars.  :)

product_title: Jamaican Original Pickapeppa Sauce - 5 oz
review_body: Pick a Peppa is a key ingredient in my sauces and roasts.  Really tasty with grilled and roasted foods!  A must have for your pantry.

product_title: Omanhene All Natural, Single Origin Cocoa Powder, non-alkalized, 7 Ounce Canister (Pack of 4)
review_body: This cocoa powder is lighter in color than most (kind of a warm tan) but has a wonderful chocolate flavor closer to rich, smooth milk chocolate than bitter dark chocolate. If you are avoiding this because it is not dutch-process, know that the quality of this particular cocoa outweighs any such labels. It makes the best hot chocolate I've ever had, short of hot chocolate made of actual melted chocolate. It worked great in baking as well and I had no problems with leavening when using a recipe calling for dutch process. Despite the light color of the cocoa, cupcakes baked up to a very dark color just as you would get with dutch process cocoa but the flavor was superior.

product_title: Better Oats Oat Revolution! Instant Oatmeal ~ Apples & Cinnamon Flavor ~ 5 Pouches per 6.15 oz Box (Pack of 3 Boxes)
review_body:
My wife and I picked up some packages of these of the dollar store and weren't sure if they'd be a good deal or not. Were very pleasantly surprised. I almost exclusively eat Quaker apple cinnamon oatmeal, but I really liked this brand.

I have to comment on the great packaging idea of this product comes in. First, if you care it's post have lower amount of packaging than comparable products and be better for the environment. Anyway, the thing I really do like about this is the pouches are also the measuring cup. You take a bowl, tear the pouch open, dump out the contents, then you fill be empty pouch with water up to a line on the pouch, dump it in the bowl, stir and then nuke it for 90 seconds. I don't know why nobody is ever thought of this before in any of the packaging I've seen, but it saves the guessing at how much water to put in or caring stupid measuring cup around with you if you're eating it work like I do. My only minor gripe is the line it asks you to tear at isn't the area that had the tear point so I mistook the tear line for the fill line and put in too much water the first four or five times I used it.

When we went back to the store we picked up another three boxes pulled me out for the next few weeks. Give the stuff a try. You won't regret it!

product_title: International Delight French Vanilla, 192 Count Single-Serve Coffee Creamers
review_body: The creamer is fine, it was the creamers that had exploded in the box that were the problem. The few that did break open left the whole box covered and sticky. So I had to go and hand wash all of them before putting them out for our staff and clients. Simply irritating...

product_title: Nescafé Taster's Choice Instant Coffee
review_body: My mom loves this Hazelnut instant coffee. Unfortunately, they do not make container any more though. Fast shipping!  It is great taste. It's great for camping.

product_title: Heinz, Ketchup Reduced Sugar, 14 OZ (Pack of 12)
review_body: Tastes every bit as delicious as regular Heinz ketchup.  What was disappointing, however, is that I purchased 12 bottles and the expiration date on each bottle was only 5 months from the date of purchase.  This was VERY disappointing as I had expected an expiration date of at least one year or more!

product_title: P.A.N Harina Blanca - Pre-cooked White Corn Meal 2lbs 3.3oz
review_body: Great, it was a long time before I was able to eat an arepa before. Thanks for the product I may order it more often!

product_title: Golden Moon - Kashmiri Chai Black Tea - 1lb Bag
review_body: I really love this tea - It is perfect for me.  It has the perfect blend of spices without being too overbearing on any one spice.  It has plenty of 'kick' to wake me up in the mornings without the caffeine jitters.  Please make it available as soon as possible - ASAP!  Thanks!

product_title: Ayam Premium Coconut Cream, 9-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I have been searching for \\"coconut cream\\" not to be confused with \\"cream of coconut\\"-which is sweet-for a long time.I couldn't find it in any supermarket and I live in NYC where you can find almost anything.
I must say that it was well worth the wait! The \\"Ayam coconut cream\\"comes real close to tasting like authenic coconut.my rice pudding,coconut cake and curries taste so much better and richer,theres no comparison between coconut milk (which I was using) and this coconut cream.
I give it 4 stars because it's pricey. the taste gets Five stars!

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: Very good, no bitter after taste...will buy more Donut Shop K-cups when these are gone.  My sister recommended and she was right!

product_title: The Republic of Tea, Organic Blueberry Green Superfruit Tea, Caffeinated, 50 Tea Bags
review_body: I love this tea.  The flavor, the \\"green\\" packaging, the absence of caffeine.  I also like that the St John's Wort ingredient is helping me to ease off the anti-depressant medication I've been taking for several years.  I drink it cold, not hot.

product_title: Maruchan
review_body: I love Maruchan ramen, and this particular flavor is difficult to find. I love using it in recipes, too. It even smells wonderful.

product_title: Newman's Own Cinnamon Fiber Flakes, 12-Ounce (Pack of 5)
review_body: Very good cereal.  You must like a strong cinnamon flavor.  It is not sweet, so the cinnamon is not hiding.  It has a good flavor.  I switch between this and Fiber One.  Sometimes I mix them.   I wish I could buy  it locally, but they are not available.

product_title: Black Truffle Tapenade 6.3 oz.
review_headline: To much olives, too little truffles
review_body: The product is not bad, but the olive taste is too strong taking the space that should be for the truffles.

product_title: Numi Organic Herbal Tea, Tea Bags
review_headline: good herbal tea without the usual yucky herbal taste
review_body:
I was 1st introduced to Numi teas when I was drawn to the artistic, beautiful packaging of Numi's rooibos tea (the version with the artistic drawing of elephants in an african savannah) at Safeway supermarket as I needed a small food item but that had an expensive-look to serve as a \\"community\\" gift for everyday munching or drinking for coworkers at work for our small kitchen/computer/lunchroom at a prestigious company. After finding their rooibos tea so wonderfully tasting as well as relaxing to my nerves as I get anxious and nervous, rooibos tea has been my #1 breakfast tea to drink in the morning.

Their rooibos is much milder than you find with the more affordable Twinings tea but rooibos tastes a little nutty and you don't need sugar since it has a very mildly sweet taste. I, however, will also add organic raw honey to it to give me the benefits not only of the herb but also the benefits of the organic unprocessed honey which makes it a complete healthful breakfast tea for me.

There's a VERY TINY cut in the corner to indicate where to rip the teabag package but what I don't like about Numi teas is sometimes, the cut is not there and so that same small paper-plastic packaging that holds each tea bag is difficult to open OR when you rip it at the cut end, the rip still doesn't result in the opening of the tea bag pkg - it's protective with tough plastic on the inside and you NEED scissors or else you won't be able to open it unless you're Superman.

But what i love about their teas is that, like another reviewer posted, they don't taste like the usual flowery herbs (like licorice, flowery herbs/roots/leaves, mint, hibiscus, rosehips, etc.) which is what i hate about Celestial Seasonings Tea and why i moved away from Twinings blackcurrant tea when they changed the formula. So you get the benefit of the herb in the tea without the yucky flowery herbal tastes/flavors.

product_title: Pure Exquisite Quality Saffron Stigma by Exir
review_body: This is defnitely better than trying to grow your own saffron.  It is a large amount of saffron for cooking use at about $35 a jar.  this is an excellent price when you look at spending $8 in the grocery store for a single use.

product_title: Van Houtte Cafe, Costa Rica Tarrazu (Light Roast) Coffee, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers 24-Count(Pack of 2)
review_body: This coffee is flavorful but gentle, not harsh or bitter. Unfortunately, the filter inside the K-Cup seems to be a little weak. On about 1 in every 5 brewed cups, the filter has split inside and a significant amount of coffee grounds are deposited into the brewed cup of coffee. We CAREFULLY autopsied the K-Cup after noticing the grounds in the coffee and saw the split filter and only a few grounds remaining in the K-Cup.  We switch around brands and strengths throughout the day and this is the first Van Houtte coffee that we have purchased. We have not had the same problem with the K-Cups made by other brands of coffee roasters.

product_title: Cellas Dark Chocolate Covered Cherry 72 Count Box - 36 oz total
review_body: These are the best cherry cordials.  Only had a few soften during shipment. Loved these!! Service was great as usual.

product_title: Kettle Brand Potato Chips Fully Loaded Baked Potato, 2-Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: I am glad I was able to find these on this site. I love this flavor and they are so crunchy. The box is packed inside another box but still some bags end up as crumbs. Most of the bags survived in tact.

product_title: Nature Factor Organic  Coconut Water, 10-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: I tried ONE for awhile, then I realized that they were sending me expired products. I went to my local market and found Nature Factor's Organic Coconut Water, and I fell in love with it. It is sweet and delicious, and sooo yummy. It is awesome post workout and when you are sick!

product_title: Art of Tea Organic Caramelized Pear Loose Leaf Tisane Tea (Caffeine Free) - 3oz Tin
review_body: I have nothing good to say about this blend/flavor.  I made one pot and threw it out after a few sips.  The caramelized pear taste was overpowering and rather unpleasant in my opinion.  I hope I can find someone that likes it as I hate to let anything go to waste, but I don't plan to brew a second pot.  That said, I've purchased other teas from Art of Tea and loved them... especially the green pomegranate.  That tea I highly recommend but not this one.

product_title: Snickers Marathon ENERGY Bar Honey Toasted Almond 12 Bars
review_body: I loved this bar! At 150 calories and 10g protein with 7g fiber, this is a great snack alternative for me. I am post op lap band surgery and working hard to meet my weight loss goals. I have tried many protein bars, most have an unpleasant aftertaste and I tolerate rather than enjoy them. Not so with this bar.   If I can find volume at a good price, I will purchase and feed to the kiddos as well! If anyone knows yummy chocolate it is Snickers.

product_title: La Vie de La Vosgienne Lemon Hard Bonbons, 2-Ounce Tins (Pack of 10)
review_body: I used to get these at specialty shops and then could't find them. They are great for when you need a little something, The tins are really great.

product_title: Pillsbury Cake Mix, Clasic White, 18.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
No complaints here. Delicious cakes turn out when you use this mix.It is good to have this on hand to make a quick dessert.
.

product_title: Crispie Sweets- I Heart You Crispie Nibblers - Rice Krispie Treats
review_body: I ordered these for my kids for Valentine's day and they loved them!  The whole family loves them.  They are exactly how a rice krispie treat should taste, but better!  We also ordered a few of the individually packaged treats with yummy toppings.  There are many different toppings to choose from so there is something for everyone.  If you're looking for a creative, edible gift for someone I recommend these.  They also have awesome customer service!

product_title: One 28 oz Bob's Red Mill Evaporated Cane Juice Sugar
review_headline: Bob' Red Mill Evaporated Cane Juice Sugar
review_body: This is a very good substitute for processed sugar.  I am eliminating as many highly processed foods as possible from my diet and this product is less processed than regular white sugar and sweetens perfectly.

product_title: Gerber Cereal with DHA, 8-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Oatmeal, so much better than the Rice Cereal
review_body: Very good deal when Subscribe and Save which we have delivered every 1-2 months.    Oatmeal DHA Cereal is not easy to find. Not available in most stores like Walmart, Walgreens, CVS, Target, etc.  I don't know why they carry the DHA Rice, but not the DHA Oatmeal Cereal.    Oatmeal Cereal my son eats mixed with breast milk and has no constipation issues like he had with the Rice.  He started this cereal at 4 months old.  Now he's 11 months.  Really enjoys eating this still.    The 8 ounce canisters are better packed than box cereal I've opened.  I will definitely keep feeding him this.

product_title: Smoke Paprika Powder
review_body: Hot Smoked Paprika from La Chinata is delicious. It gives chicken, fish, eggs, vegetables like broccoli, spinach, caulifower, etc.a smoky taste that is moderately hot, (hardly for me) not overpowering the flavors of the foods and the other spices. I discovered it at a home of a cousin who let me cook in her kitchen. She did not tell me anything about it. I tried it first with chicken that was lightly fried and cooked maily with salt and pepper. it enriched greatly the flavor of the chicken and everybody in my family loved it and asked what I had used.

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 3-Count
review_headline: Nice concept, but does not deliver
review_body: Leaks out of the top and makes a big mess.  Even tried putting in far less grounds than what it calls for but still water and grounds leaked out of the top.  Also ended up with grounds in the coffee from the leaking.  Used commercially ground, regular coffee, nothing special, just did not work.

product_title: Nestle Carnation Original Malted Milk (13 oz.)
review_body: My dad drank chocolate malted milk for years and got me hooked on it. I have since developed a preference for the original (i.e., non-chocolate) product. I can't find it in stores anymore, so the alternative for me is through Amazon or other online store. The quality is consistent, batch after batch. If malted milk is your thing, Carnation is the best.

product_title: Maldon Sea Salt Flakes
review_headline: Happy to find Maldon thru Amazon!
review_body: Maldon Sea Salt is increasingly difficult to find in my community. Imagine my delight when I looked for it online and there it was thru Amazon! Thanks for making it so easy to restock my pantry, Amazon! If you haven't used this product, I cannot recommend it highly enough. I seldom use salt while cooking (except where it makes a real difference such as baking); instead I provide a small wooden bowl of Maldon at the dinner table as a finishing salt. Years ago a friend shared a conversation she and her husband had on their way home from dinner at our house: Husband asked why food at our home always tasted so good; wife replied \\"well, it may begin with the salt and pepper \\"gingergal\\" uses! Enough said.

product_title: Dave's Gourmet Six Pure Chiles Gift Shaker
review_body: I love the hotness, and I am constantly running out of different types of pepper flakes.  I had to buy this when I saw it, and I don't regret it.  Spice it up!

product_title: Papagalos Loumidis Ground Coffee, 16 Ounce
review_body: This is the item to buy when you want classic Greek/Turkish coffee! You can't go wrong with this coffee, the most popular brand.

product_title: Annie's Organic Bunny Fruit Snacks, Berry Patch, 5 Pouches, 4 oz. Each (Pack of 4)
review_body: These are the best gummy bears that I have ever had, I don't feel bad about indulging with them because they are a healthy sweet treat and they are vegan! No animal gelatin used like in other gummy bears :)

product_title: Extra Dessert Delights Sugarfree Gum Key Lime Pie Flavored Gum 15 Stick per Pack, 10 Pack
review_body: never did I think I could put a piece of gum into my mouth and actually experience pie.  You can seriously taste the crust, the filling, and even the whipped cream on time.   I don't know how they did it, but it's amazing.

product_title: Taco Bell Jalapeno Sauce, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This jalapeno sauce is pretty good. The flavor is new and different than other jalapeno sauces I have tried - it is a fresh take on taco sauce. It is not as spicy as expected/hoped, but is still good. The sauce is nice and creamy (reminds me a little of sour cream). A great topping for your favorite taco!

product_title: Bulk Save Snyder's Of Hanover Sticks, Gluten Free 12 to 48 packs each 8Oz
review_body: These are fantastic. Better than regular pretzels. I was expecting them to be hard and grainy like everything else GF but they were not. They are made with potato and corn starch instead of rice flour. Seriously. These are really good!

product_title: Crown Prince Natural Chunk Light Tongol Tuna in Spring Water (No Salt Added), 6-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: Absolutely fabulous add a bit of Duke's Mayonnaise, celery, onion and fresh black pepper and you think you died and went to Heaven!!!!!

product_title: Camu Camu Fruit Powder 16 Ounces (1 Pound) By: Kismet Kreations
review_body: has a sweet& sour taste- not too strong. i mix it with unsweetened greek yogurt & lakanto & chi & sometimes hemp. what a nutrition packed dessert that taste great & is packed with vitamins. a great way to get natural vitamin c. although it wasn't this brand i don't think it matters. as long as it's pure.

product_title: Maine Coast Sea Vegetables Dulse Flakes, 4-Ounce Package (Pack of 5)
review_body: I love these dulse flakes.  I make peanut sauce noodles very frequently and dulse flakes are a great addition that is healthy.  It's a great source especially of iodine but also iron, vitamin B6, and B12.  Low in sodium although they add a salty flavor!

product_title: Mighty Leaf Tea Stainless Steel Tea Top Mug (Holds 14 Ounces), 1-Count Mug
review_body: lid not a tight fit, does not screw on.  Does not keep tea hot long enough.  If cup is full, tea bag stays inthe liquid, and gets too strong.  Must remove lid to get tea bag out.  Too messy.

product_title: Revolution Foods Organic Jammy Sammy Snack Size Sandwich Bar, Blueberry & Oatmeal, 5-Count Sandwich Bars (Pack of 5)
review_body: My almost 3 year old really enjoys these for a snack or dessert. The only downside is, they are pretty crumbly and can make quite a mess!

product_title: The Spice Lab's 2 Pound - Himalayan Kosher Unprocessed Cooking Fine Grain Salt
review_headline: Salt is not just salt anymore.
review_body: Until now I have always considered salt something that came in a shaker and was used as needed. Now I know better! First off, this salt is saltier than what you buy in a box at the grocery store. Just a pinch is enough to flavor almost anything. The taste is fantastic and it is great to know that it has many minerals in it. The price is a plus too. If you have not tried this salt for yourself yet, try it - you will thank yourself.

product_title: Cafe Britt Costa Rica Dark Roast Whole Bean Coffee, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2) (Packaging May Vary)
review_body: I love this coffee. I have been hooked ever since I visited Costa Rica and had the plantation taste and tour. I have tried just about all the Cafe Britt's flavors and this is my favorite. I also love the fair trade blend too. I have to say no matter what your strength of coffee you prefer this company is the way to go.

product_title: Raisin Nut Bran Cereal, 17.1-Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is my favorite \\"grown up\\" cereal. Sure I would love to eat apple jacks and lucky charms, but now that I am old, I need fiber and substance, but I won't eat it if it tastes like cardboard. I need a happy medium. This is a hearty cereal with delicious nut coated raisins with whole bran flakes. The fiber content is high (5g per 49g serving) and I enjoy the plump juicy raisins which are never hard and chewy like come other raisin brans.

product_title: Good Earth Green Tea, 18 Tea Bags - Decaffeinated Mango Peach Pineapple (3 Pack)
review_body:
This tea from Good Earth has a lovely delicate flavor of mainly pineapple. The other two fruit flavors are very subtle, and stay in the background while drinking this tea. Any flavors of green tea detected are mild as well, and this tea is not at all bitter. I can steep a tea bag for five or more minutes and the tea never takes on a bitter flavor.

I like that this tea is organic. It is rare I purchase decaffeinated, but I make an exception when the tea is of unique flavor as this one is.

~~~ Overview ~~~~

PROS:
- Organic
- Sweet flavors (mainly of pineapple)
- Not bitter
- Decaffeinated

product_title: Skyline Original Chili Recipe, 15-Ounce Cans(Pack of 6)
review_body:
I read about the taste of Skyline chili on a Tulsa, OK website [..], posted by someone trying to simulate the unique taste of cheese coneys made by the Tulsa, OK-based Coney Islander hot dog restaurant chain.

A transplanted Tulsa native that's lived in New York City since 1977, I was suddenly overpowered by the urge to recreate the mythic hot dogs of my teenage youth, so I immediately ordered a case of six 15-ounce cans.

Amazon promptly delivered the chili and I eagerly set about sampling it. Unfortunately the chili turned out to be (no disrespect intended to Skyline fans in Cincinnati and elsewhere) inedible--at least to my taste buds--and looking nothing like the product depicted on the can wrapper. The contents consisted of half watery soup, half highly spiced meat, and resembling nothing like the savory, meaty chili described by the website writer. Even after pouring off all the liquid, the remaining chili was so heavily spiced with I believe to be a heavy dose of cloves and perhaps some cinnamon and other ingredients that I stopped eating after a single bite.

Still, wanting to believe that I could somehow employ this chili to help mimic the taste of my beloved Coney Islander cheese dogs, I asked my wife to sample the chili, who proclaimed it to be \\"awful.\\"

Much as I hate to step on a product that some people no doubt love, I have to say this is the absolute worst canned chili I've ever eaten. It was so bad I felt slightly nauseated a few minutes after having the single bite, and a faint worry about food poisoning briefly entered my mind.

Needless to say, the five other cans were summarily tossed into the garbage. The quest to find the perfect chili for hot dogs continues...

review_body:
I just received a Tassimo machine from a friend who is a self confessed coffee snob. Well after Starbucks stopped selling t-discs my friend picked up a Keurig for the wider variety of coffee available with it and gave me their old Tassimo. I as they know am not a coffee snob, lol.

I was excited to find out that I only had to use one disc to fill my mug but it was the flavor that sealed the deal. To me this is a fantastic coffee, I have been drinking Maxwell House breakfast blend coffee from a drip machine forever and this absolutely blows it away! It is a mild flavor but it is very tasty. I always drink my coffee black or with just a small amount of sweetener and many coffees are just too harsh without a bunch of creamer and stuff added to it but this one is just about perfect by its self.

Maxwell house, you've definitely (still) got my business.

product_title: Thai Kitchen Coconut Milk, 13.66 fl oz (Case of 12)
review_headline: Product has slid downhill. Inconsistent in quality.
review_body: I've purchased about 5 cans per month of this for about 14 months. At first, this was a wonderful product.   Later, I started finding the bad can occasionally - where the taste was akin to either the product having a metallic reaction with the can, or the product tasting like it had gone bad. But it didn't happen often enough to make me quit buying it.  In the last few months, I've purchased more bad cans than good ones. I've written to their company, and called, numerous times. They don't seem too interested in my findings, sadly.   Just now, I read another reviewer's comments stating that Thai Kitchen was bought out about a year ago. That seems to coincide with when my dis-satisfaction with the product began. Not only is the taste often bad; but formerly there would be a nice thick lump of cream at the top of the can, and a bunch of thin watery milk at the bottom - as one would want.  Now, however, the product is as thin as coffee creamer all the way through. It never thickens upon refrigeration, either. Clearly, there is NOT as much fat in the product as formerly. So disappointing!   I wanted a product without sodium metabisulfate - which is a huge allergy trigger. The other recommended brands like Chao Koh have the sodium metabisulfate. Thai Kitchen does add guar gum, but I can live with that. If only they could keep their quality consistently good!   I'm testing A Taste of Thai presently, which is more coconutty tasting, but is very thin and I'm not sure if I like the taste yet (there is an extra fruitiness that I can't quite identify and it is a little overpowering.)   It shouldn't be this hard to get a good prepared coconut milk!

product_title: Dublin Dr Pepper Two 6 Packs - 12 glass Bottles
review_headline: hands down better than the mass produced stuff.....
review_body: The difference between high fructose corn syrup and suger is that sugar tastes natural and your body knows its limits. With high fructose corn syrup the opposite is true, it taste synthetic and the after taste is designed to leave you wanting more and it actually causes some issues for people, now the reason I started my review with a comparison of HFCS vs sugar is because no where is it more evident than regular dr peper vs dublin dr pepper. Many of the reviewers have said that this is heaven and while I won't go that far I can tell you with a 4 person taste test this stuff destroys the regular formula out on the market. To tell you how I know its simple, the 4 person taste test team took a regular super market can of dr. pepper(they don't make it in glass anymore) each poured out a small sampling 2 fl ounces, and tasted, each of us had the same prognosis, its way to carbonated and the flavor bites at the tongue, its almost like the tongue and the soda is having a fight and the soda is winning, to continue the test we washed out our mouths with water and did the same with the cups, then after 5 minutes we did the same with the dublin dr pepper, never in my life have I tried this stuff and I can tell you that even though its an expensive habit the soda is satisfying, not only is it smooth its not overly sweet and it does not assault the tongue instead it tastes like how dr pepper should taste and I am converted... I probably should have also mentioned that until I tried ddp I hated the taste of dr pepper they converted me the only complaint is the company that sold it to me \\"thebargainbox\\" needs to take some lessons in packaging their shipments one of the bottles had broken during shipment and soaked the box in ddp, and it picked up the smells of the warehouse not pleasant. Continuing on everyone in the 4 person group fell in love with this soda and now are planning on picking it up sometime in the future. Instead of suing them snapple should be selling dublin dr. pepper in every freaking store this this stuff would put everyone else out of business.  Now its time for the imnportant information, because I know as someone who is trying to watch his weight a little bit I pay attention to this stuff here are the details on the back of the bottle, serving size is 1 8oz bottle.  Calorie count: 100  Calories from fat: 0  Sodium count: 35mg  total carbs: 27g  Sugars: 27g  protein: 0   ingredients: water,imperial pure cane sugar, caramel color, phosphoric acid, natural and artificial flavoring, sodium benozate(preservative), caffeine  To be more specific this stuff is almost the same calorie count as the 7.5 ounce 90 calorie cans you can buy in any local food store with a much, much, much, much better taste.   If you can force yourself to like regular dr pepper in the store then you absolutely must try dublin dr pepper its better for you and tastes incredible.

product_title: Mikakuto Tokuno Milk 8.2 Candy 3.7oz
review_headline: The best Japanese sweetened condensed milk candy!
review_body: I fell in love with these delicious little hard candies after a trip to a small Japanese import store. If you've ever enjoyed tres leches cake, eaten a spoonful of sweetened condensed milk straight from the can, or delighted in the taste of dulce de leche, then you will likely adore these candies as well.    About the size of a small marble, these cream-colored hard candies melt slowly into a rich, sweet milky flavor that manages to avoid being too cloyingly sweet. If you're the kind to crunch your candies, these will offer a pleasant resistance and crack/crunch satisfyingly under your teeth. The flavor is superb; I prefer to savor mine slowly, sometimes enjoying one along with a rich cup of dark coffee to enhance the sweet milky taste.    Unlike any candy flavor found in traditional US markets, Japanese milk candies are a special treat. These Mikakuto Tokuno UHA 8.2 milk candies are the cream of the crop--the best of the best!

product_title: Stash Tea Decaffeinated - Premium Green 18 foil tea bags (Pack of 6)
review_headline: This is my favorite decaf green!
review_body: You can still get more flavor in a fully caffeinated green tea, but this is green, clean, and refreshing. It is not at all bitter as long as you pull the tea bag out in 1-2 min, and it has forgiven longer steeps as well. The flavor is warm and mellow with some grassy tones, but the grassy tones are not overwhelming. Light, all-day tea that's good cold as well. I'll sometimes put a bag into cold or room-temperature tea to flavor the water deliciously without adding heat to a summer day.    I often mix this with other flavors to cut the caffeine in half, or mix it with other decaf flavors (like herbal mint) for variation.

product_title: Del Destino Italian Style Grilled Green Asparagus in Oil, 13.75-Ounce Trays (Pack of 5)
review_body:
This asparagus is similar to some I can find SOMETIMES in Costco, but in JARS, and trust me, the JARS make ALL the difference! The way this is packaged, it MUST be intended to be used SOLELY at parties and/or catered events, because the little plastic trays are FULL of olive oil and have only the single plastic seal with the label on top. Once that's cut to get to the asparagus, there's NO way to reseal it. I've tried putting the whole package inside quart-sized zipper-lock bags, then refrigerating it that way, but unless they remain EXACTLY HORIZONTAL in the refrigerator, the next time you open that bag, there's olive oil ALL OVER the place inside the bag!

Currently, my LAST tray from this purchase is sitting on the top shelf of my refrigerator, open, but with no bag around it, and I'm contemplating just throwing it out because I can't recall how long it's been there, and it hasn't had \\"a seal\\" around it. Costco (briefly) had the same (or very similar -- same brand, I think) product in jars again, and I bought several. In the interim, however, I had grown MUCH more fond of a pickled asparagus product that could be found at Sam's Club. However, when my local Sam's Club did a re-arranging before Christmas they dropped ALL asparagus stock, so I can no longer find it. I can't think of the brand right now, but it was about $4.27 per jar, I think, and the only source I found online wanted something like $25 for the same jar. I've saved the JUICE from the last jar and MIGHT try putting the asparagus from a jar of this olive-oil-soaked stuff in there.

At any rate, that's off-subject for this review. I wouldn't recommend this product UNLESS you plan to use an entire pack at a time, and I like to eat A LOT of asparagus at once, but even I can't eat a whole package of this at one sitting!

Granted, this product is probably a lot healthier.  I wish I liked it since I bought the Costco pack... and I usually LOVE other the other Kashi products (go lean crunch, energy bars), but unfortunately this cereal is not one of their best.

They're unattractive and a mess to eat because of this. They also don't have that characteristic Lindt \\"snap\\" of the shell; it's like one big, misshapen, sticky lump of chocolate instead of the usual truffle - again, I believe this indicates that they melted during storage. I'm very disappointed and will not be ordering these from Amazon again.

product_title: Justin's Nut Butter Natural Chocolate Hazelnut Blend, 16 Ounce plastic jars (Pack of 3)
review_body:

I purchased Justines Chocolate Hazelnut Butter Blend at Whole Foods - a total impulse purchase. I'd never heard of it. I am crazy about Nutella and don't trust myself to buy it more than once a year, as I eat it by the spoon and I'm lucky if it lasts 3 days !!! This product sounded great and I saw the mostly good reviews.

It just doesn't taste that good. It feels greasy and is pretty flavorless. I see from another review that Justine recently changed the formulation - that reviewer commented that the \\"blend\\" isn't as tasty as the original. I wish W/F had had the little 99-cent sample so I could have tried this before dropping $10 (!!!) on the jar.

Although it was a noble effort, this product is too caloric (and expensive) - I will stick with Nutella for my splurges!

review_body: This stuff is terrible! To begin with, the packaging is completely misleading. The hefty plastic cup appears very similar to other microwaveable convenience soups, pasta dishes, etc. on the market, but they are NOT microwaveable. To microwave, you must first dump the soup into a separate dish. The instructions further state to \\"discard the container\\" after opening, so I was not sure it would even be safe to store my leftover portion in it. Turns out I didn't need to worry about it, because the soup itself was certainly nothing special! Same old salty-yet-bland canned soup garbage that ALWAYS disappoints. I ate about 1/3 out of the bowl hunger, then dumped the rest once I felt like I could make it through to dinnertime.  I had bought several of these in preparation for returning to work after maternity leave because they seemed like a nice, convenient cold-weather lunch option. BIG mistake and BIGGER waste of money!!! I predict these will meet a swift end and you won't see them around much longer.  PS - The Campbell's Healthy Harvest Tomato Basil Soup (NOT The Kettle Cooked version, just regular canned) is very good, and my husband and I always keep it in the house. It's the only canned soup we like. I should have known better not to waste my money elsewhere.

review_body: I used to buy my Piquillos at Trader Joe's, but they discontinued them.  So I ordered a case of these.  They are a litle seedy inside, which is a down side, but the flavor is good and they work well in tons of different dishes.

Only reason I gave it four stars is because I wish they had smaller blueberries, which are sweeter. Some orders have bigger ones than others. But they're all sweet. Then right the container, poke a knife into the center all the way to the bottom (before stirring), and when oil comes to top, drain off what you don't want. Makes the consistency much better.
