review_body: After tasting another well-known Italian coffee brand I figured it was the right time for Lavazza. The other well-known brand was smooth and rich. This coffee was extremely acidic, bitter, earthy, and old. Very disappointed in Lavazza, especially with all the great reviews.

product_title: Oat Revolution! Instant Oatmeal - Peaches & Cream - 5 Pouches Per 6.15-oz. Box (Pack of 3 Boxes)
review_headline: Never Thought I'd LIke Something Other than Quacker Apple Cinnamon
review_body:
My wife and I picked up some packages of these of the dollar store and weren't sure if they'd be a good deal or not. Were very pleasantly surprised. I almost exclusively eat Quaker apple cinnamon oatmeal, but I really liked the three flavors I tried.

I have to comment on the great packaging idea of this product comes in. First, if you care it's post have lower amount of packaging than comparable products and be better for the environment. Anyway, the thing I really do like about this is the pouches are also the measuring cup. You take a bowl, tear the pouch open, dump out the contents, then you fill be empty pouch with water up to a line on the pouch, dump it in the bowl, stir and then nuke it for 90 seconds. I don't know why nobody is ever thought of this before in any of the packaging I've seen, but it saves the guessing at how much water to put in or caring stupid measuring cup around with you if you're eating it work like I do. My only minor gripe is the line it asks you to tear at isn't always the area that had the tear point so I mistook the tear line for the fill line and put in too much water the first four or five times I used it.

When we went back to the store we picked up another three boxes pulled me out for the next few weeks. Give the stuff a try. You won't regret it!

product_title: Amy's Light in Sodium Organic Spicy Chili
review_body:
If you realize how much store bought chili has in daily salt it might concern you and of course it has meet products on the average. I feel virtuous when I eat this chili. No meat and low salt with a great taste. I wonder if it is healthy for you - it just might be. Of course, after I add the cheddar cheese and more salt it is a wonder my heart does not stop working. Still, adding your own salt will give you a lower salt chili. The human tongue has a hard time reacting and tasting salt that is dissolved in tomatoes or beans or any number of other products. However, if it is on the surface like a potato chip it might have less salt that you would otherwise believe. So just a pinch of course sea salt and it becomes salty enough.

I could eat this chili everyday of my life if I had to and would have no complaints. I buy a case each month and try to keep myself from running out. The only bad news is I have tried a thousand times to please myself with homemade chili and now I think I will just buy Amy's Spicy Chili and give up on the idea I could make anything better.

product_title: Findlavender - Culinary Lavender 4oz
review_body: Great culinary cooking. Got it with a lavender cook book and have been impressing my friends with the gentle, subtle flavor of the lavender. A little goes a long way and there is a lot of lavender here so it can easily be used for all sorts of dishes. Makes a great way (with a little sugar) to brighten up a lavender Margarita -rim the glass with the crushed lavender instead of salt.

product_title: Coconut Water Purity Crystalized Organic Drink Mix - 30 individual servings per box
review_body: Why buy this coconut water instead of another?  TASTY: definitely one of the best tasting coconut waters, never funky tasting. Light, floral, refreshing.  CHEAP: about $1 per serving. Much of the cost of coconut waters is the H2O that has to be shipped around the world. You'll save a bunch on shipping from Amazon too. 30 servings of Purity fit in a small box.  30 servings of bottled coconut water are HEAVY!  ECO: 95% of coconut water is just H2O.  Shipping bottled coconut water burns tons of CO2 and wastes disposable plastic containers (made of petroleum in case you didn't know).  Bad Karma!  Purity uses infinitely less packaging than bottles.  Plus it's boxed in recycled cardboard.  EZ: You can toss a packet of Purity in your bag on the way to yoga or the gym.  Most gyms/studios have free water fountains: just fill up your water bottle, add the packet and enjoy!

review_headline: Love it, not sweetened, so convenient, and delights choosy daughter!
review_body:
We love this milk! Perfect for lunchboxes, trips, anywhere on the go! I love the convenience, the fact its organic AND unflavored, unsweetened, etc. My daughter loves it, too.

We had been drinking the Horizon milk singles which was difficult to find unflavored (stores seem to carry chocolate, strawberry, vanilla). Finally we found \\"plain\\" (or \\"lowfat\\" whatever they call it) and I only later realized it's sweetened! Organic cane sugar, sure, but who needs to sweeten milk!!? Glad we noticed that and glad we found this. My daughter was delighted with the switch -- declaring \\"this tastes like milk!\\"

UPDATE 3/2013: (1) This was also amazing in a recent BLACKOUT! This is now permanently on my storm/disaster preparedness shopping list. (2) I've heard Horizon has dropped the sugar but don't have any to compare. Don't want to trash talk them so wanted to make a note. That said, we still prefer Organic Valley and it still \\"tastes like milk\\" and satisfies my choosy daughter.

I just wish prices would come back down. We buy it less now that even Amazon 24 pack is basically a $1 a serving. I hear it's cheaper at club ($15 for 18 pack). My extravagant purchase, glass bottle, home delivered, locally sourced organic milk is less than that!!

product_title: Soyatoo - Soy Whip Can, 7 Ounce
review_headline: For what it is, it ain't so bad :)
review_body: So being a vegan I do miss whip cream, so fluffy and sweet, really makes everything so much more delicious and amazing.  Like sprinkles, whip cream is a necessary condiment for ice cream sundaes.  I bought this on a whim because who doesn't like to dip there strawberries in some whip cream, or do a muff dive at a party?  I know that these are essential to happiness.  I was not that impressed but like I said in my title, it ain't so bad for what it is.  It doesn't taste like anything to be honest; It's like a flavorless whip cream on your tongue.  Not sweet at all, but has the creamy like consistency of real whip cream.  I think if they were to add more sugar, it would be delicious and some vanilla flavoring.  There only being one gram of sugar in 2 Tablespoons is why it is not sweet.  It is amazing how far vegan food as come though and the awesome thing about this product is it is organic and soy free.  They do make a soy one but I am trying to not do the soy as much.  I wonder if the soy one is sweeter?  I will have to try that one out next just to try it. So that's my opinion on this product and hope that it helps you people out if you are interested in purchasing.  I guess what I am going to do with this rice whip is maybe sprinkle the tops of my dollops with sugar, sad I know, but me loves my sugar!  Those of you who are looking to cut back on your sugar though this is the perfect happy joy joy for you and your sweets.

review_body: I love these crackers.  They are tasty on their own. They have that cracker snap.  They aren't slimy.  They hold up well with something on them.    We have started eating these with tuna salad.  Seriously yummy.    One of our favorite snacks is a nice chedder cheese and crackers.  That was gone when we went GF.  I found these by accident & was doubtful they were any good.  I was wrong.    Well worth purchasing all the flavors available.  I have not been disappointed.

product_title: La Tourangelle Avocado Oil, 16.9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: I like the quality of La Tourangelle and buy alot of sesame oil. I decided to try the avacado oil as I like to experiment with different ingredients..I don't eat meat. Avacaco oil was a first for me..and probably the last. And that has nothing to do with this oil...which I consider very good..it's very light...I restrict my oil intake and I perfer the flavor of sesame seed oil. I do recommend this oil if this is what you need.

product_title: Folgers 100% Colombian Ground Coffee, Medium Dark Roast, 27.8-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_headline: The Best Part of My Wakin Up!
review_body: There was a time when I spent more on coffee...in my previous life before kids. Now, more than ever I need a boost of caffeine in the morning. I just can't pay coffeehouse brand prices anymore. Those of you with little people may agree. I have spent more money on coffee from warehouse stores- and I honestly can't tell a difference in taste with my Folgers! For the great price-delivered right to my door- I will be sticking with Folgers to start my crazy days!

product_title: AriZona Sugar Free Pomegranate Green Tea Iced Tea Mix, 2.3-Ounce Tubs in Canister (Pack of 4)
review_body: Every time I serve this delicious tea, people ask what it is and how they can get it.  I initially purchased it at my regular grocery store, but they stopped carrying it.  I tried several other stores, but couldn't find it.  Thankfully, I was able to order it through Amazon.

product_title: Dark Chocolate Cacao Nib Toffee / Tent Box: 12 Count
review_body: Sweet Dish, a candy shop on Chestnut Street in San Francisco, closed abruptly and I loss my source for this amazing candy.  It is not too sweet, so is best for dark chocolate lovers. Its satisfying dark chocolate/salty tang, nib crunch and the soft crack of the toffee are a party in your mouth.  I swear it is the best candy I have every eaten.  I have made junkies out of every friend I have given it to.

product_title: John Wm. Macy's Asiago & Cheddar CheeseCrisps, 4.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: [[ASIN:B000G7NI1U John Wm. Macy's Cheddar & Asiago CheeseCrisps, 4.5-Ounce Boxes  Pack of 12)]]  These are habit forming and really good with a glass of wine or most anything else.  They are hard to find in most stores and in my area impossible to find.  Costco had them once and evidently discontinued them.

product_title: Amazing Grass Green Superfood
review_body:
I can't say enough about this product! I had injured my elbow, and to pick up a pen to write made me want to cry. It wasn't getting any better until I tried Amazing Grass for only ONE WEEK! There is a natural anti-inflamatory in it that took down the swelling and allowed healing to begin - at a rapid pace.

Along with this product being incredibly healthy, it has sent my energy level through the roof. I have been able to increase my workout time from 1/2 hour to 1 1/2 hours four times a week! I would cut many other items from my weekly budget before I would even consider giving up Amazing Grass.

product_title: Snyder's of Hanover Organic Honey Whole Wheat Pretzel Sticks, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I agree with another reviewer regarding the taste of the Snyder's Organic Honey Whole Wheat Pretzel Sticks -- they taste a little stale.  I bought two cases of these based on the reviews because I wanted to eat healthier snacks; however, I'm not crazy about these pretzels.  I've never eaten sawdust, but I imagine this is what it tastes like.

product_title: Kailo Artificial Instant Bowl Noodles, Beef, 4.23 oz (12 packs)
review_body: If you are looking for something good to eat move on these are not for you (wish i didnt have to give it a star at all)!  You can only put so much of your own food to make them slightly worth eating.  Reminded me of college when you had no money and only a can of pumkin and condiments left in your kitchen......and you eat the condiments rather than the can of pumkin.

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Organic Herbal Power, 17.6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I initially bought this product at Whole Foods, but their price was too high.  I love this tea, it really does settle my stomach and aids with digestion; and it tastes so good.  When I browsed Amazon, and saw the very reasonable price for 6 boxes, I quickly bought the bundle. And, I will be buying my supply from Amazon from now on.

product_title: Oreo Mint Creme Oreo Cookie, 15.25-Ounce Package (Pack of 4)
review_body: These are the best of all the Oreo varieties.  Very hard to find and almost always have to order online.  The mint is the highest quality taste and lasts in your mouth for a long time. Great to dunk in milk or eat on their own.  Beware you wont be able to put them down!

product_title: Stonewall Kitchen Chocolate Whoopie Pie Mix, 18 Ounce Box
review_body: My sister and I love Whoopie Pies ... I ordered a mix for me and ordered a mix sent to her.  This is a great Whoopie Pie mix.  Thank You!

product_title: Everybody's Nuts Pistachios, European Roast, 13-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: These pistachios are wonderful, and my family is addicted. However, the store where I always buy them isn't carrying them anymore. I will try to order from Amazon and hopefully continue to enjoy them !!

product_title: Rosarita Refried Beans, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: I love Rosarita Refried Beans.  I grew up in Mesa Az where these beans were manufactured (at least a long time ago) and I have always thought they were the best on the market.  I can't always find them on the east coast so when I saw them available through Amazon I was thrilled.  They have a smooth texture and subtle taste so they can be used in any recipe.

product_title: Marathon Bars High Protein Caramel Nut Rush, 2.82oz Bars(Pack of 12)
review_body: This Snickers product is Awesome! You definitely forget that this is a nutritional protein bar. Not only does this product contain 20 grams of protein & taste great, but it is great to eat as a snack or when you are on the go. The only downfall is that the product sells out very quickly so I would suggest you buy 2-3 boxes at a time to be on the safe side.

product_title: Barista Prima Coffeehouse Coffee, Keurig K-Cups, 24 Count
review_headline: Advertised as Medium-Bold, but more Medium than Bold.  Slightly Bitter, but Not Harsh.
review_body:
This Columbia Blend leans more to the medium side than the bold side of coffee. However, there is a slight kick to it, so solid medium coffee drinkers may want to take a pass.

The blend is also slightly bitter, but not so bitter that it would be considered a harsh taste. The bitter can be toned down by milk, which would leave no significant aftertaste.

I would put this kcup in the same category as [[ASIN:B00474OR8G Caribou Coffee, Caribou Blend, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers]], although I would choose this Barista Prima Columbia blend over the Caribou Blend.

This is an OK blend, but there are better coffee blends on the market.

Disclosure: I received this kcup in a free sample pack mailed by Keurig to its customers.

product_title: Pacific Natural Foods Organic Soup, Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato, 16-Ounce Cartons (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love tomato soup and I've been looking for a good one for a long time. I ate Campbell's for a while (the orange tomato soup is pretty tasty) but it has several unhealthy ingredients so I tried to find a 100% natural product. I tried a couple and they tasted pretty bad. Pacific soup was such a pleasant surprise. I couldn't believe how good it tastes. I usually add some raw broccoli and green onions, croutons and some shredded cheese. I can't eat more than half of the small box at a time, so this is the perfect size for me. I am a little disappointed they dont have it in stock anymore. I was able to get the small one from Big Lots for $1, but I doubt it they have it anymore.

product_title: Nissin Cup O Noodles Hearty Chicken, 2.25-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: This Cup O Noodles is my go-to quick snack or dinner. Quickly cooks in its own cup - and tastes great.

product_title: GoGo squeeZ Applesauce on the Go, Apple Raspberry Lemon Twist, 3.2-Ounce Portable BPA-Free Pouches,(12 Boxes with 4 Portable BPA-Free Pouches Each)
review_body: This is great for being on the go with 2 kids.  We can take them to ball games, swimming lessons, shopping trips, etc and the kids get a healthy snack without the worry of utensils.  My boys love them, I have told many other parents about them.  Subscribe to Amazon reminder delivery to get the best price.

product_title: Instant Yeast (LeSaffre) 1lb (16oz)
review_body: This is good yeast. I bought a four lb pack and I'm on my third pound now. It's never failed to work. It is NOT compressed yeast as another reviewer claimed. It's normal yeast just like you'd buy in the little packets from the grocery store. It is an instant yeast so there's no need to proof before you combine with other ingredients. One complaint is that the yeast is a little old - the batch I got expired about 13 months after purchase.

product_title: Maxwell House Caramel Latte Macchiato (8 Servings), T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 16 Discs (Pack of 2)
review_body: I prefer the Gevalia Caramel Latte Machiatto, which is stronger. This one wound up tasting vaguely like warm milk with a little caramel in it, and I had to use 2 espresso disks to get the same flavor. This one is cheaper, but since I had to use twice as much it didn't work out in the end.

product_title: Red Rain Energy Drink, Zero Sugar, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
This tastes better than some of the more well known energy drinks out there, for example Monster. It doesn't seem to have the kick of the equivalent amount of Red Bull. It is a sweet fruit punch flavor. Much cheaper than the major brands.

Overall, it's a decent energy drink, which I enjoy occasionally when needing to be up for extended periods, or if I'm just tired that day.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Cereal, Flax Plus Red Berry Crunch, 10.6 Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: My kids loved this! And I felt good about letting them eat it. My daughter asked for \\"the healthy cereal\\" every day. My only complaint is that it is a bit on the sweet side.

product_title: Mori-Nu Silken Lite Tofu, Firm, 12.3 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: It is great to always have tofu on hand that doesn't take up room in the refrigerated.  Water doen' t have to be squeezed out.  This tofu has the consistancy of gelatin.

product_title: Hampstead Tea Organic Fairtrade English Breakfast Loose Leaf Tea, 3.53-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3)
review_body: This is a refreshing well rounded tea.  I tried making it in a tea ball, but the leaves expand quite a bit, and I found the flavor to be better when made with the leaves loose in the teapot.  Let it steep a little bit longer than a regular tea bag.  Also, you can refresh the pot with more boiling water and get a second pot of tea and a weak third pot - this is because the leaves are large.

product_title: Brown Rice Snaps, Toasted Onion with Organic Brown Rice, 3.5-Ounce Packs (Pack of 12)
review_body: Because of food allergies, my children can only eat 100% rice crackers.  It's extremely difficult to find a rice cracker without added ingredients.  Edward & Sons is the only brand that they can eat.  We're so appreciative that someone makes a rice cracker that doesn't have lots of extraneous ingredients added.    The flavor on all their crackers is wonderful, even the plain.  They always snap and are a wonderful little size.  We use them to eat hummus or eat them all by themselves.    It's a wonderful product.  Amazon beats the discount my local natural food store can offer me when ordering a case.  We get these through the s&s program which makes the price even better.

product_title: Old Wisconsin Snack Bites
review_body: I first bought these because I wanted a replacement for the candy bars I found myself eating every afternoon. These have worked so well for that purpose that I have subscribed to get them delivered regularly. Since they don't need to be refrigerated until opened, I can store them at my desk. They taste great, and they're very satisfying. I also brought a bag along to a weekend softball tournament, and it was very helpful to snack on them between innings.

product_title: Breadtopia Sourdough Starter (Live)
review_body: I bought 2 because I was afraid one wouldn't work (or I would kill one accidentally) -- it's not that much more since you have to pay shipping anyway. Total came out to $16.74.   Anyways, both starters did fine, and I've had months of tasty sourdough now.  The only thing I'm sad about is that my sourdough is probably more Madison now than San Francisco. I don't know, my palate/expertise is not good enough to recognize authentic sourdough. This really has nothing to do with the efficacy of the product. 5/5

product_title: Wonka Kazoozles Chewy Candy, Cherry Punch, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Delicious! And big enough to share (you just won't want to)
review_body: this is one delicious candy! I first discovered them at my local theater, when I asked the attendant what the best candy they had was, and now I am addicted!!! they are soft and chewy, but not overly so. they have a great consistency to them.Nobody feeds your inner-child like Wonka!

product_title: K-Cup Coffee for Keurig Brewers, Flavored Coffee Sampler Pack
review_body: This was advertised to be an assortment of flavors, not 2 different brands of vanilla.  Had I just wanted vanilla coffee I could have just bought a box of that flavor only.  I had intended to try a variety to perhaps find a new flavor or two that I would enjoy.  I was very disappointed that the variety promised did not happen.  My Mother-in-Law enjoys vanilla and I will give these to her.  I will not buy from this vendor again.

product_title: Cafe Escapes Chai Latte K-Cups for Keurig Coffee Machines - 16 Pack
review_headline: My Favorite First Drink of the Morning
review_body:
I absolutely love my Chai latte and begin every day with it. It tastes great and has enough caffeine in it to keep me going though the day. Everyone on Facebook knows how much I love my Chai latte.

Marilyn[[ASIN:B005I56ZYM Bears With Us]]

product_title: Progresso Solid Light Tuna in Olive Oil, 5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Very tasty and the right size
review_body: No local stores stock tuna with olive oil.   This brand is very tasty and it comes in the right size for a quick salad or sandwich.

product_title: Roland Foods Basmati Rice
review_body: My wife and I have a [[ASIN:B00007J5U7 Zojirushi NS-ZCC10 5-1/2-Cup Neuro Fuzzy Rice Cooker and Warmer, Premium White]] and eat this rice with almost every meal. This rice cooks really well in our machine and has a better texture than the stuff we had been buying locally. We've gone through about 25 pounds of this rice already, and don't plan to switch brands.

product_title: Jelly Belly - Belly Flops - Irregular Jelly Beans - 2 lb. Bag
review_body: I bought this for my son-in-law.  He loves Jelly Belly's but said that the flops are just as good.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Spicy Eggnog K-Cups
review_headline: Just as good as eggnog, without all of the calories!
review_body: I love the Spicy Eggnog flavor.  When I saw it was still available on Amazon, I made sure to order enough boxes of Spicy Eggnog K-Cups to last me until next Christmas.  Usually I order from Green Mountain as a member of their coffee express club every 12 weeks.  However, my last two shipments fell at the beginning of November, before Spicy Eggnog was available, and the beginning of February, after Green Mountain had discontinued them for the year.  I was tickled to find them on Amazon.  Now I can enjoy the eggnog flavor any time I get a craving this year, even if it is the middle of June and 90 degrees.  Tastes almost like the real thing, minus the calories!

product_title: Flavor Fountain Ice Cream Flavoring - 1.7oz bottle - Mocha
review_body: Use all flavors to flavor food without calories and sugar.  Tastes great, but you MUST be careful on pricing.  I only paid $2.99 per bottle and at the time of writing this, the price is now $6.95.  Consumer beware!

product_title: MW Polar Fish, Flat Anchovies, 2-Ounce Units (Pack of 25)
review_body: They're Anchovies.  They're not as good as crown prince.  I took a gamble and picked these with a lower price, but should have forked over the extra ten bucks for quality.  The oil is \\"off\\" as are the anchovies themselves.  After a few seconds in your mouth they develop the right anchovy taste, but not until then... They might be okay if used in a recipe, but won't stand up for themselves on their own.

product_title: Coconut Dream Enriched Coconut Drink, 32 Ounce Aseptic Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Most delicious milk alternative! (But look for the best price.)
review_body:
This is not only the most delicious coconut drink on the market but also the most delicious and addictive of any milk alternative. The \\"original\\" flavour is just the right level of sweetness -- and it is far tastier than the \\"unsweetened\\" and \\"vanilla\\" options. This product is a treat to have in cereal or to drink on its own.

BUT (double-underlined!) you should NOT be paying $4.00/carton for Coconut Dream. Even at my over-priced local grocery store, this product sells for $3.59. So unless it's worth it to you to pay a premium to have 12 cartons delivered to your home all at once, I would suggest looking elsewhere.

I hope that other companies will begin to ship Coconut Dream through Amazon, thereby making the price more competitive.

UPDATE (Jan. 13): It looks like the price has gone way down since I posted my original review. Let's hope it stays low!

product_title: Bob's Red Mill 100% Organic Stell Cut Oats 24 oz. (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Steel Cut Oatmeal is the best
review_body: When I first started making steel-cut oatmeal instead of the typical rolled oats we all grew up on, I was sure I didn't have time in the morning to cook something for 20-30 minutes, as opposed to nuking it for 3-5. It actually turned out to be pretty easy, once I adjusted my habits a bit (e.g., to start the water as soon as I get to the kitchen). And it's definitely worth a little more effort, the increased flavor and texture are phenomenal. And after trying a few brands, I am very happy with Bob's Red Mill. It has a nice nutty taste on its own, and I also like to throw in some dried fruit and sliced almonds. I'd absolutely recommend you try this, and you'll be surprised at what a difference it can make in your breakfast experience. Now I find, the only time issue is one I create myself, since I slow down to pay attention to what I'm eating! instead of mindlessly eating-cereal-and-checking-email.

product_title: Circus Marshmallow Peanuts
review_headline: Hard as a rock, small bag
review_body: I had to return this item. The peanuts were not marshmallow at all, but hard as rocks. I doubt it would be humanly possible to bite and/or chew these peanuts. They were all stuck together in the package and there was residue all over the inside of the bag. I'm not sure if they are super old or the bag was not sealed properly. The bag I received was from sweetgourmet.com. First item I have ever had to return to Amazon. We are prime too so we are buying on here a few times a week

product_title: Lipton Iced Tea To Go, Lemon, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I bought this on special, thought it would be a good alternative for me than drinking straight bottled water all the time. I tried a few and didn't really like the aftertaste of the sugar substitute. But my wife and daughter loves them and finished the whole 12 (10 count) boxes, that's 120 individual packs of Tea. Now they keep asking for more, I know I'll end up get some but would like an alternative to the nasty aftertaste.

product_title: Millstone Caramel Truffle Decaf Ground Coffee, 12 Ounce Packages (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have a sensitive stomach but still enjoy a flavorful cup of coffee. I use to buy this brand from Walmart but now I am paying less money, convenient home delivery and getting the same excellent brew through Amazon.  Can't beat that.

product_title: AriZona Sugar Free Peach Iced Tea Mix, 1.9-Ounce Tubs in Cannister (Pack of 4)
review_body: This tea is awesome. It is the best artificial peach ice tea I've found. Unfortunately, it is not available in our area so guess where I looked first! And as always, Amazon came through. Really fast delivery. Comes in groups of four. Wish I had ordered more. I will next time.

product_title: Altoids Smalls Mints, 0.37 Ounce (Pack of 9)
review_body: Great way to buy Altoids.  MUUUUUCH cheaper than buying single packs in the storews.  I was going to pay this price for a 6 pack so when they came in and I got 9 packs I was VERY pleased.  Great bargin.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: I use in my refillable keurig  k-cup and it brews the perfect cup of rooibos. This is the best quality loose rooibos I've purchased. Will definitely be a regular order going forward.

product_title: Roland Quinoa, 5.46 Ounce Pouches
review_body: I love quinoa, so I was excited to try these flavored Roland Quinoa mixes for quick, easy side dishes.  I bought 3 varieties and tried the Mediterranean last night.  I was so disappointed!  It had a peculiar, almost medicinal taste. It was inedible. I hope the Black Bean and the Garlic flavors are a lot better. . .

product_title: Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn All-Inclusive Popping Kits - Real Theater Popcorn - 5 Pack - 27.5oz
review_body: I LOVE this popcorn! Very fresh, all but maybe 5 kernels popped, the flavor is awesome!! I recommend it to anyone that likes popcorn!!

product_title: Betty Crocker Supermoist Cake Mix, Golden Vanilla, 18.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Best Cake Mix Taste and Value
review_body:
Quick, easy, yummy and cheap. I too expected the worst for about a buck a box. It's wonderful! Now if the weather were cooler I'd fire up the oven more often :) I like it's plain flavor so it cradles and enhances the flavors of fresh seasonal fruits like berries and peaches AND of course ice cream.

Mug Muffin to be mixed, cooked AND eaten out of mug... In microwave safe mug Combine 4 Tablespoons Cake mix + 4 Tablespoons water. Mix well. Cook for 55 seconds on High. Let cool then frost/garnish as desired. Get your spoon and dig in :)

product_title: Earth's Best Antioxidant and Dinner Variety Pack, 4 Ounce Jars (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Great Product for my little one!
review_body: This is a great variety of foods so your little can try them all and see which ones he or she likes best.

product_title: Cocoa Powder,1 lb.
review_body: Quick delivery,  Excellent quality.  We make vegan raw protein bars for the family & go through it quite quickly.

product_title: Glass The Original Dirty Sue Premium Olive Juice, 12.69-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Dirty Sue is Very Concentrated & As a Result Well Worth the $35.18
review_body: I followed what I thought were the mixing instructions on the bottle and found that the flavor of the Dirty Sue mix was much too strong.  Needless to say, I had an incorrect ratio of vodka to Dirty Sue.  The second time that I fixed a martini I followed the directions found on DirtySue.com which is as follows:    THE DIRTY SUE  3 ounces of your favorite gin or vodka  1/2 ounce of Dirty Sue  Shake over ice and strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with two olives.    This recipe allows for 25 martinis per bottle of Dirty Sue....Wot a bargain!    DirtySue.com has quite a few of interesting martini recipes on their site.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Normal Coffee with a Kahlua Sticker
review_body: The only thing this coffee has related to Kahlua is the logo. I didn't expect alcohol, but I did expect some cream and sweetness included at the very least with anything branded Kahlua or Bailey's. It smells great but tastes horrible. All you really get from the Kahlua branding is a price markup with none of the qualities of Kahlua.

product_title: Dave's Gourmet Sauce, 5 Ounce
review_body:
Was at a market (World Cost Plus?)and came across this. There was another brand too, Melinda's or Meranda's...something, yeah. I decided to go with this one as the other had carrots and mango puree and other stuff (blah). I'm sure this is too make it not so hot but I figured this might cover up it's natural taste too.

So I stopped at Taco Bell on the way home. Figured start with something mild and got a ranchero chicken soft taco. Put one drop of this stuff and smeared it around. Not bad. Complimented it nicely. Second was a meximelt. One drop only again. This time it seemed they merged together and boosted each others spices. By the time I was done I had a nice long heat going and some sweats which lasted untill I got home.

You know when you take a shot of hard liquor on an empty stomach? That burn? Imagine that burn slooooowly moving through your system. Yeah, it' like that. I'm sure it will kill any parasites living in your intestinal tract. Might even remove any bubble gum you swallowed as a kid.

Next day, tried it again, this time on a burger. Threw some ranch on it and tried 2 drops this time. Got to my second burger and knew if I did 2 drops again that I might be in trouble, so went with only 1 drop.

1 or 2 drops per item seems to be the right amount. Pouring this stuff on like it was Tapatio WILL without a doubt lead to problems!! But I will be taking this to work for all those Tapatio junkies and others who just eat raw chilis straight up. Hehe, let's see if they think they're still macho now, huh?!! This stuff is deceiving! Seems fine at first, but man o man, that heat will catch up and bite you! I have bought the habanero version of Tabasco and didn't care for it. That was mainly vinegar with way too much of a black pepper type taste. It is hot, but I ended up throwing that away. This however, I definetly will be buying more of!!! It may overpower your food if you use too much of it, but for most part it mergeswith your food and creates a new flavor. Those who said it tasted bad or metallic must have had a bad batch.

By the way, me, i'm not....well wasn't a big chili person untill recently. I used that mild sauce (aka \\"weak sauce\\") up untill a few years ago. So I haven't trained myself into eating stuff as hot as this. Pretty much an average guy with a growing interest for new things : )

update: finally did try that Melinda's version of Naja. Did not care for it at all! It had a very quick bite to it and too much of that pepper extract taste (even though it isn't loaded with extract). Sadly the Melinda's is sitting the fridge, barely touched.....but my Dave's is almost done.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: The coffee was very, very good.  It was quite tasty, in fact I think I like it even better than any of their other blends.

product_title: Cameron's Gold
review_body: I have tried several varieties. I found this one to have a crisp flavor but lacking in body.   It's a good cup of coffee but nothing remarkable.

product_title: Pure Natural Bars, Peanut Butter, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Great if you love the taste of almonds and chocolate
review_body: PROS     - you get a generous package of 12 bars per box  - very chocolatey flavor if you like chocolate  - very strong almond flavor if you like almonds  - very moist, chewy snack bar    CONS    - the bar size is very small, so it's not a meal replacement; you would need to pair it with more food for an adequate meal  - I personally prefer a crunchy snack or granola bar, and if you don't like a bar to have a moist, chewy texture, you might not like this bar    SUMMARY    This is a good value for the price. I personally dislike the strong almond flavor with the chocolate. Pecans or peanuts would be more flavorful, but if you love almonds with chocolate you might like this bar. I has a much stronger almond flavor than an Almond Joy candy bar, but without the coconut to offset it.

product_title: Indianlife Dal Mix, 7-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 8)
review_body: I follow a special diet; gluten-free, dairy-free, sugar-free. It's difficult to find a tasty snack. I really enjoy the Dal-Mix, as it's crunchy, has a lot of flavor with a small amount of hot (I don't like my food too spicy or hot, just flavorful), and is easy to carry around with you in its zip-locked bag. We were just on vacation and I had taken a few bags with me. I thought I had had more, but ran out about 2/3 of the way through our trip; I was very disappointed that I hadn't taken at least one more bag.

product_title: 8 O' Clock Wholebean Coffee 100% Colombian - 42 oz. (Original)
review_body:
I am giving this PRODUCT a 5 Star review because I've been drinking 8 O'Clock Colombian coffee for years and love it. However, when I ordered this from the merchant \\"Eauction,LLC\\" who uses Amazon to fulfill their orders I did not receive the Colombian coffee. I received the 8 O'Clock \\"Original\\" coffee which is 100% arabica beans but is NOT Colombian. Based upon a 2009 review, for this same product, another consumer had the same problem. Fortunately, as this is fulfilled by Amazon returning it for a full refund was easy breezy and return shipping was paid by the merchant or Amazon.

I highly recommend this coffee but I would encourage you to buy it from another source at Amazon's Web site or you'll likely not get the product that's advertised and even though returns and refunds are handled professionally and promptly by Amazon, it's still a hassle to have to tape the box up, put the label on, and take it to the Post Office and retain the tracking number so you'll know Amazon received it in case the refund is not issued in a timely manner upon receipt of the return by Amazon.

product_title: Tabasco Original Sauce, Pepper, 12 Ounce
review_headline: An all natural hot sauce that compliments not overpowers..
review_body:
When it comes to adding a little kick of heat to some wings, or seafood, pizza or even a burger I turn to a brand of hot sauce that has not let me down in over 20 years of using it. TABASCO. What makes me stick to TABASCO pepper sauce, for some added heat, is how it adds the heat. This hot sauce does not come across overpowering which will destroy the natural flavor of the food. Instead it adds a sweet \\"kick\\" to your food, giving it added flavor while spicing it up a few notches.

This product contains Distilled Vinegar, Red Pepper and Salt. It is a very simple product that is all natural. TABASCO \\"Ages\\" their Hot Sauces in wooden barrels like one might age a wine. They re-use the barrels after a batch is done so with each batch the flavor continues to stay bold and get better and better.

Is TABASCO for everyone? Probably not as it does have some nice kick to it. However if you are a fan of spicing up the food in your life there is no better brand to have sitting around the house. It works for almost every food product out there and I personally would say it has about a \\"MEDIUM\\" heat to it(2500-5000 Scoville units). 5 stars for a product that has stood the test of time for over 150 years

**NOTE: If you are looking for a more \\"MILD\\" spice you should try the Green Pepper sauce. A nice sweet green pepper flavor with very little kick (600-1200 Scoville units)

**NOTE: If you want a more smokey flavor with your spice, try the Chipotle pepper sauce. It goes great with BBQ or meats with a soft kick. \\"MILD-MEDIUM\\" heat (1500-2500 Scoville units)

product_title: Jolt Caffeine Energy Gum, Icy Mint, 12 Count
review_body:
Jolt gum is a lifesaver. I've been chewing this stuff since I was in High School and, 5 years later, I'm still going. The 12 packs of Jolt last me over a year, but that's fine since they expire in one and a half. They're great to keep in your car, in backpacks, your desk at work, wherever. And just chew a piece when you need a little pick-me-up. One piece is perfect to wake you up when a professor or coworker is putting you to sleep with their presentation, or when you're working on a really monotonous project.

The taste is alright, and you start liking it after a little while. Each pack comes with 12 pieces of gum per pack, and each piece has it's own compartment (like Dentyne Ice), so you don't have to worry about having loose pieces of gum floating around once you open it (like with other energy gums). All in all, this is a great buy. It's much easier and less obtrusive to chew a few pieces of this than to go grab a cup of coffee.

One thing to note: the pack says that two pieces of gum have the same amount of caffeine as an energy drink. While this may be the case, two pieces of gum don't make you as hyper as an energy drink. Energy drinks also have taurine, guarana, loads more sugar, and plenty of other things to wake you up. This isn't a bad thing, though. It lets you control your energy level much easier.

product_title: Maxwell House Filter Packs
review_body: During the summer, I like to keep a pitcher of cold-brew coffee in the fridge for iced coffee (cold-brew coffee is less bitter than chilled hot-brew coffee).  These coffee packs are the easiest, no-fuss way I've found to make that happen.  Throw 2-3 packs (depending on taste) in two quarts of cold water, let it sit for 10-12 hours at room temperature, then remove the packs and refrigerate the delicious brew.  Serve over ice, with or without milk (or, for the particularly decadent, some half-and-half, or better still, a splash of cream).

product_title: Kuchenmeister Liqueur Cake
review_body: I bought this on a whim and they were tasty. I ended up giving two away as gifts. You can smell the amaretto when you open the packaging. I liked to heat it up to make it more gooey and less pound-cakey. But worth a try if you think you'd like it.

product_title: Kelloggs Frosted Mini-Wheats, Bite-Size Cereal, 58.8-Ounce Box
review_headline: Mini-Wheats ... Box (Pack of 2) does NOT mean Pack of 2 boxes
review_body:
The title of this product is \\"Kelloggs Frosted Mini-Wheats, Bite-Size Cereal, 58.8-Ounce Box (Pack of 2)\\".

I naively believed was a pack of two Kelloggs Frosted Mini-Wheats, Bite-Size Cereal, 58.8-Ounce Boxes, partly based on the obvious interpretation of the title, and partly because it was way overpriced to be a single box.

But it turned out that I actually got a SINGLE box of overpriced Kelloggs Frosted Mini-Wheats, Bite-Size Cereal, 58.8-Ounce Box.

Sure, the box DID pack two separate BAGS of mini-wheats inside the one box, but that hardly qualifies as a pack of two BOXES.

product_title: Martha White Buttermilk Cornbread Mix, 6-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: this is as good as it gets for great cornbread.  tastes like home made.   will order again

product_title: Maggi Seasoning 27fl.oz.(800ml)
review_headline: The most-used ingredient in our cupboard
review_body: If you haven't tried Maggi in your beef stew (or other beef or venison dish) then you really don't know what you're missing. I can't imagine cooking either venison or beef without it. It adds a deep rich goodness to any dish and we buy the big bottles to refill smaller bottles we leave by the oven/stove. We go through a lot of Maggi. :)

product_title: Great Northern Popcorn Organic All Natural Yellow Gourmet Popcorn
review_body: This organic popcorn was well priced and popped great!  My kids eat a lot of popcorn so having organic popcorn available is great!

product_title: Larabar Gluten Free Bar
review_body: Not all flavors are equal, so choose carefully to find one that matches your taste buds.  I, personally, love the cherry pie.  Who needs any other snack?  Not me!

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body: Ordered one just to see if it was any better than the original k-cup refillable, and it is far and away a much better design. I used a grind setting just a tad finer than for the drip coffee maker with excellent results. There was no water or grounds coming out anywhere and appeared to have a tight seal all around. It was simple to clean by rinsing out. We have a B60 and the ekobrew fit perfectly into the hole with no maneuvering whatsoever.

product_title: Green Mountain Naturals Keurig K-Cups, 72 Count
review_body: My wife, kids and I liked this hot apple cider so much that we've practically gone through our first order of 24 in less than a week so I am reordering.  As opposed to some of the hot chocolate k-cups, you can set the Keurig for mug size and still get a good tasting cup.

product_title: Wasa Crispbread
review_body: My daughter absolutely loves this stuff and she is a very picky eater.  It is also hard to find in the supermarket.

product_title: Red Rain Energy Shot, Berry Flavor, 2-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_body: This product seems to work the same as other similar energy drink products of this size, for a good price.

product_title: Mahatma - Saffron Yellow Rice - 5oz bag
review_headline: Great product, why are you buying it here?
review_body: This is a fantastic product, I have this at least once a week and often many more.  But at the time of this review, here, this product costs 5 TIMES what it does in the supermarket.  Look elsewhere, friends, as it is too expensive here.

product_title: Brothers-ALL-Natural Fuji Apple Crisps
review_body: They are tastey and addictive. Sure, the price is a bit much, but for 2 boxes of 12 bags each, I'd definitely order these again. You know that when there is only one ingredient: freeze-dried fruit, you really can't go wrong. I've made many of my co-workers into fellow addicts.

product_title: Oskri Honey Bar Turkish Delight, Gluten Free,  1.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 20)
review_body: These are pretty good.  I prefer [[ASIN:B0034EDLS2 KIND Fruit & Nut, Fruit & Nut Delight, All Natural, Gluten Free Bars (Pack of 12)]] or any of the KIND bars to these, but these are a cheaper substitute. They are sticky and sweet so you'll need to wash your hands after eating so they weren't great for eating on the go.  I do think their ingredient list isn't correct though.  There is no way it's 25% pistachios and only 4% rice (more like 50% rice) I can't taste the pistachios at all in it.  It's mostly rice, pumpkin seeds (taste like sunflower seeds) and apricots. I'm not sure I'd buy again, but I'll eat these.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic 2nd Gourmet Meals, Variety Pack, 4-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Great Variety Pack, Our Son Eats the All
review_body: Our son loves the flavor combinations in this variety pack, especially the chicken Mango Risotto. They can be a little runny so sometimes we mix in a little cereal to thicken them up for ease of spoon feeding but since he eats the whole jar, I can't complain. The texture doesn't seem to bother him.

product_title: RiceSelect Couscous
review_headline: Ditch the white rice, eat this
review_body: This is a very fine grained couscous, which allows it to be ready to eat in not more than 5 minutes.  If your carbohydrate staple is white rice, give this one a try.  It cooks faster, is more nutritious and tastes better too.  Mind that this doesn't come with it's own \\"spice\\" or \\"flavor\\" pack, and it may taste bland on when cooked just plain.  However it serves as a very good base.  You can add almost any ingredient to your taste to make a great couscous dish.

product_title: Chocolate Covered Jelly Rings by Joyva 5lbs
review_body: I received the jelly rings upsidedown, so all of the rings were all over the place and alot of the chocolate was broken off!! I also thought that I would be getting 7 lbs. of rings, not 5 lbs. For that price, I could have paid a little more at my corner Ralph Rottens for fresh and unbroken rings!! What a disappointment!

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: Residing in Canada, finding honeybush is quite difficult except in pricey upscale tea shops. My local tea shop has it but the price is approximately 20$/oz.    Here comes Amazon and Davidson's Tea where I could finally buy it in bulk for a reasonable price. The honeybush appears fresh and it has that strong aroma when you open the bag. Once brewed, it is not the tastiest drink but it is good served hot during a cold winter or iced cold during a hot sunny summer day. I add cinnammon, cardamom and/or lime zest to add taste to it.    It is healthy, caffeine-free and cheap, what could I ask more ? One advice though, transfer it to a sealed contained as Davidson's bags are not made for long-term storage.

product_title: Lipton Tea Bags, Family Size 48-Count,  12 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Lipton Family Size 48 count pack of 6
review_body: I have used Lipton tea for the past 40 years and the tea bag was the best improvement ever made.  Keep up the good work.  Except for twice a year Amazon is the cheapest place to purchase the family size bags.  Of course Prime shipping is a plus also

product_title: Tandoor Chef Chicken Tikka Masala, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: This tastes even better than the \\"Butter Chicken\\" you find at Indian restaurants, because it's not as greasy.  Actually, the delicious tomato-cream sauce makes this meal very addictive.  A reasonable portion size also.

product_title: Purple Sticky Rice, 10 Lb Bag
review_body: This rice is amazing! It smells like hot buttered popcorn when it's cooking and it tastes so god that it doesn't need any seasoning, sauce or anything else added to it.

product_title: Neuro Nutritional Supplement Drink, 14.5 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: I can't say if the supplement part works or not, but according to my wife who is very into the supplement components it's got the proper components that she thinks works. I personally like the taste. It's a bit of a light pina colada flavor to me.

product_title: Slim Jim Dare Smoked Meat Sticks, Habanero, .97-Ounce, Pack of 24
review_body: These are awesome, the flavor has just enough heat not to make it unbearable.  I highly recommend this product if you are one that likes spicy food.

product_title: Amish Country Popcorn
review_body: Disappointed in this popcorn, too many kernels did not pop, in the future I will not be purchasing this popcorn from Amazon.

product_title: Downey's Original Cake, 16 Ounce
review_body: tasty!

product_title: Lipton Black Tea, Loose, 1/2 pound Box
review_body: Haven't been able to find loose Lipton's tea in grocery stores for years and was delighted to find it here at Amazon. This is absolutely the best buy in tea I have made in my life. Received a very ample supply quickly at minimum cost and Amazon paid the shipping.    The Tea is as good as I remembered it and I am a happy camper again, able to make my own by the pitcher.    Thank you, Amazon.

product_title: Raven's Brew Whole Bean Deadman's Reach,Dark Roast 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: i was very excited, i love coffee, i mean i love it.  my first hint was the beans did not shine with their oils nor did the smell excite me.  second hint, it is just AVERAGE coffee it didn't blow my sox off at all, will not buy again, will attempt to return the second package also.  it is possible this seller sent me old product.

product_title: Traverse Bay Fruit Co. Dried Cranberries, 4-Pound Box
review_body: I am just placing my order for the 2nd box. These taste better than the Wholefood,and Trader Joe's - Price at about 60% off theirs.  Everyone who tasted this, from 4 year old to 84 year old loves it. The box of 4 lbs were gone in 2 weeks!!  Best buy in snack for us in 2011.

product_title: Lipton Tea Bags
review_body: I love Lipton Black tea, both regular and decaf, and I recommend both. The price was really nice and as ususal Amazon delivered quickly with no problems.

product_title: Conchita Guava Paste, Pasta De Guayava, 14 Oz Each (3pk)
review_body: Thank you for the product.  I grew up in South America and loved guava. I couldn't find it locally and I am very pleased withthis product!!

product_title: Shake N Bake Chicken Pouch, 2.05-Ounce (Pack of12)
review_headline: Easy to make (pretty much fool-proof) lol
review_body:
This is the first time I have ever received anything related towards food via Amazon, and it came in a box, with the pack of 12 inside a plastic bag all together. It has been 104 degrees in New York City recently, so the box was at room temperature but the pack of 12 inside the plastic bag was very warm to the touch.

I put it in the fridge just to be sure until I google to see that you can leave it outside, thus I'm an idiot but that is another story =)

Its pretty easy to make, just place the chicken inside a large ziplock bag, puts the crumbs of package inside, and shakes like no tomorrow, then places it in a pan, and put it in the oven.

Very convenient for those of us who have no time on our hands, are extremely busy or lazy, or when we want to give our wives a break from cooking on sundays :)

product_title: Giant Hershey's Chocolate Bar [5-Pound]
review_body: The negative reviews here are, they could get it cheaper. Well the Hershey web site listed it at $39.99 but then it it not available. The Big Y stores are only located in the North East and the product is Seasonal.    This product weighs 5 lbs but the shipping weight is 7 or 8lbs depending on packaging. That means a cost of any where between $10 and $20 depending on distance from the shipper.    Remember this is a Novelty product that the availability will vary depending on a lot of factors. (one of which is, chocolate prices are headed upward)    PS according to one reviewer it is 2 1/2\\" thick, NOT, it is more like an inch thick.

product_title: Lt. Blender's Wine Freezer, Sangria, 9.7-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Sangria Wine Freeze...LOVE LOVE LOVE IT!
review_body: My husband and I love this product.  we use a Blackberry wine or a Blueberry wine.  Thanks Amazon I can't find this product close to where I live....Great price and pack of 3 is so convenient.

product_title: Massimo Gusto Avocado Oil
review_body: Good,mild tasting avocado oil.Excellent value.Bottles arrived well packaged.This is a great oil for healthy stir-fries.Safe for high heat.Cheap enough to use for everyday cooking.  4-26-12:.After using this oil for last few months I upped my rating to five stars. product_title: Arrowhead Mills Organic Gluten Free Brown Rice Flour
review_headline: Need to eat gluten-free?  Don't buy this product.
review_body: Despite the label \\"wheat free, gluten free\\" on the packaging, this product is neither.  It caused serious illness when prepared and eaten, and it tested unequivocally positive for gluten when tested on an ELISA gluten test kit.  If you have celiac disease or are gluten intolerant, don't buy it.  Really too bad since buckwheat is a naturally gluten free product, but this company contaminated it during it processing.  The company has been informed of the problem, but has taken no action.

product_title: Emerald Nuts Cocoa Roast Almonds, Dark Chocolate
review_body: My coworker brought these into the office today and placed some in a bowl on my desk. I didn't see the container so I couldn't check the ingredients but knew as soon as I ate one that they had splenda on them. I have nothing against splenda in reasonable amounts (I use it in my lattes) but these taste like splenda covered almonds. These will go into the garbage.

product_title: Bonomos Turkish Taffy - Vanilla 24ct.
review_body: I love this candy and was so excited to find it here on Amazon. This brought back many memories from when I was a kid. I can't eat as much of it now but still love this Taffy!!

product_title: Schar Gluten Free Pizza Crusts
review_body: These are so fast and easy and they taste good. My VERY picky daughter loves them. We keep them on hand for when the rest of the family is having pizza. It works great.

product_title: Earths Best Organic First Food Fruit Starter Kit, 2.5 Ounce(Pack of 12)
review_body:
This is standard price. Babies R US and my local Path-mark sells these jars for 59. Cent each with by 12 totals $7.08 and I paid $7.04 here on Amazon. However it was delivered right to my door, no Bus, No gas, in my PJ's and with a very demanding 5-month old that is how I am dressed these days. I love these over Gerber or Beech-Nut, because they are all natural, no preservatives or hormones. I believe all of the additives and chemicals in our food is the cause for a lot of illnesses that plague our society. Why give your child crap when you don't have to and it is the same price. It also taste good. The bananas are a bit tart, though, but Bella loves them. She also suffered from constipation off and on and now that she has fruit in her diet once a day, her still seems to be regulated.

I do not remember the price at Target but it is sold there too.

This will be her brand of baby food from now on.

product_title: One 1 LB Tahitian Extract Grade B Vanilla Beans *** VERY DRY ***
review_body:
I have never bought vanilla beans before, but my mom and I wanted to make vanilla with vodka and vanilla beans (google it:) ) We weren't sure how many to order and didn't want to spend a ton since we had never done it before. These smell so strongly it is almost sickeningly sweet but not bad. Like I said, I have never bought them before so didn't know what kind to get but these are great. Also tons of beans! We bought 2 big containers of vodka and we easily have enough beans for 4!

I also found a recipe online to use the beans in sugar cookies and vanilla pudding and it tastes amazing with these beans!

product_title: Pamela's Simplebites Mini Cookies
review_body: I love Pamela's products, and Amazon is a great place to get a good prices!! I like these ginger snaps because they aren't too gingery, they're just right.... :)

product_title: Jiffy Biscuit Mix Buttermilk, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: Best mix for buttermilk biscuits I've ever found. easy to make, and does the job. As close as I can get to my great grandmna's home made biscuits.

product_title: Planters Recipe Ready Walnuts, 16-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: These walnuts were not fresh and impossible to enjoy. I suspect they're on sale because they're well past their sell-by date. You can taste the staleness.

product_title: Red Boat 40°N Fish Sauce, 8.45 Fluid Ounce
review_body: This is a very good fish sauce. It's very mild and subtle with good flavor. I put it on my pizza so I can have a little light anchovie flavor that my family can't stomach near their slice. I put it in my ramen and slip it in stews. It doesn't have a real fishy taste so it ads a good flavor people can't put their finger on. I rate it 4 star as it is expensive but it is additive free. Only salt and black anchovie, no MSG.

product_title: Cobblestone Kitchens Freezable Lime Margarita Cocktail Mix with Rim Trim, 12.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: I've purchased Cobblestone Kitchens Margarita mix before from retail stores, and it's the best out there....HOWEVER, i ordered these from Amazon, and I could have broken a window with the rock that was once the powder mix. Amazon clearly did not store this properly. On top of that, I paid more with Amazon than what I could have paid at the retailer. Lesson learned. SHOP LOCAL!!!

product_title: Maruchan Ramen, Roast Beef, 3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: There's really not much to it than the title. It says extra flavour, but its so bland and if you don't time it well,  the noodles go from rubbery to soggy in a split second.  I don't usually care enough about instant noodles to want to write a review, but this was pretty bad. But I suppose for the price, it keeps you full.

product_title: Betty Crocker Mashed Potatoes
review_headline: What Happened to BC Mashed Potatoes?
review_body: I remember when Betty Crocker introduced this line of mashed potatoes. They became a family favorite and every variety was good. Well it had been a few years since I had eaten them and decided to try the Original again and the Loaded flavor which is a new addition. What happened? Ever since Betty Crocker changed the packaging and cooking directions on their products the quality and taste has gone down hill. I'm seeing it across the board: complaints about the cake mixes, tuna and hamburger helpers, and now the instant potatoes. I tried making the Original potatoes 4 different times, trying to figure out the right ratio of water milk and butter, and each time the bits of parsley were like hard little bumps in the potatoes. They used to be soft and meld in with the potatoes. Couldn't get the mixture to the right consistency. The Loaded variety has a faint salty cheese taste. That's it. Not enough bacon bits like what's pictured on the box. Betty Crocker's directions are a joke. They are slowly but surely killing their reputation. Zero stars for the oringinal mashed varieties, two for Loaded, and that's being generous.

product_title: Gourmet Fries Seasoning Variety Set
review_body: It was our first time trying Chef's Fun Foods-was GREAT!  We tried the different flavors on all sorts of things and they really made everything taste better.  We had guests over who loved the seasonings and went home and placed their own orders on Amazon.  Everyone couldn't get enough of Chef's Fun Foods in their mouths!  It brings a whole new universe of taste.  We'll be back buying more soon.

product_title: Coffee People Donut Shop Coffee, Regular Medium Roast, K-Cup Portion Count for Keurig Brewers 24-Count (Pack of 4)
review_body: Great Product worth the money I would not buy anything other coffee.Do not have any other comments at this time
