review_body: I have been using alba coca butter lotion for 2 years and no lotion compares to this one. It moisturizes but doesn't leave a greasy or oily feeling and it smells amazing. Before I was using baby lotion but it would not moisturize as much as I needed and then I tried bath and body works lotion but that stuff actually causes my skin to break out in a rash. I will never stop using this lotion, I am very happy with it and i use it on my 4 year old son and he absolutely loves this lotiona s well.

product_title: Luzianne Specially Blended for Iced Tea, 100-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: I received this order faster than was promised and really appreciated it, where I live I cant just go to the store and buy some.

product_title: Nimm2 a well known Candy brand in germany
review_body: i grew up with those candies. so my kids and i loved them...it was like me being a kids all over again

product_title: Low-Carb Bread Mix
review_body: I have been experimenting with many different low carb bread recipes and been disappointed with all of them (horrible texture, flavor, etc).  I've been off my low-carb diet since Thanksgiving and have become addicted to the local bakery's jalapeno cheddar bread (VERY high in carbs), so I decided to experiment with Bob's Red Mill low-carb bread mix.  I had this item in my pantry for months before I made it and decided that yesterday was the day to finally give it a whirl.  I was amazed at how well it turned out!  I added in some diced canned jalapenos and a half a cup of shredded cheddar and cooked in a 2 lb bread machine (FYI - the bread did rise to the top and barely lifted the top open).  The texture is AMAZING!!!  The flavor isn't bad but still seems like its missing something.  I think it definitely needs some more flavor.  I'll probably add in a bit of splenda and a tsp of salt for starters....then maybe some garlic, basil, sundried tomatoes and maybe parmesan cheese.  It makes a great sandwich bread for the carb conscious.  I highly recommend you give it a try.

product_title: Keenan Farms Shelled Kernel Pistachio, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I prefer shelled pistachios, & these actually taste like pistachios (unlike the over-salted Sunkist brand shelled pistachios I'd been getting at the local Wal Mart). When Wal Mart ran out of them, I decided to try ordering them online & am glad I did. These pistachios are lightly salted & not quite as crunchy as Sunkist brand (which is fine with me; they taste great & are easier on my teeth). I plan to continue purchasing shelled pistachios from Keenan Farms (through Amazon.com).

product_title: Kellogg's Rice Krispies Gluten Free Cereal, Whole Grain Brown Rice …
review_body: I don't know what cereal the five star raters are eating, but it tastes like cardboard! They are mistaken that people who can't eat gluten always want to eat healthy. Get rid of the whole grain brown rice - yuk! There are plenty of \\"healthy\\" gluten free cereals on the shelves. Just give me the cereal I ate as a kid! People who cannot eat gluten want their food to taste like the product made with gluten. Rice Chex tastes way better than this! I didn't realize the used BHT until I read these reviews. Go back to the drawing board Kelloggs!

product_title: Lakerol Cassis Black Currant 24 Pack
review_body: Purchased a box of these at a specialty shop once while traveling and really enjoyed them. Now I purchased a case and am well pleased. I love black currants and these have a wonderful taste, plus they are sugar free.

product_title: Turkish Antep Pistachios (5 Pound Bag)
review_body: In the past, I've ordered Turkish Antep Pistachios from several places, including Zenobia and Bayside Candy (If I recall that name correctly), and Superior Nut had a far inferior product.  They just seemed much drier and far less flavorful than the others that I was used to.

product_title: El Guapo Vero Sandia Paleta, 4-Count (Pack of 12)
review_body: Bought these hoping they'd be like the ones I ate as a kid, but they weren't. Were pretty stale. unfortunately I bought 2 orders worth. What a waste. Hope you have a better experience if you buy them.

product_title: Coffee People Dark Roast, Jet Fuel, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_headline: Try a sample first if you can
review_body: I like strong coffee/espresso and was excited to try Jet Fuel after reading the reviews here.  After a week of drinking this coffee however, maybe I have a different definition of strong coffee.  Every day I drink this very average coffee on the way to work and say to myself, write a review so others don't do what I did, and buy 50 cups of the stuff.      It has a bitter taste with not a lot of anything else going on, and maybe that is what some people consider strong.  Maxwell House crowd perhaps.  I prefer coffee with more depth and complexity, i.e. Starbucks, and Jet Fuel misses that mark by a wide margin.      My favorite K Cups so far have been Donut Shop, Kona, and Caribou Blend.  Caribou is a great choice if you like bold and rich coffee, but now I am stuck with 50 cups of Jet Fuel.   Don't believe the hype.

product_title: Planters Peanut Butter
review_body: This peanut butter has a good, peanut taste. But too much sugar has been added. It's too sweet for me. Looking at other peanut butters, most of the popular ones do seem to have a lot of sugar. But this one tastes sweeter than the others I have tried recently in comparison. And that, to me, is not a good thing.

product_title: Liebers Cocoa Crisps, 5.5-ounces (Pack of 4)
review_body: So I bought these on a whim on managers special for about a buck a box on the four pack.  This is the correct price since they taste like cereal you'd buy at the dollar store.  The interior bag of cereal is much smaller than the box and the box cover shows round chocolatey puffs while the actual contents are deformed chalky circle shapes.  No chocolate flavor at all.  Am I missing something?

product_title: Living Intentions: Gone Nuts! White Chocolate Chip Cashews, Almonds, & Cacao Nibs, 3.5oz (Raw/Sprouted Snacks)
review_body: I was skeptic before i tried these, but they met my expectations and were of good taste. They were Not too sweet, not too bland. I could also digest these decently well without feeling bloating or flatulence (assuming that is because they were soaked and air dried).

product_title: Celebrate with a Crowd Gift Basket by ig4U
review_body:
I also ordered the [[ASIN:B005NJUI3M Snackalicious Food Gift Basket by Back Mountain Baskets Pre Order]] and I was hoping the disappointment I felt with that basket was a one off. I was wrong. These are horrible. The reason to buy a gift basket is b/c you want to send a nice classy gift to someone, esp in the business world. If you sent this people would be insulted!

The most weird off putting thing is the repackaging of the items. Why would they repackage the items in wheat thins boxes, crystal lite boxes, candy boxes and then print up fake labels?? Why? It does not look professional it looks homemade. I makes you wonder what they did to the food.

Speaking of the food -- it is NOT gourmet. Many of the times tasted bland and boring. Some even stale! Some I was just afraid to eat b/c of the repackaging. I am not kidding. This would be a no star review if I could.

**EDIT**
after I wrote this review Black Mountian now ig4U sent me a new basket. It was packaged so much better. It didn't look scary fake like the first one did. I appreciate the company's effort to make right something that was not good. I think that a person would be ok sending out their new and improved baskets. I still stick to my original post that I think the food items were boring and not names that people would know but they tasted fine this time. In fact I brought it in to share with my office and it was devoured within an hour. I change my star rating to 3 stars.

product_title: Maxwell House International Coffee Hazelnut Iced Latte Singles, 6 Count, 3.42-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8)
review_body: I mix this with a tablespoon or two of vanilla cream and the rest skim milk....delicious! Creamy and smooth, tastes like a liquid version of nips coffee candy.  It is also good and not as sweet sans the cream.

review_headline: Not as shown in the picture...
review_body: Since the picture shows six different type of bottled water, I thought I would get all of those kinds in each shipment (I signed up for subscribe & save). However, I only got 24 bottles of one kind, not six different kinds... Very dissapointed, especially that the kind I received was the one that I don't like the most. I canceled the subscribe & save order for this product.

product_title: Saucy Mama Chipotle Mustard
review_body: While I don't have the appropriate mustard-lover's vocabulary of adjectives to describe Saucy Mama's Smoky Garlic Mustard, I'll try my best to communicate to you its wondrous charms.  Not the brash, yellow mustard of ball park hot dogs and bologna sandwiches, nor the sinus-clearing, pungent stone-ground brown mustard offered from the rear windows of chauffeur-driven limos, this mustard is creamy and smooth -- not blandly mild, but rather a fitting base for the soupcon of smoke and the assertive punch of garlic in every lovely slather stroked on your sandwich, your country ham, and especially your grilled sausages and pork roasts.  Mmmmmmmmmmm.    [[ASIN:B004WHC4OW Saucy Mama Smoky Garlic Mustard, 9-Ounce (Pack of 6)]]

product_title: Stahly's Vegetarian Scottish Haggis 15 Oz (Pack of 2 )
review_body: Ever since I became a vegetarian, I've missed the taste of my grandmother's haggis.  Yay!  Now I can have it again without sheep parts.

product_title: Bali's Best Green Tea Latte Candy, 5.3-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I found Bali's Best candies on another site, but they didn't have the green tea latte flavor. This Candy has a moderate green tea taste (stronger than many candies) and has a very smooth taste. It is not too sweet and a good balance of green tea and mild sweetness. The other Bali's Best candies are equally as delicious and have unique flavor profiles.

product_title: Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks, Sweet and Salty, Chocolate Peanut Butter, 6-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: not too sweet, not too salty. One cannot eat a whole bag in one sitting but that makes it all the better!

product_title: Ener-G Foods Tapioca Loaf, 16-Ounce Packages
review_body: Very happy with this product. I always have the bread toasted, so I can't speak for it any other way. Very good!

product_title: DEBOLES PASTA ARTI FETTCNE ORG, 8 OZ
review_body: I purchased because of a recommendation from Doctor Oz.  I did very much enjoy the product.  It was not sticky and the taste was great.  I love pasta, so it was very nice to really find one that I enjoyed so much.  Amazon is great for ordering.  I have been very pleased with purchases.

product_title: Chef Paul Seasonings Parent
review_body: Chef Paul spices are simply the best! Paul Prudhomme is one of my favorite chefs, a real genius with foods.  His spices will make any backyard chef a master. I've not had anyone not remark on how good the steaks, chicken, fish, pork, or shrimp is.  I tried finding it in grocery stores, and it was a waste of time. Buy it on Amazon. I ordered it in the larger packages, and it's economical that way.

product_title: Edward & Sons Exotic Rice Toast, Thai Red Rice & Flax Seed, 2.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Not too salty, deliciously crunchy, perferct cracker!
review_body: This excellent cracker just happens to be gluten free and I am obsessed with them! They are boxed in two trays wrapped in foil packaging that are a bit difficult to open. The crackers are a good size, and can easily fit a dollop of mustard, a piece of cheese, and a cherry tomato half or olive piece. I enjoy eating risotto with these crackers to add a touch of salt and crunch to the rice dish. These would be perfect party crackers, too, but I prefer to just keep some at my desk at work to munch on in my down time.

product_title: Blue Diamond Almonds, Bold Wasabi & Soy, 1.5 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_headline: It's like crack, without the cocaine base
review_body: I don't know what they put in these things, but whatever it is it's addictive. The combination of soy sauce salty and wasabi spicy create the perfect storm of \\"I'm going to eat this entire can RFN.\\"  The cans are all perfectly sealed and the almonds are always fresh - what else can you ask for? The cost is also lower than in local stores, but you can buy the larger bags cheaper (per oz) from some Walmarts if you can find them.  Almonds are supposed to be appetite suppressants, but for me it's usually because I ate an entire can of them and am not hungry any more.

product_title: Bulk Save Voss Artesian Still Water 12 to 48 packs each 800ML
review_body:
I actually bought one of these at a local grocery store.

Yes... it's just regular water (except the sparkling one, which is pretty good), but $5 for a huge glass like this great awesome to me. I use it for pure cranberry juice, and delude it with water all the way to the top, it looks like a health vial from a videogame! How sweet is that? Works well for kool-aid to get a cool liquid color too.

I only bought to of these at the grocery store.
Not sure I would recommend buying it from here or not, depends if you really want 12 cool glass things or not. I'm fine with 2.

product_title: Smucker's  Orchard's Finest  Michigan Red Tart Cherry Preserves, 12-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: One of the best "jams" I have ever tasted
review_body:
We all remember the Saturday Night Live bit - \\"With a name like Sumcker's, it has to be good...\\" But in reality, they really do make wonderful products. My wife is really partial to cherry jellies and jams so when I saw their \\"Orchard's Finest\\" Michigan red Tart Cherry Preserves, I decided to be a home hero and surprise her with a jar. I didn't make a big deal about it. I just presented her with a Thomas's English Muffin (my favorite - even better - for me - than the much praised wolferman's english muffins) with the cherry preserves lovingly applied. Just like Igor in Young Frankenstein, she made yummy noises. She loved it and I was number one on the hit parade.

She (we, actually) finished the jar quite quickly and this morning, we dipped into a Cherry Jelly from another famous and well regarded brand. No comparison - the Smucker's just flat blew the other brand away.

Like cherries? Like Jelly? Want to have a breakfast party on your toast? Try this wonderful product.

product_title: 9GreenBox - Lucky Bamboo - Ceramic Vase 2 Set
review_body:
Just picked these up - couldn't resist two sets of little bamboo plants for $10! Some notes:

1) \\"little bamboo plants\\" are roughly a foot or so outside the vase. Not complaining, and it might say that somewhere, don't remember. Just a heads-up on the exact size.

2) I kinda assumed it would come with little decorative stones for around the roots - most other bamboo arrangements do. Not so much apparently. Vase, bamboo, there ya go. Again, totally not a deal-breaker, but I woulda picked some stones up if I'd realized that >.<

I take a star off for the lack of stones or anything. Overall though, very nice looking little bamboo plants! =)

EDIT: I had taken a SECOND star off for the lack of stones/soil, because the description claimed it had some, and I didn't see it. But I found it. Is some clear crystally stuff wrapped up with the roots. Still would have preferred stones, but they provided what was described so I'll give em their stars back =)

PS- Still get rocks or more soil. What they give you isn't enough even to hold the plants upright. Still not taking stars, they're gorgeous little plants, I'm happy. =)

product_title: United With Earth Medjool Dates, 16-Ounce Containers (Pack of 4)
review_body: Very nice product, soft and fresh and the price is as good as it gets!  Arrived on time and packaging was fine, no damage

product_title: DaVinci Pasta, Tricolors, Wagon, 16-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: This was a great find and perfect for Christmas gifts this past year. The flavor was great and it stored well! Thanks Amazon for another great find!

product_title: Kalamata Black Olives, 6 jars, pitted, Martinis
review_headline: Wonderful olives packed with NO VINEGAR!
review_body: These are easily the best prepackaged kalamata olives I have ever eaten.  All other brands I've tried are packed with vinegar, which gives the olives an unpleasant sourness and masks the olives' splendid complexity of flavour.  For years we bought these at Trader Joe's stores, but since they have switched to another supplier for their store-branded kalamata olives (yes, packed in the ubiquitous vinegar solution) I am very happy to be able to purchase these online.  Delicious for your relish trays or to snack on anytime, or cut and added to your favorite pasta, foccaccia, salad, or other preparation, the Martini brined kalamatas can't be beat.

product_title: Sugar-Free Almond Bark - Wisconsin Cheeseman
review_headline: Sugar free but not taste free
review_body: The peanut brittle is delicious.  I am a diabetic and really enjoy this tasty treat.  Do not hesitate to buy this product.

product_title: Allergy Research Group FLAX SEED OIL, SOFTGELS 100
review_body: This flax seed softgel is a quality product and delivers a quality amount of the falx oil I need on a ddaily basis. This price was very good too. I use Allergy Research vitamins often as they have always been a good value.

product_title: Namaste Foods, Sugar Free Gluten Free Pizza Crust Mix, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Gluten free and easy pizza crust
review_body: Great product.  Super easy to prepare. Spreads on a pizza pan or stone like thick cake batter, but does not stick.  Almost impossible to burn as well. Love it!!

product_title: Lotte Koala Cookie Chocolate, 1.45-Ounce Cookies (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are really great. They are just as good as I remember from years ago. Buy a few...these won't last very long!

product_title: Hormel Mary Kitchen Reduced Sodium Corned Beef Hash, 15-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: Should be called potatoes with corned beef.  Flavor of corned beef was missing, maybe because it was reduced fat.  Consider it storage food.

product_title: Honibe Honey Drop with Lemon 12 Count Box
review_headline: They are great!  Packaging could use some work though
review_body: I am a tea fanatic, 4-6 cups a days of all sorts of loose leafed teas from local tea shops around town, and grabbed these at a local grocery store last week to try out.  I am also a fan of honey, all sorts, although I prefer local/organic raw honeys over the mass-produced cheap kind.  I will be travelling for Christmas this year and portable honey sounded great!  First impression was that a box of only 20 was a tad expensive - you can buy a bottle of very quality honey for the same price, but the bottle would last you much much longer.  However, I still bought it and tried it out, and here are my impressions:  CONS:  -  Some of the drops had oozed/leaked and the inside of the box was a tad sticky.  Also, some of the drops were sticky.  Not impressed with the packaging job.  -  When popping open 1 serving of the honey, it wasn't solid like a hard candy would be, it was a tad gooey, and I had to dig it out with a spoon to get it into the hot water because it was stuck to its container.  It didn't just pop right out.  It says on the box that you can hold this honey in your hand... no you can't and I wouldn't recommend it!  haha  -  As previously mentioned, a tad pricey for only 20 servings  PROS:  - Perfect portion size for 1 cup of tea if you like your tea just mildly sweetened.  You will need 2+ drops if you like it very sweet  - Flavor is very good and you can taste the lemon.  It seems like a good quality honey was used.  - Great for travelling IF you put the drops into a Ziploc bag or other leakproof container, as some of them were sticky, so something must have leaked somewhere in the box.  It's a \\"peel off the foil and pop out\\" sort of container for each drop, so if you throw these loose into your purse and something pierces the thin foil, you're in trouble!  -  Directions for use were spot-on.  It says to drop the honey in hot water and stir for 30-60 seconds.  I was stirring for almost 60 seconds!  It's such a solid piece that it takes some working to get it all to dissolve, and of course the hotter the water, the better.  This was an impulse buy and I will probably only save the use of this honey for when I am travelling since it was so expensive per serving. The honey tasted very good and seemed of good quality but the packaging had some issues.  I haven't tried them as throat drops, but it sounds like a great idea!  I will probably stick to my raw honey in the jar or bottle for everyday use though... these are just a novelty for now!

product_title: Organic Coconut Oil 16 Ounces
review_body: This is a very unique oil, you can use it in your hair as a hot oil treatment, use it to soothe pain on an infected area on the skin, you can use it when cooking. I like the solid form of this product. No spills, melt what you need. Nice fragrance too.

product_title: Krema Cashew Butter, 12 oz
review_body: It is a good healthy but for me it is so dry. I added honey mix. It is OK I still explore which better for me.

product_title: Godiva Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa Can, 14.5-Ounces, 2 pack
review_body: Tired of those insipid supermarket hot cocoa mixes? Waiting for the taste of real deep, dark, rich chocolate? Well, then you will not be disappointed with Godiva's Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa. Definitely made for serious chocoholics. I am now totally addicted. Once you've tried it, you will never go back to Swiss Miss, Nestle's or any other whimpy imitations.

product_title: Cinnamon Sugar-Free Nut and Flax Granola, 9 oz. bag by Sensato Foods
review_body: I am always seeking healthy low-carb products, and this one is delicious! It satisfies my sweet tooth, the ingredients are healthy and no artificial sweeteners. And the low net carb count comes from it's high fiber content, which is a definite plus for those of us watching carbohydrate intake. I have tried the cinnamon and the cherry, and I absolutely love both! And, with the high fiber, they are filling. My husband even likes it! Highly recommended!

product_title: Oolong Tea 5.00 Lbs (In Loose Form, Not Tea Bag)
review_headline: Good flavor, good value, needs hygiene
review_body: This is an outstanding value for those who use tea in large quantities. Oolong is a special variety of tea whose flavor varies from robust to very mild depending on variety and processing. This particular variety is midway between green and black tea, with a nutty flavor but no need for lemon or milk. The main turnoff for me with this particular product was the lack of hygiene. Most leaves are not whole. There's a lot of powder and many twigs. Some oil floats to the surface. Worst of all was the long, black human hair that surfaced in one batch. Nobody in our house has hair like that. If you choose to buy this tea, I strongly suggest washing it before you brew. Fortunately, Oolong stands up well to that sort of treatment, and you can generally brew more than once with each batch. This product would probably work well in a restaurant that wants to offer a variety of hot tea choices.

product_title: MW Polar Foods Polar Herring In Paprika Sauce, 6-Ounce (Pack of 9)
review_body: Bought these at a very good price, wish I had purchased more at the time. The paprika flavor is very suttle and the flavor of the fish still shines through.  Polar makes a great regular kipper and these are no exception.  I would recommend these to anyone.  They make a welcome change to regular kips.

product_title: St. Dalfour French Bistro (Gourmet On The Go), Ready to Eat  Wild Pink Salmon, 6.2-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body: I purchased a dozen after a friend shared one of hers with me ~ it had some nice chunks of salmon.  So far I have opened four of the dozen I have and there seems to be no control over potatoes (starch, carbs) vs. protein (salmon) deposited into the containers.  One was okay but not quite what I remembered; second had very little salmon but I thought maybe it was a fluke; third had one large chunk of salmon; fourth had 'flecks' of salmon that I had to hunt for.  If you like ample potatoes and nicely done white beans with a little color of carrots you'll be happy.  Should be labled as veggies with essence of salmon.  (signed Stephen's Wife)

product_title: Chaokoh Coconut Milk, 13.5-Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Cans arrived dented BUT usable. This product is delicious.
review_body: The quality of the coconut milk is not over emphasized. Silky, smooth and rich without any grit or grain. Great for soups or smoothies, tastes mild and normal raw; no bitterness, no sourness. Good in cereal or in chocolate milk. Yum. Yum. Yum.    Only drawback: The cans are clearly new/fresh but must have been dented when shipped from the originating distributor because Amazon packed them well. If dented cans are what we have to put up with for this deal then we are sold. Our manual-can-opener worked just fine on all.

product_title: AriZona Sugar Free Green Tea with Ginseng & Honey Iced Tea Mix, 1.7-Ounce, 2 QT Stix in Canister (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Just like the jugs if you water it down a bit
review_body: These are a great value but the instructions on the package are way too strong - It recommends one packet per 2 quarts of water, I found that 1 packet per 3-4 quarts delivered much better flavor

product_title: Medim Wooden Dreidels W/english Translation - 100/pack
review_body: I couldn't wait to get this order because my son was using it as part of his Mitzvah project to raise money. However when I recived it I was sent 100 SMALL wood dreidels not the medium ones ordered. I contacted Amazon, returning the item, and am getting my money back because I wanted the medium ones. I was impressed that each dreidel was individually wrapped. One thing that you don't know when ordering is that the colors are same on each side. I was thinking that maybe the SHIN side would be a color, HAY another color, GIMMEL another and NUN another, but if one side is red they are all red. There are assorted colors of dreidels, but each one has only one color on it. They appear high quality even though they were the wrong size.

product_title: Snak Club Cinnamon Bears, 12 ounce bags, (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love cinnamon bears and I was so glad when I found this 6 pack because now I can stay stocked up on them!  Each bag comes with a sticker to reseal it.  They can to me perfect and soft which made me happy because I was worried that they would be all dried out and hard!

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: I was so happy to find this refillable K-Cup!  I bought one and felt the need to buy another one!  My husband and I use it several times a day and it's doubtful we will ever buy the singles again!  One thing though, watch for the cap to break off, it will still work though!

product_title: McCormick Large Specialty Vegetables
review_headline: shallots on hand all the time
review_body: Great way to keep shallots on hand.  The fresh ones are not inexpensive especially if part of it is wasted.  This allows me to have it on hand and not have to run out to get them at the last minute.  Convenient to have and taste is very good.

product_title: Cameron's Gold
review_headline: A Fantastically Rich and Dark Bean.  Smooth and Silky Every Time.
review_body:
With the high price of coffee beans these days, and me being an avid coffee drinker, I thought I would take the opportunity to try out some different beans here on Amazon. I had been an Eight'O Clock Coffee drinker over the last few years, but in addition to their prices starting to rise, I've noticed that the quality of their bean has gone down over the last year. With that - enter Cameron's Organic French Roast Whole Bean Coffee! I had never heard of Cameron's before, but am I ever glad that I purchased it - I now have a new coffee for home!

Cameron's delivers a high quality French Roast bean. When you open the bag, you immediately know you are in for a treat. In addition to the rich smell, the beans are very dark and moist. You can tell they were roasted perfectly. They grind into espresso roast nicely with a good grinder. Finally, they come through the brew in an amazing blend of smooth and silky textures. The taste matches and surpasses the rich smell. It is bold and impressive. It will make your mornings so much happier. Highly recommended!

product_title: Yuban Original Ground Coffee, 33-Ounce Cans (Pack of 2)
review_body: I am so glad that I have found that Amazon sells this.....In Los Angeles, where i just moved from, finding Yuban in the big cans was no problem, and it was often on sale at the Smart and Final for 11 bucks for the big can. Should have stocked up, because its about 6 bucks for the SMALL can here in Georgia. Huh? I am absolutely going to buy this coffee from Amazon, two cans for around twenty bucks is a massive deal. People have laughed at me when i tell them my favorite coffee is Yuban, because its made by the Kraft company- but let me tell you, to me, its THE best coffee i have had and I worked in a coffeehouse where we were encouraged to try every coffee on the wall. Now that i have, good ol' Yuban is my favorite. Keep your gourmet blends. And the Rainforest thing they have going on is pretty great too, which is why i tried it initially.

product_title: Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter
review_body: If you like chocolate and peanut butter then you must try this, absolutely the best! Keeps my chocolate cravings satisfied with protein instead of a not so healthy candy bar.

product_title: Kraft Mayonnaise
review_body: This mayonnaise has a very good flavor and consistency. Other brands I've tried in addition to being less flavorful also seemed to separate out leaving water in my well drained tuna. One more convenience is that the jar is close to vertical to the top making it easier to get to the last with a spatula.

product_title: Pepperidge Farm Goldfish Grahams Crackers
review_headline: PEPPERIDGE FARM GOLDFISH CHOCOLATE GRAHAM CRACKERS(PACK OF 8)
review_body: A delicious great tasting product by Pepperidge Farm that normally cost you $2.49 per bag, sometimes on sale at the supermarket 2 for $4.00, but I picked my Pepperidge Farm Chocolate Graham Goldfish Crackers (Pack Of 8) through Warehouse Deals fulfilled by Amazon.com and shipped free to my home for an awesome price of ONLY $10.63!!! If you can get a deal like this I highly suggest purchasing it right away! If not, no worries and try getting it a little more than my bargain for no more $13.00 in my opinion, seeing as if you were to pay the retail suggested price on bag for $2.49 X 8 = $19.92 would still be a bargain if you look at it this way like I do! Good Luck and happy bargain shopping, ENJOY!!!

product_title: Moyishi Calendula Flowers - Herbal Tea Marigold - 1 lb. Bulk
review_body: This supplier knows what she is doing! I wasn't sure about ordering calendula flowers but gave it a try. (Her lavender and muslim bags were great). However, I needed some for facial care products and baby cream I was making. She delivers again. I am quite pleased with the quality and the look. A pound of calendula is a lot! I plan on making teas out of it as well. She also included a sheet on good uses for it.

product_title: ZICO Natural Coconut Water,11.2 fl. oz. (Pack of 12)
review_headline: The best I've tried so far :)
review_body: I haven't tried every brand, but I've tried ONE and Vita Coco and found that I prefer the taste of ZICO. I can't provide a very complex comparison as I've been drinking ZICO for a while, but the one word that comes to my mind as far as the taste, compared to the other brands is \\"cleaner.\\" It just tastes more refreshing and I use it as a substitute for Gatorade or Powerade after workouts and athletic activities. Highly recommended if you are looking for a good-tasting coconut water that is not from concentrate. Also worth noting is that the Amazon price is a bit better than the prices at local supermarkets: I've been happily subscribing and saving to it for over a year now :).

product_title: Durkee Steak Dust, 29-Ounce Containers (Pack of 2)
review_headline: My beef brisket wasn't the same without it!
review_body: Like everyone else, we found this at Sam's Club and were upset when they didn't sell it anymore.  As other reviewers have said, it truly makes the best steaks and burgers.  In addition, I also use it liberally when I slow cook a beef brisket (After trimming the fat, cover in steak dust and bake at 275 degrees for about 8 hours).  My beef brisket was not the same without it.

product_title: Billy Bee 100% Pure All Natural Clover Liquid Honey, 16 oz. Squeeze Beehive (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have used this honey my entire adult life (40 years). I have tried Sunflower Honey and other brands where the country of origin is a multiple choice. But, Clover Honey has it's own distinct taste and this Canadian brand has an incredible, non-crystallizing shelf life.  Because I live in the U.S.A., I have had to drive into Canada and bring this tasty product home.  Border ugly!  Thank you, Amazon, for offering a stress-free way to satisfy my preference.

product_title: Taiwan Dried Ume Plum
review_body: This is a great tasting Sour Plum, Savorly addictive. Reminds me of a Saladito without the Salt. Ummmh. Reminds me of a Cured prune my Aunt used to bring from Hermosillo Sonora no longer available.

product_title: Nonni's Cioccolati & Chocolate Hazelnut Biscotti, Net wt 1 lb 15.2 oz , 25 Count
review_headline: Great!  But Not at this price!
review_body: Nonni's are great...they are all natural and even fit into my weight loss program!  However, the 25 count box are only $9.25 at Sam's Club.  Amazon is a bit over priced on this product!

product_title: Beach Cliff Sardines in Soy Oil, 3.75-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: I used to love beach cliff sardines - especially in mustard sauce - but their quality has gone downhill so much I can't even finish what I have. They are dry, sauces are cheap tasting and there aren't even enough to make a decent sandwich any more. On top of that I got brushed off when I contacted them. Concerning the three sardines they said that the cans are packed by weight and not quantity. Well... I don't buy it. If the sardines were small, the can would be *full* of small sardines. If the fish were bigger, the can would be *full* of a few big sardines. Maybe they're dense, heavy fish so only three fish with lots of space left over.  I guess Beach Cliff is another American company cutting corners to drive themselves into oblivion/bankruptcy.

product_title: Cruncha ma-me Edamame Veggie Snack, 0.7 Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_body: This is a great snack! It tastes great and it's healthy and tasty --a nice alternative to nuts and dried fruits--perfect for tossing into a backpack before a hike, watching the game, or for an on-the-go snack. The 8-packs will tide me over until there's a family-size pack available.

product_title: Twinings Earl Grey Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 12-Count (Pack of 3)
review_body: I tried brewing this tea on every setting and still it came out tasting like lightly flavored water. The smell was slightly on target but it too was very weak. I would not recommend this tea or the English breakfast. They both are a waste of money. Drink hot water instead.

product_title: Starbucks Breakfast Blend, T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 12-Count Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: Easy to make a fresh, hot cup of deliciously rich and bold Starbuck's coffee with the T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers and if you add auto-ship, one never runs out.

product_title: Rhythm Superfoods Hickory Bar-B-Q Sweet Potato Chips, 1-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I recently discovered Rhythm Food's Kale Chips and decided to give their Sweet Potato Chips a try.  I'm sad and disappointed to report I didn't care for them and will not purchase again.     First the chips still had a slight raw taste to them unlike the kale chips. I realize that this is suppose to be a raw food so I might be getting a lot of \\"duhs\\" from anyone reading this review.  If you don't mind the starchy flavor and are use to \\"raw\\" food then this won't bother you however if raw foodies want to convert someone to the raw food lifestyle I wouldn't suggest using this product as an introduction.     Second the Bar-B-Q flavoring is lacking and barely covers the chip (maybe this is the entire problem?) so the Bar-B-Q flavor barely came through.     Otherwise the chips had a great crunch to them so if you don't mind my first two complaints then I can positively report that these would satisfy the need for a crunchy snack.

product_title: Canterbury Naturals Coconut Macaroon Cookie Mix, 9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: These were the easiest macaroons I have ever made.Everyone loved them and could not believe I just added water. Next time I will try dipping them in chocolate. It is too hot right now and they would melt. I highly recommend.

product_title: Kellogg's Mueslix, 15.3-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5)
review_body: The Kellogg Mueslix Cereal was ordered one evening and just a couple of days later it arrived. The item was well packed. Contents were fresh. Encountered no problems  and plan to use this resource again.

product_title: Xan Confections All Natural Ladybug Truffles, 6-Piece Assortment (Pack of 2)
review_body: These marvelous goodies were wonderful to share with family at Christmas. Of a generous size, they can be enjoyed over a longer period of time. Artistically presented, each in their own container. I bought two boxes, and the second will be my Valentines treat! Well worth the price.

product_title: Gerber 3rd Foods - Vegetables, 6-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I understand that the smell of cooked broccoli isn't the greatest, but we gradually introduced this to my son who absolutely loves it. It's also a great way to get some vegetables in him too.

To each their own I suppose...

product_title: Sun Maid Calimyrna Figs, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Dry as Shoe Leather and Tasteless -- AVOID!
review_body:
Received these figs from Amazon and was horribly disappointed. They are almost inedible. They are extremely tough and as dry as shoe leather. There is very little fig \\"meat\\" inside the leathery skin.

I will look elsewhere from now on. I have had Calimyrna figs before and know what to expect. These \\"figs\\" from Sun-Maid are only fit as a food source for starving cattle! Where is the quality control at Sun-Maid?

product_title: Earth's Best Organic 2nd Dinner Variety Pack, 4 Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_body: I purchased this food on Amazon then saw it at Babies R Us for 30 cents less per jar.  I like the product but AMAZON is overcharging!

product_title: Halo Purely For Pets Liv-a-Littles Protein Treats 100% Wild Salmon -- 1.6 oz
review_body: I had to put my 6 month old kitten on a limited ingredient diet. There are a lot of limited ingredient and Hypoallergenic foods out there (well not a LOT, but at least options), but good look finding limited ingredient treats for cats. Good luck finding any cat treat that doesn't have chicken or chicken meal in it. These pure salmon treats were the only thing I could find, and thank goodness, my cat LOVES them! She purrs when I get out the container, and barely lets me break them up into her bowl before eating them. I usually get little salmon crumbs all over her head because she will shove her way in there...even when we open the fridge, she tries to poke her head in there to see if she can find them :) I've found that it is really important when raising a cat to be able to reward them for good behavior. Positive reinforcement is the key, and I wouldn't be able to do that without these treats. Thank you Halo! The salmon sprinkles are also great for encouraging them to eat wet food if it's not their favorite thing.

product_title: Ice Breakers Gum Big Pack Cool Mint - Hershey
review_body: I looked everywhere for this gum for my husband. So , I checked where I can usually find the impossible....Amazon!!!Thank you for saving me!!!

product_title: Earth's Best 2nd Vegetable Variety Pack, 4-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_body: My baby and toddler both love this baby food. I tasted the food myself, and enjoyed the taste. The other baby foods do not taste so good.

product_title: Russell Stover Sugar Free Chocolate Delight Snack Bar, 5-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: This item will satify your taste for chocolate. The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is because by the time you add shipping, it was alittle pricey to me. I still may order somemore because of the wonderful taste.

product_title: Chicken of the Sea Chunk Light Tuna in Oil, 5 oz Tins, 24 pk
review_headline: Tastes okay. Loaded with soybean oil.
review_body: Almost every can I received was dented but I guess it's to be expected at this great price.     The taste was okay but I have to say I'll never buy this again for the simple fact that the soybean oil spilled all over my can opener and counter top EVERY SINGLE TIME I opened a new can. Probably didn't help that they were all dented but still it was a mess no matter how careful I was.

product_title: (Food Grade) Utah Red - Jurassic Salt - (Fine) Rock Salt
review_body: I have chronic high blood pressure and my naturopathic dr recommended this salt to help my sleepy thyroid and overall health.  Because it has iodine it helps my thyroid.  Because the salt is natural with no added anti-caking ingredients it will not have ill effects on my body or BP.  This is the best tasting salt i've ever had!  Somewhat sweet.

product_title: NongShim Kimchi Noodle Ramyun, 4.2 Ounce Packages (Pack of 20)
review_body: i like spicy food, but the jeat is so overpowering, it burns your taste buds and takes away all the background flavors.

product_title: NOW Foods Comfy Chamomile Tea, 24-Count(Pack of 5)
review_body: Purchased this item years ago at a vitamin store.  Very pleased.  Simple.  Effective.  Pure chamomile.  That's all you need.  Also individually wrapped to fit in your wallet or purse.  Would purchase again.

product_title: Mad Dog 357 Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce 5oz
review_body: You will be disapointed in this sauce its tabasco with sweet barbeque sauce mixed with water.... really let down when my friend bought it over for some chicken. I laughed when he said be careful... on a heat scale i would give a 6 right below temporary insanity sauce... if you want hot don't spend money on this product unless you like sweet vinegar. =P

product_title: Ziyad Foule Muddamas (Fava Beans), 15.5-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I really hate full size fava beans, but these little fellows are really great. I use them in Moroccan soups, and in various salads and substitute them for garbanzo beans (which we can't eat) to make hummus, falafel, etc.

I would serve them more often but they are not my husband's favorite bean and I appreciate that Amazon has packs of only 6 cans because even though they cost more per can that amount is more suitable for the amount of the beans that we use. I've used Cedar brand before. However, I saw on line that the Canada Food Packaging company is having their foods canned in China now and Cedar brand is from Canada. See their web site:
[...]

'Nuff said about that! This is the first time I've used the Ziyad brand, and they are fine.

product_title: Green Mountain Sweet Lemon Black Perfect Iced Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count
review_body: We don't drink this by itself because it is not sweet enough. However, if you add real lemonade, it makes a very tasty Arnold Palmer.

product_title: Philippine Brand Dried Mango, 20-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 2)
review_body: Great value and much superior to what you find in stores. Makes a great snack or after dinner treat, but for those who are health conscious remember to keep it to a few pieces since they are covered in thin sugar. Try to keep the bag tightly sealed once you open them since the slowly begin to dry up. Will be ordering more soon :)

product_title: 1 X Foojoy Brand China Green Tea, 2g X 100 Teabags
review_body: Very delicious! I decided to start drinking green tea to curb my hunger and so far so good! I was afraid I would have to force myself to drink it since I usually hate anything healthy but I am really enjoy it. Helps me not feel hungry and has a mild taste, not over powering or too bitter. You can add honey to it if you need a little sweetness, I prefer it unsweetened though.

product_title: PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter and Powdered Cocoa Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories - 6.5 Oz Each - 2 Pack
review_body: I am the type of person that has been addicted to PB my whole life.  So when I saw this, believe me I had my doubts as to whether it was going to be good.  Well, I can't say enough good about this product, it comes out just like creamy PB and it tastes just as good as the regular PB.

product_title: Grace Cock Flavored Soup Mix - 1.76 OZ
review_body: This was the hit of the party, as a prank gift for my brother. No report on how it tastes, just yet!

product_title: One 1 Pound LB Madagascar Bourbon Planifolia Extract Grade B Vanilla Beans 6~7"
review_headline: Great product from a great suppler.
review_body: While I haven't ordered these beans thru Amazon I have ordered from Vanilla Products USA and will not buy from anyone else! They came in very quickly and are very wonderful to cook with and getting the free beans with every shipment is the best..  If you are not sure what to try, look for their sampler packs.. three different types in shipment.. Planning on buying more soon as I tend to put vanilla in everything now... I will not buy them from the store ever again as Vanilla products USA beats them all in price and freshness.

product_title: WWII German Broom Handle Pistol Hop Up Airsoft Replica Hand Gun
review_body: It was a nice gun it is pretty good but the huge orange tip is a turn off and also it advertises 2 clips but i only received one.

product_title: TOXIC WASTE Hazardously Sour Candy, 1.7-Ounce Plastic Drums (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love sour stuff - especially the sour stuff that makes you wish you hadn't eaten it.    Anyways, I will sum it up quickly: I can handle a warhead very easily - I get that initial blast of sour but it goes away right away, and isn't as intense as I'd like. The candies are basically the same - Except, they are a bit more intense and last a bit longer - plus, there is a little sour left over in the middle once you bite into it.    I have it a 3 star because that's the way you should rank things (by Amazon's rankings, a 3-star is 'its ok'). These are 'ok', and I like them better than warheads. They don't fulfill my needs for a ridiculous sour candy, though.

product_title: T1L-78991-V0Parent
review_body: I'm a fan of spicy things but this hot sauce contains too much heat for me and probably most people.  Unless you want your mouth to burn for an hour after eating, or if you want your butt hole to burn for an hour after pooping the next day, then don't buy this sauce.  I would recommend the Frank's Red Hot - \\"Buffalo.\\"  Stay away from the \\"Hot Buffalo,\\" unless you love the pain of fire hole.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: I bought this stuff a while ago--- talking many many months here.  I still have 1/2 bag left.  I use it every so often for guests who are picky about coffee.  The stay fresh bag really works.  It's about 90% as strong as when I first got it.  Decent tea!  I add a bit to cheap bitter coffee to spin up the flavor a bit.  Friends \\"love\\" my \\"coffee.\\"  He he he!  And Yes, I also do the same with my spearmint teas.  :)

product_title: Premium Almond Paste - 66% Almonds (1LB Tub)
review_body: Eat out of the box and enjoy!  This is very similar to the expensive German marzipan at a much more favorable price. If you like the chocolate coated kind, just buy some dark chocolate to eat along with :)

product_title: Jack Link's Original Turkey Jerky
review_body: I love this Jerky.  In fact, I like it so much I got a subscription through Amazon.  As others have mentioned, it is pretty salty but it packs plenty of flavor and the quality is consistent.  Its a healthier alternative to regular beef jerky.  Unless someone told you it was turkey jerky, you'd be hard pressed to tell.    -Good flavor  -Not too soft, not too tough  -Stays fresh for at least a week after opening, not that a pack makes it that long  -Seems to be a hit with most people

product_title: Bonsaiboy Flowering White Jasmine Trachelospermum Jasminoides
review_headline: Better left indoors, but overall a great plant!
review_body: I received my plant promptly and when I did it was already covered in buds so I knew it was going to be a pretty bloom! My buds opened up into beautiful jasmine flowers within a week and a half, and if it wasn't for the Texas heat they wouldn't have shriveled up and fell off the plant. That being said, if you live in a very hot or a very cold climate, keep this inside by a sunny window and there it will thrive. Mine sure looks great on my desk at the office :) *But if you keep in in the air conditioning, remember to put a tray of water under it to keep the air around the plant humid! Otherwise it may dry out and start to look poor.* I remember reading somewhere to keep these plants in temperatures ranging from 70-90 degrees, so that may be some good guidelines on whether you put the plant indoors or outdoors. The only complaint I have with the actual seller is that they shipped the plant wrapped in plastic. My plant was not damaged or suffocated when I received it, but that still just seems odd to me...

product_title: Campbell's Dry Onion Soup, 2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I got this product in Feb of 2010 and am out so I come back and it is gone I hope they get it back before the holidays. This onion soup mix is all around the best  product of the onion soup mixes when it comes to the dry. I will not buy the others so we have had less dips and haven't been able to have it in stews and roast. bummer.Campbells onion dry soup mix is has less of the bad stuff the others have.I can't think of the word but it is the better one for you. And taste just as good if not better than the other ones.  Onion Lover Deb

product_title: Godiva Chocolatier Dark Chocolate with Almond Bar, Large
review_body:
I am attempting to improve my overall health, so the almonds/dark chocolate mix was the perfect late day snack. This dark escape from reality is perfect for choc-o-holics everywhere! The luscious dark chocolate squares are the perfect size for an afternoon break. And with this slight crunch of almonds, it is the perfect blend of creamy crunchy. I usually detest crunchy in my creamy, so for me to say this is the highest accolade a nut bar could have.
If there was one thing I would ask them to improve, it would be to make them more accessible!
I LOVE THIS BAR!!!!

product_title: vitaminwater XXX, 20 fl oz, 24 Pack
review_body: This water is the first thing I have found that gives me energy on tired days.  Better than coffee which actually makes me tired.  Get it!  You won't regret.  It tastes great and is refreshing and energizing for your BLAH tired days- or for everyday! I usually don't write reviews but I love this stuff.

product_title: Raisin Bran Crunch Cereal, 18.2 -Ounce Boxes
review_body: I feel this is too sweet for me. If it can be lighter taste, I think it will be perfect.

product_title: Folgers Brazilian Blend Ground Coffee, 27.8 Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_body: We love this coffe and had zero luck finding it in stores locally. It has a great rich taste and love the smell when it is just brewing. If you like coffee you need to try this one!!

product_title: Celsius Ultimate Fitness Partner Energy Drink, Variety Pack, 12-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Really enjoyed receiving this ultimate pkg on the subscription savings...too bad I only got 1 order out of it before it was \\"no longer available\\" for subscriptions.

product_title: DisposaCups - Disposable Cups for use in Keurig® Brewers - 50 Cups, Lids, Filters - 100% Disposable
review_headline: DisposaKups - great product, wide open choices!
review_body: Over a year ago I purchased a Breville K-Cups brewer and immediately found the the available selection and choices to exceed what I had expected. I loved using it and brewing what I wanted, 1 cup at a time. I found that I was paying about 40cents/cup and that was also great.  Now the prices have soared to nearly or over $1/cup and that has made me slow down my purchase rate and my enjoyment of my single cup brewer.  Enter the DisposaKups and suddenly the price is reasonable again and I can grind my own or purchase Ekobrew and use their coffees. These are so simple, convenient and easy that I really enjoy that my world of coffee is wide open again.  Thanks for such a great product!  Ted

product_title: Bariani Olive Oil
review_body:
I was listening to public radio one day awhile back ago, and the topic was on olive oil. I learned alot from this program and it really wasn't something that gave me much thought, until then. My

\\"better half\\" never liked extra virgin olive oil because of the rancid flavor. Alas, cheap olive oil, walmart brand! Since then Iv'e tried several different brands. I love Lucini and Lucini garlic infused, which combined with a baked potato, is out of this world. The Bariani is really tasty and I've fried with it, mixed it in dips and on and on, it's the most flavorful to me.From what I gather this oil is somewhat made the old-world way, no fancy process or frills, the real stuff and it shows in it's flavor and sight. The only complaint I had with my order was when I recieved my bottle it was frozen solid and luckily the glass didn't crack. I live in WI and this was in Nov. So I faulted knowone. Don't be afraid to try different brands and I will eventually give the Creta brand from Greece a try.Give Bariani a shot, it's that good!

product_title: Heinz Reduced Sugar Tomato Ketchup, 13 oz (Pack of 6)
review_body: We bought this as a low carb substitute for the 17-Day Diet program. My wife and I could not believe how genuinely terrible this stuff tastes when compared to regular Heinz Ketchup. We either had to forego ketchup altogether or just cheat on the diet with regular Heinz. We chose the latter and lost weight on the program anyway. We had absolutely no hesitation in dumping this product right in the garbage.

product_title: NOW Foods Sucanat, Organic Cane sugar, 32-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: The best sugar to purchase.  Has a strong molasses taste. Sugar with actual vitamins.  Better for you than white sugar with no nutrients.

product_title: Desert Essence Coconut Shampoo, Nourishing for Dry Hair. 8 fl.oz
review_body:
I recently purchased the Desert Essence Coconut Body Wash, Coconut Shampoo and Coconut Conditioner on Amazon.com. My husband and I have used other Desert Essence products before and loved them (Tea Tree Blemish Stick- amazing on insect bites and Tea Tree Deodorant which works as well as any deodorant/anti-perspirant with loads of nasty chemicals in it) We have been big fans of coconut-smelling products for a while but I have often shied away, as a lot of them smell very sickly sweet. No one wants to end up smelling like a cupcake or a pina colada!
Not so with these! We love love love all three and the smell is subtle and not sweet or overpowering. I have long hair and wash it nearly every day (terrible I know) and the shampoo and conditioner keeps my mane glossy and hydrated. I get little hints of coconut now and then throughout the day but I like that- I live in NYC and having clean smelling hair by the end of the day can be tricky.
The body wash has a nice consistency and my husband loves using it. He works on construction sites in all weathers and it doesn't irritate or dry out his skin.

Nice packaging- you absolutely get your money's worth with 8fl oz. and as I said, we use them nearly every day and a little goes a long way. When I purchased all three they each had a slightly different label so there as been no confusion during those early morning, bleary-eyed showers!

The MASSIVE plus for me with these products is that in addition to using sustainable, organic ingredients, neither the finished product NOR the raw ingredients are tested on animals or contain animal by-products. They are vegan. They are also gluten free and have no nasties (phosphates etc) in them. Plus it is a small American company...let's support them!

Highly Recommended.

product_title: Joyva Tahini, 15-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: I don't know what the problem is with those who don't like this tahini because of how bitter it is: roasted sesame seeds are bitter. If you don't like that, you might want to add sugar or not eat sesame seeds. Some raw brands have a less strong flavor, but that's just a different thing. Joyva tahini is the standard tahini.  I have tried several other roasted tahinis this year (2011) in an attempt to explore different options and coming back to using Joyva again after trying several much more expensive brands from our local co-op. Some other brands contain emulsifiers that keep the material from falling out of the oil and hardening, which can make it easier for beginners.  Basic recipe: add lemon/lime juice and salt until thin enough to pour. If you are feeding children or people without a taste for the bitter flavor, you might need to add a little sugar. Don't make it sweet, just take the edge off the bitter.

product_title: Heater Meals Green Pepper Steak with Rice, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_body: This self-heating meal worked exactly as expected. You just follow the instructions on the insert. There is a chemical reaction that goes on inside a pouch. This pouch warms up your heater meal. My brother ate the meal during a recent camping adventure. He liked it. He thought the taste was similar to \\"real\\" food or normally prepared foods.  It didn't get too warm. The food was about lukewarm or warm.  It smelled and looked appetizing though. We will probably buy more of this, if the need arises, again.

product_title: Golden Malted Waffle and Pancake Flour, Original, 33-Ounce Can
review_body: I purchased this waffle/pancake mix from Amazon because when living in south Florida we went to Disney World over 100 times and then moved to hillbilly NC (unfortunately). We still drive down to Disney though. When staying at Caribbean Beach Hotel (our favorite due to restaurant/food choices) I asked a chef what type of waffle mix they use for Mickey Mouse waffles. He told me what they use which is Carbon's Golden Malt. The mix is delicious, light and great waffle mix.

product_title: Rokeach Gefilte Fish Heimeshe Style, 24-Ounce Glass (Pack of 3)
review_headline: To me this is the best taste of Gefilter fish but one  bottle was broken.
review_body: I would say the gefilte fish is five stars quality but one bottle was broken. I left massage to amazon packing people but with on response to me. As I did not know it was broken so the fish source was dropping around on my carpet upon my kitchen. This packing was so out of my imagination. It was over sized box without a proper cushioning. So the cans and glass bottles in conjunction to empty space composed a perfect rattling. My lesson to learn here was that I shall never combine the glass bottle and can in one order.

product_title: Roland Ginger Tea/Canisters, 2.5000-Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Black tea is good, has no taste of ginger flavor
review_body: I'm going to include a picture of the tea leaves I just brewed so you can get a glimpse of the large cut leaves of this black tea from China.  Because I bought it at a greatly reduced price, I'm not too upset that I taste no ginger whatsoever in the brew.  There was no aroma either when the perfectly sealed canister was opened, revealing the bagged tea inside.  The bag was not sealed, but folded over, and the leaves looked very black.  Because this is called, Roland Ginger Tea/Canisters, 2.5000-Ounce (Pack of 8), and it does not expose any ginger essence at all, I can only rate it at 2 stars for being a black tea (as described on package and Amazon) which was perfectly presented and at a great price for black tea from Hong Kong in little mauve metal canisters with cute images of ginger and a pretty decoration.  I cannot recommend this as a ginger tea and will move forward with presenting these canisters as part of assembled gift baskets with [[ASIN:B004NRTVWE Melitta Tea Filters, 40-Count (Pack of 6)]] and [[ASIN:B001GCVLVI, Walkers Shortbread Assorted, 8.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)]], [[ASIN:B005M8GFJA Tea Bag Buddy, White]] and more.  The cute little canisters are attractive and can be used after the tea is exhausted.  I may also include [[ASIN:B0009VZP6Y Ting Ting Jehe Chewy Ginger Candy Value 10 Packs - 10x5.25 Oz]] so the lack of ginger in the tea won't be sorely missed.

product_title: Harris Decaffeinated Black Tea, 50 Tea Bags, 3.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: large amount of tea.  I do not know if I will use them all but I do know it tastes good and I do not have to go to grocery to buy the tea.

product_title: Vita Coco Coconut Water with Tropical Fruit, 17-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: The tropical fruit in this drink just didn't work for me. I prefer the taste of Bom Dia Coconut Splash Mango. Maybe the Mango Vita Coco version is better .

product_title: Trader Joe's Just Mango Slices
review_headline: LOVE the product, deducting one star for the high price
review_body: I cannot tell you how much i adore dried fruits, and mango slices are my absolute favorite. However, moving to the US from Ireland (where dried fruit is just that - naturally sweet and delicious) i found i was bitterly disappointed to discover that most of the widely available dried fruit here is heavily sugared and, in my opinion, completely ruined.     I finally found these guys and they're a regular purchase for me at stores, but they are vastly over-priced here on Amazon. They've been hiked up to an excessive amount similar to the ridiculous pricing of such quality dried fruits in health food/vegan stores that aren't Trader Joe's, ie. aren't good for your tummy AND your wallet.     It's sad that you can buy a near poisonous meal for a family for $10 at a 7eleven or Tedeschi, but the same amount of money at a health store or co-op like Harvest (my local grocery here in Boston) will barely get you a container of dried fruit or 3 decent bell peppers. How are people supposed to change their lifestyles and improve their health for themselves and their children if the good stuff isn't affordable and the ramen and pop tarts are .45cents? It sends the wrong message and is the absolute propagation of disease and obesity. We need more places who share the values and philosophy of Trader Joe's - customers first, accessible, unpretentious, understandable health education, feel-good food at a feel-good price. Thank you Trader Joe's!    Rant over :)

product_title: Simply Organic Onion, White Powder Certified Organic, 0.74-Ounce Containers (Pack of 6)
review_body: Look folks, I am not a midget; and these bottles are, okay; aside from that the powder is so tasty and mixes so well that I kept it; but next time advertise it as Simply Organic Onion Whte teeny weeny containers -- but all in all it's a good buy I like it teeny weenie and all.

product_title: Walkers English Creamy Toffees, 5.5 Pound Bag
review_body: My wife and I love the Walker English toffees and were so looking forward to receiving them for the upcoming holidays.  Everything about the order was fine except the toffees themselves were not fresh, soft and chewy.  I would have to rate them about 80 on a scale of 100 for freshness.  That being said, I would order them again.  Amazon is the only place I can find them here in the United States.

product_title: SeaBear Smoked Salmon Jerky, 1.25 Ounce Unit
review_body: The salmon is pretty tasty.  A little on the salty side, but still good.  Not tough to chew too.  The only grip I have is the price.  17 bucks for 5 ounces.  I'd give it more stars if there were more in there, or the price was lower.

product_title: Next Organic Brazil Nuts Dark Chocolate Covered, 4-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: I ordered these from Amazon, but they are not listing it as a verified purchase which is odd. I only mention this as I tend to believe the verified purchases eliminate the \\"shill factor.\\" The nuts were delivered in perfect condition on a hot day. These candies are delicious and if you can resist not eating at least half of one package as a single serving, you have more self control than I! Organic dark chocolate covered Brazil nuts are difficult to find at a reasonable price. Now I wish I had purchased more while they were on sale. The nuts are fresh tasting medium sized covered in a glossy dark chocolate. This chocolate does not readily melt on your fingers, such as non-glossy chocolate typically does. I am enjoying these heavenly treats (5 pieces for 219 calories).

product_title: Fondarific Buttercream Green Fondant, 32 Ounces
review_headline: Made me look a professional cake decorater
review_body: This stuff is amazing.  I wish I had discovered it years ago instead of struggling to make my own fondant.  It is very easy to use and comes in great colors and it tastes great.  I will definatly be using it for my next cake.  At my sons Birthday party I was asked if I was a professional cake decorater - I am not but this stuff is that GOOD your cakes will look amazing.

product_title: Kettle Valley All Natural Real Fruit Snacks, Strawberry, 0.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 30)
review_body: My 3 year old son LOVES these, as well as my husband.  Strawberry is his favorite, but he like the tropical and raspberry too.  They are similar in texture to the Gerber fruit strips (so not chewy, but not too stiff like the Stretch Island ones).  We started buying them when my son was about 18 months, and on Amazon, it works out to be cheaper than the Gerber ones PLUS they are at least twice the size.  Great kid snack (and like I mentioned, my husband and I eat them too!).

product_title: California Rice Oil Company Oil Rice Bran, 25.4-Ounce Units (Pack of 3)
review_body: I like getting three bottles instead of buying in a gallon size. I use this for frying and save the olive oil for salad dressings.

product_title: Maranatha Natural Almond Butter 26oz Lightly Roasted
review_body: I bought this product from Costco this past weekend. I am a student teacher and I gave a jar to my mentor and kept one for myself. The next day she came to work complaining that it made her sick. I was not sure if it was because it was a new addition to her diet or not so I ate some of mine despite her warning. I became sick in the same way (diarrhea and severe upset stomach) within the hour. I have been eating this product almost every day every since Costco started selling it so I know that this is not normal but it is really scary. I am a vegan so it is not likely that the apple that I had today was the culprit. I would stay away from this product for a good while. I contacted Maranatha as well as Costco, Costco \\"noted\\" the problem but took no steps to remove it from the shelf and I am waiting for Maranatha to get back to me. DON'T BUY!!!!!!!!!

product_title: MimicCreme Creamer Substitute, Unsweetened, 16 Ounce
review_headline: Tastes great.  Rice flour is in mix.
review_body: Really enjoyed using this as a cream in cooking cream sauce, just drinking it straight, or mixed in tea.   Rice flour is in creme coffee substitute but doesn't bother flavor.

product_title: NongShim Savory Chicken Bowl, 3.03-Ounce Bowls (Pack of 18)
review_body: Not a fan of all the spicy noodle bowls; they all go way overboard on the salt and the heat is overpowering. So far, the only non-spicy available from Nong Shim are the Ginger Beef and the Savory Chicken. I prefer the beef, but the chicken is a nice alternative. The flavor may be too mild for some; it's basically a thin chicken boullion. If you're looking for spiciness, you won't find it here. And although the salt content is pretty high, it doesn't seem to taste as salty as the spicy version, but I definitely don't taste any \\"styrofoam.\\" And this comes in an 18-pack instead of the usual 12, so the per unit price is on the low side. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a non-spicy, cheap ramen.

product_title: La Vie de La Vosgienne Pastillines Hard Candy, 2-Ounce Tins (Pack of 10)
review_headline: Not too sweet, not too shabby
review_body: I remember my grandmother always carrying around candies in a tin shaped like raspberries or something. I purchased these since they looked similar. They aren't fruit-shaped but are round and are very much smaller than the ones I remember (little smaller than the end of my pinky finger). The three flavors do taste similar, but you can distinguish them from one another. I did like that they weren't too sweet like most of the hard candy you find in the store. Plenty of candies in a tin, would purchase again and recommend to others who want slightly sweet and flavorful hard candy.

product_title: Community Coffee Whole Bean Coffee, Columbia Classico Blend, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: I'm not too picky about what coffee I drink, so the cheaper the better!  I'd suggest watching slickdeals.net for coupon codes / deals on this product.

product_title: Bakery On Main Gluten Free Granola Bars, 6-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: I bought these to keep in my desk at work. I really wish I could say these bars were good, but they are not. It's difficult to find decent gluten-free snacks, and these are definitely off the list.  They seriously are bad, they taste & smell like they've been sprayed with insecticide, like Raid. I took one home and put it out in the yard, and the birds and squirrels wouldn't come within six feet of it. Something is not right with these.  I'll stick to Kind Bars for now.

product_title: Ella's Kitchen Organic Baby, 3.5 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 7)
review_headline: Best snack out there, but buy elsewhere!
review_body: We love Ella's! Amazingly pure and delicious portable snack. But this price is crazy - it is cheaper at our Whole Foods in Manhattan! Eek!

product_title: Thompson's Punjana Irish Breakfast 80 teabags (8.82oz) x 1 pack
review_body: I've been drinking trader joe's irish breakfast tea for years and decided to try this when I saw it in my local grocery store. review_body: First off... I don't write reviews of everything I buy... just things that really stick out to me and to be honest I can't believe I'm reviewing a spice but this stuff is da bomb!!! product_title: Glass Tabasco Bloody Mary Mix, Extra Spicy, 32 Ounce
review_headline: The Worse Bloody Mary mix I have ever tasted.  You can easily make or buy a Better One
review_body:
I generally have a Virgin Mary every day and a true Bloody Mary maybe once a week. I've experimented with a lot of different tomato juices, hot sauces, and spices but I've only tried a few Bloody Mary mixes.

I purchased the Tabasco mix locally to see what I might be missing. I was really surprised how bad it was. But tastes vary - so I'll describe the taste and you can decide if you want to try it.

The most dominant taste in this mix is NOT tomatoes -- which is quite unusual! In the Tabasco mix the most dominant flavor is Worcestershire sauce and there is a very heavy dose of that. While I love Worcestershire sauce, it needs to be balanced with other flavors. Worcestershire should be used as a subtle flavoring and never be the dominant taste. Sadly, the Tabasco Company does not know that.

At the same time I purchased this Tabasco mix - I also purchased the Mr & Mrs Ts mix. The Mr/Mrs Ts mix is far superior ---- displaying a good balance of tomatoes working against the considerable heat of chiles and other flavors. I'd recommend Mr/Mrs Ts if you must purchase a mix. But I don't recommend you purchase a Mix!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I'd prefer you create your own mix! Try this simple recipe which requires only two ingredients.
.
.

SIMPLE BLOODY MARY RECIPE - Two Ingredients:

1.) Tomato Juice or V8 juice - I prefer the low sodium variety of V8 but that is NOT a critical factor. Use whatever juice you like.
Actually the lowest priced cans of tomato juice at my local supermarket have proven really excellent! Go figure.

2.) A Good Quality Hot Sauce. Using a better than average hot sauce is absolutely key. I strongly recommend (if you do not already have a favorite) one of the following (I've taste tasted about 30 different ones and below is my short list of favorites which are also readily available:

a) Huy Fong Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce - This sauce has considerable heat but it is nicely balanced against a bit of sweetness combined with a hint of garlic. It really makes the virgin/bloody mary quite special. Virtually every supermarket carries it - look in the Asian section!

b) Cholula Original Hot Sauce - features a fine blend of peppers - low to medium heat and readily available - look in the Mexican section

c) Tapatio Hot Salsa Picanta - another widely distributed and excellent Mexican Hot sauce. Once again you will find this in your Mexican isle.

d) Tabasco Chipotle hot sauce - a well know national brand. The Chipotle pepper is smoked and has a unique flavor. Commonly available and worth a try. There are many other brands of Chipotle sauces. If you like the taste of this one you are off to the races to see which brand you prefer. But a good place to start is with this Tabasco product.

e) El Yacateco Green

That is simple as it gets. A juice and a dash of a really good hot sauce. This is not only far better than the Tabasco mix (which is horrid) but it is also better than the Mr/Mrs Ts Bloody Mary mix! An added bonus of mixing your own ----- you can adjust the heat level to your individual preferences. You can't do that with a mix.

review_headline: Taste good but do not comply with my diet
review_body: I'm counting carbs, and I ordered these hoping they would provide an alternative for me to high-carbohydrate snacks. The similar veggie chips I have bought in the grocery store list 2 grams of carbs; this product lists 18g; fiber - only 2g -- that's 16 net carbs, way too many allowed on my diet. It would be helpful to have the nutrition facts presented on the product page before purchase (or if it is there - I missed it). The other figures are not bad: calories: 130, fat calories, 50, total fat: 6g; saturated fat: 0g; trans fat: 0g. Although on my low carb diet, I don't have to worry so much about calories and fat. product_title: Pomona's Universal Pectin, 1.1 Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Works great, and a good value too
review_body: I'm not a real homemaker, but I play one in my kitchen.   I've helped the Mrs. can things in the past, but my involvement was pitting, coring, and dumping out really big pots of boiling water. My wife canned the way that worked for her, packets of SureJell and lots and lots of sugar. We have been progressively reducing our families sugar consumption. As summer rolled in and fresh strawberries ripened, I sallied forth and picked 75# of them. (Yes, I know. Nobody needs that much jam. I dried a bunch). I had read that Pomona's worked with low-sugar recipes so I bought some.  In the middle of my first batch of strawberry jam, my wife observed the small amount of sugar I was using and told me flat out that my jam wasn't going to set. She had tried SureJell's \\"Low or No Sugar\\" with poor results. She hadn't noticed my box of Pomona's. I thanked her for her opinion, and continued on my merry way.   After my first two batches set perfectly, she paid more attention and discovered my secret. Pomona's. I have since made low sugar versions of raspberry, blueberry, and blackberry jams and all have set perfectly. I could scarcely be more pleased.  Next to being being able to get a good set with low sugar recipes, my favorite feature of Pomona's is that I can make HUGE batches. Instead of working in small batches, as some other unnamed pectin requires, I was able to make an enormous batch of jam with 3 boxes worth of Pomona's. Again, I was advised it would not work, but every single jar came out perfectly. Pomona's has a special place in my pantry.  Once I knew to look for Pomona's, I have seen it in most grocery stores. It tends to cost more than SureJell but since the yield is higher per box, it's actually a better value. And the best value is in the 6 pack right here on Amazon.

review_body: My daughter and I visited a Japanese tea house and they served lychee iced tea which neither of us had had before. We loved it. Haven't made it iced, yet, but I will.  I like that they double seal the container. While everybody else is cutting costs and packaging as cheaply as possible, this is a very nice bonus and will keep the tea flavorful for a long time, I think.  I use this for our \\"special\\" tea, don't drink it every day, because I don't want to become so used to it that it becomes ordinary.  This is a wonderful tea!

review_headline: HORRIBLE TOXIC LITTER - I got sick!  Don't buy!
review_body: Yikes!  This litter has an overpowering perfume odor combined with dust that gets all over you!  When putting new litter in last night, it was especially bad as breathing became compromised and the smell plus choking was scary!  Even after I left the area I could feel AND smell the litter on me and taste it in my mouth, plus I started having neurological symptoms. I became itchy, tense, anxious and my body felt like pins and needles were sticking me all over. Oh, and did I mention a huge migraine headache?    I purchased this clumping litter from Petsmart a couple of weeks ago because I had just purchased the Omega Paw Self-cleaning Litter Box here on Amazon. I had hoped for a high quality litter to use in the new box. I was highly disappointed!    Before last night, I had limited my exposure to this awful smelling stuff but still experienced some of the above symptoms to a lesser degree.  Today I ordered the highly rated Ever Clean litter from Amazon which is to be delivered tomorrow.  I hope I'm not disappointed.     Moral of story:  Check reviews on Amazon before you purchase anything.

review_body:
