review_body: This is my favorite green tea and now I have a whole lot of it!  For some reason, it doesn't taste as bitter as other green teas I've tried.

product_title: Crunchies Freeze-Dried Fruit Snack, Tropical Fruit, 1.5 Ounce Pouch
review_body: I like these so much I enrolled in the Subscribe & Save over a year ago.  It is not the cheapest snack, but I save money by ordering these in bulk through Amazon rather than buying these from my local grocery store.  There are no artificial ingredients or added sugars; this is just fruit.  Yet, this is a great portable snack that will not go bad sitting in your car, or your child's backpack.  I usually keep a supply in my car to satisfy my huger while driving home from work.     I completely disagree with the serving size listed on the package.  It claims five servings per bag.  But, if you're eating these as a snack, you'll only get one serving out of a package, maybe two servings if it's for a child.  If you're using this on top of cereal or yogurt, then of course it will last much longer.  When the bag is empty, you'll find a bunch of fruit powder left at the bottom.  Don't throw it away, this makes a great topping for yogurt.    This snack is not for everyone.  My kids and I love them, but my husband can't stand them.  These are not the consistency of other dried fruits, like raisins.  These are crunchy, just as the name implies.  You can happily crunch them like potato chips, or to make them last longer, eat one at a time, and let them slowly dissolve in your mouth, like a sugar cube.  Sweet without the guilt.

review_body: The Laggs Hibiscus Tea is a very good value, both for health benefits, taste and price. I will purchase again.

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Drinking Chocolate, Mini Semi-Sweet Chocolate Drops, 12-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: I know my hot chocolate and I have tried them all.  This is the best.  It is almost worth going to San Francisco just to get it.

product_title: Mrs. May's Ultimate Crunch Bar, Cranberry, Acai & Goji, 1.4-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: High quality comes at a higher price
review_body:
The Ultimate Crunch Bar makes a decent snack when I need something to hold me over between meals. I like that there are no artificial ingredients in these, and that they provide healthy benefits.

I know how good nuts are for you, but don't really like them plain. Eating them in this bar makes it easier for me to get the nuts I should eat.

The overall taste of the cranberry bar is nutty. There is an underlying fruit flavor (tart more than sweet), which was nice. I like the whole or nearly whole nuts, plus the seeds.

As for texture, don't eat one of these if you have a cracked or loose tooth! You've got the natural hardness of nuts, plus the syrup holding it together is very dense and sticky. You can pry chunks off of the bar if you prefer, rather than bite it, so that's a plus.

The problem I have with the Ultimate Crunch Bars is the price. Granted, you're getting a pretty high-quality item here, but I still have trouble paying that much. I was lucky to have gotten a couple as a gift, but when I looked up how much it was to purchase, I decided to just write up a review and leave it at that.

I do recommend these, though. They are truly good for you and do provide a nice energy boost without any crash. I eat one of these and I'm good for a few hours. Certainly a healthy option when compared to other quick things you could munch on.

These are labeled as vegan, and gluten-free. They are a product of China.

review_body: The quality of the product is fine. I was however a little dissapointed to find   that I received 1-five pound package instead of 5-pound packages as shown in the  illustration.The single large package did not carry the Fisher brand labeling as  shown.This meant I had to seperate the pecans into smaller bags myself at an additional expense to me. The almonds really stand out with the chocolate.  I have always loved Rice Krispy Treats since I was a kid but now I have something similar but far better for me!  I think I love this one more than the Caramel Chocolate version!

product_title: Pastariso Organic Brown Rice Rotini, 8-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: My kids love them.  It's as good as any other brand of brown rice rotini.  Can't beat the price of buying in bulk.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Wild Mountain Blueberry, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: I originally tried Wild Mountain Blueberry in a sample package and was immediately hooked. I was so happy to find I could purchase and entire box of this smooth tasting, great smelling coffee. It's my entire families favorite flavor right now!

product_title: Lion snacks
review_body: Candy bars arrived with an expiration date of Feb. 2011- almost a year out of date. Not eligible for return per Amazon, had to throw in the garbage.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: This is a spiced tea. Cloves and cinnamon makes it similar to chai. It needs a bit more brewing time than other herbal teas, but overall a great herbal drink.

product_title: Riviera Original Minestrone Soup 15 oz12ct
review_body: I spent years in Northern California enjoying this soup. It seems like 25 or 30 years ago the cans were a lot larger.  When I was poor and going to college, my wife and I would have it for dinner with some french bread and it was so tasty, thick and filling, a better dinner time meal could not be had for the price.  I use to like to throw some parmesean cheese on it too just to really push my happy button.  I live in Northern Nevada now and I was able to find it once in a store called \\"Scolari's\\" but they don't seem to have it anymore.  I googled it and found it on Amazon but they are out of stock (maybe they stopped making it).  Watch out that you don't order the \\"Restaurant Recipe\\" which is edible but can't compare to the Original recipe.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Cereal
review_headline: Faux rice krispie bars for Gluten Free Folks
review_body:
I purchased these to make Gluten Free (faux) rice krispie bars since rice krispies contain gluten. Everyone loves them. I don't eat them as cereal but use them to make treats.

Yes! You are correct. These are NOT certified GLUTEN FREE. The bag states that they are \\"wheat free\\". I hope that I have not inadvertently caused sickness to anyone. Personally, I have been using these for sometime with no problem-----but someone else might.

review_headline: Hate when my mouth was set on Delicousness and then disappointedness

Even living in Chicago, it's hard to find Brachs in the grocery stores these days so what do I do ? I go searching for this candy and thankfully my go to store Amazon saves the day! Unfortunately this batch taste as if they had been sitting on a shelf for about 1 year and the sugar had ran away. The Candy was extremely hard and I was extremely disappointed.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: This is a decent coffee. I can't find a replacement machine for my old single cup machine. They all now seen to be drip instead of pressure/pump models. For drip coffee, these are OK.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: This item claims to be decaf.  It is not.  I tried the sample that came in the box of other sample's.  I am not allowed to have caffine, and my heart went through the roof.  From now on I stick to Green Mountain.

product_title: Tazo Chai Tea Latte Concentrate 32 oz
review_body:
I've been trying to duplicate the terrific spicy chai tea I get at my two favorite local Indian restaurants and so far the only one that has come close is the Third Street brand. This Tazo brand is very good, but it doesn't have the spicy kick that Third Street Chai has.

If you're used to this brand or don't go for spicy chai, then Tazo is very good, but if you want a bit of 'umph' to your chai, definitely go with Third Street!

product_title: Organic Valley Organic Single Serve Milk, 8 Ounce Aseptic Cartons
review_body: I really miss being able to get milk in shelf stable packs. It was so convenient to get Parmalat milk in other countries and occasionally here, but I haven't seen it in years. I love these! GOT to have milk in my coffee every morning, and am often too lazy to dash to the store at night if I run out. These are great for travel, camping, work. Coffee is a big deal for me, and if I'm going somewhere that I think there is a chance that powdered creamer is the only option (getting an oil change, a waiting room, hotel room, etc) then one of these is perfect tucked in my purse. I love the taste, and love the fact that it is ORGANIC!!!

product_title: Planters Mixed Nuts
review_body: This is another combination by Planters that I like to have on hand in my office for clients to munch on if they come in hungry. It's also nice for my administrative assistant and me if we're fading fast (!) and can't get away for something to eat. Much better for us than cookies or the like.

product_title: Bionaturae Organic Bilberry Fruit Nectar, 25.4 Ounce -- 6 per case.
review_body: I love this drink. Its a bit sweet and thick for me, so I do a 60juice/40water mix and it lasts longer, and tastes better.

review_body: Just a great little gigabit switch. Very sturdily constructed of heavy sheet metal, in a nice compact form factor. Doesn't generate any heat in operation, and the price was right.

product_title: Lakerol Special Menthol Liqorice (24)
review_body: I embrace everything licorice.  When I quit smoking it was either go through a bag of the real deal and turn into a fattie or buy a carton of these puppies.  Lakerol won and so did my conquest against smokes. xx

product_title: Brooke Bond Taj Mahal Orange Pekoe 100 Tea Bags 7 Oz
review_body: I first became aware of Taj Mahal Tea in my favorite Indian Restaurant; and they were gracious enough to share with me the name and brand. It is smooth; and rich in taste. I am yet to find anything which can be purchased in the local stores that even begins to compare; the closest is ordered on-line from Fortnam and Mason of London, UK. The perfect compliment to any Indian dish; or simply a cup of Tea on a cool evening. Also, it makes fantastic Iced Tea as well; the flavor is never stale, and holds it's own with the ice. I highly recommend all of the Brooke Bond Teas.

product_title: Quaker Oatmeal To Go Oatmeal Raisin Squares, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Like an oatmeal cookie- a bit sweat but good to eat!  Quaker reputation is a bonus, but more cake than nutrient bar.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs

review_body: I've always loved this coffee. It's medium in strength and not at all bitter> Also, I get it on subscribe and save which I love!

product_title: La Nouba Sugar-Free Marshmallows 2.7 Oz (6 bags)
review_body: I was looking for a recipe for sugar free marshmallows, when I found these already available to order. They arrived quickly and are delicious. I have eaten them alOne and used them in hot chocolate and love them.

product_title: Bigelow Cozy Chamomile, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I would recommend this tea for anyone who enjoys a good tasting cup of chamomile. Good value with the 2 pack.

product_title: Pan Asia Pike Eel In Soy Sauce, 110-Grams (Pack of 8)
review_body: This delicious eel is packed in soy sauce and is a good substitute for fish when I don't have any on hand.  It works well with sushi.  Tuna and salmon in the can tastes so terrible these days.  I bought this eel for a great price in quantity of 8.

product_title: Necta Sweet Saccharin Sugar Substitute 0.5 Grain Tablets 500 ea
review_body: I wanted saccharin; not nutrasweet. I searched at 2 local drug stores and 2 grocery stores and nobody sells saccharin any more. I was happy to find it here. These 1/2 grain tabs will probably last me 5 years.

product_title: DisposaCups - Disposable Cups for use in Keurig® Brewers - 50 Cups, Lids, Filters - 100% Disposable
review_body: For those reviews that say the coffee wasn't strong enough or the cup leaked, they simply don't know what they're doing.  First of all, use the right kind of coffee.  The first time I used it, I put in a medium roast that wasn't ground very fine.  And yes, the coffee was weak.  So I switched to a VERY FINELY ground dark roast and it was perfect.  And yes, they will leak and leave grounds in your Keurig if you don't let some of the filter hang over the edge and seal it correctly.  I had no problem with sealing the cup...so far so good.  Makes as good a cup of coffee as the more expensive ready-made k-cups and have yet to find any grounds in my coffee or in the Keurig.  Really a good deal, plus I had them three days after ordering.  Very quick shipping.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body: This is great stuff, can be used in cooking as a healthy alternative to butter or other oil. I also use it as a base for skin creams. It's a great product, and the price was incredible, even with shipping it was cheaper than buying it from my local health food store.

product_title: Country Ham Shanks

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk

product_title: Zevia All Natural Soda, Cream Soda, 12 Ounce (Pack of 24)

review_body: I wasn't sure what to expect when I ordered this soda. I grow stevia in my garden so I'm familiar with the flavor, but I've never experienced it in the form of a drink, much less one of my favorites. product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_body: When I was pregnant and I got cold, this tea help a lot. This is a kind of tea that my family have to have during winter/cold season.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_headline: Not Bad, But There are Better
review_body: As the popularity of the Senseo pod system wanes and that of the Keurig system grows, there is diminished availability of pods that fit the Senseo. The Senseo brand pods are available on Amazon at a decent price. Unfortunately, the Senseo pods are not as good as competing brands formerly available on Amazon such as Fratello, Halo, Millstone, etc. Of the Senseo pods, the French Roast has a richer flavor than most of the others. It is often on sale and is a bargain when that happens. I suspect that the Keurig system makes good coffee, but I cannot imagine paying so much for a Keurig pod (thimble).

product_title: Pop-Tarts Frosted Brown Sugar Cinnamon Toaster Pastries, 12-Count (Pack of 3)
review_body: What can I say? They're a box of delicious! Came in one big box with 3 boxes inside containing 12 each (6 packages with 2 pastries in each). So one big box with 3 smaller boxes with 6 packages in each containing 2 pastries... INTERESTING!  I say this is totally worth it, considering the price.

product_title: The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Peanut Butter, Crunchy, 18-Ounce Plastic Jars (Pack of 4)
review_body: Fabulously peanutty with just the right amount of salt and crunch.  Use a little elbow grease to stir it up well when you first open it - I recommend placing it in the sink to facilitate cleanup and provide leverage - and then store it upside down.  That seems to keep it well mixed.  Just make sure you tighten the cap very well if you're going to do that.

product_title: Justin's Natural Chocolate Almond Butter, 10-Count (Pack of 2)
review_headline: You can't beat this amazing Almond Butter!
review_body: After trying several different Almond butters, I can honestly say this is far and above the rest.  No oily mess to deal with and unbeatable consistency.  With the individual packages you can take them to go or use them as your serving proportions.  I have been nothing but pleased with my purchase and the many other different variations Justin's has produced, so check them all out!

product_title: PG Tips Black Tea, Pyramid Tea Bags, 80Count Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: Great product -- a nice, strong black tea and this is the only tea I drink.  Purchasing thru Amazon is cheap and fast!

product_title: Tootsie Roll Strawberry Frooties - 360 Pack,38.8OZ
review_body: I bought this for my wife. She loves strawberry tootsie rolls and she was very pleased with these. I'm less of an enthusiast, but even I can appreciate tasty flavored candy. My only complaint is that I can't seem to find these things locally in our grocery store. The cost of shipping was about as much as the price of the product itself.

product_title: Thé Du Hammam Green Tea (3.5 Oz Loose in Pouch)
review_body: i used to drink this tea brand back in france and they have the tastiest selection. i am glad to find it over here!!

product_title: Nabob 100% Colombian, 14-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Brewers (Pack of 3)
review_headline: When the T-Discs do the job...
review_body:
I'm just about ready to chuck my Tassimo brewer. I keep getting T-Discs that seem faulty, I end up with half a cup of grounds and half water. I ordered this item because according to the picture the cover of the disc is half red and half green, I haven't had a problem with those, but the ones that came the cover of the disc has a red strip with green on both sides, I ended up with water and grounds every where.

Now I have three packs of T-Discs that are only good if I empty them.

product_title: Dark Chocolate Sea Salt Caramel SQUARES Gift Bag - 33 Count
review_body: The chocolates are delicious! I was pleased to find an impressive salted caramel chocolate, especially one by Ghirardelli. Unfortunately, despite the fact that the chocolates were packaged in bubble wrap, several pieces were broken, which did not bode well for the caramel filling.

product_title: Good Health Olive Oil Lemon & Feta Baked Hummus Chips, 3.5 oz
review_body: We just discovered this great chip. While my husband said they reminded him of Pringles,I would say that considering the ingredients, it's an amazing product.  First up is chickpea (flour, rice flour, salt) Olive Oil Garlic & Feta w/Lemon.  Included among the other ingredients are Cheddar cheese, lemon juice solids, spices and dried sesame seeds.  The flavor is subtle at first and then really grows on you.  Used with or without a dip, knowing it's only 1/3 calories from fat(55% less fat than potato chips), and no cholesterol is a great plus.  Also, a serving provides 3 grams of proteins.

product_title: Stuffing Mix Savory Gluten-Free (6 Bags) 9 Ounces
review_body: Yes, it was expensive, but worth every cent.  The package did look small, but that was deceiving.  When prepared, it expanded.  Added sauted onion and celery.  Didn't need anything else.  Would definitely buy again!

product_title: Hellmann's Honey Mustard
review_body: Just purchased this form under $3.00 a bottle. Great deal! It expires in December of 2011 but we will surely use it all by then! Can't even get it this cheap with sales and coupons in my area.

product_title: The Spice Lab Himalayan Pink Salt - Coarse Gourmet Pure Crystal - Nutrient and Mineral Fortified for Health - Kosher & Natural Certified 3-4mm - 1 Pound
review_body: This pink salt has a very nice subtle flavor. I didn't know salt could vary in flavor until I tried this one. We bought the salt initially because (a) it's organic and (b) my daughter wanted pink salt! But the flavor is what really made the difference. I don't know much about salt, but I want to say that this has a \\"rounded\\" flavor meaning it isn't harsh or distinctive on food, rather it seems to become part of the food, going in and bringing back the flavor of the food in an enhanced way. Sounds silly, but I am learning good quality ingredients really make a difference.

product_title: Monin Fruit Puree, Raspberry, 33.8-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: I bought this to use for making raspberry lime rickeys, an old-fashioned soda-fountain drink. I think syrup would be better for soda drinks; this is so thick that I lose a lot of carbonation stirring until it's mixed. The flavor is great, though, and it's perfect for adding to ice tea, lemonade, smoothies, or topping ice cream.

product_title: Miracle Noodles, Angel Hair - 24 Pack
review_body: 15 second rinse, one minute blanch into boiling water. They taste like nothing, and are almost calorie free. I make my own random dressing concoctions to flavor them, eat two or three packages as on-the-go meal at work, and they are filling. The 24 pack is the most economic for sure! I plan to continue them into my diet and therefore replace as I run out.

product_title: Pita Bread ,10 count (Grecian Delight)
review_body: the pitas are terrible dont buy bread online! its not very fresh and when you try to roll it up for a gyro it breaks in half istantly! DONT BUY!

product_title: McCormick Spaghetti, Thick & Zesty, 1.37-Ounce Units (Pack of 24)
review_body: This item sells out so quickly in my local store, and it is the only spaghetti mix I will use.  I substituted with another store brand and was so disappointed.  This seller got the item to me very quickly--and I won't run out for a while!

product_title: SodaStream Sodamix Syrup 16.9 Ounce
review_body: I purchased the Soda Stream cola mix because it seemed \\"all natural\\" from its list of ingredients.  When I received it, however, the ingredients listed things like acesulfame and sulfites, which I'm allergic to.  Not happy.

product_title: Lenny & Larry's The Complete Cookie, Oatmeal Raisin, 4-Ounce Cookies (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a good alternative to a nutrition bar but it is caloric. The label is somewhat deceptive since the amount of protein is for two servings. Eating the whole cookie amounts to about 500 calories.

product_title: Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter
review_body: My first taste sent my mind back to that moment where you try a Reese's cup for the first time in a couple years, remembering it as delicious from childhood (or maybe the commercials), and instead think it has a kinda stale taste, chocolate and peanut butter somehow managing to drown each other out into a grainy mush.    As I ate more, the cocoa flavor took over, but more as a sharp edge than a \\"rich\\" flavor.    That said, I bet it *does* go great with bananas, and I mainly got what I was looking for: a compact, high-calorie sweet fix that stores well (got in February 2011; use by date Nov. 2012--well over a year).     The texture is light, almost mousse-like, and definitely easily spreadable. I'm thinking pancakes.    I'm unsure whether I want to get used to the taste, though: it's got enough chocolate to induce cravings.    So, if \\"spreadable peanut butter cup\\" sounds good to you, go for it. If you're more used to \\"real\\" food, think twice about the perfect reviews.

product_title: Tully's Coffee Italian Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body:
You should stop selling these DEFECTIVE Tully's products!

I bought 2 packages of Tully's Italian Roast K-cups (48 cups) on July 20, 2011. I quickly discovered that all were defective. The airtight seal on each and every K-cup was broken and, when put into the Keurig coffeemaker, it spilled coffee grounds into both the coffee and the machine.

I contacted Tully's customer service line, explained what'd happened and they couldn't have been more rude, condescending and unhelpful. They refused to send a refund or coupon through Amazon (to eventually credit my account) unless I sent these two boxes back and they inspected them. By the time these were opened a month later, the Amazon packing was long gone and these crappy K-cups were despoiling our pantry. My wife tossed them in disgust.

Our first and last purchase from Tully's. Shame on them for such lousy customer service and for failing to stand by their products!.

product_title: Boyer's Coffee Chocolate Cherry Decaf, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_headline: For all of us decaf lovers
review_body: For anyone who loves coffee but has to drink decaf, it's a chore to find really good decaf and near impossible to find flavored decaf, especially in grocery stores. This is a wonderful coffee, with a rich flavor and none of the caffeine. I buy it over and over again. And at Amazon prices even cheaper than grocery stores. Awesome!

product_title: FiberPlus Antioxidant Bars, Chocolate Chip, 5-Count Bars 1.2 oz(Pack of 12)
review_headline: Items are very fresh. Important in a 10-Pack.
review_body: These 10 packs of fiber plus boxes contain 60 bars. I was worried about a nearly approaching expiration date. But these are far better than the grocery stores! Purchased in February, Expires in September! That's 8 months of freshness for a 1 month supply. Great deal! Fast 2 day shipping when I ordered them.    Subscriber.

product_title: Sadaf Falafel Mix, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Since we're almost 100% vegetarian nowadays, the falafel mix is marvelous to have on hand when a 'meaty' meal item is wanted.  This mix is seasoned just right, is amenable to no-oil baking methods or healthy olive oil frying on stovetop.  The price is fair [competitive with any supermarket] and contents are fresh.  If your local markets aren't selling falafel mixes, go with this one and save the struggle!

product_title: Klein's Naturals Cashews, Roasted, Unsalted, Shelled, (Pack of 6)
review_body: Being allergic to gluten, it is very difficult to find a healthy snack to eat during the day.  I really like cashews but have always avoided them due to the high fat content and sodium.  After doing more research, I read in the Whole Foods site that people who ate nuts tend to lost more weight than those who did not.  Cashews also had the lowest fat content compared to the other nuts.  So I wanted to try a bag but did not find any unsalted cashews at Costco.   So Amazon.Com to the rescue. I looked at different brands and found the reviews on this brand to be more consistent.  I'm glad I did.  The cashews came in 16oz small tubs sealed with plastic.  The cashews were delicious and fresh.  Best of all, they were unsalted.  As the article indicated in the Whole Food site, you do feel full/satisfied after eating that you no longer have any food cravings.  This is my 3rd order and finally tried the subscription option to save a few more bucks.

product_title: Snickers Marathon ENERGY Bar Crunchy Dark Chocolate 12 Bars
review_body: These bars had very good reviews so I tried them. I don't like the fact that they taste like viamins.The bars expire soon also, as though they were close to expiration when I ordered them. Very disappointed.

product_title: Kashi TLC Cookies, 8.5-Ounce Boxes
review_body: I don't feel too guilty when I have this cookie for a late snack.  Satisfies my chocolate craving and one cookie is just the right amount.  Excellent taste and texture.

product_title: Campbell's Homestyle Soup, 18.6 Ounce Cans
review_body:
But recently the entire recipe was changed! Why? Now it looks and tastes...like the competition. Before, there was no competition.

This product description shows what the soup USED to look like.

Now, there is a different, larger pasta noodle...not as good
The meatballs are made differently, not as tasty and are smaller...

The broth flavor...
Everything...
Was Changed!
