product_title: Coffee Masters Flavored Coffee, Chocolate Raspberry, Ground, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: Great flavored coffee at a great price through amazon. I always used to order from coffee masters but amazon was about $2-3 cheaper per bag.

product_title: J&D's Malt Salt
review_body: Just found this stuff - it's amazing! I've wanted some of this to put on veggies, popcorn and chips for-freakin-ever! Great flavor and not overpowering!

product_title: India Tree Cinnamon Sticks, 6-Inch, 12 Quills (Pack of 4)
review_body:
When I ordered this product, it said it was real cinnamon (i.e.\\"canela\\") and \\"product of Sri Lanka\\". I ordered based on that, but they sent me Indonesian \\"cinnamon\\" (not Canela). Not at all what I wanted, and this item has been deemed \\"not eligible for return\\", and the website has been revised to match what they sent me.

I don't think they did it to be evil, but they should have admitted they no longer stock what I ordered instead of taking my money for something I did not want. This product is WAY too expensive for common non-canela \\"cinnamon\\", so I feel a bit ripped-off. And now I still have to find some real canela. Two stars, because it's probably an overpriced yet adequate product if you weren't bait-and-switched from something else. For me, it was just a total waste of time and money. :(

product_title: The Peanut Shop of Williamsburg Green Boiled Peanuts, 8-Ounce (Dry Weight) Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body: I look to buy boiled peanuts fresh every time I go down south. The next best thing to fresh boiled peanuts are boiled peanuts in a can.  I didn't know they existed until I googled them and found them on Amazon.  They are not as good as fresh but they satisfy the taste.  These are just a little bit too salty but tasty.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic Fruit Yogurt Smoothie
review_headline: my 1 year old daughter loves it!
review_body: I first ordered two boxes when packing for an international trip with my baby daughter. It tastes great and is very convenient for traveling. I could not imagine my baby daughter flying internationally without having one smoothie at hand. After we returned home, I subsribed it for monthly delivery. Now I always have one or two pouch in the diaper bag.

product_title: Amber Lyn Chocolates - Sugar Free - Dark Chocolate - 15 Bars
review_headline: Quality product and superior customer service
review_body:
I discovered Amber Lyn chocolate about 9 months ago and was floored by just how good this sugar free dark chocolate was. Some people find the maltitol objectionable and its true that some folks have a harder time with its digestion, however, other sweeteners have their own issues as well, not the least of which is how it affects the taste of the product. I'm not diabetic but I have friends who are, I am however, a life long struggler with weight and avoidance of sugar goes a long way to making that battle more productive. But being a chocolate lover, that was always a trade off till I found this product, the taste is downright sublime and satisfies far more so than even other gourmet chocolates made with sugar. I experimented with various brands of sugar free chocolates, but at the risk of sounding like a chocolate snob, IMO those should've come labled \\"taste compromised\\". Amber Lyn's is a taste that is pure satisfaction, a single bar is so satisfying in its taste and mouth-feel that often, it will last me 3 days as I nibble on it for a desert rather than devour it (though that temptation is definitely there). My diabetic friends have all upon exposure to its taste, promptly placed orders themselves and not one has had anything even remotely negative to say about it.

Finally, a note regarding their customer service. I live in Las Vegas where the general rule is if you're ordering food online, either avoid ordering heat sensitive goods from March to September or make sure you can get extra care in shipping. A craving overcame my normal precaution about this and I placed a order just as temps were hitting 100 degrees and carrier trucks are often 10 degrees hotter inside. I was fully expecting a molten mess to arrive at my door as I had spaced off my normal precautions regarding such a order, yet the package arrived in a sytrofoam lined box with cold gel packs wrapped in paper between the chocolate containers. My order was literally in pristine condition and totally without any say so on my end, they just knew to take that extra step for their customer. That is a very rare level of service these days and Amber Lyn cemented my loyalty for life with that move.

Bottom line: If you're looking for quality, taste, and satisfaction not just for your taste buds but for your presence as a customer, I cannot recommend these people enough. If all corporations were this dedicated to customer satisfaction, a lot of lawyers would be out of a job.nd totally without any say so on my end, they just knew to take that extra step for their customer. That is a very rare level of service these days and Amber Lyn cemented my loyalty for life with that move. Bottom line: If you're looking for quality, taste, and satisfaction not just for your taste buds but for your presence as a customer, I cannot recommend these people enough. If all corporations were this dedicated to customer satisfaction, a lot of lawyers would be out of a job.

product_title: San Francisco Bay Coffee, OneCup Single Serve Cups
review_body: Had to try this as soon as I received it. Made a great bold cup of coffee. Was very impressed  with the \\"pod\\". Very little waste, as compared to the regular k-cups. I will be trying different flavors in the future.

product_title: Kellogg's Granola without Raisins, Low Fat, 18-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5)
review_body: this cereal is no longer available in the southeast texas area so the plus is that it is available, however, the price for this box is about fifty percent above other cereals.  Not a good value.  Searched around and found a local brand of granola at much better value.

product_title: GG Scandinavian Bran Crispbread, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: I bought these because dr Oz recommended it for a healthy dose of fiber in your diet.   Boy does it work. It curbs your apetite and it helps you with a healthy bowel movement. By itself it's very dry and hard to swallow. But if you have it with some kind of dip it works great. Just make sure to drink plenty of water.  I eat these crackers with hummus, varieous cheeses, yogurt dip,avacado,salsa, etc.....

product_title: Body Choice Strawberry Smoothie, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: I bought these for myself, but I can't keep my teenage son and husband out of them. They are that good! My husband is real picky when it comes to items with whey protein in them, but he says there is no aftertaste. I am not as picky as him, but these are a real treat to drink! I take one to work, and I blend it with ice, half in the AM for breakfast, the other half in the afternoon for lunch. I have a spoonful of peanut butter with it, eaten directly off the spoon, to round out my \\"meal\\", and I can go all day then and not be hungry. This is the easiest diet choice I have ever made! I have also tried the orange flavor, which is also very good, but I prefer the strawberry flavor. The ingredient list is very nice too, all pronouncable items, which is a real plus! I hope it goes on sale again, so I can stock up- thanks to my family members we are almost done with the 4 dozen I bought to start off with =/

product_title: Log Cabin All Natural Syrup, 22 oz (Pack of 3)
review_headline: A little goes a long way
review_body: I love this syrup, it doesnt have all those added ingredients, its not like dark amber syrup thats extra sweet. A little bit goes a long way. When i pour it on my waffles i only need to pour it in the middle and thats enough for 1 whole waffle. So if you think this little bottle wont work for big families you would be mistaken, i use half as much as i would with the fructose added syrups.

product_title: Starbucks VIA® Ready Brew Iced Coffee
review_body: I am an admitted Starbucks addict. I spend $60 plus a month on coffee shop coffee. I am amazed at how good this tastes!!!! I am seriously considering only buying the via from now on. I have wanted to cut down my coffee bill and this makes it all possible. I have added Torani's white chocolate mocha sauce to this but only a tablespoon. It is perfectly sweet for me with this addition.  This may have been the best thing Starbucks has ever done in my opinion. Love it!

product_title: Taylors of Harrogate Yorkshire Gold
review_body: Was turned on to this tea by my Britsh friend, Fiona, it is a fabulos tea! I have it almost every morning (occaconally we like to have another Britsh Fav - Ty-Phoo) with a splash of milk and some biscuits. Makes for an excellent breakfast and a great start to the day. I use 4 bags for my two quart pot and get about eight cups of tea.

product_title: Premium Bourbon-Madagascar Vanilla Beans - 1/4 lb. - Approx. 27 beans
review_body: These were not my first purchase of vanilla beans but are of the same quality and freshness that I am accustomed to. I am pleased. We make our own vanilla extract and the beans, when split and inserted into the bottle of high quality alcohol, (Everclear cut with good quality Brandy, for example) begin to release their essence right away. We use 3 to 4 beans per bottle...more beans, stronger extract. If the bottle is clear, you can see the dark chocolate color begin to ooze from the beans right away. We seal and date the bottles and don't open them for at least a year. Talk about delayed gratification! It is such a delight to cook with this heavenly extract, and when you finally uncork the bottle the aroma will transport you. Great beans, excellent price.

product_title: Jolly Rancher Twist - Apple, 160 count
review_body: I bought these from Amazon, it was a good deal and was shipped very quickly.  I wish they would sell the Cherry Jolly Ranchers by the box.

product_title: Nissin Chow Mein Q&E Teri Beef, 4-Ounce Units (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Delicious ! but Nutrition Label is misleading
review_body: I give this Five Stars for overall value and flavor.    And if you look at the Label it states just 290 Calories and 650mg Sodium per Serving, which ain't bad. But wait - there are TWO SERVINGS per package !    Seriously, what normal person is going to make 1/2 a package ?    Can't be too down on the manufacturer, though, as this game is being played by many.    And don't forget it's MADE IN THE USA.

product_title: Eden Organic Black Beans, No Salt Added, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I have always loved black turtle beans and eat them often. I was happy to learn of Eden Organic and the no-BPA can. As others reported, the shipment arrived very badly dented. Wasn't thrilled with that, but okay. Stuff happens. The real disappointment came when I opened the first can. I actually thought I had opened a can of kidney beans by mistake.

These are not traditional black turtle beans. I don't know what kind of bean they are, but if you are looking for the traditional black turtle bean, this is not it. And it's not just the reddish brown color that gives these away - even the taste is unlike traditional black beans.

They don't taste bad, just more along the lines of a kidney bean taste instead of a black bean. I know there are other types of black beans and maybe this is one of those. But the can says black turtle beans and those they certainly are not.

product_title: Great Northern Popcorn, Portion Packs (Pack of 24)
review_body: The popcorn arrived the same day as our new Great Northern Foundation 8 oz popcorn machine. While using these packets couldn't be simpler, they are just a smidge too wide for easy access to the preheated popping bucket. You're having to dump the whole package, oil, salt and popcorn, into the bucket from the side, and if the oil, salt and popcorn were all in one compartment, it might be narrower and easier. That said, we found the popcorn that came out of these prepackaged packets just a little salty for our taste. In future, we'll probably make it without using the whole packet of salt. The butter-flavored salt is a great idea, just maybe a little less of it.

product_title: Lindt Excellence Dark Chocolate, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body:
To the whiners complaining this has artificial ingredients: Did you read the label before buying it?

The salt:chocolate ratio is great and you get that slight crunch from the salt crystals in each bite. It's absolutely AMAZING and as another reviewer states pairs fantastic with red wine.

Don't give a product a bad review because you don't like the ingredients or this chocolate isn't \\"good enough\\" for you because of the amount of sugar. You're not Ruth freaking Reichl -- get over yourselves. And I'm pretty sure even she would think this is delicious.

product_title: Solo Filling, Raspberry, 12-Ounce Unit (Pack of 12)
review_body: I bake cakes and this is the ONLY filling I do not attempt to make myself because it is so delicious and so easy to use that there is no point in trying to duplicate it!  The case price is great, much more of a deal than buying individual cans at the grocery store.  I will continue to buy this product for years to come.  Most importantly, my cake customers love it too.

product_title: Giant Reese’s Milk Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups Candy Bar Valentines
review_headline: Great, but too much for one
review_body: They did an amazing job translating the peanut butter cup to such a large size, managing to maintain a good ratio of chocolate and peanut butter filling. If you are more of a fan of the chocolate you may find it a bit too heavy on filling, but I personally found it perfect. There are some complication related to the size that makes it a bit messy to eat because the chocolate breaks, don't bother trying to cut it. I think most people will be hard-pressed to enjoy a full pound of Reese's cups over anything less than a month's time, so it's probably best to give one of the pair away.

product_title: Kleins Natural’s Natural Dried Apricots Discs, Dried Apricots Snack Packs, Sweetened Dry Apricot, 7-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Another great product from Kleins' Naturals
review_body: These are apricot fruit leather-type snacks, in round form; the calorie, sugar, and fiber counts are great for healthy food plans, including diabetics.  The flavor is tangy, much like the California apricots.  I'll be sure to keep these on my list of things to reorder in the future.

product_title: Native Forest Organic Coconut Milk
review_headline: Every Can Was Dented - Product Was OK
review_body:
Package arrived today and both the outer (Amazon) and inner (product) boxes were completely undamaged but every can inside was dented -- some very minor and others very misshapen. And the damage \\"location\\" varies widely, so that means they were damaged BEFORE they were boxed up. I opened the worst one and tasted the product. It tastes OK to me, but I don't know for sure that its safe. Guess I'll know by morning. :o) Had I known I would be receiving dented cans I may have opted not to purchase, and instead waited for a sale at my local store. In my opinion Amazon should sell the damaged and undamaged merchandise separately and at different price points.

Update: No issues post sampling :) -- the product inside was indeed OK, so I have increased the rating from 2 to 3 stars.

product_title: Post Trail Mix Crunch Cereal, Raisin & Almond, 17-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: I can no longer find Trail Mix Crunch Cereal in the grocery stores, so was happy to find it through Amazon.  I prefer the vanilla/cranberry flavor, but can't find it, so settle for the raisin/almond [[ASIN:B001E52ZBW Post Trail Mix Crunch Cereal, Raisin & Almond, 17-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)]].  I'm getting 4 boxes at a time which will last me for months.

product_title: Crown Prince Natural Salmon
review_headline: Oops! My mistake: CONTAINS BPA! Goodbye to this product!
review_body:
UPDATE: BUT 5 stars GO TO AMAZON WHO ISSUED A CREDIT FOR MY LAST ORDER OF THIS PRODUCT! GOOD WORK AND THANK YOU AMAZON, I AM IMPRESSED!!! -Mo
..........................................

(change from 5 stars to 1) CANCEL THIS PRAISE OF THIS PRODUCT! It DOES contain BPA! -Mo
..........................................

This is *great* fish; no BPA, no added salt (*I* choose what and if salt is added), I LOVE lots of eatable fish bones (top calcium availability), congratulations Crown Prince and thank you for canning fish I can eat without BPA!

product_title: Miracle Fruit Tablets
review_body:
Lemons are the best with this product, they taste like a sweetened lemonade...
Limes taste like limeade...
and Snozzberries taste like snozzade...wait...

These are great for little tasting parties like we had...everyone was curious what different things would taste like and we had tasted many things in the fridge from pickles, lemons, limes, cheese, and sriracha. Little on the expensive side but still fun to try.

Knocked off one star because it's not amazing, but it definiately is interesting and pretty much everything just tastes sweeter.

product_title: Dona MariaPlatillo, Pollo con Mole,  Chicken with Mole, Medium Hot,10-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Don't be fooled by the picture
review_body: The label shows chunks of chicken. Inside, however, are a few token scraps of chicken in tub of tasteless mole.

product_title: Dan-D-Pak Rice Crackers with Wasabi Peas, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: Good wasabi flavor without everything in the bag being flavored with it.  The rice crackers are crispy, and the wasabi peas are almost a tempura coating- and potent, but when eaten with the other crackers, just right :)

product_title: 1883 Melon Syrup 1000mL
review_body: ive been looking for a melon syrup to add to my homemade green tea frappucinos (like starbucks) and so glad i found this one!  starbucks uses torani, which is now discontinued.  this tastes exactly like it so its a great replacement!  and a great price for a HUGE bottle

product_title: Underwood Deviled Ham Spread, 4.25 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: Wow, I wish they would reduce the sodium in this product. It could be so convenient to have around for a quick bite. But no, not worth the health hazard. And the taste is overwhelming salt, it hits you on the first bite.

product_title: Liquid Aminos 16 oz. 16 Ounces
review_body: when I decided to become vegan many years ago i became acquainted with health food  not to say I became health nut. Even not being vegan anymore, Bragg liquid Amino is one  thing i cant live without.  Not only is a supper healthy adding to the daily meals 16 amino acids combined, its flavor is awesome :)

product_title: Freshpak Rooibos Tea, 80 Tagless Teabags (2 x Pack)
review_body: I cannot do caffeine and this tea is great.  It has a thick taste unlike herbal teas and is very satisfying!

product_title: Esposito's Finest Quality Sausage - CHEESE AND PARSLEY SAUSAGE - (4) 24oz Packages (Net Wt. 6lbs.)
review_body: This is the best thin sausage that I have had since moving to South Carolina several years ago. I will definately try some of their other products when I place my reorder.

product_title: Sprout Organic Baby Food (Pack of 12)
review_body: I like the Sprout brand very much but I have to say that my daughter is sensitive to Italian style food right now and really disliked this meal a lot. Perhaps the spices are too strong? Not sure but this one was not a hit! She disliked the lasagne too. We are sticking with the Holiday turkey, mac and cheese, and peach pumpkin pie. We have yet to try the chicken and vegetable, or the other turkey option but I would recommend this brand, just not the spicier meals.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Whole Bean Coffee, Colombian Peaks, 33 Ounce
review_body: This product was a great deal when I first signed up for subscribe and save. Started off at $10.93, then when up to $11.03, then wow, $19.00. I understand a little price increase, but this is ridiculous

product_title: Morton & Bassett Herbs De Provence, .7-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Very interesting and unique flavor--one of my favorite spices
review_body: I bought a jar of this while on a roadtrip one weekend (so not from Amazon) along with a few other new spices (including [[ASIN:B004K6G90A Morton & Basset Chinese 5 Spice, 1.9-Ounce (Pack of 3)]] which is fantastic beyond words) and immediately got hooked. I think that it is the bright little taste of lavender that gets to me so much, but overall this is just a really great spice, a terrific mix of flavors that is completely unexpected. I hate to use the word \\"unique\\" because it's such a vague word, but this flavor is just that: a world unto itself. Oddly enough it's one of the few spice flavors that I can conjure up in my memory just by thinking of it--isn't that funny? If I just picture the jar in my head I can recall the flavor (and that's not as easy as it sounds!). Anyway, love the spice and I have to say that, as a previous reviewer said, this is the ultimate flavoring for an omelette: you put this on eggs once and you're hooked. I've yet to meet a Morton & Basset herb that I didn't like and I like the jars so much that I save them when empty and reuse them.

product_title: Annie Chun's Ramen
review_body:
Ramen is one of those items I like to keep on hand. After becoming vegan, I was hard pressed to find a ramen I could eat. Then I found this ramen at Whole Foods and decided it was so good, I had to buy it by the case!

My favorite way to enjoy this ramen is to prepare as directed, but add miso, seaweed and sesame oil. DEEElicious!

Also try Annie Chun's \\"ginger soy\\" flavor. It's pretty tasty too.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Light Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: When I put my first K-Cup in, I thought it was defective -- it shook like a maracca egg, and most Keurig owners know that there is a tiny basket-shaped filter halfway down in the cup.  Nonetheless, I put the cup in and pushed the Brew button.  After an brief initial stream of normal-looking coffee, clear water started streaming through the bottom of the K-Cup into my coffee mug.  My wife came in, noticed, and said \\"Oh, are you cleaning the basket today?\\"  I removed the spent cup and cut the foil.  These so-called K-Cups are just a plastic cup with a teaspoon of instant coffee in it.  Listen, folks, a 16oz jar of Folgers elsewhere on this site costs $18.37 and has \\"60 more servings than 12oz jar.\\"  Which means you can get 240 servings at about 8 cents per cup.  If you were like me, and were in something of a rush going through the supermarket aisle, you saw \\"Naturally Roasted Soluble and Microground Arabica & Robusta Coffee\\" on the box and did not see \\"Instant Freeze-Dried Coffee\\" anywhere on the package.  So you paid 42 cents per cup of instant coffee and some unscrupulous marketing guy is getting a raise for overcharging us more than 500% for no-name instant coffee.  So why would you buy this product?  Because you were fooled by that guy, no doubt, like I was.  I want my money back.

product_title: Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn Seasoning, Movie Theater Style, 12-Ounce Jar
review_body: The butter flavor of this topping is decent. But the salt is beyond reason. I shook a minimal amount on our first batch of popcorn and none of us could continue to eating past the first few bites. Now, I sprinkle maybe 3 shakes over an entire large bowl and then I end up with several really salty bites and a bunch of popcorn with no topping flavor at all on it. I might consider a low-salt version of this, but with the amount I have left of these bottles, it will probably take me 3 years to get through it. I'll probably end up throwing them away.

product_title: igourmet Collier's Cheddar (7.5 ounce)
review_headline: The Best Sharp Cheddar Cheese I've Ever Eaten
review_body: This is THE, bar-none, BEST cheddar cheese I've ever eaten.  It has an excellent texture and many layers of flavors that make it great in salads, sandwiches, sauces or just sliced with apples or pears.  On fresh toast with fresh apples and a sprinkle of curry powder and you'll have a gloriously happy mouth. All other cheddars totally pale compared to this one.  It's a wee bit expensive, but honestly it is worth the extra cost for something this special.  A little will go a long way with this kind of flavor.  When I found Colliers Cheddar at my local Safeway, I kept buying it every week or so.  Unfortunately, they quit carrying it; I was so disappointed.  Now that I see it on Amazon, I can get my Colliers hit again!

product_title: White Poppy Seed, 10 lbs.
review_body: great product and delivery!We love the taste and quality, it grinds and cooks well! It has a superb nutty taste and makes a wonderful posto charchori (bengali words). We cook it  bengali style and enjoy it with fresh steamed rice!

product_title: Mastro Lorenzo Espresso, 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Brewers (Pack of 3)
review_body: I am totally happy with this espresso. I like it just as well as my ESE espresso maker, and actually get more espresso from this (plus it's easier). Note though, this pulls a 1.5 oz shot, not your typical 1 oz shot. However I have discovered it is enough for my 12 oz of milk. So for me it has saved me money since with my ESE espresso maker I have to use two pods to get the same satisfaction in the cup.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings - Herbal Tea Caffeine Free Jammin' Lemon Ginger
review_body: This tea smells like coffee but tastes terrible. It has no tea flavor, just a little weak cinnamon, burnt cocoa taste.

product_title: Broadway Basketeers Birthday Celebration Gift Tower with a Gourmet Assortment of Sweets, Nuts & Pastries
review_headline: A lot smaller than I thought, not worth the price
review_body: It'd MAYBE be worth the price if it was no more than $15... but almost $40!?!? No way. That was a stupid purchase on my behalf. The largest box on the bottom is the size of my hand and, obviously, it gets smaller as it goes to the top. And, because of the box sizes, there wasn't much in the plastic bags inside each one. They stuff some of the boxes with shredded tissue to make it look like there's more too. The pro's about it are that it's definitely asthetically pleasing with the \\"gold\\" boxes and red bow, and the treats inside were very good, though very few. My suggestion would be to skip this product and find something that isn't such a huge rip-off.

product_title: Sonoma Syrup Co. Simple Syrup
review_body: I recently used this simple syrup to make mojitos.  It gives a great minty flavor (and cuts down on the time for muddling the mint leaves).  I received my bottle at a trade show, but I intend to buy more as soon as I run out.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Miso Ramen, 1.9-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6)
review_body: If you add about a 1/2 teaspoon of miso paste to each cup you'll have something resembling miso soup - but if you have to do that, why bother getting these ramen pks?

product_title: Yogourmet Freeze Dried Yogurt Starter, 1 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_body: I have used this starter at least six times and have never been disappointed with the results. it's a good product.

product_title: Kinder Chocolate Milk and Cocoa Chocolate 8 Bars Pack, TEN 100g/Bar
review_body: Came in a great package with cooling bags and it was not melted by the high outside temperature. This chocolate is one of the most commonly used for kids in Western Europe, I am wondering why it is not sold in major retail stores in the US. Great product! 5 stars, thanks!

product_title: Destiny Deep Sea Water, 16.9 Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: This is a great product to try for those  looking for a good substitute for FIji water.  It has the cleanest taste, and I truly believe the story behind it.  I am really glad I gave it a try. Thanks Destiny!

product_title: Olive Tortilla Chips
review_headline: Even my Italian husband loves them!
review_body: Delicious! We are new to Gluten Free products and have begun trying everything out there. Even my gluten free resistant Italian-American husband likes these! They are his favorite!!!

product_title: Wonka Laffy Taffy, Banana Flavor, 145 count tub (Pack of 1)
review_body:
All three arrived in good condition and well packed within the time frame indicated by Amazon. Great stuff if you like it, and I do; not so good if you don't.
I will definitely order this again when my supply runs out.
Thanks Amazon!

product_title: SF Signature Milk Chocolate Fondue, 3.5-Pound (Pack of 2)
review_body: Throw the bag in the microwave, turn on the fountain, pour the melted chocolate from the bag into the fountain, ????, profit.    The chocolate tastes great, you don't have to cut it up/mix it with oil/anything else.    Don't try to heat it in the fountain alone, unless you have lots of time on your hands. In my experience, once you bust out the fountain, people drool in anticipation and making them wait half an hour + for the fountain alone to melt the chocolate causes unhappy guests. It works much better heating in the microwave for a little bit to get it melted and then dumping it into the fountain; maybe a 5 minute ordeal TOPS.    Texture: smooth, not waxy at all.  Sweetness: high, they added plenty of sugar to the cocoa.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend Medium K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: I'm not quite sure how to state this, but this is the nastiest tasting coffee, I have ever had in a K-cup. It even smells horrible!  I truly think something is wrong... I asked one of my co workers to smell it, and he's reply was \\"it smells toxic\\".  So...........I have returned the remaining 49 K-cups, even though it states grocieries can not be returned.  I really think someone should look into this, it might be a bad batch!  Have not heard from Amazon yet as to what they intend to do, I hsave asked for an exchange of another brand, but so far no refund on my credit card, and no reply as to an exchange.........but according to my tracking number, they have received it.  We'll see.........in the meantime, pick another brand.  I don't even want to put a rating, but I can't get this published unless I give it a rating, so Iguess, I have to put 1 star to get it published.  It does not even deserve 1 star.

product_title: Broccoli and Friends Sprouting Seed Mix, One Pound
review_body: good price, makes for nice sprouts, wish it were just a tad been stronger with the radish, I love the spicy bite.  shipment was fast, thanks!

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Dark Coffee, 5 Pound
review_body: As always, fast delivery from Amazon.  This is a very good tasting decaf coffee.  Dark and rich in looks and flavor.  This bean provides a rather strong tasting cup of coffee which was just what I was looking for.  No aftertaste which is so common with many decaf coffees.

product_title: Gatorade Propel® Powder Packets, Berry. Case of 120
review_headline: I made a mistake ~ DON'T BUY
review_body: You can get these PROPEL paks for $2.99 per box (10 per box) at Target; I got ripped but it was my own fault for not checking first.

product_title: Justin's Nut Butter Natural Maple Almond Butter, 10, 1.15 ounce Squeeze Packs  (Pack of 3)
review_body: First, Justin's is the best almond butter ever. It's a joy to eat on anything.     I wanted something for snacks/meals at work, and these are perfect. First you never need to worry about the oil separating out in the jar, since you squish each packet to combine before opening. Next you don't need a knife - the corner of the packet tears open easily and you can just squeeze it on to what ever you'd like. And if you only open one, it's automatic portion control.    Last but not least, they make great mini-gifts for coworkers who've given you that coffee packet when you really needed it, or that paper plate when your lunch was leaking. Even better, you may get someone else hooked so you can split the order next time.

product_title: Pepperidge Farms Goldfish, Flavor Blasted Xplosive Pizza, 6.6-ounce bag
review_body: A super delicious snack that I have grown to love. While at my computer I can devour an entire bag of 6 oz. Pepperidge Farm good are A-1 with me. Hope they'll develop new flavors soon.

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Squares, Dark and Mint Filled, 5.32 oz., (Pack of 6)
review_body: This was some of the best chocolate I have ever tasted and the mint creme center was tasty and delicious. The price was very good too. All in all a very pleasant experience enjoying them.

product_title: True Lemon Crystallized Lemon, 32 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love lemon on everything, especially on vegetables.  With these little packages, I can even take them with me to the restaurants.  THey are also great poured into cans of diet SPRITE.  It adds a little more zest to my drinks.  I love this product!

product_title: Carbon's Golden Malted Original Waffle and Pancake Flour
review_headline: Best Waffles I have ever eaten.
review_body: I have bought this waffle mix twice and will definitely buy it again.  Had company over for waffles and sausage and they wanted to take a can of mix home, so I had to order more.

product_title: True Lemon Shaker
review_headline: OPPS!!  Not the same as the True Lemon in envelopes
review_body: This True Lemon is not the same as the True Lemon that is sold in the single serving envelope.  It does not have the fresh Lemon flavor that the envelopes have.  The envelopes are labeled for use in water, teas & recipes.  The large jar is labeled for cooking, baking, & seasoning.  I called the manufacturer and they said the true lemon is different in the jar because it is designed to survive the heat of cooking and baking.  If you want the taste of fresh Lemon for beverages, you have to use the True Lemon in envelopes.

product_title: Sensible Portions Pita Bites Original Sea Salt - 20 oz
review_body: The order arrived with at least 1/2 of the chips broken. I will not order this again. Good chips, but not the way to get them.

product_title: Green Mountain Half-Caff Coffee K-Cup 108 Pack
review_headline: The third cup in the morning or the last cup at night.
review_body: This is my coffee when I don't want more caffeine but want a cup of coffee.  Unlike Decaf, this has a real coffee taste and smell.  It is as satisfying as a cup of \\"real\\" coffee while cutting the caffeine.  I find this to be the perfect choice for my third cup in the morning or the last cup at night.

product_title: Rice Dream Rice Drink
review_body: As a mom of a child with dairy allergies, it's very hard to travel without this product. The small boxes are very convenient, and being that many times the original formula of this milk is hard to find, I'm assured that I have it available when we are out. Yes, a little pricey, but worth it.

product_title: Harry and David Moose Munch Confection Milk Chocolate and White Chocolate Cranberry - 2 Pound 8 Ounce Christmas Holiday Day Gift Box
review_body: what else can ya say???  The gift recipient almost didn't receive it!  I had never tasted it before, but wowwwwww

product_title: David Sunflower Seed, Nacho Cheese Flavor, 5.25-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I always have loved David's Nacho Cheese flavored sunflower seeds. They are my favorite and the only ones I eat now...

product_title: Newtons Fruit Thins Cranberry Citrus Oats, 10.5-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_headline: More a cookie than a "thin", but that's not a bad thing.
review_body:
I ordered the Newtons Fruit Thins because they were intriguing. As a long-time fan of the Newton cakes (Fig Newtons, Strawberry Newtons, etc) I was expecting either a soft, chewy product or some kind of a cracker.

It was neither, but rather a fruit cookie that in some ways reminded me of the stained-glass cookies my mother used to bake at Christmas (these had chopped up bits of colorful fruit candies in them, hence the resemblance to stained glass windows). They've got a satisfying crunch, and they're more aromatic than most packaged cookies I've had. The citrus and cranberry flavors really come off with a scent that's like cranberry-orange juice, which may not appeal to your average chocolate chip cookie fan, but my 2-year-old certainly enjoys them and I feel better giving her these rather than some Chips-A-Hoy.

These really fill a snack/dessert niche better than a fruit or healthy snack niche, so long as you order them with that expectation you won't be disappointed.

product_title: MIO Liquid Peach Tea, 1.62-Ounce, (Pack of 4)
review_body: I must admit, I am hooked.  I have tried almost all the flavors and the Peach Tea is my favorite.  I really like how you can add more or less to suit your personal taste.  It is a great alternitive to drinking Kool-aid(hate the stuff!) or Soda.  I find myself drinking at least 2 more glasses of water a day because of this product.

product_title: Light Grey Celtic coarse sea salt, 1 lb. bag
review_headline: Miracle Salt is What it Should be Called!
review_body: Did you know that if you wake up in the middle of the night to..., you know... p that that's a sign of a mineral disfunction?  Well I just found that out, and took the advice to take a little bit of this salt right before going to bed (I take like a quarter tea spoon with some cranberry pills), and do you know that I do not wake up AT ALL all night long!!!  It's like a miracle happened.  I have not slept through an entire night in, well, a few years!  but now this Celtic Sea salt in take before bed is doing the trick!  A miracle I tell ya!  A miracle!  and I love this salt ta boot!  I put it on just about everything.

product_title: Ausome Candy Super Mario Theme 3 Dees Sour Gummy Candies Movie Theatre Concession Candy Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Sour gummy candies, exactly as expected
review_body: I found these to be exactly as I expected.  They are typical gummy candies dusted with sour stuff.  The figures lack detail because of the sour stuff.  The first box I opened contained two transparent plastic packets of five pieces each.  The first packet had all Mario and Yoshi.  The second packet had all Donkey and Diddy Kong.  Mario and Yoshi were Strawberry and Mixed berries.  Donkey and Diddy Kong were Watermelon and Orange.  They were all yummy!  The packaging is exactly as pictured.

product_title: Wilton Decorative Icing Mix
review_body: How could anything negative be said about old-time buttercream frosting?  This is the first time I've used it, and the results couldn't have been better.  Will certainly order more Wilton products.  Shipped very quickly from seller.

product_title: Bar Harbor All Natural Maine Salmon Chowder
review_body: I just finished my first bowl of this clam chowder, and was disappointed to find, or rather, not find, clams. Don't get me wrong -- the soup was good, with a very nice texture and taste, but the clams were AWOL. Several times I bit into something that provided a small burst of clam flavor, but only once did I find a clam fragment big enough to look at. I'm going to buy some chopped clams to kind of \\"chum\\" a bit. This, of course increases the cost of the meal. I'm going to try some other brands as well.    I do hope that Bar Harbor does some testing. The label shows clams as the most prevalent ingredient, but I don't see how that can be -- my money is on the potatos.

product_title: Martha's Gingerbread Pancake Mix (Large 2lb Mix)
review_body: If you like gingerbread, then this is one of the only gingerbread pancakes mixes I could find.  As I am a ginger lover, they are a bit mild for me, but I think right for most tastes.  I like them for a change of pace from regular pancakes, especially with powdered sugar on top!

product_title: Weaver's Coffee and Tea The Blend, Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have tried almost all Weaver's Blends and single-origin coffee, and the aroma and flavor are always HUGE!  I will drink nothing else, ever.  Weaver's is always fresh!

product_title: Salsa, Garlic Cilantro, Medium, Organic, 16 oz.
review_body: Bulk Nuts for You - Are you nuts this item is less than $3.00 in the store. This is a great product but a horrible price.

product_title: Udi's Gluten Free Granola Sampler (2 Original, 2 Au Naturel, 1 Cranberry, 1 Vanilla)
review_body: I thought I was going to have to give up granola once I went gluten free.  The other granolas I tried, well, let just say they tasted like they should be 'good for me'.  Udi's GF Granola is light years better that all other GF granolas: crunchy and stightly sweet.    Purchasing note - you do get 6 bags of granola.  I ordered the subscription and used the discount code UDISO3II (list about 1/2 down from the top of the page) and got almost $9.00 off.

product_title: Lucky Eight Jasmine Green Tea - 100 Individually Wrapped Tea Bags (7 Oz)
review_body: An excellent tea! This is an elegant green tea with the marvelous perfume of Jasmine flower petals. The convenient bags brew a large (16 oz) cup of wonderfully aromatic tea that is nicely concentrated and without a perceptable tannic bite.  The quality is equivalent to many loose Jasmine teas. If stored in an air-tight container, this tea will maintain its flavor for months.

product_title: All Bran Cereal, Strawberry Medley, 13.2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_body: Fantastic cereal just very hard to find. Not sure why that is since everywere I go it's always sold out and the other flavors from the same brand are just sitting on the shelves not selling. And Amazon even has trouble keeping it in stock.

product_title: Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories
review_body: If you love Peanut Butter but don't like the calories, THIS IS YOUR DREAM COME TRUE!!! This peanut butter tastes, looks, and smells just like normal peanut butter! But the calorie content is so low that it makes you want to eat lots more of it! Definitely recommended! Works great for baking products too!!!

product_title: Inspired Cuisine Creme Brulee Mix, 4.55-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 8)
review_body: This creme brulee mix makes a reasonable facsimile of the real thing within several minutes with no hassle.  While the real item is a bit better, this one is pretty close and allows me to make something that I would not attempt otherwise.  While I love to cook, desserts are not my thing.  This is a very good item worthy of a try.  I'll buy it again.

product_title: Diamond Inshell Nuts
review_body: I like the Diamond mixed nuts but there were not enough evenly mixed nuts in the bag leaving me feeling a little cheated also they were not fresh as they could have being tasted like they had being sitting for some time so i would not ever buy them again.

product_title: Crystal Light Skin Essentials, White Peach Tea, 7-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Why can't I buy this locally?
review_body: We found this flavor of tea in our local store, bought it and loved it.  Then we could never find it again.  Researching it on the 'net, we found that \\"it is not available in your area\\".  Why not?  We bought a whole lot of it from Amazon and hope that when it runs out, we can get more.  Yes, it's that good.

product_title: Ancient Harvest Organic Quinoa Flour
review_headline: a good deal on high quality flour
review_body: I love this flour and use it for my son's GF diet recipes.  Buying Gluten Free products on Amazon saves me the long trip to the specialty store. Per box, this flour was priced slightly lower than Whole Foods. The shipping brought it up to Whole Foods price, but I saved on gas and time going there.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body: I was really looking forward to this cacao powder and really wanted to like it, but it is REALLY not good.  It tastes very mild and the only taste I can really get out of it is the bitter taste.  It doesn't have the rich taste I am use to .. just bland and bitter.

product_title: FiberWise Natural Fiber Rich Pasta Spaghetti, 16-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: 12 Grams Fiber and 8 grams protein per 2 ounce dry serving !
review_body: I have used this product for 5 years and absolutely love it.  My family doesn't care for the taste or look of 100% Whole Wheat pasta.  FiberWise provides much more fiber than whole wheat with a look and taste that my family doesn't notice as different than regular pasta.  It is a little darker than regular pasta, but no one has ever commented on that.  Maybe I'm the only one who realizes that.     When my local grocery store quit carrying FiberWise, I started purchasing from FiberWise directly, but had to purchase twice as much, plus pay postage. Amazon ships quickly and I can combine with other purchases for free shipping.  I have also used the macaroni, shells, fettuchini, penne and others.  Every type has the same fiber and protein and has been accepted by even my most picky grandchild.

product_title: Boston Tea Finest Grade Loose Naturally Decaffeinated Apricot Green Tea, 8-Ounce Bag
review_body: I have been trying to find a decaf apricot loose leaf tea that compares with one served at a little cafe I frequented in the Dallas metroplex. I was so hoping this would be the one but it isn't. It has a 'bite' to it that I don't care for. I tried mixing in plain green tea, at first by half then 3/4ths and I just can't drink it. Very disappointed :-(.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Cereal
review_body:
This is a good product and were it certified gluten free, I'd have given it 5 stars. My kids like it, even the older ones. It's plain, naturally, but that's the idea. While it hasn't caused any serious reactions, we're not seriously allergic to gluten, just intolerant.

For those who are dairy free, we've served it with rice milk, (we tend to avoid soy milk as too much if it isn't good for kids due to the hormonal influence), hot cocoa (dairy free; this makes it into a hot cereal that can be more fun than simply cooking hulled millet.)

We buy it by the case on subscription to save money as it's difficult to find any plain millet where we live.

product_title: Cafe Caribe Dark Roast Espresso Coffee, 10-Ounce Bricks (Pack of 6)
review_body: This espresso coffee is exceptional for taste, convenience of packaging and well worth every penny! The perfect cup or three to brighten your day, any day!!

product_title: Nature's Path Chia Plus Granola, Coconut Chia, 12.34-Ounce
review_body: I buy this product at local farmers market stores and this deal was a great price for the amount of boxes included. Will definitely be purchasing again from this buyer in the future. Received in June and the expiration on the product is good until November thats 5 months plenty of time to finish the boxes. This product is an extremely healthy alternative to the high in sugar cereals found at the popular grocery stores. Fast delivery.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Double Black Diamond, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I've tried various dark roasts with K-cups and could not find something that was dark and rich enough.  Tired the Caribou, Jet Fuel, French Roast....nothing.  My apartment smells great and this is a smooth, rich cup of coffee.  I highly recommend it to dark roast lovers.

product_title: First Colony Coffee Ghiradelli Double Chocolate Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: Ghiradelli Double Chocolate coffee is my FAVORITE coffee!  The hint of chocolate is subtle and compliments the flavor of the roasted beans perfectly.  While described as a light roast, I like to grind the beans finer to produce a more robust brew.  For me, it's more than just coffee -- it's a real treat!

product_title: Emerald Old Fashioned Honey Roast Peanuts, 12-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 12)
review_body: When I was young, I remember flying and getting a small packet of these on each flight, which I loved. I came across these and thought I would buy a few canisters. Big mistake, I have probably gained 3 to 5 pounds in peanut fat. They are very good and more than a little addicting. I open a can and say to myself, \\"okay self, we will just eat a few and put them away\\". Next thing I know I've eaten the whole jar. Other than causing the tendency to eat to the point of self-loathing, they are fantastic. They are in no way healthy and are covered with a honey shell, but they taste of heaven. My only legitimate complaint is that there are some rock-like globs of the honey coating mixed into the nuts and I have bitten down on them painfully more than once. I will not buy them again because I don't want to become obese, but I would recommend them to others.

product_title: Flaked Coconut (Unsweetened)
review_body: I love the BIG flakes of this coconut. It is perfect in homemade granola or for a snack for children.

product_title: America'S Finest Products Soilove Soil/Stain Remover, 16 oz
review_body: I don't even remember when and where I found Soilove. All I remember is this green bottle was sitting on the top of my laundry shelf that I haven't use it for years. Not until I became a mom that I notice Soilove is such a great product. My in-law are the main baby caretakers and they hate using bibs!! I bought many pretty bibs my in-law just use them as part of a cute outfit for my son. Then I tried Baby Bjorn pocket bibs and my in-law still don't want to use them. My son particularly loves purple yam puree. All his clothes were full of purple stains. I hate to see my son in a dirty cloth. One day I just remember I still have half bottle of Soilove on top of the shelf so why not give it a try? I'm so glad that I did. I've been using Soilove to save my baby's clothes.

product_title: Anna Tubetti #62 Pasta, 1 Pound Bags (Pack of 20)
review_body: I love Anna Pasta, but I have ordered this twice and each time, several bags were broken and the pasta comes out of the bag.  The first time there were 6 broken bags, the second time, I found 11 busted bags and the pasta all over the box.  Although the pasta is good, it is not sanitary to find your pasta all over a box, especially eleven bags!  Let's get with the program and give your customers what they pay for....quality.  Thanks!

product_title: Antica Tostatura Triestina Retail Pack - Espresso Pods, 7-Gram Packages
review_body: Unless I am mistaken, there is no description of the number of pods contained in the item. Without that and a clear description of the coffee, I can not even consider it.

product_title: Cascadian Farm Organic Fiber Almond Butter Crunchy Granola Bars, 7.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: These granola bars are very good. My one complaint is that they are rather crumbly, which don't make them the best choice for kids. But this isn't exactly a flaw with the product.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_body: I love this tea! I use it hot or cold and it tastes sooo good either way. It tastes sweet without any sugar! If fact, the first few times I made it I had to check the contents to make sure it didn't contain sugar or artificial sweetener. It really takes away my craving for something sweet after meals. Great product!

product_title: Loma Linda Low Fat Big Franks, 20-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are delicious in a Hot Dog bun.  they are a good size and don't fall apart when cooking.  i've tried other veggie sausages but these are the best.

product_title: Betty Lou's Nut Butter Balls, Peanut Butter, 1.7 Ounce (Pack of 18)
review_body: Barely sweet.  Could not distinguish the flavor of peanuts over any other nut.  Just a rich fatty taste with a hint of alcohol in the background.  The packaging led me to believe that these were going to be a wholesome treat both in nutritional value and taste.  At the end of the day there are much better protein and health bar solutions.

product_title: Star Anise & Cinnamon Formerly Green Chai 20 Bags
review_body: This a a fabulous tea. So smooth and full of flavor and aroma. By far my favorite chai when I have to use a tea bag

product_title: Bumble Bee Chunk White Albacore Tuna in Water (866253) 5 oz (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Mush - it disingrates in mayonnaise. No Chunks.
review_body: I just tried this brand after after having not had it for a long time. It seemed to disintegrate in mayonnaise. It is the consistency of baby food. It dripped out of the sandwich even though I didn't use a large amount of mayonnaise. On the plus side there were no off flavors.    I have been getting my tuna at Costco, they have Kirkland(house brand) 7oz cans. There are huge, solid chunks of real, white tuna meat. They are hard to break up with a fork. This is by far the best tuna I have had in a can, but I get it from Costco more because the size is better to make a couple of sandwiches, instead of the normal one and a half or so I can get out of  5oz cans. This Bumble Bee brand was just one sandwich for the same 5oz. I don't know if there is more water, or the consistency just meant the tuna didn't go that far because it broke down. Maybe the next time they shrink-ray the tuna and go to 4oz cans, the extra large family size will be large enough to get two sandwiches out of? As for now I am going to hold off on buying from a supermarkets until I can get at least a 6ox. Until then it is Costco. Note: My rating has nothing to do with the size issue, that is just a bonus rant. I can't mention tuna without getting mad about the size of the cans, although actually getting a can of mush is much worse!

product_title: Fischer & Wieser Razzpotle Roasted Raspberry Chipotle Sauce, 40-Ounce Bottle
review_body: This is a great product, the price is way too high, Costco is much more reasonable, but I needed it NOW!  It's fantastic over cream cheese, to serve with crackers of your choice!  Yum!

product_title: DisposaCup Lids - 100 Disposable Replacement Lids for Use with Any Keurig® K-cup® packs - BOX of 100
review_body: I purchased these for my husband to use with his mini-keurig.  They have worked well and allowed him to re-use the little containers (can you tell I don't make the coffee?)a few more times.  He's pleased!  I'm pleased!

product_title: Premium Bourbon-Madagascar Vanilla Beans - 16 beans JR Mushrooms brand
review_body: At Target, you can buy two, small, dry vanilla beans for $8.  Here for $9.29 you can get sixteen plump, moist and pungent vanilla beans, with free shipping!  They smell amazing and are keeping very well in my pantry.  They taste amazing in baking, and I'm making a big bottle of extract with them right now.

product_title: Hormel Compleats Turkey & Dressing, 10-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 6)
review_body: Thews might be OK in a real pinch. The flavor is OK. they are so skimpy on the meat though. I would rather pay another buck and get a few bites of meat with the meal. They are filled up with lots of gravy and maybe four bites of meat. They are pretty sad meals. Military MRE's and significantly better in most cases. I have tried several of the varieties. The issues are all the same. A great deal of sauce and hardly any meat. It is edible. Hardly satisfying.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Original Ground, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 4)
review_body: I have been an 8 o'clock  coffee drinker for years and I don't think you can beat this brand for any price. If you want real coffee and not some flavored trendy drink, try this or maybe the Columbian blend.The price is very good, better than any B&M in my area and so convenient with home delivery..

product_title: Ghost chili pepper - The hottest pepper in the world!!! 1,000,000 Heat Laval
review_body: You think Habanero is hot??  It's NOTHING compared to this pepper!  If you like hot, this is the pepper for you.  Adam from Man vs. Food first introduced me to this pepper.  Trust me, this is the hottest pepper you will ever have.

product_title: Celtic Sea Salt Fine Grnd Pou
review_body: Odd that the less processed the salt the more expensive it is.  I'm sure there must be a logical reason.  This is a damp, slightly coarse product.  You will need to use it from a salt cellar because it won't pour through the holes in a shaker.  I drink distilled water exclusively and there are some health advisers out there who say that trace minerals should be taken to make up for the lack of them in distilled water.  Some even claim that the water can actually remove trace minerals from your system and that is one big reason I use a quality sea salt, to hopefully replace trace minerals if indeed they are being depleted by drinking distilled water.  This salt is very tasty but it is not very much salt for the price.  Still, I plan to buy another bag.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body: I am very happy with this oil.Ready to order more.Recommend to all my family and friends.They love it too.Great for food and for skin care.Best healthiest lotion ever (accept for face) and remedy from sun burn. Enjoy!

product_title: Magnum 100% Jamaican Blue Mountain Coffee, Whole Bean, 1 lb
review_headline: wow thought the search was over!
review_body: Well just received my Jamaican coffee.  The aroma upon opening bag was incredible!  It permeated the house! Brewed some using a French press.  I immediately noticed a nice buttery smooth full body taste but the more I drank it the more I noticed this slight burnt after taste.  The coffee was supposed to be a medium roast.  All I can say is for my taste preference a medium-dark roast is a little bit to strong for me. It unsettled my stomach,  I could not even finish my cup of coffee.  O well I guess its back to \\"Country Traders\\" Jamaican Blue Mountain Coffee!.

product_title: Pamela's Products Gluten Free Whenever Bars, 6 Count
review_body:
These bars were pretty good but visually speaking, very unattractive! I was a little hesitant to bite in. This could be because I am phobic of \\"healthy\\" foods that try to pretend to be tasty. So many of them just aren't. They really aren't. This particular product was actually pretty good. Even my husband tried one and liked it and he doesn't like coconut as much as I do.

The chocolate Chips helped I think. But this is really a nice treat and I am happy to say a tasty one that you won't regret eating!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Green Tea
review_headline: Great tea!  Not so great packaging though
review_body: I love the taste of this tea.  It's very smooth and not bitter as another reviewer stated.  Very mellow and soothing.    My only gripe is the packaging.  With all other tea I've purchased in 20 count boxes, the bags came individually wrapped in metallic packages. These bags are loose in the box without any wrappers.  They're all hooked together like sausage links, and as stated in the description they have no strings.  So you have to fish them out of your tea cup with a spoon.        If they were individually wrapped and had strings, they'd be 5 star IMO.  And if you use Amazon's \\"suscribe and save\\", not only will this be cheaper, but shipping will always be free.  And you can cancel at any time.  I love this feature!

product_title: Bravo Greek Coffee 16 Oz
review_body: Don't let the lower price fool you.  This stuff is easily as good as other brands of greek coffee.  In fact, it's my favourite!  It has an almost chocolatey taste to it.  Smooth and wonderful.      To make the best coffee, pick up a stainless steel maker like this one: [[ASIN:B001RZWIY8 Stainless Steel Turkish Coffee Pot (14 fluid Oz)]]   Not as pretty as the copper ones, but it makes a great coffee and it will last forever.      Per coffee, medium-sweet: one demitasse cold water, two teaspoons coffee, two teaspoons sugar.  Apply medium heat on gas, high heat on electric.  Stir once after it's started to warm up a bit.  When coffee starts to rise, let it get close to the top, then remove from heat.  Let sit for 30 seconds, then pour into demitasse cup(s), with a slight rocking motion to get the froth off the inside of the pot.  Cheers!

product_title: Pain Is Good, Batch #114 Jamaican Hot Sauce, 6.7 fl oz
review_body: This is a great hot sauce with a kick. My boyfriend likes to marienate it with carne asada and everyone seems to like it. Not to hot, just the right kick for that extra flavor.

product_title: Breath Savers Mints
review_body: I like them very much.  I did buy them at Walmart when it was a small Walmart.  Now that it is a Super Walmart they don't cary them.  Thank you Amazon for having them

product_title: Shark's Fin Cake
review_body: Well I bought it just to say I bought shark meat, but when i cooked some up... IT WAS AMAZING! I recommend this to anyone who isn't afraid to do something bad.

product_title: Community Coffee Private Reserve Ground Medium-Dark Roast, 100% Chicory, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body:
There is chicory and then there is Community Coffee Chicory. I started using chicory with another company's mixed coffee and chicory product available in the Seattle area and learned to love the special flavor it gives to enhance my coffee. When a friend went to visit her family who had just moved to Mississippi, she was nice enough to return with various bags of chicory so we could taste test all the ones the local grocery store had. The winner was Community Coffee's chicory. I have tried their coffee/chicory mix, and it's good too, but I like flavored ground coffee and playing with really dark roasts and medium roasts that are available up here, so buying just chicory works the best for me. I've been buying Community Coffee for about 8-10 years and was pleasantly surprised to see it sold on Amazon.

If you haven't tried chicory, take the chance and brew some up! It's full of anti-oxidants, and has been known to help lower blood sugar with type 2 diabetes and help the liver work better. Even tea drinkers can like chicory. I also like that I don't need to put as much in the brew filter; it simply doesn't take as many grounds to brew. If you've had chicory and found it to be bitter or have heard the 'bitter coffee' stories about it, keep that in mind. If I am only brewing it without the coffee, I only put in 2 1/2 or 3 scoops instead of 4.

Community Coffe Chicory and Amazon.com. A prefect combination! Try it today!

(This is not paid for by Community Coffee or Amazon. I really like them both!)

review_headline: Great beans can make a great cup of coffee!
review_body: I've been roasting coffee beans on and off for about ten years now. Two years ago I switched to decaf and these beans are some of the best tasting and best priced I've found. I know another reviewer complained about them being flavorless, but I couldn't disagree more! I can make a cup of coffee that rivals anything you could buy in any coffee house! Be sure to roast them past 2nd crack and let the beans degas for 12-24 hours after you roast them or it will taste like you made a cup of coffee out of grass clippings. But if you roast them right, they make a delicious cup of coffee!

In addition, the product name is pretty misleading: it's called \\"ginger pear\\", but there's no ginger in it. There's ginkgo and there's natural pear flavoring, but no ginger. product_title: Splenda No Calorie Sweetener Packets
review_headline: Tastes the SAME as regular SPLENDA, just BETTER for you ...
review_body: I am a HUGE FAN of Splenda.  I have been using it for years.  Many years ago, I used to ONLY use sugar (and a lot of it).  I have a real sweet tooth.  Anyway, I tried the pink and blue packet artificial sweeteners and did not like the weird after taste they left.  Once I tried Splenda, I was hooked.  I gradually weaned myself off of sugar and only use Splenda (and Jay Robb spoonable granulated Stevia).  I REALLY like Splenda to sweeten my tea and oatmeal.    When I saw the SPLENDA ESSENTIALS (basically Splenda with a BONUS, something good for you ... fiber, antioxidents or B vitamins), I decided to try ALL of them.  I really like the SPLENDA ESSENTIALS.  They all taste the same to me ... the same as regular SPLENDA.  The ONLY difference I noticed is the packaging.  It is not that THIN, yellow packaging.  It is a thicker (almost like a wet-n-dri wipe) package.  Other than that, I wouldn't have even noticed a difference.  I now use all three of the different SPLENDA ESSENTIALS (fiber, B vitamins and Antioxidents) to sweeten my tea so I can get the nutritional benefits of all three.

product_title: Yuban Dark Roast Ground Coffee, 33-Ounce Cans (Pack of 2)
review_body: We've been buying Yuban for the last 15 years. It was easy to get in Las Vegas, but moving to Pittsburgh has made it impossible to find. review_headline: Humbles olive oil, lemon and feta chips

I now understand the customer reviews that warn of hummus chip addiction!  My friends really like them, too.  I can no longer find them at Costco or any of my grocery stores which is unfortunate as I feel these chips would sell really well. Thank goodness for Amazon.

product_title: 3 Savers Package:Simply Asia General Tsa Stir Fry Sauce (6x4.22 Oz)
review_body:
This stir-fry sauce makes for a simply wonderful dinner. I'm not a big fan of Asian foods, but I must admit, this sauce was delicious. It has a nice flavor blend and pairs so perfectly with chicken and broccoli.

My only gripe about this sauce would be the high sodium. A lower sodium version would be nice, though I know most Asian dishes are usually salty. This sauce certainly tastes salty, and there is no need to add additional salt to the meal.

The sauce has a nice consistency and coats the food nicely. You can see sesame seeds throughout, and can taste the seeds and oil as well.

I really like how the broccoli soaked up the sauce and flavors, so biting into a piece of it yielded some amazing tastes. You can still taste the foods you've cooked with the sauce, it doesn't overpower at all.

The convenient packet tears open and you just pour out the sauce. Super easy!

I made my dish as follows;
- Two skinless boneless chicken breasts, cut into thin strips
- One package (16 ounces) frozen broccoli florets, thawed
- Tablespoon olive oil

Cook chicken in olive oil until mostly done, then add in broccoli to heat through. Pour in sauce and allow to heat on low for five or so minutes to infuse the flavor. Serve over rice or quinoa.

product_title: King Oscar Sardines In Olive Oil Two Layer 3.75-oz

product_title: RC Cola, 12 oz Can (Pack of 24)
review_body:
A company called Chero-Cola Co. had a line of sodas called Royal Crown in 1905. They reformulated one of their products in 1934 and \\"Royal Crown Cola\\" was born. Consumers called it RC Cola for so long the company finally made it official. \\"ME and MY RC to taste mighty good to me\\" was a popular commerical in the 1970's. It is not available everywhere, so some people are lucky to find it this way on Amazon. A very popular cola in the south, I have heard southerners swear by drinking a glass with a few shelled peanuts in the soda, say it tastes great that way. I have also heard that the combination of a Moon-Pie and RC was big in the 1950's but sounds like too much suga for me. Either way the 1950's was their heyday and they spent tons on advertising especially with celebrity sponsors like Bob Hope and Bing Crosby.

Packaging: It is sold in plastic, glass and cans and like many sodas the glass bottle tastes better but good luck finding it. SMOOTHNESS: It is more smooth than Coca-Cola, but more uppity than Pepsi. CARBONATION: RC has average carbonation, the big two colas are a bit more fizzy. SWEETNESS: It is a little lighter in sweetness than the 2 big colas. COLA Flavor: You can taste the cola pretty well.

In 1954, it was the first brand to be sold in an all aluminum can, the first to offer a low calorie diet cola, and a caffeine free soda. Four years later, they introduced the first 16-ounce bottle.
Dr. Pepper/7Up company owns this now, and they in turn were bought by Cadbury Schweppes a British company in 2000, who seems to be buying up all the soda companies in the country with the exception for the big 2. Check out their web site.
Update: As of June 2, 2007, Cadbury Scweppes is selling off their soda division. Let's hope someone keeps the regional sodas alive.

product_title: Powdered Coca Tea Delisse 1 Kilo
review_body: High quality coca products do not have a paper wraps since they can harbor dirt and bacteria and the printing ink can change or contaminate the delicate flavor of the tea bags.   Organic coca tea bags do not contain preservatives or additives; therefore they must be properly stored. All coca tea Air Tight Bags are re-sealable with zip lock closures and once opened the bags must be kept closed at all time to avoid contamination in a dry, cool, dark place away from strong-flavored foods. An extra airtight container is recommended when the tea is stored over one month.  Do not store coca tea products inside a refrigerator if you have produce inside. Many fruits and vegetables, especially if they have been damaged, give off ethylene gas as they ripen. Coca tea bags are very sensitive to the presence of even very low levels of ethylene gas. The refrigerator acts as a trap for the ethylene gas given off by the generating varieties, allowing it to build up to damaging levels. Although not hazardous to humans, the ethylene gas leads to the early aging and rotting of the tea.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Pilaf Chicken Flavor, 2.7-Ounce Cups ( Pack of 6)

All ingredients are natural (no chemicals added).  Even the cup container itself is labeled \\"food-grade\\".  Some (not all) food cups contain only organic ingredients, and some are gluten-free; each cup is so labeled if applicable.       The cups provide a fast snack or meal-idea: pour boiling water into the cup, stir, let stand a few minutes, and eat or pour over such as pasta and rice.      The company does well to make the food cups taste good, and each individual will have his/her own favorites.      Keep in mind that McDougall food cups are aimed at the vegan/health-consicious market.  Since they are pricey (the large cups go for almost $2.00 each), I wouldn't recommend them for non-vegans/vegetarians, as there are many less-expensive (and less-healthy) alternatives.    Amazon sells the food cups for less than the Right Foods website does; the company website has a larger variety.    Those who are vegan or thinking of becoming vegan would do well to visit Dr. McDougall's website (drmcdougall dot com) for more information.

product_title: Cugino's French Onion Soup Mix (Formerly Baked Burgundy French Onion)
review_body:
This makes absolutely the best French Onion Soup I have ever had. Nuf' said. I use the box recipe with a couple of changes.

Matt's French Onion Soup

Serves: 2

Need two soup crock pots. Some will be left over and can be frozen in a vacuum bag for future usage.

1 box Cugino's Baked Burgundy French Onion Soup Mix
4 (1-ounce) slices of circular provolone cheese 2 should be slighly larger that the top of the crock pot's opening
4 slices bread
2 slices mozzarella cheese

1. Make the onion soup per the box direction except double the boil time to thicken the broth.
2. Meanwhile, place each bread slice on a cutting board.
3. Press and rotate the upside down open end of the crock onto the bread and rotate it to cut it into a circle the size of the crock pot opening.
4. Place one of the circular slices of bread into the bottom of each crock pot.
5. Place a slice of the smaller provolone cheese over the bread in each crock pot.
6. Place a slice of mozzarella cheese over the bread in each crock pot.
7. Ladle the soup mix while still very hot into each crock pot about 1/2 inch from the top.
8. Place the remaining slices of circular bread onto the top of each crock pot making sure the top is even with the top of the crock pot.
9. Place the remaining slices over the top of the crock pots.
10. Place the crock pots in the oven and broil until the top layer of provolone cheese is browned and toasty.
11. Serve immediately and enjoy after it's cool enough to eat! Yum yum! So tasty!

product_title: PEZ Nascar Pull and Go Cars O.87-Ounce Assorted Cars & Candy Dispenser (Pack of 3)
review_body:
With so many different PEZ dispensers out there, how can I say that you ask? There are a couple of reasons.

First, most PEZ dispensers are simply that: PEZ dispensers. They perform no other function (unless you count \\"catching dust\\"). These are also pullback cars, which cross the floor at a pretty good clip.

Second, I'm old enough to remember when PEZ dispensers actually shot the candy into your mouth. Trial lawyers ended that fun; modern PEZ dispensers are designed to merely push a piece of candy out far enough so that you can grab it with your fingers. However, these PEZ dispensers use an entirely different mechanism, and at least in some of them, when you push down the button at the front, you can bounce candy off the ceiling!

Note: Should you be so lucky as to acquire any of these accidental throwbacks, please be content to catch the candy in your mouth ON THE REBOUND off the ceiling, and for God's sake don't tell a trial lawyer!

Carrageen has long been used as a thickener and emulsifier in ice cream, yogurt, cottage cheese and other processed food products, including soy milk.\\"    Dr Weil cites research indicating that \\"a study published in October 2001 suggest that carrageenan may not be as safe as once thought. Findings from animal studies and a review of the scientific literature showed that degraded forms of carrageenan can cause ulcerations and cancers of the gastrointestinal tract...Dr. Tobacman thinks that undegraded carrageenan - the kind most widely used as a food additive - might also be associated with malignancies and other stomach problems. She suggests that such factors as bacterial action, stomach acid and food preparation may transform undegraded carrageenan into the more dangerous degraded type.

product_title: S&B Oriental Hot Mustard 3.o Oz / 85 g
review_body: This is close third to PF Changs Mustard.  Colemans being a close second.  Follow the directions on the can, This is a dry mustard powder that needs to be mixed with a liquid. It is reminiscent to a horseradish heat that comes on strong and instant, but also dissipates just as fast.  This does have a slight bitter after-taste when the heat dissapates. I have found mixing in a small amount of prepared Dijon makes this a smoother product, and less acrid.  It also is a bit grainy straight out of the can mixed/prepared. I only use one Tablespoon of dry mustard at a time with 1 Tablespoon of prepared.  I prefer buying COLEMANS Dry mustard, because it is not as acrid, has a better heat to it and is not as grainy.

review_headline: Not as strong as I would have liked
review_body:
When I first received the bag and opened it, I was in heaven. The smell of this coffee is amazing. However, the taste doesn't measure up to the smell.

Some background: I love strong coffee and can't stand the thought of putting sugar in it. So far, I have used this coffee in my espresso machine to make cappuccinos.

First, let me comment on the crema. I was expecting more. From reading other reviews, I expected the thickest crema I'd ever seen. In fact, the crema is about the same as with most brands of coffee I use in my machine. Depending upon how fine I grind the coffee, how much coffee I use, and how tightly I pack the coffee, the crema is better or worse. This brand didn't make any noticeable difference.

From a flavor standpoint, I find this coffee rather weak. It might be okay straight up as espresso, but once I add steamed milk, it's quite watery. I brewed it side by side with Costco's Kirkland Espresso (Starbuck's roast), and the Kirkland brand is much bolder and more intense.

So if you're looking for a strong coffee, one with intense flavor, this isn't the coffee for you.

product_title: Keemun Black Tea 50g 25 teabags by A2AWorld Green Tea
review_headline: Keemun Black Tea - one of the Best Chinese Black Tea
review_body:
Keemun Black Tea - one of the Best Chinese Black Tea

It is produced in Qimen County and the neighboring areas close to Yellow Mountain in Anhui Province, China, Keemun black tea is a competitive type of black tea in China. This is attributed to the high yield and excellent quality of tea trees growing in the region thanks for the rich soil and favorable weather. Tea production in Qimen County has a long history which can be traced back to the Tang Dynasty. The county was initially teemed with green tea and then turned to produce black tea in the Qing Dynasty over 100 years ago.

Keemun black tea, or \\"Keemun Scent\\" and \\"the Queen of Fragrance\\", is featured by fine picking and fabricating process, firm and slender figure, dark and sleek color and luster, faint fragrance of honey or orchid, as well as long-lasting freshness. And the liquor is characterized by bright red as well as sweet and mellow savor. Keemun black tea can be drunk without adding anything so as to taste its peculiar fragrance, or added with milk, granulated sugar and lemon to obtain different flavor.

Being famous at home and abroad for its excellent quality, Keemun black tea is one of the three major sorts of tea with intense fragrance which are globally recognized. It is mainly exported to dozens of countries and regions including Britain, Holland, Germany, Japan, and Russia. Meanwhile, it has been serving as national tea gifts over these years.

How Does it made from ?
-----------------------

Keemun Black Tea is made entirely of young Hao Ya, Keemun's finest grade of tea leaves. The bright amber infusion has an appetizing honeyed sweet aroma while the taste is wonderfully smooth and with a light hint of floral aftertaste. It comes in a tin can for easy storing.

Brewing Guide of Keemun Black Tea
---------------------------------

We recommend using purple clay or porcelain tea ware. Rinse tea cup and teapot with hot water. Use about 2 grams of tea leaves (1-2 teaspoons) for every 150ml of water. Steep tea leaves in hot water at 100°c (212°F) for 1 minute for the first and second brewing. Gradually increase steeping time and water temperature for subsequent brewing. If you like milk with your tea, add 10 to 15ml of sweetened/plain dairy milk and stir.

Taste of Keemun Black Tea
-------------------------

A harmonious combination of fruity, flowery and smoky flavors gives this tea a very unique and intriguing flavor.

review_headline: Best GF bread mix at best price per pound
review_body: Let's face it: most store-bought gluten-free bread is absolutely terrible.  This is the best-tasting bread mix for making fresh gluten-free bread at home.  With this mix, I find that if I activate the yeast before mixing the dough and then keep the dough extra-warm after I shape it, I can get the loaf to rise just like wheat bread.  Priceless!    It should be noted, however, this is *not* a good mix to use for pancakes or waffles, even if you add your own baking powder. review_headline: New pantry item to always have on hand.
review_body:
