product_title: Familia Swiss Crunch Muesli, 11-Ounce Packets (Pack of 10)
review_body: Great for lunch as well as breakfast. Much better price than what you find in the grocer's.

product_title: Xylichew Gum, Peppermint, 100-Piece Jar (Pack of 2)
review_headline: short-lived taste, but good for your teeth
review_body: The flavor is great at first, but doesn't last long.  If you're going for a long-lasting gum, this one isn't for you.  But, it does stay soft a long time, and fights cavities.  Also doesn't have Aspartame like other brands like brands of sugar-free gum.  Great to give your kids after meals to fight cavities.    I bought the XyliChew mints also, the mints are great & have the same amount of xylitol as the gum.  I would buy the mints again.

product_title: Mary's Gone Crackers, Crackers
review_body: Mary gone (organic) Crackers tastes great.  The 12 pack carton is a great deal!

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Chinese Noodle Soup,Lower Sodium, 1.4-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Okay first, I'll admit, I have no idea what I thought this \\"should\\" taste like. I guess like chicken, only not, but then I don't even really remember what real chicken soup tastes like anymore since I haven't eaten chicken in 5+ years now.

But anyway, I tried this and thought it was just nasty. I can't really describe it, other than that after the first sip I poured the rest of it down my sink drain and the sesame seeds clogged it. :(

product_title: Hachez Premium Cocoa Chocolate Bar, 88% Premier Cru, 3.5 Ounce
review_headline: The smoothest dark chocolate in the world!
review_body: 88% is pretty intense and in most chocolates it would be extremely bitter with that sour note, but not Hachez!  This stuff is incredibly smooth and delicious.  It has only 8 grams of sugar in the whole bar.  For those of us who either don't love sweets or are working on cutting back on them, this is the perfect treat - intense, smooth chocolate with just a hint of sweetness.  World Market used to carry it, now I have to buy it online since I'm down to my last 3 bars.  Also, try their chocolate leaves, they are gorgeous and delicious.

product_title: Xylichew Gum, Fruit, 100-Piece Jar (Pack of 2)
review_body: I like this gum. This is my favorite flavor.  Yes it does kind of lose it's flavor quickly, but the benefit of no sugar and seeing that it actually helps in keeping teeth healthy is a very big plus to me. This from a long time, advid gum chewer. I'm glad to see amazon selling this.

product_title: Doctor Kracker Snackers, Pumpkin Seed Cheddar, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: Great taste, great crunch, very healthy, perferct for a low carb diet.  We buy in bulk and vacuum seal for future use.

product_title: Bear Creek Country Kitchen Soup Mix (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Vegetable Beef soup-didn't like the flavor
review_body: I am a huge fan of Beer Creek's Chicken Noodle Soup. The soup is delicious and I buy it by the case.  I decided to try the Vegetable Beef.  Bought a case and ended up not liking it at all.  It just seems to have a horrible taste -no vegetable or beef flavor at all.  So if you happen to try this one FIRST, don't use it as an example......it's just a matter of personal taste because the Chicken Noodle is a 10-star soup!!

product_title: Mr. Coffee Columbian Medium Roast Whole Bean Coffee, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 6)
review_body: We've become mild coffee snobs since discovering how to begin with whole beans when brewing coffee.    We're very happy with these Mr.Coffee brand beans, makes a very acceptable cup of coffee at an attractive price.

product_title: Bentley Royal Classic Premium Hand Decorated Exotic Wooden Tea Chest, 144 Tea Bag Set
review_body: Nice assortment of black and green teas, some with subtle flavors in a very attractive box.  Unlike many flavored teas that can overwhelm the delicate natural tea taste, these aren't overpowering.

product_title: Country Choice Organic Sandwich Cremes
review_body: Just bought these again at Kroger- Unbelievably tasty- beats Oreo but is more expensive and actually worth it- plus no high fructose sugar.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Instant Hot Oatmeal, Variety Pack of Four Flavors, 8-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Most grocery store variety oatmeals have fillers and are from the rolled oats variety. The best tasting and most nutritious oatmeal comes from steel cut oats, but it is a chore to cook. You have to cook it very slowly and watch it carefully as it will easily boil over all over the place.

I was astounded to find instant organic steel cut oats at my local Costco. You simply open a packet into a bowl, add boiling water from your kettle or microwave and stir. There are many flavors to suit your moods. All of them are delicious in my opinion. Try this and you will agree.

My Costco stopped carrying this brand, so I found it here on Amazon. Apparently there were many requests at Costco and they have now decided to again carry this brand. It is cheaper at my Costco. $8.35 for 32 packets and 53.6 ounces.

You can't beat this for a quick breakfast.

product_title: Pop-Tarts, Go-Tarts! Snack Bars, Frosted Chocolate Chip, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: These poptart GO tarts are the best for a snack or breakfast on the go!  My kids take them as mid-morning school snacks.  They love the taste and the texture is great too.  I hope Amazon restocks these again. GREAT DEAL!!

product_title: KIND PLUS Bars, Passion Fruit Macadamia + B Complex, 1.4-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body: The first taste of each bite is very sweet passionfruit, with a very perfumey quality. After that you taste and feel the coconut, rice crispies and apple.This is a chewy bar, easy on the nut flavor. Added B vitamins. This KIND bar is like candy.

product_title: Jack Link's Beef Jerky
review_body: This is my jerky of choice hands down. I have tried many brands and flavors, but this is my favorite. Not really all that spicy to someone with a palate that craves heat, but very delicious. Big tender pieces for a commercially produced jerky.     If you want better jerky you need to go to the butcher shop. This is the best commercially made jerky available.

product_title: South Beach Diet Tide Me Over On-the-Go Tropical Breeze, 10 Packet Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love this stuff. Oddly though I think it tastes just like fresh strawberries with sugar despite being the tropical breeze flavor. I haven't tried the Strawberry Banana yet... wonder what that tastes like.

product_title: Good Earth Tea for Sleep, 15-Count Tea Bags  (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Good Earth Tea, Tea for Sleep
review_body: I normally buy this product from my local grocery so there were no surprises.  Although Amazon offered much better pricing.

product_title: Maruchan Ramen Roast Chicken Flavored Noodle Soup 3 oz (Pack of 24)
review_body: Man, when it's the end of the month and there is no food in the fridge, I like to cook up a hot pot of Ramen Noodles. I just boil those noodles and hook it up with canned pork, tuna, cheese, green beans, tomatoes, lima beans, or pig feet. The best way to eat Ramen noodles is to pour a lot of hot sauce on top of it. Mm! Mm! Good! A hot bowl of Ramen noodles on a cold rainy day at the end of the month makes me feel good inside. It feels you right up. My favorite flavors are Beef, Roasted Chicken, and Scrimp.

product_title: Land O Lakes Cocoa Classics Hot Cocoa Mix
review_headline: This product really calls for 10 stars
review_body: This the best hot chocolate I have ever had.  I love this flavor.  I introduced it my niece and she now loves it as well.

product_title: Lavazza Gran Crema Espresso Pods (40 Individually Wrapped Pods) in Bulk Packaging
review_headline: Decent pods at a good price
review_body: Chose these pods mainly on price; I was looking for a \\"name-brand\\" coffee that wouldn't break the bank. They're pretty good, but not as good as Illy or Starbucks. I'll probably try a few other brands before settling on one in particular.

product_title: Late July Organic Cheddar Cheese Sandwich Crackers, 1.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 48)
review_body: These crackers have a great flavor and are wonderful for between meal snacks, or to take with you to eat anytime.

product_title: Gluten Free All Purpose Baking Flour
review_body: This flour stinks of Garbanzo beans, and I like Garbanzo beans on any other occasion, but for some reason the smell is so strong when ground, I have learned to read the labels of GF products and if beans are the first ingredient I will not but it.  My guess is some people are more sensitive to it then others, it almost makes me gag when the flour is wet.  I do have friends who don't mind it or don't notice it, but me and my non Celiac boyfriend think it's nasty.  Since we love to bake, I have found that equal parts white rice flour and Tapioca flour with a teaspoon of xanthem gum work great in place of flour.

product_title: Carlos V Chocolate Drink Mix, 14 oz.
review_body: Carlos V is the best! My housemate brought some with him when we moved in together, and it was unbelievably delicious. We promptly finished it off...thank goodness for Amazon. ;)

product_title: De Cecco Bulk Pasta, Penne Rigate, 5-Pound Packages (Pack of 4)
review_headline: It SEEMS like such a great deal, but there's a little problem
review_body: I love DeCecco pasta and jumped at this deal.  The problem is that the five pound bags come packed in a box which is NOT PACKED INSIDE A SHIPPING BOX.  Some of the bags were split and we lost about a pound of pasta to spillage within the box.  Planned to portion the bags into 1 lb storage bags anyway, so we were prepared.  It was a hassle.

product_title: Real Theater Popcorn Kit - 40 Pack
review_headline: HAS BECOME A STAPLE IN THE HOUSEHOLD
review_body: From quality in taste to price value this product doesn't have any competitors I am aware of at this time.  Buying the 40-count pack reduces the actual cost per popcorn package to just over 1.50/per unit and this included factoring in shipping costs as well.  Maybe you'll find a popcorn that is better but after our searching for quite awhile this particular product, to our knowledge, has no brands coming near it in terms of ease of preparation and taste.  \\"As is\\" or dressed up with your choice of toppings and salt it is a treat.  Have never before had popcorn that batch-after-batch pops up gigantic and fluffy popcorn with few kernels remaining.  Has become a staple in our household.

product_title: Hodgson Mills Whole Wheat Buttermilk Pancake Mix (6x32 OZ)
review_body: I use this product for other baking needs besides pancakes.  I have included it in crumbles, \\"impossible\\" recipes that require a biscuit mix, etc.  Wonderful product.

product_title: Zsweet Granular Zero Calorie Sweetner 8.8 oz
review_body: Mild sweeetness - though ultimately tastes like soap - or something reminiscent of soap.

product_title: Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars
review_body: If you like almonds and cruchy granola bars these bars are for you.  They are higher in fat than I would like them to be.  But they are delicious.  Great for a quick breakfast or snack.  There are 2 bars in each packett and I usually eat one for breakfast and then one later for a snack.

product_title: Gerrit's Extreme Fresch Power Mints, 0.5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Small but powerful and sugar free
review_body: These mints are great.  They're tiny (like tick-tacks) but small and refreshing, not overpowering like Altoids.  The packaging is nice and convenient to carry.  Mints are kept \\"fresch\\" in a plastic bag until you're ready to use them.  They're also sugar-free and contain Xylitol which my dentist suggested I look for on the label.

product_title: Bellino Polenta, 17.6-Ounce Vacuum Pack (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Almost as good as from scratch
review_body: Nothing can beat making polenta the old-fashioned way. But, if you want to save time and a lot of stirring, this is the best instant I've come across. The texture is 90% as good as from scratch, and it cooks in just a couple of minutes. Perfect for when you want polenta, but are pressed for time. Nice price as well -- cheaper than what I've seen it in grocery stores. Each package is vacuumed packed, so if you don't open it, it will keep fresh for a very long time.  Good stuff!

product_title: Dilmah Premium 100% Pure Ceylon Tea, 50-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I had a friend from Sri Lanka who brought some of this tea into the office.  I was pleasantly surprised with the flavor of this tea, and am glad it is available online.  I have not seen it locally in any of the specialty stores.

product_title: Organic Scottish Oatmeal
review_headline: Scots know how to blow their oats to bits
review_body: These are a great whole grain for healthy eating, and they taste great too. My wife likes them with butter and salt but I like 'em sweet with [whatever]. Usually just brown sugar but you could be use a more healthy sweetener or some berries. I find these oats more pleasing than \\"Irish steel-cut\\" styles where the whole oat is just cut in two. These oats are like blasted to bits with a bomb.. ok I think stone ground.. but I like to exaggerate that angry Scots blew them to bits. We subscribed to this product, we like it so well. Recommendations: Buy, Eat.

product_title: Fattoria Estense Balsamic Vinegar Gold Label, 8.5 Fluid Ounce
review_body: This is a quality aged balsamic vinegar.    Slightly thick and slightly sweet.

product_title: Tazo Chai Tea Latte Concentrate 32 oz
review_headline: good but not the same as retail
review_body: this is the original chai tea stuff, and is good almost straight over ice, or with a little milk - iced or hot.  But please note, that this chai is not the same as you get when you order Chai in that Star place on the corner.  they use a stronger concentrate.  this one is the same, but with water ordered.  thats the difference.

product_title: O.N.E. Drink, Cashew Fruit, 11.2-Ounce Aseptic Containers (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I didn't finish this drink. It was just too acidic for my taste. It says it's less acidic than orange juice, but I would actually disagree. If it is truly less acidic ph-wise, it tasted differently.

The flavor was good, but WAY TOO SWEET! I can't believe how much sugar is in this one little container. 33 grams!

I wouldn't recommend this as a healthy drink unless you want tons of vitamin C.

product_title: Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix
review_body:
I suppose if you have been gluten free for a long time this bread is great, but it has a slightly sweet taste (some may like that) and its much like other gluten free breads, its very dense. It is better than most I've had though and the price is right.. I use it for bread crumbs to make meatballs.. something I haven't been able to do until recently.

Its a good product for the money, considering how much a gluten free diet costs - I just couldn't use it for bread.. it does however make a decent pizza crust.. haven't tried it for much else.

product_title: Premium Quality Salt Cod
review_body: I sent an email to the supplier, asking questions about the cod, since it was not what I expected(I thought it would be dried salt cod) as to how long it would last in the refrigerator, and suggestions as to preparation, and they NEVER got back to me. I stuck it in the freezer...not sure how to deal with it. Lots of money shelled out for fish I cannt prepare as of yet...

product_title: True Orange ~ 100% Natural ~ 6 Pack
review_body: I love true Orange.  I looked all over for it and finally found it on Amazon.com.  It flavors my water which allows me to drink the recommended amount of water that keeps me healthier.

product_title: 3 Ballerina Tea Extra Strength All Natural Dieters Drink Sampler Value Pack (1x Lemon, 1x Cinnamon, 1x Orange, 1x Regular Flavors) - 72 Tea Bags in 4 Boxes (7.52 Oz)
review_body: 3 Ballerina Dieters Tea is excellant.  I recommend this product to anyone who needs to detox their system, naturally, while on a diet.

product_title: Apollo Baklava 22 oz box (12 pcs)
review_body:
This is my second purchase of Appollo Baklava and they are, indeed delicious, my only \\"complaint\\" ( and it is not a complaint really ), is the baklavas should be sliced in smaller portions.
Mich
Seattle

product_title: Farmer's Market Foods, Organic Canned Pumpkin Pie Mix, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Wrong item and badly damaged cans
review_body: I have already sorted through this with customer service.  The product is wonderful, but I received the plain pumpkin (not the pie mix), and 6 of the 12 cans were very badly dented.  Amazon packaged them and sent them anyway.  There is no way the cans could have been dented after packaging because of where they were located in the case.

product_title: Wonka Nerds Giant Chewy Candies, 1.8-Ounce Bag (Pack of 48)
review_body: I really love nerds so this was a great opportunity to relish in a favorite pastime.  The only bad part about this candy is it isn't very cute.  And as a person who doesn't like jellybeans, I have to say it doesn't taste jellybean-ish.

product_title: Sun Maid Mediterranean Apricots, 15-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 4)
review_body: I've enjoyed Sun-maid apricots from the grocery store, I use them quite a bit.  Being able to order 4 at a time at such a good price has been wonderful.  Bon appetite!

product_title: Daisy Daze Spring Apron Cookie Assortment Gift
review_body: Everything about this product was excellent, the shipping on the item was a little high I thought.

product_title: Necta Sweet Sugar Substitute Tablets, 1 Grain, 500 Count Bottle
review_body: I like the product for several reasons I like the 1 Grain because it does not take as many to sweeten things. My main use is to sweeten tea and it works as well as the liquid sweetner and most of the packet type and is a lot less expensive. The only draw back is if you use too much it leaves a bitter taste.

product_title: FruitaBu Organic Smooshed Fruit, Smoooshed Strawberry, 0.4-Ounce Flats (Pack of 30)
review_body: The Strawberry is the tastiest of the Smooshed fruit bars.  It is a very good afternoon pick me up.

product_title: Madhava Organic Agave Nectar - Raw, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love this product it is the best natural sugar substitute that I have tried. I would highly recommend to anyone.

product_title: Back To Nature Classic Creme Sandwich Cookies, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: [[ASIN:B001FA1S1E Back To Nature Classic Crème Cookies, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)]] these were wonderful, we have not eaten the 6 boxes but they are better than their competitors major brand.

product_title: Bigelow Sweet Dreams Herbal Tea, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I work Nights. and Bigalow Sweet Dreams Herbal Tea provide a delicious way to relax and calm me enough for a good day's sleep. It tastes better than any other I have tried. I recommend it to all my co-workers.

product_title: Amedei I Tartufi Pralines
review_body: Absolutely the best dark chocolate. Need to savor in small pieces, as it is so rich.

product_title: Icebreakers Liquid Ice Cinnamon 12 30-count packs
review_headline: Why are Ice Breakers Liquid Ice discontinued?
review_body: Why are Ice Breakers Liquid Ice discontinued?  They are fantastic little, but powerful breath mints.  Powerful flavor that is long-lasting.  The news that Hershey's has discontinued production is HIGHLY disappointing.

product_title: -   Vita Life Matcha - Green Tea Powder - 10.58oz - Twin Pack!
review_body: great product, wonderful taste, beautiful packaging, and they even give you a spoon to measure out 2g (1 serving).  my only complaint is that i found it cheaper ($6) at an asian supermarket, but this is the best green tea powder option on amazon.com

product_title: Tetley Inc Tea Bags
review_body: I love this tea, I almost don't want to review it and tell others, because it's too good. For those who are coffee drinkers, it's a darker, richer tea. Whenever I serve it to my company they want to get their own box of it. It has a great flavor, black or however you want to dress it up. I would highly recommend this tea to any tea drinker or coffee drinker.

product_title: Oyster Mushrooms, 1 Lb Bag
review_body: [[ASIN:B000RHSX9G OYSTER MUSHROOMS,(DRIED) 1 lb.]]    Very good product quality. These rehydrate and cook up fantastically. The seller's packaging was far and away the best I've ever received. I will purchase from Angelina's again for certain...

product_title: Creme Savers Hard Candy Strawberry & Creme, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: These candies have a delicious strawberry taste! I'd give them five stars if not for the sugar.

product_title: Batch Marrowfat Peas Red, 14.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: Had to counter the other review.  These are british peas and not like the canned peas in the USA.  Personally, I LOVE them.

product_title: A Taste of Thai Spicy Peanut Bake 3.5oz
review_body: It sounded good so I bought it at my local store. WOW ! When you take it out of the pouch, you think... is this it!  It looks dry and I was going to add my own spices but I decided against it.  This \\"power\\" turns into a creamy sauce that is GREAT!.  All you have to do is put the chicken (or whatever) in a bag and shake.  No need to add anything else and bake... it 's a little spicy but it's awesome!

product_title: Popchips, Sea Salt & Vinegar, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love Salt & Vinegar chips and once I went on my diet I felt like I had to give them up because it's so hard to find healthy ones.  Then I finally found these and I love them!  They're strong tasting and I actually like them better than regular salt & vinegar chips.  They're less oily and I don't feel sick or guilty after having some.  The one-ounce bags are perfect for a snack, but the 3.25 ounce bags end up being cheaper so I divide it up into 3 ziplock bags once I open them.  It works great!

product_title: Ka-me Green Tea Pumpkin Seed & Goji Berries Snack Mix, 7.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is a really tasty blend.  My biggest problem?  Once I start eating them, I don't stop.  I have to actually budget myself or I just keep eating them without even noticing.  I've just reordered them.  I like them and they seem pretty healthy.  I seldom crave sweets but when I do, this mix really satisfies me.

product_title: Progresso Soup, Lentil, 15.25-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 6)
review_body: Cooks unevenly, large clumps. You must stop heating halfway through to stir. Distinctly metallic taste.

product_title: House - Shichimi Togarashi - Japanese Mixed Chili Pepper 0.63 Oz
review_body: I love this spice mix, to blend with sugar and salt for edamame!  Great side dish, great snack.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Ice Cool Brew Tea, Blueberry, Tea Bags, 48-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I recently kicked a pretty serious diet coke habit and started drinking more water and lots of tea. This tea made the transition very easy. We cold brew it and add a little splenda. Highly recommended!!

product_title: Sharkies Organic Energy Sports Chews, Fruit Splash, 1.58-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: Was skeptical upon ordering this product as so many fruit snacks claim to be good when they really aren't. These however, are pretty tasty. My kids asked for seconds immediately after finishing the first pack I gave them; so, I guess that says something! Am reordering as Amazon has a good price on this product and got it out to us quickly.

product_title: Orville Redenbacher's Gourmet Microwavable Popcorn, Corn on the Cob, 3-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: It is so good to taste popcorn that tastes as if it were taken right out of a pot of boiling water, buttered and salted to taste.  The smell of corn on the cob runs throughout the house.  Great summer smell all year long.

product_title: Scarpetta Marinara Sauce, 20-Ounce Jars (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Revolutionizing Jarred Pasta Sauce - The Classic Red Sauce
review_body: This red sauce is at the heart of Italian cuisine - for the family, an everyday basic at the table, with love. The search for a true marinara sauce is over.  Our commitment to fresh and organic ingredients prompted us to add this recipe to our product line.  With a straightforward combination of garlic, tomato and fresh organic oregano, it makes for the perfect pizza sauce as simply the foundation for your fantasy. The true flavor of pizza comes from the toppings - so we encourage you to add them creatively. Also recommended use with the pizza stone.  Use fantasy when adding toppings.  We love figs, prosciutto and after cooked topping with fresh arugula. The necessary classic garlic based red sauce for all kinds of meals and dipping - calzones, empanadas,mozzarella sticks, chicken cutlets, eggplant parmigiano - and of course ravioli!  Buon appetito!

product_title: Stevita, Stevia Liquid Extract, 3.3 fl oz (100 ml)
review_body: I have been looking for a way to give up splenda which is my favorite artificial sweetener.  So, a friend told me about this particular brand.  I had bought another company's stevia (in a green box) and found that it really didn't give me a palatable reason to switch. So, I tried my friends suggestion and it's true. For me, there is no bitterness in aftertaste, and it certainly does not remind me of motor oil!  Is it as good tasting as splenda?  Well, it's a close one.  The benefits of stevia outway the long term effects of splenda (sucralose) or nutrasweet(aspartame).  I am not so sure that I would allow my boys to use it though.  They can have natural sugar in moderation.  Dr. Oz gave a thumbs down for stevia because there is some information out there that it may cause sterility.  It's something to think about.  However, most of us use these sugar-like products because we have some problem with sugar itself.  I say, educate yourself -- and make your choice.

product_title: Whey Low Type D Granules, 1 lb.
review_body: This is a good product and meets all of the promises expressed by the manufacturer.  I thought initially that it had the same sweetness as sugar, but for some reason I found myself using more of it than I would have used refined sugar under the same circumstances.  I don't know if it's because of the very fine granules (much finer than table sugar), or if it just wasn't really quite as sweet as table sugar; it's hard to say.  I doubt I will purchase this product again unless it comes down in price.   The price seems reasonable until you factor in shipping charges and, again, the fact that it goes so quickly. I purchased a 1 lb. bag and it only lasted for about 10 days. The same amount in table sugar would have lasted a month or longer! I got it to bake with and to use in my coffee but it went so fast I never got the a chance to bake with it!  I have used Suzanne Somers' \\"Somer Sweet\\", made from a Chinese fruit, so it's a safe artificial sweetener and it's 5 times sweeter than sugar.  I found it to be much more cost-effective than the whey low because the price is comparable but it lasts a very long time.  I went back to that for my coffee.  I have not baked with that product yet, although the manufacturer says that it works beautifully in baking.  Hope this helps.

product_title: Gluten Free Brownie Mix
review_body: These Brownies are great. I have even made them with flaxseed substitute is instead of eggs, and they turned out a little \\"fudgeier\\" if that is a word. Tasted great though.  Everyone in your family will love them!

product_title: Emeril's Bayou Blast, 3.45-Ounces (Pack of 6)
review_body: great hard to find spicy flavoring. my local grocery stores no longer carry it. It was actually cheaper on line.

product_title: Originial Tings Crunchy Corn Sticks, 2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_body: If you've never had Tings, you're missing out on one of the greatest culinary experiences known to humankind.  Okay, so maybe that's a slight exaggeration, but they definitely do for vegans what those Cheeto things do for dairy-eating folks.  The nutritional yeast doesn't exactly make them taste cheesey; rather, they taste like what I imagine Cheetos taste like under all of that coating.  Delicious though, and EXTREMELY addicting!  I have been known to consume an entire package in one sitting, so if you're on a diet watch out as they are certainly not a low calorie food.

product_title: Morita Chipotle Powder, 20 Oz
review_body: I have had a hard time finding good chipotle powder. Not only does this have great flavor, you get a lot for what you pay.

product_title: La Tourangelle Grapeseed Oil, 16.9-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
review_body: Received in a timely but the cans did have dents as mentioned in previous reviews. The oil does not burn quickly which is great. It seems that grapeseed oil is the new olive oil. You hear about the health benefits everywhere. Has a very subtle taste so it doesn't over-power any dish you are cooking.

product_title: Reese Petite Smoked Oysters, 3.7-Ounce Cans (Pack of 20)
review_body: I've gone through and tasted all the brands.  Reese petite is the best choice.   Purchased 2 for one @ 2.18 when on sale.

product_title: Progresso Solid Light Tuna in Olive Oil, 6-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: I order the case because this is good stuff.   When the case is gone, I will order another.    This tuna is not perfect.  Ive had better but not at the supermarket for sure.   I like this  tuna just out of the can.    A few drops of balsamic, hot sauce, lemon and I'm set.    The cost is unbeatable for the quality you get and the enjoyment factor.  It is not because I am Italian or anything.  I just have a keene sense of what is good and bad tuna.   I simply cant do anything with the popular brands out there, maybe you can.   My cousin Betty was a master tuna salad maker girl and ever since Ive been searching for that special can.   This tuna won the taste test championship tournament not too long ago by the way.  Great job Progresso

product_title: Chef Hans' Louisiana Cajun Poultry Seasoning, 7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Chef Hans' Louisiana Cajun Poultry Seasoning.
review_body: It is a wonderful seasoning, and the stores here don't sell it anymore.   I'm not sure why, so I have to buy the case, and I share it with my family.

product_title: Back to Nature Bakery Squares, Oatmeal Raisin, 5-Count Bars (Pack of 10)
review_body: My 4-year-old son loves these little Bakery Squares. It's definitely a great alternative to Pop-Tarts or frozen waffles.

product_title: Sun Crystals Natural Sweetener, Granular, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: I was tempted to try Sun Crystals as an alternative to Splenda when I read their special offer.  While it is similar to Splenda, it is substantially heavier/denser than Splenda and is not as sweet.    I find that I need about 25% to 50% more (by volume) of Sun Crystals in my tea and coffee.  And because this is so much heavier by volume, Splenda is a better value.    On the plus side, I like their packaging and I detected no aftertaste!

product_title: Pirate's Booty Wild Tings
review_body: This was the first time we've had tings - a friend told us about them and since since they ended up being 2.17 per bag - we gave them a shot.  My daughter has a severe milk intolerance and I have a wheat allergy - and it's rare to find something delicious that we can both have.  My daughter is 2 years old and can now enjoy cheetos just like her friends - and they taste wonderful!  I'm so thankful for products like these that taste good, help us feel normal, and are affordable!  If I could give 6 stars I would!

product_title: Pirate's Booty Chaos, 2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_body: A bag of Chaos is like your own personal party mix, that's healthy. Chaos has a little bit of everything from the Robert's American Gourmet line. It's great if you don't know what you're in the mood for because you get a little bit of sweet, lightly salty, crunchy, light and hearty in one. One 2 ounce bag is supposed to be 2 servings at 140 calories each, but it's too good to stop eating half way through.

product_title: Good Earth Red Tea, Sweet and Spicy, Tea Bags, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love this tea.  I can't find it in any stores in my area so I order it in bulk.  Doesn't need any sweetener and is good hot or cold.

product_title: igourmet Maytag Blue - Pound Cut (15.5 ounce)
review_body: This is awesome cheese. And for me and a few of my friends who suffer migraines and have trouble with blue cheese, are able to eat this. I first heard on Emeril Live that this cheese is different than other blue cheeses. And he is right, whenever I can find and afford it, I have been able to enjoy it without pain. I hope you enjoy it as well.

product_title: Funky Monkey Snacks JiveALime, Pineapple with Lime, Freeze-Dried Fruit, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: The product tasted terrible and the pineapple version made the whole inside of my mouth raw.  I couldn't even give the stuff away - nobody liked it at all!!! AND it's expensive!

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: I can't find many brands of decaffeinated coffee pods. Senseo's brand is satisfactory but it is nothing like the decaffeinated coffee I get in restaurants. Folger's brand of decaffeinated coffee pods is a little better than Senseo's.

product_title: Spanish Cheese Assortment 2 Pound Hand Cut Imported from Spain
review_body: I am a huge fan of Manchego cheese, so I ordered this sampler as an indulgence for my husband and myself.  It was delicious, and well worth the price.  If you're considering this, go ahead and purchase.  You won't be disappointed.

product_title: Swee-Touch-Nee Tea, 100-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Swee-Touch-Nee tea, a Russian-style tea, has a wonderful rich, not bitter, taste.  Everyone I serve it to comments on it and asks what it is.  (I give away a lot of teabags!)

product_title: old parent Crystal Light Sunrise, Ruby Red Grapefruit, 2-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 4)
review_body: This is as close to grapefruit juice as it gets but it doesnot interfer with medications like the juice.  Very refreshing and tangy.  No artificial taste.

product_title: The Chocolate Traveler Bittersweet Chocolate Wedges, 1.75-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_body: I am familiar with this product, Trader Joe used to carry it in double size. When I received the 12-pack shipment, I noticed that the chocolates had a white powder on them, meaning a) they are not fresh, b) they have been exposed to temperature change.  Looks are half the taste, so I would not order this product again unless I am guaranteed to receive fresh and properly stored chocolates.

product_title: Horizon Organic Low Fat Organic Milk Box Plus DHA Omega-3
review_headline: Who ever thought you would be buying MILK on the internet
review_body:
From a price point of view, AMZN cannot be beaten.

Convinience - #1

Taste of the product - like other reviews, it's really too sweet. Even for a guy like me who really enjoys desserts, it was a bit on the sweet side.

If you cool it down, it does decrease the sweetness a bit, but still too strong. Maybe they had to make it this sweet so you don't have to refridge it. I poked a big hole in it and pour it on ice and let it sit for about 5 min for the ice to melt, then it tasted great when diluted a bit with ice.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic Whole Grain Multi-Grain Cereal, 8 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Very few baby rice cereals are gluten free, but this is the best one by far.  With celiac disease in three generations of our family, we do not want to take any chances with our little ones.  Thanks, Amazon, for recognizing the need for gluten free groceries!

product_title: Nescafe Taster's Choice Instant Coffee, Decaffeinated, .059-Ounce Single Sticks, 80-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body:
IMHO this is the best decaff instant coffee for its price.
If you are looking for convenience, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Taster's Choice but love instant coffee, I don't think you could find a better source than Taster's Choice, at this price. On the other hand if you have a sophisticated palate for Coffee then this might not be for you, but since most coffee sold in the US is mediocre at best you can expect better than average (for an instant coffee). The packaging is great for single-serving convenience, for camping trips...

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Caramel Turtle Brownie Mix
review_headline: Spoil yourself with a luxurious brownie
review_body: These brownies are soft, moist and delicious. They are so much better than other brands I've tried. Mmmmm!! If the ingredient list used whole wheat flour and something that wasn't \\"partially hydrogenated\\", I would've given them 5 stars. (Hodgson Mill brownies are also awesome)     These brownies are delicious, rich and chocolately. Enjoy them in moderation. :-)

product_title: Kraft Spaghetti Classics, Tangy Italian Spaghetti Spice Mix & Parmesan Cheese, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: This dinner is so quick and easy to make, and the whole family likes it.

product_title: Nile Spice Soup, Black Bean, 1.9 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I've tried several of the Nile Spice soups and this one, just like the other ones, is a hearty, filling and delicious soup.
It makes a great fast lunch and has a simple list of ingredients.
Highly recommended!

product_title: Jack Link's Beef Jerky, Peppered, 1.8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 8)
review_body: Ever since I was in high school and my best friend recommended I try Jack Links, I've loved their products for taste and quality.  Their regular is flavor is good and if you like some black pepper kick, then this is the one for you.  Good sized peices ranging from 3 or 4 bites to kibble at the end (most of the kibble is pepper that rubbed off).  Low fat tasty snack could almost be a meal.

product_title: Coffee Masters Gourmet Coffee, Hawaiian Blend, Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Valve Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: has some what of a bitter taste.does not quite compare to other hawaiian blends i have tryed.

product_title: The Pepper Plant Original California Style Hot Sauce 10 Fl. Oz.
review_body: I tasted this at the Olive Pit in Corning, CA on an olive burger this summer and I couldn't get over it.  I eat a lot of hot sauce and I believe this is the best I've ever tasted.  It is now a staple in my fridge.

product_title: Silkenty Organic Chinese White Tea, 150-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: This is a lot of tea for the money. Each bag is nicely packaged in its own pouch. Very mild brew. A good value for organic tea.

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Newman O's Cookies
review_body: These don't taste like Oreos, but they're good.  I like that they're organic and that I can buy them with my Amazon certificates.  I wish they got softer in milk, but that won't keep me from buying them again!

product_title: Cinnamon Monkey Bread (Single Pack)
review_headline: YUM! How did I live to 46 yr old and miss this delicious treat!
review_body:
About a year ago, a my favorite Aunti prepared 'Monkey Bread' for breakfast for us one morning while we were visiting her home. She is a fabulous cook, so while we enjoyed every tastie morsel of her sinfully delicious bread, I resigned myself to never being able to enjoy it at home, as I will never be the skilled baker that she is.
Then, one day, while poking around here on Amazon, under bread mixes, I saw Monkey Bread mix. It looked just like the sweet sticky bread my Aunti had prepared. I decided to purchase a box and give it a try. Well, it was easy as can be and the kids loved helping me with rolling the pieces in cinnimon sugar. The kit includes everything. We cooked ours in a bundt pan [so tat is what that pan is for?!]. The results were amazing! The kids, my husband and everyone else who was lucky enough to be here when this was prepared, has been begging me to 'hurry up' and order more. In fact, our 17yr old son has declared the \\"Amazon\\" monkey bread is our new holiday breakfast entree tradition!
Enjoy! We all gave this mix two sticky thumbs up!

product_title: Atkins Advantage Morning Granola Breakfast Bars, Peanut Butter Crisp, 5-Count Box of 1.3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 4)
review_headline: The Best Food Product Atkins Markets
review_body: The peanut butter morning granola bars are delicious.  Beware though that Atkins sells another peanut butter bar that tastes terrible and actually has more calories than these.

product_title: Medaglia D'Oro Instant Espresso Coffee, 2 oz
review_body: I of course prefer freshly made espresso but sometimes instant is good in a pinch.  I travel around Europe extensively and there are several brands available there which aren't at all bad.  This brand is OK for using it as a coffee flavoring in custards, etc., but as a beverage, it rates rock bottom in my book.

product_title: Roland Calabrese Olives, 5-Pounds Bag
review_body: These green olives (with seeds) are on the small side (bigger than picholines, but not by much) -- seldom much over 1/2 inch long. They're very nicely spiced with garlic, hot chilis, fennel, and bay leaves. Like most green olives, rather salty. Quite a good value at less than $5 per pound. Very authentically Italian (imported from Calabria -- toe of the boot), they're perfect for an antipasto salad. I would prefer that there were five bags of one pound each, but since they keep quite well, dealing with a five pound bag is not that much trouble. You'll want to pour off the liquid after opening, and transfer them to a rigid plastic container or ziplocks. Good deal for olive lovers!

product_title: Dunkaroos Cinnamon Graham with Vanilla Frosting and Sprinkles, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 14)
review_body: Dunkaroos  are hard to find in stores,and the price is very good ; even with the shipping included.The shipping was very quick.

product_title: LightFull Smoothie, Chocolate Fudge, 11-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_headline: A healthy food that tastes great and satisfies- can't ask for more!
review_body: I purchased these at a local grocery store and was `hooked' immediately. I have tasted all of the flavors and prefer the cafe latte and chocolate. Those are the flavors I would pick for ice cream. The others taste good, as well. I enjoy the full feeling after drinking them. I don't feel like reaching for more food!:-) I have put one in my blender and added 5 or 6 ice cubes. That increased the volume without thinning it.  Makes it feel more like a meal. A great way to watch calories and feel like you're having a treat. I would highly recommend these for anyone looking to enjoy eating healthy.

product_title: Pirouline Pumpkin Spice & Chocolate Hazelnut Creme Filled Rolled Wafers, 28-Ounce Tins (Pack of 3)
review_body: I love these. It's like hazelnut nutella wraped in a crispy yet flaky wafer. SOOOO GOOD but a little pricy which is good because it's truly a treat when I get them. And it helps with keeping the waist size down to where I like it, lol.

product_title: Carnation Instant Breakfast, Chocolate Malt Powder, 1.26-Ounce Units (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Chocolate Malt Flavor, Carnation Instant Breakfast
review_body: Love this flavor! Much better than Rich Milk Chocolate flavor! Please carry this product on a regular basis!

product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy
review_body: I don't know why my local Safeway discontinued these German candies in place of their own Bear candy- there just isn't any substitute for the original.

product_title: Pirate's Booty Soy Crisps, Rich Cheddar Cheese, 3.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a great snack, I usually don't even need the full serving. It is nice to sprinkle cayenne pepper on them for a kick.

product_title: Kellogg's Cereal-in-a-Cup, Family Assortment, Individual-Serving Cups (Pack of 60)
review_body: This is a great choice for a family, this way everyone gets what they want, and it lasts about a month.

product_title: Alessi Zuppa Toscana Tuscan White Bean Soup, 6 Ounce, (Pack of  6)
review_body: This soup is actually sold in the gourmet food section of our local grocery store at quite a bit higher price than offered here. It is quick and delicious and will be a staple at our house from now on. No one who tries it can believe it is a simple dried mix that only has to have water added. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Torani Lime Syrup, 750 ml
review_body: I ordered this syrup on Monday with standard shipping and Thursday night it arrived. Shipping is more then most items on Amazon, but with such a fast turn around rate I wouldn't let that keep you from ordering this product.

product_title: Gourmet Coffee Gifts of Pure Kona Coffee from The Big Island of Hawaii, The Ultimate Coffee Gift
review_body:
Short of visiting a coffee plantation on Kona, this is the best.

Be sure to read the suggestions included by the manufacturer.

Try it in a vacuum brewer for a real treat!

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body:
ARTHUR:
The Lady of the Lake,...

product_title: Tofu Shirataki Noodles Fettuccine Shape, 10 bags
review_body: I really hoped that I would like these.  However, I found them to be horrible in taste and texture.

product_title: Kraft Spaghetti Classics, Tangy Italian Spaghetti Spice Mix & Parmesan Cheese, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Kraft Noodle Classics, Tangy Italian Spaghetti Dinner
review_body: My cousin from Germany brought over the German Kraft Spaghetti kits and I thought they tasted better than anything we have here in this country.  I tried getting them here or ordering on-line without success.      Finally I decided to take a chance with the American variety which apparently is only available on-line.  To my surprise, it was pretty close to the same thing, and fantastic, I might add.  The only difference is the German Kraft box had the tomato paste included.  The American Kraft box says to add tomato paste & water or tomato sauce.  In a way, that's even better...and it is less expensive.

product_title: Van Houtte French Vanilla Caffeinated Light Roast Coffee Keurig K-Cups, 108 Count
review_body: I am enjoying my coffee and coffee pot.  It's the best. Coffee and tea at anytime you want it. And don't forget that great hot cocoa.

product_title: Athena Dark Chocolate Cherry Truffle Cremes - 4 oz Gift Box
review_body: Whata  great way to support Breast Cancer research and to buy a great gift for someone.  I bought them to bring to a friend in the hospital - we loved them!  I love that 100% goes to the casue and that it is not a marketing gimmick.

product_title: Pamela's Products Chunky Chocolate Chip Cookies
review_body:
I ordered the Pecan Shortbread and the Chocolate Walnut cookies in July 2006. They were shipped in the same box. The Chocolate Walnut cookies arrived in perfect condition, but the Pecan Shortbread cookies were all broken up into little pieces, in all of the 6 individual boxes inside the case pack. I tried to return them online through my account login, but it says this item is not eligible for return. So I'll be phoning Amazon on Monday to figure out how to remedy this.

Regarding the cookies themselves, I love the Pecan Shortbread cookies, and I've been buying them locally for about 4 years. I like them better when they're kept in the fridge, it just gives them a better crunch for my tastes. If you need to avoid gluten, these are a winner. I just hope the warehouse people stop giving these things the drop test... ;-)

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Raw Chocolate Nibs,  King of Cacao 16 Ounce Pouch (Pack of 2)
review_body: These things are awesome!!! Now this is my kind of thing. I'm a bitter/dark chocolate person and this fits the craving.

product_title: GF Biscuit Mix
review_headline: SUGAR IS NUMBER 3 INGREDIENT, might as well call it sugar mix
review_body: It is a shame WHEN YOU ADD SUGAR AS A PRIMARY INGREDIENT IN THE FIRST 5 ITEMS! Being allergic to gluten, doesn't mean a person is NOT ADDICTED TO SUGAR! Sugar is the number one substance that manufacturers LOAD UP ON and place in the top ingredients when they omit so-called allergies, like gluten. I AM SICK AND TIRED OF NOT BEING ABLE TO HAVE WHEAT FREE GOODS and being forced to take in sugar. I AM ADDICTED TO SUGAR, AS WELL ARE MILLIONS OF US! stop replacing what could be valuable gluten free foods with sugar------ AND SUGAR IS KNOWN BY OTHER NAMES and is the same:; maltodextrin, sucrose, sucralose, dextrose, dextrin, ORGANIC SUGAR (that's a joke, sugar is sugar!)

product_title: Sugar Daddy Caramel Lollipops Large [24CT Box]
review_body: As a kid I enjoyed Sugar Daddies big time. That was in the late 60's and early 70's if you must know. It is a very hard caramel bar on a lollipop stick. They lasted forever because first you had to suck on it for a long time to soften it up, and only then could you begin to start pulling on it with your teeth and it would stratch like taffy into these long curls.  When I was a kid they had little trading cards inside of race cars and dragsters, very cool. The same company made Sugar Babies which had the caramel flavor but were a soft chewy candy about the size of a peanut M & M.

product_title: Nabisco Teddy Grahams, Cinnamon, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I could eat a whole box of these things in one sitting.  I put like 2-3 in my mouth, then wait a minute till they're kinda soggy, then I eat em.

product_title: Arrow Spacemaker Deck Box Basket Weave
review_body: Blue Weber agave is the lowest glycemic index of agave nectar.  This is 100% blue weber, a great flavor, and price.  I use it in tea, and baking, or just about any where I would use a bit of sugar.  The texture and flavor is like honey.  Great stuff!

product_title: Arrow Spacemaker Deck Box Basket Weave

Mixed with pure lime juice, it is a wonderful tropical fruit salad glaze...try it over strawberries, mangos, bananas and blackberries.  Mmmmm!  Free shipping makes this the best price around.  Love it!

product_title: Jack Link's Super Size Beef Sticks, 1.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Its Great, But package is a bit " Beat up"
review_body: Looks like it got squashed a little, and i guess somebody opened the package because i think there was supposed to be a seal there since this is new. But I checked everything inside it counted all of the peices and everything was there. I tried one and its great. This is a good buy for what you get. I just got a Damaged package but its not damaged that badly just the outside is a bit squased. Overhaull 4 stars out of 5 I will buy here again. Fast delivery. Thanks

product_title: MTR Lemon Rice , 10-Count, 10.5-Ounce Box (Pack of 2)
review_body: Use a pouch of this and a pouch of MTR Pongal  Microwave for 2 mins, fluff then microwave for 2 mins more.  Great with salmon.  Mildly spicy.  I could not cook a lentil rice dish as good as this combo (even in restaurants have never had lentils as good as MTR)

product_title: All Natural Pork Loin Crown Rib Roast
review_body: I purchased a pork crown roast from this company and I was very satisfied. The product shipped just in time even though it was the holidays. I had spoken with customer service and though I usually got a voicemail message, they always called back the same day and were very friendly and informative about the status of the order. It arrive in great condition and was enjoyed by my friends and family. I would definitely order from them again!

product_title: Twinings Mixed Berry Tea, Tea Bags, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Great tea.  Tastes good both hot and cold.  Could be a tad bit more fruity, but it is great as is.

product_title: Geoff & Drew's Signature Red Box of 8 Fresh Baked Brownies
review_body: I gave an assortment of X-mas gifts that were food this year.  Nothing got as good a compliment as these bownies.  People said they expected another boxed brownie and they were really surprised how good they were.  I did not eat any of them, but I am going to order some to see what the whoop-lah was all about.

product_title: Ka-me Wasabi Peas Snack Mix, 6.0-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: Wasabi flavor is not very strong.  The mix is good to snack on, I made it better for my taste by adding wasabi peas and wasabi almonds.  This addition gives the mix a stronger wasabi flavor, which is what I like.  I like the many different types of snacks that are within the bag.  12 6oz bags is a lot of snack mix!  Mixing it all together, with the additional peas and almonds, and taking it to work, has made for a tasty mix to munch on throughout the day.

product_title: Twinings Prince of Wales Tea
review_body: Lady Grey is practically the only tea my family and I drink. First we bought it because of cornflowers, which are kinda a symbol of Russia, where I was born, but we stayed with it for the taste. Try it cold with lemon - it's amazing!

product_title: LifeSavers Sugar Free Butter Toffee Hard Candy, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are sooo good I'm on my third order!  I've ordered many of the sugar-free products and this is #1.

product_title: Milka Alpine Milk Chocolate, 3.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 10)
review_body: I havent actually purchased these here yet, but I grew up with the Milk Brand in Europe, and I am SOO pleased to see them here for sale. All I can say is if your a chocolate lover, you WILL LOVE MILKA, its in no way close to any of the chocolate I've had here of just regular store brand typs. So if you need a small push, here it is, you wont regret it, I dont know anyone how doesnt absolutely love it when they taste it.

product_title: SPLENDA No Calorie Sweetener Granular, 9.7-Ounce Resealable Bags (Pack of 2)

review_body: If you love lychees you have to try these.  They are delicious and the taste is spot on.

review_body: This is one coffee brand where the decaf is even more flavorful than the regular. We get outstanding mugs of coffee when we use one decaf and one medium roast pod in our Senseo coffee maker. review_body: I only drink Mint Green tea and Tempest Tea's mint green is my favorite. I take it with me everywhere.

review_body: I LOVE THESE CHIPS AND THEY ARE SO MUCH HEALTHIER THAN REGULAR CHIPS AND THEY TASTE GREAT AND THEY LOOK UNIQUE.

product_title: Hershey's Cinnamon Chips
review_headline: No real cinnamon in these chips
review_body:
Ingredient list for Hershey's Cinnamon Chips:
Sugar; nonfat milk; partially hydrogenated vegetable oil (palm kernel and soybean oil); palm kernel oil; contains 2% or less of: cornstarch; artificial colors (Yellow 6 Lake; Yellow 5 Lake; Blue 2 Lake); natural and artificial flavor; salt; palm oil; soy lecithin.

I wish I'd known the ingredient list for Hershey's Cinnamon Chips when I bought these (the ingredient list was not part of the product description as the time of this review). There's no real cinnamon in them. I had been using King Arthur's mini cinnamon chips previously (ingredients: sugar, palm oil, cinnamon, nonfat dry milk, soy lecithin) and was happy with them, but I was curious about Hershey's chips. They were cheaper than King Arthur's, and I'd heard people rave about the Hershey's cinnamon chips.

Well, curiosity killed the cat. Now I have a lot of bags of Hershey's cinnamon chips that I don't want to use in my baked goods..... I might end up using them if I'm baking something to give away where the person eating it won't know I made it. I used my King Arthur chips in Cinnamon Chip Bread, great results, but when I switched to Hershey's, the chips kinda melt and get mixed a little with the bread dough, and that turned my bread YELLOW. Artificial colors are on the ingredient list before the natural & artificial flavor.... that's a lot of artificial color! I usually don't care about artificial ingredients, I'm a junk food addict who drools at the sight of bright orange Doritos, but the yellow bread the Hershey's cinnamon chips made was displeasing. Not to mention the flavor of the bread, which was negatively affected by the Hershey's chips. Didn't have that same sweet cinnamon flavor that the King Arthur chips give.

Why'd I give this product 3 stars instead of 1 star? My husband didn't care about the changes in the bread, he'll eat anything I turn my nose up at, so he'll probably end up eating stuff I make for him with the Hershey's cinnamon chips. Also, his coworkers still gobble up the Hershey's cinnamon chip bread, so I'll use the Hershey's chips there too. Hopefully my bags of chips won't go to waste, but I won't buy Hershey's cinnamon chips again.ips. Also, his coworkers still gobble up the Hershey's cinnamon chip bread, so I'll use the Hershey's chips there too. Hopefully my bags of chips won't go to waste, but I won't buy Hershey's cinnamon chips again.
