product_title: Bob's Red Mill Banana Chips, with Sugar, 10-Ounce Packages (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Excellent Alternative To Fatty Potato Chips For Snacks
review_body: We use these as handy snacks, also crush them and blend into breakfast muffins baked from a basic recipe.  Excellent product, as all of Bob's Red Mill products have proven to be for us.  The flavor is subtle, lightly sweet, and these are filling without being fattening.

product_title: Tofu Shirataki Noodles Fettuccine Shape, 10 bags
review_headline: If it sounds too good to be true, it probably is.
review_body: I very much wanted to like tofu shirataki noodles. Unfortunately, they are just a little too unusual for my taste. They're not awful, but the texture is very slippery and chewy. As was mentioned in other reviews, even after rinsing and soaking they still have a distinctive smell and taste. A sesame-soy based sauce seems to compliment the shirataki noodles best. (i.e., masks the taste) Spaghetti sauce just doesn't taste right with it. Since this product is not available locally and has to be shipped from New York to Texas at a net cost of about $5 a package, I would be very unlikely to purchase it again.

product_title: Atkins Advantage Shake, Cafe Caramel Creme Latte Shake, 11-Ounce, 4-Count Cans  (Pack of 6)
review_body: I consider myself an expert when it comes to fine tasting caramel. This product was so lacking.  The caramel was more like burnt butterscotch and I literally gagged trying to get the drink down.  Unfortunately, bought a 4-pack and being diet conscious and $ conscious, knowing that most things that are good for us taste the worst, I'll finish off the other three spacing them out between the other flavors but I will not be buying this product again.

product_title: Shelton's Organic Chicken Broth, Regular, 14.25-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Beware this product.  It's made with \\"organic turkey product\\" -- who knows what that is.  The main ingredient, and most of the other ingredients, are not organic.  I don't even want to use this stuff after reading the label.  I've lived in the city where it's produced and that water is NASTY.  And, as I learned to my dismay, grocery items are not returnable.  So if you want broth from mystery meat and nasty water, this is for you.

product_title: Twinings
review_headline: Great tea at a great price
review_body: I love Twinings Earl Grey Tea and I was thrilled that  Amazon is carrying it at such a great price. Thanks Amazon

product_title: McCANN'S Steel Cut Oatmeal, Traditional, 28-Ounce Tins (Pack of 4)
review_body: I HAVE ORDERED THIS OATMEAL SEVERAL TIMES. IT IS VERY GOOD.  ONLY ONCE DID THE CANS COME ALL DENTED UP, BUT THEY WERE REPLACED QUICKLY. I WILL CONTINUE TO DEAL WITH THIS VENDER.

product_title: Orville Redenbacher's Gourmet Microwavable Popcorn, Ultimate Butter, 6-Count  Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: ORVILLE REDENBACHER MAKES THE BEST,CAN'T BEAT THE PRICE,ULTIMATE BUTTER TASTE LIKE REAL BUTTER,LIKE WHEN YOU MADE BACK IN THE 1950'S.

product_title: Kellogg's Live Bright Dark Chocolate Vanilla Bars, 4-Count, 1.23-Ounce Bars (Pack of 4)
review_body: I really enjoyed these bars. I loved the vanilla and chocolate combination. They also pack a lot of nutrition and energy.     Most healthy bars like this taste rather awful, but these are delicious and are filling to boot. I would recommend them wholeheartedly.

product_title: Jeremiah's Pick Coffee French Roast, Whole Bean, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: A really good coffee, nicely roasted and with a great taste. Strong flavor, I found I used a slightly smaller amount as finely ground beans, a hallmark of excellent coffee. If you like dark roasted coffee--you should try this one.

product_title: Bigelow Constant Comment Tea, 40 Count Box
review_headline: Great tea, fast delivery right to my door!
review_body: Within 1 business day of ordering this item, the tea was delivered to my house! Talk about service!  As always this tea is one of my staples, nothing has changed, so another great purchase experience on Amazon!

product_title: Jelly Belly, Belly Flops
review_body: I ordered 2 bags of the Belly Flops and loved them! Same excellent taste - just funnier looking! I went on your website to try and order more & couldn't find them. I was so happy to receive your email about the Outlet. I will definitely be ordering more. I recommend this more economical way to enjoy Jelly Belly!!!

product_title: Top Hat Dwarf Blueberry Plant - 6" pot - Bonsai/Patio/Outdoors
review_body: I received this top hat about 10 days ago. It was only 2.5 inches tall but had green leaves growing out of the main stalk. I transplanted it into a much larger pot with some peat moss, perlite and a little potting soil and it seems like it is doing fine. Blueberries love acidic soil so make sure your soil is on the acidic side. Also water with ph balanced water in the 6 range.

product_title: Dried Pears, 8 oz.
review_headline: Best price, responsive vendor, but best product?
review_body:
This is my first experience purchasing and using dried pears since I live in a place where specialty items like this are not easily found. This is the best price available of the varieties offered on Amazon, and the company responds immediately, with low shipping charges.
The product is unsulphered, which may be prefered by some. Its texture is tough. Its flavor is present but muted, rather like canned pears. That said, when braised in a little chicken broth, the dried pears perked up and did what they were supposed to do in a wild rice pilaf dish. I'll definitely soak them before adding to breads or cookies.
The next time I order, though, I may try Melissa's, to compare quality.

product_title: Drogheria & Alimentari All Natural Spice Grinder Red Pepper (chili), 0.71 Ounce Jars (Pack of 3)
review_body: My husband likes red pepper on his food, I do not. This self crushing bottle is perfect. I put it on the table and whoever wants fresh crushed red pepper can use it.  I bought this a couple of years ago and could never find it again.I googled it and Amazon had it. It came in pack of three and one we will give as a gift for people who like extra red pepper.

product_title: Guiltless Gourmet Tortilla Chips, Unsalted Yellow Corn, 7 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Would give them 5 stars if they went back to the original oil free recipe.  No reason to add all of that fat back into these chips, they were fine before.

product_title: Carnation Instant Breakfast, Variety Pack, 1.26-Ounce Units (Pack of 3)
review_body: I believe in eating breakfast everyday. But there are times when I run short of time. Carnation Instant Breakfast is the prefect answer for those days. High in protein, easy to mix (no lumps!), satisfying, filling, and tastes great!

product_title: Dilmah Ceylon Green Tea Variety Pack, 20-Count Individually Foil Wrapped Teabags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I drank two cups of each flavor, coming to the conclusion that this is unremarkable tea.  You can barely tell the difference between flavors.  It's not bad and I'll drink all six boxes I got in the bundle but I won't buy it again.

product_title: Ahmad Tea, Early Tea, Ceylon Special with Early Grey
review_body: I have been drinking this tea for years.  The earl grey is subtle, not overpowering or artificial as it can be, and the tea is rich and delicious.  Nice large leaf tea, not dust.  The tin is fun and reusable too! A bargain for the price.

product_title: Almondina Almond Cookies, Choconut, 4-Ounce Package (Pack of 7)
review_body: Choconut is my favorite Almondina cookie. The Chocolate taste is very satisfying. Almondina cookies are low in fat and have NO trans fats or saturated fats, so are better than many other cookies. Highly recommended!

product_title: Jacobsen's All Natural Snack Toast, Cinnamon Raisin, 5.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: Jacobsen's Snack Toast is perfect for breakfast or a snack with a little cream cheese or soft spread cheese.  It's crisp, light and only 40 calories per piece!  Delicious!

product_title: Cafe Altura Whole Bean Organic Coffee, 2 Pound
review_body: Best coffee I ever bought. I grind this very fine and add boiling water to a french press. I've stopped going to Starbuck's, etc., completely: this is better.

product_title: 1950's Nostalgic Candy Gift Box - Retro 50's Candy
review_headline: Great gift for a Candy lover
review_body: ASIN: B0001VSA2I We bought this gift for our friend who LOVES candy and was celebrating his 60th birthday-the box was heavy and full of a variety of candy from his youth.  He enjoyed not only eating the candy but,  the memories that went along with each piece. We will definitely order this again.

product_title: Numi Organic Black Tea, Loose Leaf Tea
review_body: After much experimenting, I'm a totally devoted fan of Rishi Teas but I make one exception and Numi's Jasmine Pearls is it.  Jasmine pearl tea is my favorite tea, hands down, but as any jasmine pearl lover knows, it ain't cheap!  This tea is a great value AND tastes good.  I defy anyone to find a better deal on GOOD jasmine pearl tea!      9-30-09  I'm dropping my rating to 3-4 stars.  I've been drinking Rishi Tea's version of jasmine pearls recently.  I just opened a new bag of Numi's jasmine pearls when the Rishi ran out.  The difference in fragrance is dramatic!  I can barely discern any jasmine aroma if any when I opened the Numi bag.  The Numi tea tastes good, even sweet (did they sneak in a hint of sweetener??) but this is jasmine tea after all.  I think I'll bite the bullet and pay the extra $$ in the future for Rishi's jasmine pearl.

product_title: Pamela's Products Amazing Wheat Free & Gluten-free Bread Mix
review_body: It has been 11 months since I began a gluten free diet and this is the first bread I've eaten which tastes good. It is moist and holds together well even when sliced warm out of the bread maker. I bake it in a Breadman TR 875 and follow the directions on the bag of the bread mix (which says to NOT use the gluten free setting). I'm baking bread from Pamela's bread mix for my 11 year old granddaughter who also must eat gluten free. It allows her to take sandwiches to school like the other kids. The bread toasts well and probably freezes well, but we eat it too fast to worry about that. It bakes well with added herbs, cheese, etc. It's a good product.

product_title: Fig Balsamic Vinegar 12.7oz
review_body: This fig vinegar is fabulous mixed with olive oil for salad dressings.  I never use any other dressings after discovering this.

product_title: Harney & Sons Black Tea, Paris, 20 Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: First had this tea at a high-end steak house. Couldn't find it locally. Very mild caramel scent and flavor.

product_title: Downeast Lobster Rolls
review_body: I could not believe how good these were!  I hate goopy mayo in salads - this has the just the perfect amount to highlight the big chunks of lobster.  The bun is wonderful too!  Will order again!

product_title: Twinings Prince of Wales Tea
review_body: This is one of the teas that I enjoy on a weekly basis and I normally buy the Twining brand, so when they offered this at a discount, I jumped at the chance; Thanks Amazon!

product_title: Wish Bone Salad Dressing, Sweet & Spicy French, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_body: very good i coulnt find this dressing any where, i was told it wasnt being made any more i was happy to find it.

product_title: LightFull Smoothie, Chocolate Fudge, 11-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: Rich and creamy. Definately tastes like a guilty pleasure--but without the guilt! Love it!

product_title: Country Choice Organic Sandwich Cremes
review_body: My local supermarket carries Country Choice Vanilla Wafers, but not the sandwich cookies.  These are truely a melt-in-your-mouth treat.  The cookies do crumble easily, unlike the more famous chocolate sandwich cookie, but the vanilla creme more than makes up for that.  I just ordered the last box, sorry folks, you'll have to wait for a new shipment!

product_title: OrgraN Instant Chocolate Mousse Mix, 4.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 8)
review_body: I have always used the Nestle Mousse, but since they have stopped making it I bought this kind.  It is very fluffy, but not quite as sweet as the Nestle.

product_title: Chex Snack Mix Chocolate Peanut Butter, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 8)
review_body: I purchased this favor in the 8oz bags and now wish I had purchased twice as many. It has a great \\"sweet & salty\\" taste and the peanut butter does not over power you. They could have left out the pretzels but I can deal with it. Recommend you give it a shot.

product_title: Bariani Olive Oil
review_headline: The most amazing olive oil ever!
review_body: I actually buy a huge bottle of this olive oil every so or often from the Italian grandmother (a Bariani, I presume) who sells it every Saturday at the Berkeley Farmers' Market. Definitely the most expensive olive oil I have ever bought but also hands down, the very best I had!

product_title: Droste Dutch processed cocoa 8.8oz x 3 boxes (total of 26 ounces)
review_body: I've tried tons of Cocoa and Droste is truly the best out there.  I make mocha coffees and also bake with it.  It's the best!

product_title: Blue Diamond Gluten Free Almonds, Bold Salt & Vinegar, 6 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I am on the Atkins diet, have been for four years, and almonds are an important part of snacking, these almonds are delicious. I have found blue diamond to be so fresh, and the salt and vinegar satisfy a multitude of cravings.

product_title: Wild Bill's Beef Jerky
review_body: Chew bowls are marginally better. This stuff makes good dog treats. Package date was within parameters but product seemed much older...near mold condition. Dry and tough.  Good teeth required.

product_title: Xanthan Gum, 4 oz.
review_body: Was very happy to find this at such a resonable price and I am sure it will a very good product.  The unfortunate part is they seem to charge shipping according to the price of an item, not the weight.  By the time you add up shipping and price of the xanthan gum you will pay the same anywhere.  Not a savings!

product_title: Fiber One Cereals - Caramel Delight, 15.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: Excellent fiber content and yummy caramel flavour at a great price per case.  Parents and kids happy with breakfast this week.  It's a whole grain flavor but we are used to that.  This makes a good home made trail mix ingredient with Raisins, nuts, and a sprinkle of chocolate chips or M&M's of your choice.  Enjoy!

product_title: Deli Fresh Greek Myzithra Cheese, approx. 16oz (1lb)
review_body: The product came extremely fast and was exactly what I ordered. Was packed  very well!!

product_title: Cugino's Gourmet Foods, Ridiculously Delicious DIPZ!, Onion Wonion Dip Mix, 1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: The title of my review says it all. The Flavor is an odd chive too salty flavor with very little onion taste. Stick with Knorr Products.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: Timothy's Midnight Magic is the perfect coffee for anyone that likes a dark roast, full bodied coffee.  Starbucks doesn't make the K-cups for the Keurig coffee makers but once you try this you won't care.

product_title: Trident Splash Strawberry with Lime 10 Pack
review_body:
For the 3 seconds the flavor lasts (the outside strawberry flavored gum mixed with a lime liquid center) it's pretty enjoyable. After that, it's all downhill. Not since chewing Fruit Strips gum as a child, can I remember a gum losing flavor this quickly. You maybe get 5-10 minutes of flavor and after that it's like chewing rubber.

The packaging is another annoyance it's a foil blister pack with a cardboard sleeve containing nine pieces of gum. It's a waste of packaging if you consider the whole thing could have been put in a Mentos-like package.

I made the mistake of buying a 3 pack. If you must, go with a single pack. It will be enough to turn you off.

product_title: LifeSavers Tangy Fruit Hard Candy, 6.25-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: it's always nice to have a little more variety than those original five flavors. i especially like the green apple

product_title: Stash Premium Ginger Peach Green Tea, Tea Bags, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I bought this tea to keep my digestive track healthy and in good working order. It did not take long to work for me. I am very pleased with it. This will be a staple in my pantry.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_headline: Building the future and buying milk online are one in the same thing.
review_body: I hear it's amazing when the famous purple stuffed worm in flap-jaw space with the tuning fork does a raw blink on Hara-Kiri Rock. I need MILK! 61!

product_title: Mathew Walkers's Christmas Pudding 227 Grams(8ozs)
review_body: It's been many  years since I've tasted such a great Christmas pudding - I could almost imagine my late Mum stirring and tasting and steaming and basting - thanks for the re - creation!    Paired with the swift, efficient and well communicated service, you can be sure I'll order again next year.    Many thanks from an old Brit!

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: Its fast and easy to use. No mess no fuss. Coffee comes out fresh and tasty.  Whats not to love?

product_title: Boylan Black Cherry Soda, 12 Ounce (12 Glass Bottles)
review_body:
$30 for a 12 pack?
Are you serious?
Trader Joe's sells 4 packs for $3.
And that's about all they are worth.

product_title: Slightly Unsalted Grandpa Po's Originals
review_headline: I'm diabetic, and thank GOODNESS for Grandpa Po!
review_body: I've tried every one of this line of products and I have to say, I'm blown away by just how satisfying they all are. Not too much, not too little, every recipe falls within my personal taste parameters, as well as everyone I know who has tried 'em, for that matter.  The ratio of carbs to protein, the low sodium, etc., makes this a VERY attractive snack to me because I'm diabetic.  It's why I'm compelled to write a review. It's REALLY hard satisfying some of the cravings a diabetic gets. We LOVE our carbs, but it's SO hard finding low-carb snacks that give the same satisfaction as, say, a loaf of bread, or crunchy sweets, etc. The Grandpa Po line literally saves my a** because too often I \\"cheat\\" on stuff that drives up my blood glucose, and that is VERY bad. So, a handful of this stuff LITERALLY is a benefit to my health. Fellow diabetics, TAKE NOTE!

product_title: Orville Redenbacher's Gourmet Microwavable Popcorn, Movie Theater Butter Light, 3-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is the best tasting popcorn.  And BONUS!  It's light, too!  They stopped carrying it in the local grocery (I hope they're not discontinuing it!!).  Thank goodness for Amazon.

product_title: Jelly Belly Licorice Bridge Mix, Assorted Flavors, 5 Pound Bag
review_body: Previously, this was only available to me at Cracker Barrel stores; this meant I only purchased it when we went on a trip and stopped for breakfast or lunch. (There isn't a Cracker Barrel less than 100 miles away).     This mix is addictive. It's sweet and doesn't have an overly strong licorice taste. I like having some before I drink a cup of coffee--reminds me of sambuca.    Amazon's price is very good considering the price on Jelly Belly's site is $9/lb.

product_title: Strawberries & Cream Wax Plant - Hoya - Great House Plant - 4" Pot
review_body: I really like the plant this flower is suppose to be on.  What do I mean, well I have had this plant about a year and it still has not bloomed.  The plant is very pretty like I said and easy to care for and has grown well, just no flowers.

product_title: Pemmican Premium Cut Beef Jerky, Traditional Original, 3.65-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: The next best thing to home made
review_body: Although not quite as good as it was a year ago, this is still the best commercial beef jerkey out there.  Excellent flavor, texture and cut.  After this, I can't settle for any other store brand.  At under $4.15 per bag, it's a good deal.  I can't find it anywhere in California for under $6.50 a bag.

product_title: Tenkei - Japanese Pudding Marshmallow Candies with Creamy Pudding Filling- 2 Bags - 2x2.8 Oz
review_body: My daughter is a nut for Japanese things, and had to have these candies.  I tried them also.  They are exactly what they say - a puffy marshmallow with a puddinglike center.  The first one seems strange, but after that they are kind of addicting.  They have a very nice vanilla flavor, and chewy yet creamy texture.

product_title: Altoids Curiously Strong Mints, Liquorice, 1.76-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_body: While searching for a gift for a friend I accidentally stumbled across Licorice Altoids.  I'm in heaven!  The aroma of a closed box (plastic off) is incredibly soothing and calming.  It's not necessary to eat the Altoids...but I do.

product_title: - Honest Tea Citrus Green Energy Tea 16.9 Oz. Case of 24 Usda Certified Organic
review_body: I have long been a fan of Honest Tea drinks and especially like that they are based in Bethesda, Maryland, not far from where I live.  Citrus Energy Green Tea is a combination of green tea, lemon, orange, acerola, and yerba mate, and I was hooked from the first time I tried it.  Sadly, it's sometimes hard to find.  But it is my absolute favorite, and I try to keep a few bottles in my fridge.  If you like a tea drink without too much caffeine but with a lot of flavor, this is a good drink to try.

product_title: David's Sunflower Seeds Reduced Sodium 5.25 Oz (Pack of 12)
review_body: I recently found that I have hypertension thus need to reduce salt.  Unfortunately I also have an addiction to sunflower seeds.  Luckily I found these reduced salt seeds!  The only thing I could wish for is that they have even less salt.  As they are you can't tell the difference between these and fully salted seeds, which is a good thing.

product_title: Twinings Prince of Wales Tea
review_body: The orange and lemon peels make this tea very hippy.  Despite  the initial oohing and ahing over the pretty blue flowers, this is a regrettable purchase.  I was hoping for a stronger bergamot component than Twinings' Earl Grey but instead I got something that seems very herbal.  Blech.  I disagree with the positive reviews.

product_title: Barilla Plus Penna Pasta~2pk~14.5oz Boxes~
review_body: This is great pasta -- without regard to the \\"healthy\\" aspect. It's got great flavor and great texture. It's great with a sauce or just plain with olive oil and a little parmesan. I hope Amazon's price comes more in line with other sellers. I usually pay about $1.50 a box in stores.

product_title: SunGold Foods Sunbutter, Natural, 16-Ounce Container (Pack of 5)
review_body: I love this product. It is great in sandwiches and in recipes. The taste and consistency are very similar to peanut butter. My family who eats peanut butter all the time loves it. This is a safe alternative for people with nut allergies.

product_title: E & A Tea Company Variety Pack, 1.06-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: very good tea but one problem?
review_body: I gave my sister a box of this tea and she thought was great. I mean really great especially one particular flavor. Unfortunately I do not know which flavor she liked the best? LOL I also had a negative review on one of these flavors from a coffee drinker but I question his ability to appreciate fine tea. Therefore if you're looking for another Lipton stay away but if you're looking for a cut above in something with refined flavor it's worth a try. Just remember which flavor you like the best.

product_title: Marie Sharp's Fiery Habanero Sauce 5 oz.
review_headline: Not the hottest, but the tastiest!
review_body: After you use Marie Sharps hot sauce you can't go back to Tobasco sauce. This sauce is just as much about flavor as it is about being spicy hot. Sure, Marie Sharps has even hotter sauces, but a few dashes of this is fine for me!

product_title: Hawaiian Gold Kona Coffee Gourmet Blend -2 Lb Bag
review_body: If you are looking for a \\"Good Hot Cup of Coffee\\", this is the bean for you. It is dark roasted, full of flavor and the beans have a shimmer of oil I have never seen in any other Kona coffee! My store discontinued it and i now am ordering it because NO OTHER coffee compares to the flavor !! So, if you enjoy a \\"real\\" cup of coffee, drink up my friends and have a tasty wonderful day !!    http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B001VF09VS/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

product_title: Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Kona Blend, Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag
review_headline: Good Coffee, Not a Great Coffee
review_body: First, I have to confess that I expected this Kona blend to knock my socks off.  It didn't do that, or even come close to it, but it is a perfectly adequate coffee even if it is not what I would call a great coffee.  It is very mild, not bitter, and can be made in various strengths according to individual preference with no bitter after-taste.  I don't feel that I wasted my money but I am not sure I shall buy Jeremiah's Kona Blend again.

product_title: Amazin' Raisin Lemon Flavored Raisins, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: Five stars to the Amazin Raisin lemon flavored raisin.  A healthy, nutritious and tasty snack.  I definitely plan to keep a handy supply in my pantry.  PS - I like the orange and strawberry too.

product_title: Zola Brazilian Superfruits Acai Juice
review_body: Not only does this drink have very good nutrients and antioxidants, but most importantly, the flavor is natural and well mixed, not too over-powering of a blueberry flavor.  I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a flavorful, nutritious, acai drink.

product_title: Knorr Rice Sides
review_body: I wanted to keep some extra food in the house if I was short on cash and low on food.  Good thing.  These were actually really good.  Very flavorful and a really good deal.

product_title: Cool Brew® Fresh Coffee Concentrate - Original 1 Liter - Make Iced Coffee or Hot Coffee - Enough for over 32 drinks
review_body: I used to live on this stuff when I lived in New Orleans for college.  When I saw it on amazon, I was very excited and ordered it right away.   This cool brew coffee is less acidic than coffee so it is easier on your stomach.  It also has a smoother taste.  It tastes GREAT over ice with a splash of milk and some splenda.  Sometimes, I blend that concoction in the blender.  It tastes better than a frapachino...seriously.  I have no idea why they don't sell this everywhere.  It is a fantastic product.

product_title: ORGANIC MILLET - HEIRLOOM QUALITY 1 LB
review_body: First time I've tried millet. I should probably learn more how to cook it first. It is crunchy and tasty.

product_title: Spatini Spaghetti Sauce Mix 3 envelopes in Box Net wt. 2.4 oz
review_body: This product has been known in my family since 1962.  I do not understand WHY it has been so hard to get it as of late.  It gives spaghetti sauce that UMPH!!!!!  Come out, come out, where ever you are.  Is it being held for ranssome?  It is a great product, with all of the seasoning needed for the best spaghetti sauce.  People used to rave about my spaghetti sauce. Spatini was my secret ingredient.  Great Great Great is how I describe it.  L. Denise    Yes i am over 13. Today 8-8-2007 I my Birthday

product_title: Solo Filling, Raspberry, 12-Ounce Unit (Pack of 12)
review_body: This filling is great! In fact, I enjoy all the Solo fillings. A little pricey but worth it. Pulled out a package of Puff Pastry from the freezer and 1 can of this filling and had 8 BIG turnovers in no time! Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes and you are a hero. This product is very fruity tasting and I believe you will enjoy it as much as we do!

product_title: Mayonnaise, Safflower, 24 oz.
review_body:
If you're looking for a soy free choice for mayo the Hain Safflower mayonnaise is an EXCELLENT choice. It really tastes like you would expect it to. If you're looking for the sweeter taste of Miracle Whip, keep looking, this is definitely the saltier/tangier style of sandwich spread.

You may notice a slight bite or aftertaste to it if you just eat it straight, but on a sandwich or part of a salad, you won't notice it at all. I started using it even on my husband's sandwiches and he never noticed the switch.

product_title: Klein's Naturals Raisins, Organic, 12-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have had better organic raisins.  They are super duper sweet.  I had two other brands already opened when I bought thse.  These were far sweeter but less flave.  Some may prefer that.  Small and over sweet.  Still.  This is better than nonorganic.

product_title: Stevita Stevia Clear Liquid Extract, 1.35-Ounce Container  (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Stevita brand is the BEST stevia
review_body: I have tried a number of brands of stevia products, and this is by far and away the best tasting!  (Others all seem to have what I call a sort of \\"nutty\\" flavor that I don't care for.)  A nutritionist told a friend of mine it tasted the best and I have ordered it on-line ever since.  I have never seen it in any store, and I am SO happy Amazon is now carrying it!  (best price and easiest delivery)

product_title: Glass The Original Dirty Sue Premium Olive Juice, 12.69-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: Just as good as the olive juice from the olive jars...........and not quite as expensive!

product_title: All Purpose Gluten Free Flour, 1 lb.
review_body: Made cookies for my neighbor who cannot eat gluten.  She raved about them.  Great product.  Thank you.

product_title: Numi Tea Petite Bouquet - Assorted Flowering Teas, 4 Count Box
review_body: excellent product, great flavor, attractively packaged an excellent keeper as a collectors item and outstanding tea flavor.

product_title: Happy Baby Organic Puffs
review_body: My 11-month-old son loves these organic puffs. They've almost become a daily staple and they've been ultra useful whenever I need him to settle down when we're out in public. All I have to do is shake the container and I've got his attention. Powerful stuff! Lots of vitamins, with less sugar than the store brands. Apple and banana are both great.

product_title: LightFull Smoothie, Peaches & Cream, 11-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: I recently learned about this product and tried it, and I love all of the flavors.  When I am working, I always need a snack to keep me going.  Now with LightFull, I have a plan to snack on something good for me.  I eat lighter at lunch knowing that I have a good snack coming and one that will fill me up.  This product is perfect for my diet.

product_title: Big Acres Milagro Mole, 12.5-Ounce Bottle
review_headline: Not too bad for a bottled Mole
review_body: This bottled moles is not too bad, and better than most though the price is normal, the shipping cost is high.

product_title: Hershey's Cinnamon Chips
review_headline: Delicious-but where else can I buy them?
review_body: I discovered this treasure at a local grocery store several years ago. Since then I have created my own special chocolate cinnamon cookies that are to die for. Recently I have been unable to find them anywhere!! Even more recently I have moved overseas with my husband and can only find them here on Amazon. (...) It's cheaper for me to have relatives buy them and ship them to me than it is to order this bulk quantity and pay the high shipping costs.  But enough about my shopping dilemmas! These are delicious. You can eat them plain as mentioned before, or bake with them. Highly recommended!!

product_title: Bertolli Classico Pure Olive Oil
review_body:
It appears from all I have read that this olive oil and many others are not 100% olive oil but rather blended with hazelnut or some other oil... I have tried this brand although the taste is ok I am disappointed to learn that I am not truly getting all the benefits of olive olive because of how it is made...and not totally being 100% Extra virgina Vinci Code/ despite an urge to bail out at the end of every chapter, resisting a constant tendency to fall asleep, /The Bookman's Promise/ drew me on through, constantly absorbed, from the first page to the last. This is despite the fact that I have a passing interest in some of the ideas in Brown's book but none whatsoever in the setting of Dunning's. I have not the faintest glimmer of interest in the rare books business, but I nevertheless felt Dunning's (and Janeway's) love of this trade seeping out of the pages and through my skin.

I'm left with the inescapable feeling that Dunning loves both the human race and what he does; that's a wonderful combination, rarer and more precious even than a Burton first edition. Janeway ends the book disappointed in his fidelity to his own promise, but Dunning lives up to his for me.

product_title: Eclipse Midnight Cool Sugarfree Gum, 12-Piece Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: This is great gum, like a combo of the old Blackjack gum with a minty bite.  The other reviewer shouldn't have dissed this- he apparently bought it without knowing it was licorce based and doesn't like licorice.  Well he can send me his- I love it.

product_title: Odense Almond Paste, 7 Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I make and easy and very delicious almond cake and it always tasate better when I use Odense's almond paste. The flavor is richer. The recipe on the box is also good. Here is mine: In a mixer mix 1 stick of unsalted butter and the tube of almond paste, then mix in 3 eggs, scape down the side of the bowl, and mix in 3/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup flour, 1/3 tsp baking powder, and 1Tbs of Kirsh and tripple sec. Put this in a well buttered and at least the parchment lined bottom cake pan and bake for 40-50 minutes at 350. This is an elegant but easy cake to make, it is sticky in the pan so don't skimp with the greasing. You can dust the top with powder sugar or cocoa or make a simple granash (heated cream with chocolate)

Also this is the cheepest place to get the almond paste it is 2 to 3 dolars more out in the market.

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Pop's Corn Organic Microwave Popcorn
review_body: I really enjoy organic foods, so when I came upon this item I was thrilled they were making organic popcorn- especially Newman's Own, a brand I've liked in the past.  I have to agree with the other poster, the popcorn is bland and almost flavorless.  There are other brands of organic popcorn that I've found more recently that are far better.  Don't waste your money on such a vast amount of product!!!  I would suggest even making your own popcorn- it is still going to be healthier than this and you can flavor as you like so it will taste much better than this!

product_title: Green Cracked Olives (krinos) 1lb, Dr.Wt. 10oz
review_body: I ordered the Krinos Cracked Green Olives.  I enjoyed them a lot.  I did think the shipping was a little high and next time I order I'll order more than just a couple of jars to counter the high shipping.

product_title: Glutino Gluten Free Breakfast Bars, Blueberry, 5-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: It is so tough to find GF/dairy free food for 'on the go'.  These are good, and they hold together well.  My son really likes them.  He likes them for breakfast and as a snack when we are running around (he is 6).  It makes our lives easier to have these around.

product_title: Knorr Chicken Bouillon Cubes, 2.3-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: I love keeping these on hand because you will find plenty of ways to use them and they are easier to use than buying the canned or boxes because  you don't have to use it right away.  I use them for soups, sauces & many other recipes to give it flavor plus you save money because there is two bouillon cubes in each envelope and it lasts a lot longer than the ones you buy in a jar.

product_title: Enjoy Life Bars
review_body: I liked this bar, particularly because of its dairy, egg, and peanut free aspect. It tastes pretty good too, compared to some of the sandy or cardboard box tasting bars I have experienced, this one comes out in the forefront on flavor!  I highly recommend this bar if you have allergies to dairy and peanuts!

product_title: Half a Dozen Cans (6 Cans) of Coffee Du Monde - 15 oz. cans
review_body:
Ok, Starbucks is awesome too, but this coffee is an acquired taste and is without the doubt the most unique and great tasting coffee.

Since it has chicory, you do not mix as much as you would normal coffee. (To be precise, you would mix about half as you normally would).

However, even know it is robust, it still contains less caffeine then normal coffee. By the way, chicory is extremely healthy for you.

Try it today, taste what New Orleans has had for well over 140 + years.

product_title: Club Snack Sticks, Original, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: These are great tasting!  I like to keep them on hand for a quick snack when guests stop by.  Everyone who tries them comment on the great flavor.  I haven't used them for dipping, but I'm sure the light flavor would complement any dip.

product_title: Ahmad Tea - English Tea No.1 - 4 packages!
review_body: We received a gift basket with this tea in it for Christmas. When my wife tried it she couldn't get over how great it tasted. Being a tea drinker all of her adult life and fancying herself as knowing a good tea from a bad she just had to have a supply of this tea. We couldn't find a local store that carried it so we went to Amazon to order some. The company that we ended up with wasted no time in getting the tea to us without difficulty. Of course once you add in the shipping the price of the tea goes up, but that's a small price to pay in order to make my wife a happy woman.

product_title: Seasoning Mix, Southwest Taco, Organic, 1.13 oz.
review_body: Makes great tacos, burritos, chili, and just about anything else you want with a spicy, south of the border taste.

product_title: Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies Pumpkin Spice Cookie, 3-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: This was the first time I had this flavor of Breakfast Cookie and I really liked it.  It wasn't too rich like some of the other flavors.  I would recommend this product.

product_title: Leonidas Belgian Chocolates: Valentine's Day Ballotin
review_body:
I was looking for the best chocolate I could buy online and I FOUND it.
Without a doubt the most incredible chocolates you will ever eat. I received a box of Godiva for Christmas and purchased these for Valantines Day. Needless to say, I wont be looking for the Godiva box any longer! Give me the Leonidas Belgian ANY DAY!!!!! (Think I'll order some now)

product_title: T-Sac Tea Filters
review_body:
I have tried a number of different tea bag products like this, with mixed results. These T-Sacs are the best of breed. I use them so I can bring good tea to work without having to deal with a teapot and the disposing of used loose-leaf tea. I can quickly fill a number of these T-Sacs with good quality loose-leaf tea and the long flap that folds over to keep the tea from falling out, also works to fold over the mug so that I can easily remove the sac when it's done seeping.

Only one suggestion to the manufacturer, it would be nice if there was a mark of some kind to indicate where the opening was because when you take them out of the box, unless you squeeze them to reveal the opening it's not immediately apparent. Maybe I should wear my glasses when I do this? Anyway, it's not a showstopper.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: I now ordered and reordered Senseo Egberts Dark Roast Coffee Pods from Amazon.com 5 times.  It's great having free shipping, saving money over the retail price and not having to go out to the store.  Thanks Amazon.com

product_title: Bear Naked All-Natural Granola Snack Pack, Peak Protein, 2-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)
review_body:
I just purchased this flavor of the Bear Naked granola the other day and tasted it for the first time when I received it today. I like the fact that it does have more protein than the other varieties, but I think the flavor is a little bland. The addition of more dried cranberries would improve it quite a bit.

So the flavor/amount of cranberries could be a tweaked a little but overall I'm satisfied anyway.

product_title: Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Chocolate Covered Almonds w/o the Chocolate?
review_body:
Cocoa Roast Almonds? Dark chocolate flavor?

Well, I love nuts, and I also love chocolate. And these almonds DO have a chocolate flavor to them - no doubt about it. Of course the do NOT have that nice, soft, creamy chocolate covering that melts in your mouth... But then, the only reason you are even CONSIDERING these is because ... you are on a diet. (sigh).

Considering the diet restrictions, this product will give you the taste satisfaction of chocolate and nuts, but not all the satisfaction of sucking off the chocolate and then eating the nut. Sorry about that, but that's the way it is. But, you do get a very healthy snack, and if you are wanting something different, the strong hint of dark chocolate, you gotta try these!

product_title: U.S. Mills Skinner's Raisin Bran, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is, by far, the worst tasting cereal we've ever had.  The raisins are fine, it's the flakes that leave the most horrible taste in your mouth, sort of a cross between fake bacon bits and cardboard.  My entire family complained about these, even our 3 year old who will eat ANYTHING, pushed her bowl away after one bite.  We bought some other types of cereal from U.S. Mills and it wasn't very good either, but this was definitely the worst.

product_title: Red Raspberry Puree - 30 Ounces (1 container)
review_body: Excellent product.  I ordered the Key Lime.  Though it is extremely concentrated a little goes a long way.  Made a great Key Lime Pie.  Only complaint is the shipping.  The shipping is more than the product itself.  Probably won't order again.

product_title: Kitchens Of India Ready To Eat Dal Bukhara
review_body:
I normally love this dish. It's one of my faves at the local Indian restaurant I frequent. But this version of it, perhaps because of what's required to market something in a foil bag and ship it all over thither and yon, isn't very good.

It's thin, for one thing, and my first packet of it contained a whopping three chunks of cheese. Say what?! I love the cheese! Where's the cheese?! Added to the cheese shortage is the fact that the dish is a wee bit salty, and you've got a palak paneer that doesn't really light my fire. IF I combine it with a biryani from the same company, it's tolerable, but I normally like this dish with nothing more than a couple of slices of naan. Ah, well, live and learn.

product_title: Orville Redenbacher's Naturals Light Popcorn, Zesty Pepper Butter Popcorn, 4-Count Mini Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love this popcorn! The taste is great and it gives me the oppertunity to eat a health popcorn with flavor. But no matter how much I try I can only seem to get half the corn in the bag to pop.

review_body: Being disabled and not able to go to places like Costo's or Sam's club, this is great to get it delivered, and not have to pay the local supermarket price. My only problem was finding space to put them, but I did it. Great !!

As far as the price goes, $[...] is outrageous when Costco carries the chocolate variety at like $[...] (or less). Whole Foods has a great price, too, but the closest one to us is like 100 miles away.

review_body: Not quite as creamy as the regular mac & cheese, but this is a great product. Tastes good and is super easy and the perfect snack size.

review_headline: Pringles Chips arrived in small pieces
review_body: The chips arrived promptly, but the chips in all the containers were broken.  Some of the containers were so severly broken that they were just crumbs.

product_title: Lavazza Premium Drip Coffee, 100% Premium Arabica Ground Coffee, 10-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Should only be used with a coffee press
review_body: This is a great light roast coffee.  Like everyone else has said, you don't get acid gut when drinking this.    With that said...the grind is VERY coarse, and does not taste that great when made in a drip coffee maker.  I use this coffee in my french press. You need to let it steep a little longer than other coffees, but the result is the most amazing cup of coffee!

product_title: If You Care 100-Count No. 4 Cone Brown Coffee Filters
review_body:
I've always been very particular about my coffee and I'm sorry I didn't begin using these filters earlier. With your first cup, you'll immediately notice a delightful difference. Unlike the inexpensive bulk coffee filters I bought for years, these natural filters allow the coffee to drain a little faster. If your ear is tuned to your coffee maker, you'll notice a difference in the drip sound straight away. The faster drain means the water does not linger and thereby pick up unpleasant oil and acid. The verdict: Your coffee is served hotter and tastes far more mellow.

Two things to note. 1) If you're using a cheap coffee maker that gives your coffee a metallic taste, I'm not sure how these will make a difference. (I use a Cuisinart and I love it.) 2) A medium grind works best. If you use a fine grind, you might find a bit of it in the bottom of the pot. Still the same, the coffee tastes so much better, it's worth the extra clean up.

product_title: Glutino Chocolate Wafers, 4.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: If you've been missing kitkats these are your cookies!
review_body: First time I saw these cookies was at a whole foods store.  I ate the box immediately!  They are wonderful.  A great creamy chocolate blend with a crisp waffer cookie layer inside.  Closest to a kit kat bar that I have had in over 3 years!  If anyone is in need of a chocolate fix you should give these a try!

product_title: Ketchikan Gift Basket
review_body:

product_title: Bertolli Premium Pasta Sauce, Summer Crushed Tomato & Basil, 13.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: I was a Ragu fan for years, but I gotta tell you Bertoli is super good.  A very nice Italian taste.  The size is right for a couple or just one.  Yes, it doesn't have a way of sealing but I find that clothes pin does very nicely and is very cheapo.  Hope this helps.

product_title: Rapunzel Organic Vegan Vegetable Broth Powder, 4.41 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This broth has been a staple in my pantry for about five years now.  I use it in soups, stews, pilafs, casseroles, mashed potatoes, curries, sauces and more.  Because I use so much of it I was pleased to find that I could get it in quantity and also in powder form, which is easier to deal with than the cubes when using large quantities.  I am no longer a strict vegetarian but still eat like one for the most part, and while I can use this to fine effect in dishes containing meat, fish or poultry, it is nice to know that I can easily acommodate my vegan and vegetarian friends with few or no adjustments to my recipes by using this instead of non-veg broths as a seasoning staple.  Couldn't do without it!

product_title: Slim Jim Snack Sticks
review_body: Well, it's as advertised, tabasco flavored double sized slim jim.    It's just not as great as some of the other flavors like sweet/hot, nacho, and so on. It's not even really that hot. They captured 80% of the flavor of tabasco, and none of the heat.

product_title: Good Seasons Salad Dressing & Recipe Mix, 0.7-Ounce Packets (Pack of 24)
review_body: Although I enjoy all of the Good Seasons package salad dressings, the Mild Italian works the best for all types of salads and meals.  Plus I love making it up freash when I want to use it.  It is not a dressing that has been sitting on the store shelf for months and then months in the fridge trying to use it up.

product_title: Soynut Butter, Creamy, 16-Ounce Plastic Jars (Pack of 6)
review_body: I've had really good soy nut butter and not-so-great soy nut butter and to me this one falls squarely in the really good category.  You do have to stir it and if you want it to stay mixed up keep it in the 'fridge but this is a small price to pay for something so delicious.  Now if only I could find a way to eat only one serving each day...

product_title: Numi Tea Petite Bouquet - Assorted Flowering Teas, 4 Count Box
review_body: I was a little nervous ordering this, but i really love it.  The little pot makes just enough for one cup and so far i've tried 5 of the teas and liked them all.  its a great way to introduce yourself to the world of flowering teas.

product_title: BLACK TAFFY 5lbs
review_body: The taffy was shipped just as stated, when I purchased the product, on line. I plan on purchasing from this company again in the future.  They are a good company to deal with.

product_title: Good Sense Tubs, Cross 'N Country Mix, 20-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 4)
review_body: Really a great mix - there is some chocolate that makes it far tastier than most \\"trail mixes\\". Maybe not as healthy, but if you want good taste and fun eating - this is the ticket.

product_title: Gloria Jean's Coffees, K-Cup, Black Gold Extra Bold for Keurig Brewers, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body: I love really bold flavored coffees, and so far, I've found that this is one that I like to drink. Though just a little stronger would be great!

product_title: Organic Nectars Agave 100% Raw Premium Agave Syrup, 46-Ounce Jug
review_body:
I tend to limit my son's intake of sugar because it increases and intensifies his eczema flareups. I have used this to sweeten his cereal and in making KoolAid. He does enjoy the taste better than sugar.

It has a nice sweet taste but is not overpowering like all of the chemically produce sugar alternatives. The texture and color is very similar to store bought honey.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: I've been using a Windows XP laptop for a number of years and between the malware, the viruses, reinstalling XP, well lets just say I was beyond frustrated.  Then my Tuscan Milk showed up and I rushed to pour myself a tall, talk glass of that white wonder.  I set the glass on my desk and began to write this review when the phone rang.  There was no caller ID so I reached over to grab the phone and spilled my Tuscan Milk on the laptop!  The machine zapped and zinged and moaned and shut off.  Oh noooo Tuscan, what have you done to me!  I carefully wiped off the milk and powered the machine up.  Immediately I knew there were changes.  The BIOS screen was gone, replaced by a full, gray screen.  Then a picture of an apple showed.  Soon, a foreign login screen appeared and it had my user name.  I entered my password and glorious music played, followed by the most beautiful interface I had laid eyes on.  I clicked the postage stamp and my email was all there!  I clicked the icon of the world and a web browser opened.  I clicked the calendar icon and this thing called iCal appeared with all of my events!  Ever since, whatever Tuscan Milk did to my computer, its been like a revelation and working better than it ever had before.  Thank you Tuscan Milk!

product_title: Raw Revolution Organic Live Food Bars, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body: i don't know how you can mess up coconut and chocolate, but they did.  for the amount of fat and calories in these babies, they should taste a lot better.  if you're really looking for delicious raw food bars, i prefer 'larabars.'

product_title: Coffeecakes.com Traditional Cinnamon Walnut Coffee Cake
review_body: I have relied upon coffeecakes.com to deliver my gifts in a timely fashion.  When FedEx made a mistate, coffeecakes helped the elderly recipient get her cake.  The cakes are delicious and can be frozen which is great for those who live alone.  Good Stuff!

product_title: El Yucateco Chipotle Hot Sauce, 5 FL OZ.
review_body: The chipotle sauce is one my favorite chipotle sauces because of its emphasis on the smokey flavor. It's also sweet, which blends well with the smokiness. I am a fan of the chipotle chile, so I'm glad of their growth in popularity.

product_title: Namaste Foods, Gluten Free Sugar Free Muffin Mix, 14-Ounce Bags
review_body: This muffin mix makes the yummiest muffins (with mini chocolate chips), cobbler, and so many other things.  I've made cobbler with peaches and raspberries; with cherries; with apples; with blueberries...  Just spoon the mixture onto the cooked fruit.  Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes.  Namaste has a terrific cookbook.  Also tells how to make dumplings with the muffin mix.  THANK YOU, NAMASTE!!!  The yummiest products for those of us who are gluten-intolerant and have other allergies.

product_title: Glico Pocky Chocolate
review_body:
I have to admit, that Glico sometimes have made some exceptional snacks with their Pocky range, such as their Pocky Strawberry, which is a blast. With this milk chocolate version, I was not so impressed.

The idea is the same: pretzel stick dipped in chocolate. It is not as sweet as some, so those who do not like sugar-induced psychosis will appreciate these snacks.

Overall, the taste is ok, but I found myself rather quickly bored with them. Other varieties of Pocky were much more interesting. Having said that, they make a great reading snack, as they do not leave your fingers covered in garbage, and your pages stay clean.

Not a bad snack, but a little boring for me.

product_title: MarketSpice Cinnamon Orange Tea 16 oz(454 g)
review_body: If you like Orange-Spice Tea, you cannot find a better tea than Market Spice.  I am personally not typically a fan of orange-spice teas because I find them too bland. This is not the case with Market Spice Tea it is anything but bland.

product_title: Emerald Sea Salt & Pepper Cashew, 10oz Canister (Pack of 4)
review_body: We have picked up a number of Emerald nuts recently.  We liked [[ASIN:B0015ZQBUC Emerald Cocoa Roast Almonds, 11oz Canister (Pack of 4)]] and absolutely loved [[ASIN:B0015ZQBZ2 Emerald Marcona Almonds, 11.5oz Canister (Pack of 4)]], but we did not care for these at all. I have no problem with the quality of the product, but I do have a problem with the recipe.    In theory pepper and sea salt sounded like a great combination.  Salty with a slight peppery taste sounded great, but in reality, the pepper was overwhelming. Everyone in our family tried them and no one cared for them. The sea salt alone would have been good, and even a lighter coating of pepper would have been okay.    We love Emerald nuts in general, this one just wasn't a hit with our family.

product_title: A Taste of Thai Pad Thai for Two, 9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: The noodles are fine, but the sauce is weak with a slightly wierd flavor.  There are better options and customer service never responded to an email I sent them.  So, that probably means they know they make bad pad.

product_title: Haribo Chewy Candy, Pico-Balla, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: I wish all candy was this good
review_body: Pico-balla is a very subtle candy--and you will find yourself eating a large amount of it if you don't pay too much attention.  The different colors are each differently flavored, and you can eat this chewy treat slowly or quickly.  I like to bite off the outer layer first and then eat the inside, but my wife eats the inside part first.  Just a very different candy from what we are used to--it doesn't taste overly \\"sugary\\", won't feel like you are greasing your mouth with fructose, etc...give it a try.  I wish I had bought two boxes.  I wish Amazon offered the Balla-Balla, too.  I can't wait to try that sometime, but I would rather wait until I can get it at a good price.  Amazon's price is about 66% of the World Market price, and even less what online candy stores sell it for.  Take a chance on it.

product_title: Gevalia Cappuccino, T-Discs for Tassimo Hot Beverage System, 8 Espresso & 8 Milk Creamers (Pack of 2)
review_body: This is terrific.  A little place I use to buy my cuban coffee closed and I have not found a place to replace it.  Well I just bought a pack of the cappuccino and WOW.  It brings back wonderful memories of my Cuban coffee. And yes it even has the foaming milk.

product_title: Cherrybrook Kitchen Gluten Free , Sugar Cookie Mix, 13-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I just bought my second case!  I have found if I put the dough in the refrig. , I can roll them out , and make all the fun shapes my kids use to get with gluten. Best of all they kept asking , do these have gluten in them?

product_title: Kashi 7 Whole Grain Pilaf, Our Original, 8.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: The taste leaves something to be desired
review_body: After enjoying the Kashi frozen dinners that have pilaf in them, I was looking forward to trying this pilaf. Unfortunatly, the flavor is very bland and dry. I was very dissapointed. Perhaps next time I will try cooking it with some added ingredients to improve the flavor. Afterall, I have an entire box of 12 of these to experiment with. Any recipe ideas are welcome!

product_title: Hodgson Mills Steel Cut Oats 18 oz. (Pack of 6)
review_body: I really like these oats. I cook one cup (dry) of oats at a time, and store it in the refrigerator. It lasts me 4 or 5 days. It's great with maple syrup, honey, molasses and/or fruit. I am surprised by some of the hyperbole within the reviews of steel-cut oat products. Rolled oats and steel-cut oats are very similar, and both are delicious. Most reviewers are saying that the steel-cut oats have a better texture. Although I agree, they don't seem to appreciate the extent to which their oatmeal's texture is determined by the amounts of water (or milk) and time used to prepare it. The instructions printed on the packages of rolled oats (aka quick or instant oats) has the cook use far too much water and too little time during cooking, resulting in oatmeal with a thin or \\"slimy\\" consistency. By manipulating the amount of water and time used during preparation, you can get the oatmeal to have almost the exact same consistency as you would get from steel-cut oats. The texture will still be slightly different, perhaps inferior, but the difference is subtle. The taste of steel-cut oats is also similar, but slightly better. I cannot understand why so many people are raving about steel-cut oats while acting as if rolled oats are the most disgusting thing on the face of the planet. They are both very good. I think that most people would prefer steel-cut oats, however. If you like rolled oats, you will like steel-cut oats. If you don't like rolled-oats, you probably will not like steel-cut oats either.

In bold letters reads, \\"1 in 12 Scores! Instantly\\" On the inside of this particular cap reads \\"No one said working out was easy. Please try again.\\" Those I didn't win, this witty phrase gave me a smile. My rating: 4.752/5

2. The bottle is constructed from a two piece glass mold. It seems that there are tribal designs embossed into the glass in symmetrical curcular patterns. Exactly two lizards grace the bottle. The words, \\"Healthy Refreshment\\" marquee around the bottom of the bottle. Overall, a very high quality bottle. Weight: 87.234 grams unloaded. Score: 4.854/5

3. The label is a four color design with two lizards creating a Taoist yin yang symbol. Very artful. Very spiritual. Very Score: 5.000/5

4. Contents: The drink is good.

And there you have it. This is my review of Sobe Green Tea. For reference, this liquid does not appear to be flammable. Have a good evening.

product_title: Ouma Condensed Milk Rusks (2 Pack)
review_body:
As I am currently reading the wonderful series by Alexander McCall Smith (\\"The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency\\" series, which is set in Botswana), and its delightful heroine, Mma Precious Ramotswe, along with her assistant and various friends, is often found to drink a cup of red bush tea (Rooibos), along with an Ouma Rusk, I ordered the rusks not having the slightest idea of what they would be like, but rather out of curiosity.

To my delight, they are very, very good. They are not hard, but solid, and can be eaten just as they are or, as seems to be the custom in the books, dipped briefly in coffee or tea. It seems the dipping does enhance the flavor a smidge. I chose the condensed milk flavor because I thought this might be a favorite of Mma Ramotswe.

One reviewer of another flavor of Ouma Rusk noted that the shipping charges are excessive. Indeed they are -- $3.00 more than the entire cost of the product. Still, it is the least expensive way to obtain the rusks unless one orders directly from the South African Food Shop, but since they have a $20.00 minimum per order, if you don't order other products, it's not the best way to go.

I'm going to make Ouma Rusks a permanent item on my grocery list. They're wonderful dipped in Rooibos Tea, by the way. They seem to go together.

product_title: Economist
review_headline: Don't let the name fool you
review_body:
Despite the name, The Economist is not a magazine about economics. It offers a full range of coverage about politics, world affairs, business, books, arts, culture... and of course, finance and economics. As an American, I especially appreciate the Economist's outsider perspective on U.S. issues; it puts all the silly things that the American media focus on in a more balanced perspective. Of particular note, the weekly "Lexington" column offers perhaps the most insightful commentary on U.S. politics of any newspaper or magazine, and it does it with prose that is witty and direct.
Many people complain about the price, but let me tell you: it is worth every penny. I started a subscription on a lark several years ago and thought I would not renew it when it expired, but I became addicted. It is the only magazine I read. I eagerly await the mailman's arrival every Saturday afternoon, because I know he'll be bringing me the best and most comprehensive news and analysis magazine in this world.
One minor criticism: if you live in parts of the country that are away from postal hubs, you may not get your magazine on Saturday like you are supposed to. When I lived in Hawaii, it was always several days late -- and this was maddening. Even in the Washington DC area, I sometimes wouldn't get my copy until Monday. But ever since they started printing the U.S. edition of the magazine in California, it has gotten somewhat better.

I had never heard of these, and when I came across the product listing I thought these were going to be more like \\"around the house snacks\\" given the description and comments.

These are only really enjoyable to eat in the same way whey protein shakes or powerbars or other \\"good for you\\" meal replacement or snack-like food units are enjoyable: they stop the hunger with a minimum of fuss.

The balls are fairly dense.. prepare to \\"gnaw\\" on them. Taking a bite is a commitment. The texture with all the exterior seeds is coarse. The peanut butter flavor is, well, faint. Using the words \\"great tasting\\" in the marketing is stretching the truth a bit, IMHO. (I would not buy these for taste alone.)

On the plus side, they work. I was running out of the house without having had breakfast, so I threw two balls in my pocket and ate them in the first 10 minutes of driving. My hunger reacted the same way it would to any other 400-calorie breakfast -- it went away, and stayed away until lunch. There was no negative aftertaste or other unpleasantness, and it made me feel like I had eaten food rather than some sort of snacky candy thing.

I don't have a particular allergy related need for this product, although I like the fact that it doesn't use refined sugar. I'm not sure how much of this product I will order in the future, but I can foresee finishing this pack.

product_title: Kitchens of India  Curry Paste Variety Pack
review_body:
I LOVE Indian food, and I've struggled to re-create my favorite restaurant dishes at home. I love to cook, and it's not terribly difficult, but it always seems that the best dishes require dozens of ingredients, mostly spices, that have to be pre-blended in a specific order. So I had pretty much relegated myself to getting my Indian food fix with occasional visits to my favorite Indian restaurants.

Then I discovered the Kitchens of India products. Oh. My. Goodness. This stuff is incredible! Butter Chicken is one of my all-time favorite dishes, and my favorite Indian restaurant (Saffron in Seattle) does an amazing version of it. The Kitchens of India Curry Paste for Butter Chicken comes *very* close to the quality of that restaurant dish.

The ingredients in the paste are all-natural -- no preservatives, nothing with unpronounceable names. Just tomato paste and spices (mostly). You just add butter (natch), chicken, and water, and let it simmer for 20 minutes.

I've used chicken breasts cut into large pieces, and chicken thighs, too. I prefer the flavor of thighs (skinless/boneless), but they're both good. I usually serve it with Pulao -- Basmati rice spiced with cinnamon stick, cardamom pods, cumin seed, bay, cloves, sultanas, and slivered almonds. Yum!

Amazon's price is good, too, considering that you get 3 servings or so from each 3.5-oz package.

I can't wait to try more of the Kitchens of India products -- so far, I've had this one and the lamb curry, and both have been exceptional.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Whole Coffee, French Roast, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 4)
review_body:
A few years ago, I was teaching in the culinary program of a university here in Philadelphia. One of the things we did was incorporate tastings in most of the courses. As the students got more senior, they learned to run the tastings themselves. In the course of doing this, we got to taste a range of products through the eyes and palates of future chefs and kitchen managers.
All the tastings were blind so brand names were not a factor.
In two coffee tastings, each with over twenty tasters and using filter drip brewing, Eight O'clock French Roast came in second in a field of a dozen coffees. The coffee that beat it both times-LaColombe-costs just about twice as much.
This coffee is smoky and emphatic with a full body and a long-almost winey finish. A great bargain and widely available.

Lynn Hoffman, author of[[ASIN:1601640005 bang BANG: A Novel]] and[[ASIN:0131186361 New Short Course in Wine,The]]

product_title: Lavazza Crema e Aroma - Coffee Beans, 2.2-Pound Bag
review_headline: Full vs. Medium Roast Espresso Beans
review_body:
Espresso beans can be roasted in different ways. Lavazza and Illy represent the best of two different approaches to roasting beans for Italian espresso. Illy roasts their beans for a longer time, but at a lower temperature, than Lavazza. As a result of its higher roasting temperature the Lavazza is darker, and according to some people more robust, than Illy is.

At its best, when properly ground, tamped, and brewed, Lavazza espresso is a bit stronger tasting and also a little bit more bitter than Illy. The Lavazza espresso also has a very pure black color once brewed and when it is done properly it has a hint of licorice in the aftertaste. Personally, though, I prefer the Illy approach which is why I am giving this coffee four rather than five stars. But, even so, I certainly recognize the high quality of Lavazza. In my opinion Lavazza represents the very best of the widely available dark (as opposed to medium like Illy) Italian Espresso roasts.

product_title: Bob's Red Mill Organic Quinoa Grain
review_headline: The best brand of quinoa I've found
review_body:
The brand you buy matters more for quinoa than many other grains. Quinoa grows covered with a layer of bitter compounds called saponins. You want a brand that's been well-washed so you can cook it straight out of the bag. Beware! Most brands say that they're pre-washed. That doesn't mean that their quinoa won't require yet more washing before it'll taste good. Bob's Red Mill does a great job, with no bitter taste whatsoever, even when the quinoa is cooked like rice in a small amount of liquid.

Also, some brands do a really bad job separating the quinoa from the chaff. I've yet to find anything but quinoa grains in Bob's packages.

This usually isn't the cheapest brand of quinoa available. But, to me it's worth spending a little more to have quinoa I can just measure and cook, without having to rinse it more or pick out bits of detritus.

product_title: Dave's Insanity Gourmet Salsa, 12 oz
review_headline: Holy crow! This sh*t is HOT!! (which is a good thing)
review_body:
I bought a bottle of Dave's Insanity twelve years ago at a hot sauce store in Boulder, CO, back when Dave's was the hottest sauce made. One or two drops in a pot of soup made the whole thing damn near unbearable (yet my roommate managed to use half the bottle in around 2 months).

So when I saw the salsa, I thought I knew what I was getting into. I assumed that the salsa would be pretty ungodly hot but somehwat milder than the sauce, given that this contains OTHER ingredients like tomatoes and onions. Boy, was I wrong. This stuff is as hot as the Insanity sauce, even though it is \\"diluted\\" with salsa ingredients. Which is not necessarily a bad thing. The heat won't kill you, and it won't even cause any real damage. (It'll just feel that way.)

Don't expect to empty the jar at the same rate at which you scarf down that chipotle corn salsa or the green olive tomatillo tapanade, though. I eat a little bit of this everyday with tortilla chips and sour cream, sprinkle a tiny amount on a plateful of nachos, and spread an 1/8 teaspoonful on quesadillas, and have for the last three months. I think the salsa level has decreased by a few tablespoons in that time, and to me that seems like progress.

Good stuff, but only for committed chileheads (or, more accurately, for those chileheads who should be committed).
